messages.actionBoard.labels.buildImprovement: Build 1 major or play 1 minor improvement
messages.actionBoard.rules.bakeBread: Bake bread: turn grain from your supply (not from your fields) into food using a Fireplace, Cooking Hearth or other baking improvement.
messages.actionBoard.rules.cultivation: You can plow one field and then immediately sow grain or vegetables in all of your empty fields, including the one you just plowed.
messages.actionBoard.rules.farmRenovateFirst: You can only build fences if you renovate first.
messages.actionBoard.rules.farmRenovationOnce: You are not allowed to renovate twice in a single action.
messages.actionBoard.rules.fencingCost: You can build any number of fences, paying 1 wood for each new fence you build.
messages.actionBoard.rules.fencingPastures: You may fence a stable, or divide an existing pasture into several smaller ones by building fences on the fence spaces inside the pasture.
messages.actionBoard.rules.growthLaterRoom: Note: if you grow your family here and build a single room later, you will not be able to use "Wish for Children".
messages.actionBoard.rules.growthOccupancy: The new room is immediately occupied by the person who did not have a room of their own yet.
messages.actionBoard.rules.growthRequired: You may not skip the family growth only to play a minor improvement.
messages.actionBoard.rules.growthWithoutRoom: The number of rooms in your house does not matter for this effect.
messages.actionBoard.rules.growthWithRoom: You can only grow your family here if you currently have more rooms than people, regardless of whether those people are still at home or on action spaces.
messages.actionBoard.rules.houseRenovateFirst: You may only build a major improvement or play a minor improvement if you renovate first.
messages.actionBoard.rules.houseRenovationOnce: You are not allowed to renovate your house twice in a single action.
messages.actionBoard.rules.improvement: You can either build 1 major improvement or play 1 minor improvement.
messages.actionBoard.rules.sow: Sow: place 1 grain or vegetable from your supply onto an empty field, then add more from the supply (grain fields hold 3, vegetable fields hold 2).

messages.cardFaces.A001_Shelter.description: You can immediately build a <STABLE> at no cost, but only if you place it in a pasture covering exactly 1 farmyard space.
messages.cardFaces.A001_Shelter.name: Shelter
messages.cardFaces.A002_ShiftingCultivation.name: Shifting Cultivation
messages.cardFaces.A003_PaperKnife.description: Select 3 occupations in your hand. Select one of them randomly, which you can play immediately without paying an occupation cost.
messages.cardFaces.A003_PaperKnife.name: Paper Knife
messages.cardFaces.A004_Baseboards.description: You immediately get 1 <WOOD> for each room you have. If you have more rooms than people, you get 1 additional <WOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.A004_Baseboards.name: Baseboards
messages.cardFaces.A005_ClayEmbankment.descriptio: You immediately get 1 <CLAY> for every 2 <CLAY> you already have in your supply.
messages.cardFaces.A005_ClayEmbankment.name: Clay Embankment
messages.cardFaces.A006_StorageBarn.description: If you have the Well, Joinery, Pottery, and/or Basketmaker's Workshop, you immediately get 1 <STONE>, 1 <WOOD>, 1 <CLAY>, and/or 1 <REED>, respectively.
messages.cardFaces.A006_StorageBarn.name: Storage Barn
messages.cardFaces.A007_GardenersKnife.descriptio: You immediately get 1 <FOOD> for each <GRAIN> <FIELD> you have and 1 <GRAIN> for each <VEGETABLE> <FIELD> you have.
messages.cardFaces.A007_GardenersKnife.name: Gardener's Knife
messages.cardFaces.A008_FoodBasket.name: Food Basket
messages.cardFaces.A009_YoungAnimalMarket.descrip: You immediately get 1 <CATTLE>. (Effectively, you are exchanging 1 <SHEEP> for 1 <CATTLE>.)
messages.cardFaces.A009_YoungAnimalMarket.name: Young Animal Market
messages.cardFaces.A010_WoodenShed.description: This card can only be played via a __Major Improvement__ action. It provides room for one person. You may no longer renovate.
messages.cardFaces.A010_WoodenShed.name: Wooden Shed
messages.cardFaces.A011_MudPatch.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <PIG>. You can hold 1 <PIG> on each of your unplanted <FIELD> tiles.
messages.cardFaces.A011_MudPatch.name: Mud Patch
messages.cardFaces.A012_DrinkingTrough.descriptio: Each of your pastures (with or without a <STABLE>) can hold up to 2 more animals.
messages.cardFaces.A012_DrinkingTrough.name: Drinking Trough
messages.cardFaces.A013_RenovationCompany.descrip: When you play this card, you immediately get 3 <CLAY>. Immediately after, you can renovate without paying any building resources.
messages.cardFaces.A013_RenovationCompany.name: Renovation Company
messages.cardFaces.A013_RenovationCompany.prerequ: In Wooden House with Exactly 2 Rooms
messages.cardFaces.A014_CarpentersHammer.descript: Each time you build at least 2 wood/clay/stone rooms at once, you get a total discount of 2 <REED> as well as 2 <WOOD>/3 <CLAY>/4 <STONE>.
messages.cardFaces.A014_CarpentersHammer.name: Carpenter's Hammer
messages.cardFaces.A015_CarpentersAxe.description: Each time after you use a <WOOD> accumulation space, if you then have at least 7 <WOOD> in your supply, you can build exactly 1 <STABLE> for 1 <WOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.A015_CarpentersAxe.name: Carpenter's Axe
messages.cardFaces.A016_RammedClay.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <CLAY>. You can use <CLAY> instead of <WOOD> to build <FENCE>.
messages.cardFaces.A016_RammedClay.name: Rammed Clay
messages.cardFaces.A017_ReclamationPlow.descripti: After the next time you take animals from an accumulation space and accommodate all of them on your farm, you can plow 1 field.
messages.cardFaces.A017_ReclamationPlow.name: Reclamation Plow
messages.cardFaces.A018_WheelPlow.description: Once this game, when you use the __Farmland__ or __Cultivation__ action space with the first person you place in a round, you can plow 2 additional <FIELD>.
messages.cardFaces.A018_WheelPlow.name: Wheel Plow
messages.cardFaces.A019_Handplow.description: Add 5 to the current round and place 1 <FIELD> tile on the corresponding round space. At the start of that round, you can plow the <FIELD>.
messages.cardFaces.A019_Handplow.name: Handplow
messages.cardFaces.A020_DoubleTurnPlow.descriptio: When you play this card, you can immediately plow up to 2 <FIELD>.
messages.cardFaces.A020_DoubleTurnPlow.name: Double-Turn Plow
messages.cardFaces.A021_FamilyFriendHome.descript: Each time you take a __Build Rooms__ action while having more rooms than people already, you also get a __Family Growth__ action and 1 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.A021_FamilyFriendHome.name: Family Friendly Home
messages.cardFaces.A022_Telegram.description: Add 1 to the current round for each fence in your supply and mark the corresponding round space. In that round only, you can place a person from your supply.
messages.cardFaces.A022_Telegram.name: Telegram
messages.cardFaces.A023_StoneCompany.description: Immediately after each time you use a __Quarry__ accumulation space, you get a __Major or Minor Improvement__ action during which you must spend at least 1 <STONE>.
messages.cardFaces.A023_StoneCompany.name: Stone Company
messages.cardFaces.A024_ThreshingBoard.descriptio: Each time you use the __Farmland__ or __Cultivation__ action space, you get an additional __Bake Bread__ action.
messages.cardFaces.A024_ThreshingBoard.name: Threshing Board
messages.cardFaces.A025_Bassinet.description: You can place a(nother) person on the first non-accumulating action space used in each work phase, if there is only 1 person, including newborns, on that space. (There can never be two people on __Meeting Place__.)
messages.cardFaces.A025_Bassinet.name: Bassinet
messages.cardFaces.A026_SleepingCorner.descriptio: You can use any __Wish for Children__ action space even if it is occupied by one other player's person.
messages.cardFaces.A026_SleepingCorner.name: Sleeping Corner
messages.cardFaces.A027_OvenSite.description: When you play this card, you get 2 <WOOD> and you can immediately build the __Clay Oven__ or __Stone Oven__ major improvement. Either way, it only costs you 1 <CLAY> and 1 <STONE>.
messages.cardFaces.A027_OvenSite.name: Oven Site
messages.cardFaces.A028_ForestSchool.description: You can consider the __Lessons__ action spaces not occupied. You can replace each <FOOD> that an occupation costs with <WOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.A028_ForestSchool.name: Forest School
messages.cardFaces.A029_AleBenches.description: In the returning home phase of each round, you can pay exactly 1 <GRAIN> from your supply to get 1 bonus <SCORE>. If you do, each other player gets 1 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.A029_AleBenches.name: Ale-Benches
messages.cardFaces.A030_BakingSheet.description: Each time you take a __Bake Bread__ action, you can use this card to exchange exactly 1 <GRAIN> for 2 <FOOD> and 1 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.cardFaces.A030_BakingSheet.name: Baking Sheet
messages.cardFaces.A031_DebtSecurity.description: During scoring, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> for each major improvement you have, up to the number of your unused farmyard spaces.
messages.cardFaces.A031_DebtSecurity.name: Debt Security
messages.cardFaces.A032_Manger.description: During scoring, if your pastures cover at least 6/7/8/10 farmyard spaces, you get 1/2/3/4 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.cardFaces.A032_Manger.name: Manger
messages.cardFaces.A033_BigCountry.description: For each complete round left to play, you immediately get 1 bonus <SCORE> and 2 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.A033_BigCountry.name: Big Country
messages.cardFaces.A034_Loppers.description: Each time you build 1 or more <FENCE>, you can also use this card to exchange 1 <WOOD> and 1 <FENCE> in your supply for 2 <FOOD> and 1 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.cardFaces.A034_Loppers.name: Loppers
messages.cardFaces.A035_SwimmingClass.description: In the returning home phase of each round, if you return a person from the __Fishing__ accumulation space, you get 2 bonus <SCORE> for each newborn that you return home.
messages.cardFaces.A035_SwimmingClass.name: Swimming Class
messages.cardFaces.A036_FacadesCarving.descriptio: When you play this card, you can exchange any number of <FOOD> for 1 bonus <SCORE> each, up to the number of completed harvests.
messages.cardFaces.A036_FacadesCarving.name: Facades Carving
messages.cardFaces.A036_FacadesCarving.prerequisi: Wood in Your Supply >= Current Round
messages.cardFaces.A037_Bucksaw.description: Each time you renovate, you can also pay 1 <WOOD> to get 1 bonus <SCORE> and 1 <GRAIN>.
messages.cardFaces.A037_Bucksaw.name: Bucksaw
messages.cardFaces.A038_WoolBlankets.description: During scoring, if you live in a wooden/<CLAY>/stone house by then, you get 3/2/0 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.cardFaces.A038_WoolBlankets.name: Wool Blankets
messages.cardFaces.A039_Chapel.description: This is an action space for all. A player who uses it gets 3 bonus <SCORE>. If another player uses it, they must first pay you 1 <GRAIN>.
messages.cardFaces.A039_Chapel.name: Chapel
messages.cardFaces.A040_PottersYard.description: Immediately place 1 <CLAY> on each unused space in your farmyard. Each time you turn a space into a used space, you get the clay and you can immediately exchange it for 2 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.A040_PottersYard.name: Potter's Yard
messages.cardFaces.A041_VegetableSlicer.descripti: Each time you upgrade a Fireplace to a Cooking Hearth, you immediately get 2 <WOOD> and 1 <VEGETABLE> (not retroactively).
messages.cardFaces.A041_VegetableSlicer.name: Vegetable Slicer
messages.cardFaces.A042_ForestLakeHut.description: Each time you use the __Fishing__/__Forest__ accumulation space, you also get 1 <WOOD>/<FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.A042_ForestLakeHut.name: Forest Lake Hut
messages.cardFaces.A043_FarmyardManure.descriptio: Each time you build 1 or more <STABLE> in one turn, you place 1 <FOOD> on each of the next 3 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.A043_FarmyardManure.name: Farmyard Manure
messages.cardFaces.A044_PondHut.description: Place 1 <FOOD> on each of the next 3 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.A044_PondHut.name: Pond Hut
messages.cardFaces.A045_FireProtectionPond.descri: Once you no longer live in a wooden house, place 1 <FOOD> on each of the next 6 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.A045_FireProtectionPond.name: Fire Protection Pond
messages.cardFaces.A046_ClawKnife.description: Each time you use the __Sheep Market__ accumulation space, place 1 <FOOD> on each of the next 2 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.A046_ClawKnife.name: Claw Knife
messages.cardFaces.A047_Trellises.description: Immediately place 1 <FOOD> on each of the next round spaces, up to the number of <FENCE> you have built. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.A047_Trellises.name: Trellises
messages.cardFaces.A048_ShavingHorse.description: Each time after you obtain at least 1 <WOOD>, if you then have 5 or more <WOOD> in your supply, you can exchange 1 <WOOD> for 3 <FOOD>. With 7 or more <WOOD>, you must do so.
messages.cardFaces.A048_ShavingHorse.name: Shaving Horse
messages.cardFaces.A049_NestSite.description: Each time 1 <REED> is placed on a non-empty __Reed Bank__ accumulation space during the preparation phase, you get 1 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.A049_NestSite.name: Nest Site
messages.cardFaces.A050_MilkJug.description: Each time any player (including you) uses the __Cattle Market__ accumulation space, you get 3 <FOOD>, and each other player gets 1 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.A050_MilkJug.name: Milk Jug
messages.cardFaces.A051_DriftNetBoat.description: Each time you use the __Fishing__ accumulation space, you get an additional 2 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.A051_DriftNetBoat.name: Drift-Net Boat
messages.cardFaces.A052_ThrowingAxe.description: Each time you use a <WOOD> accumulation space while there is at least 1 <PIG> on the __Pig Market__ accumulation space, you also get 2 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.A052_ThrowingAxe.name: Throwing Axe
messages.cardFaces.A053_Claypipe.description: In the returning home phase of each round, if you gained at least 7 building resources in the preceding work phase, you get 2 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.A053_Claypipe.name: Claypipe
messages.cardFaces.A054_Credit.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 5 <FOOD>. At the end of each round that does not end with a harvest, you must pay 1 <FOOD>, or else take a <BEGGING> marker.
messages.cardFaces.A054_Credit.name: Credit
messages.cardFaces.A055_JunkRoom.description: Each time after you build an improvement, including this one, you get 1 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.A055_JunkRoom.name: Junk Room
messages.cardFaces.A056_Basket.description: Immediately after each time you use a <WOOD> accumulation space, you can exchange 2 <WOOD> for 3 <FOOD>. If you do, place those 2 <WOOD> on the accumulation space.
messages.cardFaces.A056_Basket.name: Basket
messages.cardFaces.A057_MilkingParlor.description: When you play this card, if you have at least 1/3/4 <SHEEP>, you immediately get 2/3/4 <FOOD>. The same applies if you have at least 1/2/3 <CATTLE>.
messages.cardFaces.A057_MilkingParlor.name: Milking Parlor
messages.cardFaces.A058_AsparagusKnife.descriptio: In the returning home phase of rounds 8, 10, and 12, you can take 1 <VEGETABLE> from exactly 1 vegetable field. You can immediately exchange it for 3 <FOOD> and 1 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.cardFaces.A058_AsparagusKnife.name: Asparagus Knife
messages.cardFaces.A059_PotatoRidger.description: Each time after you harvest 1+ <VEGETABLE>, if you then have 3+ <VEGETABLE> in your supply, you can turn exactly 1 <VEGETABLE> into 6 <FOOD>. With 4+ <VEGETABLE>, you must do so.
messages.cardFaces.A059_PotatoRidger.name: Potato Ridger
messages.cardFaces.A060_OrientalFireplace.name: Oriental Fireplace
messages.cardFaces.A061_WinnowingFan.description: After the field phase of each harvest, you can use a <BAKE>-improvement but only to turn exactly 1 <GRAIN> into <FOOD>. (This is not considered a __Bake Bread__ action.)
messages.cardFaces.A061_WinnowingFan.name: Winnowing Fan
messages.cardFaces.A062_BeerKeg.description: In the feeding phase of each harvest, you can use this card to exchange 1/2/3 <GRAIN> for 0/1/2 bonus <SCORE> and exactly 3 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.A062_BeerKeg.name: Beer Keg
messages.cardFaces.A063_DutchWindmill.description: Each time you take a __Bake Bread__ action in a round immediately following a harvest, you get 3 additional <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.A063_DutchWindmill.name: Dutch Windmill
messages.cardFaces.A064_BarleyMill.description: In the field phase of each harvest, you get 1 <FOOD> for each grain field that you harvest.
messages.cardFaces.A064_BarleyMill.name: Barley Mill
messages.cardFaces.A065_SeedPellets.description: Each time before you take an unconditional __Sow__ action, you get 1 <GRAIN>.
messages.cardFaces.A065_SeedPellets.name: Seed Pellets
messages.cardFaces.A066_FeedingDish.description: Each time you use an animal accumulation space while already having an animal of that type, you get 1 <GRAIN>.
messages.cardFaces.A066_FeedingDish.name: Feeding Dish
messages.cardFaces.A067_CornScoop.description: Each time you use the __Grain Seeds__ action space, you get 1 additional <GRAIN>.
messages.cardFaces.A067_CornScoop.name: Corn Scoop
messages.cardFaces.A068_AsparagusGift.description: Each time you build a number of <FENCE> equal to or greater than the current round, you immediately get 1 <VEGETABLE>.
messages.cardFaces.A068_AsparagusGift.name: Asparagus Gift
messages.cardFaces.A069_LargeGreenhouse.descripti: Add 4, 7, and 9 to the current round and place 1 <VEGETABLE> on each corresponding round space. At the start of these rounds, you get the <VEGETABLE>.
messages.cardFaces.A069_LargeGreenhouse.name: Large Greenhouse
messages.cardFaces.A070_LiftingMachine.descriptio: At the end of each round that does not end with a harvest, you can move 1 <VEGETABLE> from one of your fields to your supply. (This is not considered a field phase.)
messages.cardFaces.A070_LiftingMachine.name: Lifting Machine
messages.cardFaces.A071_ClearingSpade.description: At any time, you can move 1 crop from a planted field containing at least 2 crops to an empty field.
messages.cardFaces.A071_ClearingSpade.name: Clearing Spade
messages.cardFaces.A072_CalciumFertilizers.descri: Each time you use a __Quarry__ accumulation space, add 1 additional good of the respective type to each of your planted fields growing a single type of crop.
messages.cardFaces.A072_CalciumFertilizers.name: Calcium Fertilizers
messages.cardFaces.A073_AgriculturalFertilizers.d: Each time after you turn at least 2 unused spaces into used spaces in one action, you get an additional __Sow__ action.
messages.cardFaces.A074_StableTree.description: Each time you build 1 or more stables on your turn, place 1 <WOOD> on each of the next 3 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <WOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.A074_StableTree.name: Stable Tree
messages.cardFaces.A075_LumberMill.name: Lumber Mill
messages.cardFaces.A076_Cob.description: At the start of each work phase, if you have at least 1 <CLAY> in your supply, you can exchange exactly 1 <GRAIN> for 2 <CLAY> and 1 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.A076_Cob.name: Cob
messages.cardFaces.A077_Hod.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <CLAY>. Each time any player (including you) uses the __Pig Market__ accumulation space, you immediately get 2 <CLAY>.
messages.cardFaces.A077_Hod.name: Hod
messages.cardFaces.A078_Canoe.description: Each time you use the __Fishing__ accumulation space, you get an additional 1 <FOOD> and 1 <REED>.
messages.cardFaces.A078_Canoe.name: Canoe
messages.cardFaces.A079_GardenHoe.description: Each time you take an unconditional __Sow__ action planting <VEGETABLE> in at least 1 field, you get 1 <CLAY> and 1 <STONE>.
messages.cardFaces.A079_GardenHoe.name: Garden Hoe
messages.cardFaces.A080_StoneTongs.description: Each time you use a <STONE> accumulation space, you get 1 additional <STONE>.
messages.cardFaces.A080_StoneTongs.name: Stone Tongs
messages.cardFaces.A081_InterimStorage.descriptio: Each time you use a clay/reed/stone accumulation space, place 1 <WOOD>/<CLAY>/<REED> on this card. At the start of rounds 7, 11, and 14, move all the goods on this card to your supply.
messages.cardFaces.A081_InterimStorage.name: Interim Storage
messages.cardFaces.A082_WorkCertificate.descripti: Each time after you use an action space, you can take 1 building resource from a building resource accumulation space with at least 4 building resources on it.
messages.cardFaces.A082_WorkCertificate.name: Work Certificate
messages.cardFaces.A083_ShepherdsCrook.descriptio: Each time you fence a new pasture covering at least 4 farmyard spaces, you immediately get 2 sheep on this pasture.
messages.cardFaces.A083_ShepherdsCrook.name: Shepherd's Crook
messages.cardFaces.A084_Silage.description: In each returning home phase after which there is no harvest, you can pay exactly 1 <GRAIN> - even from a field - to breed exactly one type of animal.
messages.cardFaces.A084_Silage.name: Silage
messages.cardFaces.A085_Homekeeper.description: Exactly one clay or stone room in your house can hold an additional person if the room is adjacent to both a field and a pasture.
messages.cardFaces.A085_Homekeeper.name: Homekeeper
messages.cardFaces.A086_AnimalTamer.description: When you play this card, you immediately get your choice of 1 <WOOD> or 1 <GRAIN>. Instead of just 1 animal total, you can keep any 1 animal in each room of your house.
messages.cardFaces.A086_AnimalTamer.name: Animal Tamer
messages.cardFaces.A087_Conservator.description: You can renovate your wooden house directly to stone without renovating it to clay first.
messages.cardFaces.A087_Conservator.name: Conservator
messages.cardFaces.A088_HedgeKeeper.description: Each time you take a __Build Fences__ action, you do not have to pay <WOOD> for 3 of the fences you build.
messages.cardFaces.A088_HedgeKeeper.name: Hedge Keeper
messages.cardFaces.A089_StablePlanner.description: Add 3, 6, and 9 to the current round. You can place 1 stable on each corresponding round space. At the start of these rounds (not earlier), you can build the stable at no cost.
messages.cardFaces.A089_StablePlanner.name: Stable Planner
messages.cardFaces.A090_PlowDriver.description: Once you live in a stone house, at the start of each round, you can pay 1 <FOOD> to plow 1 <FIELD>.
messages.cardFaces.A090_PlowDriver.name: Plow Driver
messages.cardFaces.A091_ShiftingCultivator.descri: Each time you use a <WOOD> accumulation space, you can also pay 3 <FOOD> to plow 1 <FIELD>.
messages.cardFaces.A091_ShiftingCultivator.name: Shifting Cultivator
messages.cardFaces.A092_AdoptiveParents.descripti: For 1 <FOOD>, you can take an action with offspring in the same round you get it. If you do, the offspring does not count as "newborn".
messages.cardFaces.A092_AdoptiveParents.name: Adoptive Parents
messages.cardFaces.A093_BedMaker.description: Each time you add rooms to your house, you can also pay 1 <WOOD> and 1 <GRAIN> to immediately get a __Family Growth with Room Only__ action.
messages.cardFaces.A093_BedMaker.name: Bed Maker
messages.cardFaces.A094_LazySowman.description: Each time you decline an unconditional __Sow__ action on your turn, you can immediately place another person on an action space of your choice (even if it is occupied).
messages.cardFaces.A094_LazySowman.name: Lazy Sowman
messages.cardFaces.A094_LazySowman.rules: The additional person cannot be placed on __Meeting Place__.
messages.cardFaces.A095_Angler.description: Each time after you use the __Fishing__ Accumulation space while there are at most 2 <FOOD> on that space, you get a __Major or Minor Improvement__ action.
messages.cardFaces.A095_Angler.name: Angler
messages.cardFaces.A096_TaskArtisan.description: When you play this card and each time a <STONE> accumulation space appears on a round space in the preparation phase, you get 1 <WOOD> and a __Minor Improvement__ action.
messages.cardFaces.A096_TaskArtisan.name: Task Artisan
messages.cardFaces.A097_Freshman.description: Each time you get a __Bake Bread__ action, instead of taking the action, you can play an occupation without paying an occupation cost (at most once per turn).
messages.cardFaces.A097_Freshman.name: Freshman
messages.cardFaces.A098_StableArchitect.descripti: During scoring, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> for each unfenced <STABLE> in your farmyard.
messages.cardFaces.A098_StableArchitect.name: Stable Architect
messages.cardFaces.A099_FellowGrazer.description: During scoring, you get 2 bonus <SCORE> for each pasture you have covering at least 3 farmyard spaces.
messages.cardFaces.A099_FellowGrazer.name: Fellow Grazer
messages.cardFaces.A100_Curator.description: In the returning home phase of each round, if you return at least 3 people from accumulation spaces, you can buy 1 bonus <SCORE> for 1 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.A100_Curator.name: Curator
messages.cardFaces.A101_CookeryOutfitter.descript: During scoring, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> for each cooking improvement you have. (Ovens are not considered cooking improvements.)
messages.cardFaces.A101_CookeryOutfitter.name: Cookery Outfitter
messages.cardFaces.A102_Grocer.description: Pile the following goods on this card (<WOOD>, <GRAIN>, <REED>, <STONE>, <VEGETABLE>, <CLAY>, <REED>, <VEGETABLE>). At any time, you can buy the top good for 1 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.A102_Grocer.name: Grocer
messages.cardFaces.A103_Portmonger.description: Each time you take 1/2/3+ <FOOD> from a <FOOD> accumulation space, you also get 1 <VEGETABLE>/<GRAIN>/<REED>.
messages.cardFaces.A103_Portmonger.name: Portmonger
messages.cardFaces.A104_WoodHarvester.description: In the field phase of each harvest, you get 1 <WOOD>/1 <FOOD> for each <WOOD> accumulation space with exactly 2 <WOOD>/at least 3 <WOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.A104_WoodHarvester.name: Wood Harvester
messages.cardFaces.A105_BarrowPusher.description: For each new field tile you get, you also get 1 <CLAY> and 1 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.A105_BarrowPusher.name: Barrow Pusher
messages.cardFaces.A106_SlurrySpreader.descriptio: In the field phase of each harvest, each time you take the last <GRAIN>/<VEGETABLE> from a <FIELD>, you also get 2 <FOOD>/1 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.A106_SlurrySpreader.name: Slurry Spreader
messages.cardFaces.A107_Catcher.description: Each time you place your 1st/2nd/3rd person in a round on a building resource accumulation space with exactly 5/4/3 building resources, you get 1 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.A107_Catcher.name: Catcher
messages.cardFaces.A108_MushroomCollector.descrip: Immediately after each time you use a wood accumulation space, you can exchange 1 <WOOD> for 2 <FOOD>. If you do, place the <WOOD> on the accumulation space.
messages.cardFaces.A108_MushroomCollector.name: Mushroom Collector
messages.cardFaces.A109_SmallTrader.description: Each time you take a __Major or Minor Improvement__ action, if you play a card from your hand instead of taking a major improvement from the board, you also get 3 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.A109_SmallTrader.name: Small Trader
messages.cardFaces.A110_Roughcaster.description: Each time you build at least 1 clay room or renovate your house from clay to stone, you also get 3 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.A110_Roughcaster.name: Roughcaster
messages.cardFaces.A111_WallBuilder.description: Each time you build at least 1 room, you can place 1 <FOOD> on each of the next 4 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.A111_WallBuilder.name: Wall Builder
messages.cardFaces.A112_ScytheWorker.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <GRAIN>. In the field phase of each harvest, you can harvest 1 additional <GRAIN> from each of your grain fields.
messages.cardFaces.A112_ScytheWorker.name: Scythe Worker
messages.cardFaces.A113_HeresyTeacher.description: Each time you use a __Lessons__ action space, you get 1 <VEGETABLE> in each of your <FIELD> with at least 3 <GRAIN> and no <VEGETABLE>. Place the <VEGETABLE> below the <GRAIN>.
messages.cardFaces.A113_HeresyTeacher.name: Heresy Teacher
messages.cardFaces.A114_SeasonalWorker.descriptio: Each time you use the __Day Laborer__ action space, you get 1 additional <GRAIN>. From round 6 on, you can choose to get 1 <VEGETABLE> instead.
messages.cardFaces.A114_SeasonalWorker.name: Seasonal Worker
messages.cardFaces.A115_ChiefForester.description: Each time you use a <WOOD> accumulation space, you also get a __Sow__ action for exactly 1 <FIELD>.
messages.cardFaces.A115_ChiefForester.name: Chief Forester
messages.cardFaces.A116_WoodCutter.description: Each time you use a <WOOD> accumulation space, you get 1 additional <WOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.A116_WoodCutter.name: Wood Cutter
messages.cardFaces.A117_WoodCarrier.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <WOOD> for each improvement in front of you.
messages.cardFaces.A117_WoodCarrier.name: Wood Carrier
messages.cardFaces.A118_Treegardener.description: In the field phase of each harvest, you get 1 <WOOD> and you can buy up to 2 additional <WOOD> for 1 <FOOD> each.
messages.cardFaces.A118_Treegardener.name: Treegardener
messages.cardFaces.A119_FirewoodCollector.descrip: Each time you use the __Farmland__, __Grain Seeds__, __Grain Utilization__, or __Cultivation__ action space, at the end of that turn, you get 1 <WOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.A119_FirewoodCollector.name: Firewood Collector
messages.cardFaces.A120_ClayHutBuilder.descriptio: Once you no longer live in a wooden house, place 2 <CLAY> on each of the next 5 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <CLAY>.
messages.cardFaces.A120_ClayHutBuilder.name: Clay Hut Builder
messages.cardFaces.A121_ClayPuncher.description: When you play this card and each time after you use a __Lessons__ action space or the __Clay Pit__ accumulation space, you get 1 <CLAY>.
messages.cardFaces.A121_ClayPuncher.name: Clay Puncher
messages.cardFaces.A122_PanBaker.description: Each time you use the __Grain Utilization__ action space, you also get 2 <CLAY> and 1 <WOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.A122_PanBaker.name: Pan Baker
messages.cardFaces.A123_FrameBuilder.description: Each time you build a room/renovate, but only once per room/action, you can replace exactly 2 <CLAY> or 2 <STONE> with 1 <WOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.A123_FrameBuilder.name: Frame Builder
messages.cardFaces.A124_Knapper.description: Each time before you use an action space card on round spaces 5 to 7, you get 1 <STONE>.
messages.cardFaces.A124_Knapper.name: Knapper
messages.cardFaces.A125_Priest.description: When you play this card, if you live in a clay house with exactly 2 rooms, you immediately get 3 <CLAY>, 2 <REED> and 2 <STONE>.
messages.cardFaces.A125_Priest.name: Priest
messages.cardFaces.A126_MasterWorkman.description: Each time before you use an action space card on round spaces 1/2/3/4, you get 1 <WOOD>/<CLAY>/<REED>/<STONE>.
messages.cardFaces.A126_MasterWorkman.name: Master Workman
messages.cardFaces.A127_Lodger.description: This card provides room for one person, but only until the returning home phase of round 9. If, by then, there is no room elsewhere for that person, remove it from play.
messages.cardFaces.A127_Lodger.name: Lodger
messages.cardFaces.A128_RiparianBuilder.descripti: Each time another player uses the __Reed Bank__ accumulation space, you can build a room: if you build a <CLAY>/stone room, you get a discount of 1 <CLAY>/2 <STONE>.
messages.cardFaces.A128_RiparianBuilder.name: Riparian Builder
messages.cardFaces.A129_Swagman.description: Immediately after each time you use the __Farm Expansion__ or __Grain Seeds__ action space, you can use the respective other space with the same person (even if it is occupied).
messages.cardFaces.A129_Swagman.name: Swagman
messages.cardFaces.A130_MummysBoy.description: Once per round, when placing a person after your first two, you can place it on the action space with your 2nd person and use that space again, unless it is on the __Meeting Place__ action space.
messages.cardFaces.A130_MummysBoy.name: Mummy's Boy
messages.cardFaces.A131_CraftTeacher.description: Each time after you build the major improvement __Joinery__, __Pottery__, and __Basketmaker's Workshop__, you can play up to 2 occupations without paying an occupation cost.
messages.cardFaces.A131_CraftTeacher.name: Craft Teacher
messages.cardFaces.A132_Publican.description: Each time before another player takes an unconditional __Sow__ action, you can give them 1 <GRAIN> from your supply to get 1 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.cardFaces.A132_Publican.name: Publican
messages.cardFaces.A133_Braggart.description: During the scoring, you get 2/3/4/5/7/9 bonus <SCORE> for having at least 5/6/7/8/9/10 improvements in front of you.
messages.cardFaces.A133_Braggart.name: Braggart
messages.cardFaces.A134_FullFarmer.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <WOOD> and 1 <CLAY>. During scoring, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> for each pasture you have holding the maximum number of animals.
messages.cardFaces.A134_FullFarmer.name: Full Farmer
messages.cardFaces.A135_AnimalReeve.description: If there are still 1/3/6/9 complete rounds left to play, you immediately get 1/2/3/4 <WOOD>. During scoring, each player with 2/3/4+ animals of each type gets 1/3/5 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.cardFaces.A135_AnimalReeve.name: Animal Reeve
messages.cardFaces.A136_DrudgeryReeve.description: If there are still 1/3/6/9 complete rounds left to play, you immediately get 1/2/3/4 <WOOD>. During scoring, each player with 1+/2+/3+ building resources of each type gets 1/3/5 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.cardFaces.A136_DrudgeryReeve.name: Drudgery Reeve
messages.cardFaces.A137_RiverineShepherd.descript: Each time you use the __Sheep Market__ or __Reed Bank__ accumulation space, you can also take 1 good from the respective other accumulation space, if possible.
messages.cardFaces.A137_RiverineShepherd.name: Riverine Shepherd
messages.cardFaces.A138_Harpooner.description: Each time you use the __Fishing__ space you can also pay 1 <WOOD> to get 1 <FOOD> for each person you have, and 1 <REED>
messages.cardFaces.A138_Harpooner.name: Harpooner
messages.cardFaces.A139_HollowWarden.description: When you play this card, you immediately get a __Major Improvement__ action to build a Fireplace. Each time you use the __Hollow__ accumulation space, you also get 1 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.A139_HollowWarden.name: Hollow Warden
messages.cardFaces.A140_ShovelBearer.description: Each time you use the __Clay Pit__ or __Hollow__ accumulation space, you also get a number of <FOOD> equal to the amount of <CLAY> on the respective other accumulation space.
messages.cardFaces.A140_ShovelBearer.name: Shovel Bearer
messages.cardFaces.A141_TurnipFarmer.description: At the start of the returning home phase of each round, if both the __Day Laborer__ and __Grain Seeds__ action spaces are occupied, you get 1 <VEGETABLE>.
messages.cardFaces.A141_TurnipFarmer.name: Turnip Farmer
messages.cardFaces.A142_Cordmaker.description: Each time any player (including you) takes at least 2 <REED> from the __Reed Bank__ accumulation space, you can choose to take 1 <GRAIN> or buy 1 <VEGETABLE> for 2 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.A142_Cordmaker.name: Cordmaker
messages.cardFaces.A143_Stonecutter.description: Every improvement, room, and renovation costs you 1 <STONE> less.
messages.cardFaces.A143_Stonecutter.name: Stonecutter
messages.cardFaces.A144_Sequestrator.description: Place 3 <REED> and 4 <CLAY> on this card. The next player to have 3 pastures/5 field tiles gets the 3 <REED>/4 <CLAY> (not retroactively).
messages.cardFaces.A144_Sequestrator.name: Sequestrator
messages.cardFaces.A145_Ropemaker.description: At the end of each harvest, you get 1 <REED> from the general supply.
messages.cardFaces.A145_Ropemaker.name: Ropemaker
messages.cardFaces.A146_StorehouseSteward.descrip: Each time you take exactly 2/3/4/5 <FOOD> from a <FOOD> accumulation space, you also get 1 <STONE>/<REED>/<CLAY>/<WOOD>. (If you take 6 or more <FOOD>, you do not get a bonus good).
messages.cardFaces.A146_StorehouseSteward.name: Storehouse Steward
messages.cardFaces.A147_AnimalDealer.description: Each time you use the __Sheep Market__, __Pig Market__, or __Cattle Market__ accumulation space, you can buy 1 additional animal of the respective type for 1 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.A147_AnimalDealer.name: Animal Dealer
messages.cardFaces.A148_Woolgrower.description: This card can hold a number of <SHEEP> equal to the number of completed feeding phases.
messages.cardFaces.A148_Woolgrower.name: Woolgrower
messages.cardFaces.A149_HouseArtist.description: Each time you use the __Traveling Players__ accumulation space, you also get a __Build Rooms__ action. Each room you build during the action costs you 1 <REED> less.
messages.cardFaces.A149_HouseArtist.name: House Artist
messages.cardFaces.A150_Stagehand.description: Each time another player uses the __Traveling Players__ accumulation space, you can take your choice of a __Build Fences__, __Build Stables__, or __Build Rooms__ action.
messages.cardFaces.A150_Stagehand.name: Stagehand
messages.cardFaces.A151_Minstrel.description: At the start of each returning home phase, if only one action space card on round space 1 to 4 is unoccupied, you can use that action space.
messages.cardFaces.A151_Minstrel.name: Minstrel
messages.cardFaces.A152_NightSchoolStudent.descri: Each returning home phase in which no player returns a person from a __Lessons__ action space, you can play an occupation for an occupation cost of 1 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.A152_NightSchoolStudent.name: Night-School Student
messages.cardFaces.A153_PigOwner.description: The first time after you play this card that you have 5 <PIG> on your farm, you immediately get 3 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.cardFaces.A153_PigOwner.name: Pig Owner
messages.cardFaces.A154_Paymaster.description: Each time another player uses a <FOOD> accumulation space, you can give them 1 <GRAIN> from your supply to get 1 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.cardFaces.A154_Paymaster.name: Paymaster
messages.cardFaces.A155_Conjurer.description: Each time you use the __Traveling Players__ accumulation space, you get an additional 1 <WOOD> and 1 <GRAIN>.
messages.cardFaces.A155_Conjurer.name: Conjurer
messages.cardFaces.A156_Buyer.description: Each time another player uses a <REED>, <STONE>, <SHEEP>, or <PIG> accumulation space, you can pay them 1 <FOOD> to get 1 good of the respective type from the general supply.
messages.cardFaces.A156_Buyer.name: Buyer
messages.cardFaces.A157_Bohemian.description: At the start of each returning home phase, if at least one __Lessons__ action space is unoccupied, you get 1 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.A157_Bohemian.name: Bohemian
messages.cardFaces.A158_CulinaryArtist.descriptio: Each time another player uses the __Traveling Players__ accumulation space, you can exchange your choice of 1 <GRAIN>/<SHEEP>/<VEGETABLE> for 4/5/7 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.A158_CulinaryArtist.name: Culinary Artist
messages.cardFaces.A159_JoineroftheSea.descriptio: Each time another player uses the __Fishing__/__Reed Bank__ accumulation space, you can give them 1 <WOOD> to get 2 <FOOD>/3 <FOOD> from the general supply.
messages.cardFaces.A159_JoineroftheSea.name: Joiner of the Sea
messages.cardFaces.A160_Lutenist.description: Each time another player uses the __Traveling Players__ accumulation space, you get 1 <FOOD> and 1 <WOOD>. Immediately after, you can buy exactly 1 <VEGETABLE> for 2 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.A160_Lutenist.name: Lutenist
messages.cardFaces.A161_PatchCaretaker.descriptio: Each time you use an accumulation space while already having used another accumulation space for the same type of good that work phase, you also get 1 <VEGETABLE>.
messages.cardFaces.A161_PatchCaretaker.name: Patch Caretaker
messages.cardFaces.A162_ForestTallyman.descriptio: Each time both the __Forest__ and __Clay Pit__ accumulation spaces are occupied, you can use this card as an action space to get 2 <CLAY> and 3 <WOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.A162_ForestTallyman.name: Forest Tallyman
messages.cardFaces.A163_BuildingExpert.descriptio: Each time you use the __Resource Market__ action space with the 1st/2nd/3rd/4th/5th person you place, you also get 1 <WOOD>/<CLAY>/<REED>/<STONE>/<STONE>.
messages.cardFaces.A163_BuildingExpert.name: Building Expert
messages.cardFaces.A164_WoodWorker.description: Each time you take <WOOD> from an accumulation space, you can exchange 1 <WOOD> for 1 <SHEEP>. Place the <WOOD> on the accumulation space.
messages.cardFaces.A164_WoodWorker.name: Wood Worker
messages.cardFaces.A165_PigBreeder.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <PIG>. Your <PIG> breed at the end of round 12 (if there is room for the new <PIG>).
messages.cardFaces.A165_PigBreeder.name: Pig Breeder
messages.cardFaces.A166_Haydryer.description: Immediately before each harvest, you can buy 1 <CATTLE> for 4 <FOOD> minus 1 <FOOD> for each pasture you have. (The minimum cost is 0).
messages.cardFaces.A166_Haydryer.name: Haydryer
messages.cardFaces.A167_BreederBuyer.description: Each time you build at least 1 <WOOD>/<CLAY>/stone room and at least 1 <STABLE> on the same turn, you also get 1 <SHEEP>/<PIG>/<CATTLE>.
messages.cardFaces.A167_BreederBuyer.name: Breeder Buyer
messages.cardFaces.A168_AnimalTeacher.description: Immediately after each time you use a __Lessons__ action space, you can also buy 1 <SHEEP>/<PIG>/<CATTLE> for 0/1/2 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.A168_AnimalTeacher.name: Animal Teacher
messages.cardFaces.A169_OffSiter.description: Once the total printed building cost of all the major improvements you have is at least 9 building resources, this card provides room for 1 person for the rest of the game.
messages.cardFaces.A169_OffSiter.name: Off-Siter
messages.cardFaces.A170_Hayward.description: You can build <FENCE> at any time without placing a person. (This is not considered a __Build Fences__ action.)
messages.cardFaces.A170_Hayward.name: Hayward
messages.cardFaces.A171_Sidekick.description: Immediately after each time you place a person on an action space card, you can pay 1 <FOOD> to place another person on the card immediately left to it (and so on).
messages.cardFaces.A171_Sidekick.name: Sidekick
messages.cardFaces.A172_BoatPainter.description: At the end of each work phase, if both the __Fishing__ and __Traveling Players__ accumulation spaces are occupied, you get your choice of 1 <GRAIN> or 2 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.A172_BoatPainter.name: Boat Painter
messages.cardFaces.A173_ClayThief.description: Once this game, at the start of a work phase of your choice, you can turn this card face down to get all of the <CLAY> on the "Hollow" action space.
messages.cardFaces.A173_ClayThief.name: Clay Thief
messages.cardFaces.A174_MasterHora.description: Immediately before each time you place a person on an action space with the (meeple) symbol on the game board extension, you can buy 1 <VEGETABLE> for 1 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.A174_MasterHora.name: Master Hora
messages.cardFaces.A175_HollowGardener.descriptio: Each time you take at least 3 <CLAY> from the "Hollow" accumulation space, you also get 1 <GRAIN>. If you take at least 6 <CLAY> from it, you also get 1 <VEGETABLE> (instead of <GRAIN>).
messages.cardFaces.A175_HollowGardener.name: Hollow Gardener
messages.cardFaces.A176_Wheelmaker.description: When you play this card, if you have another occupation in play and more <WOOD> than all other players combined, you immediately get <WOOD> from the general supply until you have 15 <WOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.A176_Wheelmaker.name: Wheelmaker
messages.cardFaces.A177_Middleman.description: Place 1 <STONE> and 1 <FOOD> on all action spaces with the (meeple) symbol on the game board extension. Next time you place a person on them, you get the goods.
messages.cardFaces.A177_Middleman.name: Middleman
messages.cardFaces.A178_CarpentersBoy.description: Each time another player builds a room, you immediately get 1 <WOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.A178_CarpentersBoy.name: Carpenter's Boy
messages.cardFaces.A179_MountainShepherd.descript: Each time you use either __Quarry__ accumulation space, you immediately get an additional 1 <SHEEP> from the general supply.
messages.cardFaces.A179_MountainShepherd.name: Mountain Shepherd
messages.cardFaces.A180_AnimalBrander.description: Each time you use the __Animal Market__ action space, you can pay 1 <FOOD> to use the same option twice (instead of once).
messages.cardFaces.A180_AnimalBrander.name: Animal Brander
messages.cardFaces.B001_UpscaleLifestyle.descript: You immediately get 5 <CLAY> and a __Renovation__ action. If you take the action, you must pay the renovation cost.
messages.cardFaces.B001_UpscaleLifestyle.name: Upscale Lifestyle
messages.cardFaces.B002_MiniPasture.description: Immediately fence a farmyard space, without paying <WOOD> for the fences. (If you already have pastures, the new one must be adjacent to an existing one.)
messages.cardFaces.B002_MiniPasture.name: Mini Pasture
messages.cardFaces.B003_Moonshine.description: Randomly select an occupation in your hand. Either play it for an occupation cost of 2 <FOOD>, or give it to the next player.
messages.cardFaces.B003_Moonshine.name: Moonshine
messages.cardFaces.B004_WoodPile.description: You immediately get a number of <WOOD> equal to the number of people you have on accumulation spaces.
messages.cardFaces.B004_WoodPile.name: Wood Pile
messages.cardFaces.B005_StoreofExperience.descrip: If you have 0-4/5/6/7 occupations left in hand, you immediately get 1 <STONE>/<REED>/<CLAY>/<WOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.B005_StoreofExperience.name: Store of Experience
messages.cardFaces.B006_ExcursiontotheQuarry.desc: You immediately get a number of <STONE> equal to the number of people you have.
messages.cardFaces.B006_ExcursiontotheQuarry.name: Excursion to the Quarry
messages.cardFaces.B007_Wage.description: You immediately get 2 <FOOD> and 1 additional <FOOD> for each major improvement you have from the bottom row of the supply board.
messages.cardFaces.B007_Wage.name: Wage
messages.cardFaces.B008_MarketStall.description: You immediately get 1 <VEGETABLE>. (Effectively, you are exchanging 1 <GRAIN> for 1 <VEGETABLE>).
messages.cardFaces.B008_MarketStall.name: Market Stall
messages.cardFaces.B009_BeatingRod.description: You can immediately choose to either get 1 <REED> or exchange 1 <REED> for 1 <CATTLE>.
messages.cardFaces.B009_BeatingRod.name: Beating Rod
messages.cardFaces.B010_Caravan.description: This card provides room for 1 person.
messages.cardFaces.B010_Caravan.name: Caravan
messages.cardFaces.B011_Feedyard.description: This card can hold 1 animal for each pasture you have, even different types. After the breeding phase of each harvest, you get 1 <FOOD> for each unused spot on this card.
messages.cardFaces.B011_Feedyard.name: Feedyard
messages.cardFaces.B012_Stockyard.description: This card can hold up to 3 animals of the same type. (It is not considered a pasture).
messages.cardFaces.B012_Stockyard.name: Stockyard
messages.cardFaces.B013_CarpentersParlor.descript: Wooden rooms only cost you 2 <WOOD> and 2 <REED> each.
messages.cardFaces.B013_CarpentersParlor.name: Carpenter's Parlor
messages.cardFaces.B014_Hawktower.description: Place a stone room on round space 12. If you live in a stone house at the start of the round, you can build the stone room at no cost. Otherwise, discard the stone room.
messages.cardFaces.B014_Hawktower.name: Hawktower
messages.cardFaces.B015_CarpentersBench.descripti: Immediately after each time you use a wood accumulation space, you can use the taken wood (and only that) to build exactly 1 pasture. If you do, one of the fences is free.
messages.cardFaces.B015_CarpentersBench.name: Carpenter's Bench
messages.cardFaces.B016_MiningHammer.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <FOOD>. Each time you renovate, you can also build a <STABLE> without paying <WOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.B016_MiningHammer.name: Mining Hammer
messages.cardFaces.B017_ForestPlow.description: Each time after you use a <WOOD> accumulation space, you can pay 2 <WOOD> to plow 1 <FIELD>. Place the paid <WOOD> on the accumulation space (for the next visitor).
messages.cardFaces.B017_ForestPlow.name: Forest Plow
messages.cardFaces.B018_GrasslandHarrow.descripti: Add 1 to the current round for each building resource in your supply and place 1 <FIELD> on the corresponding round space. At the start of the round, you can plow the <FIELD>.
messages.cardFaces.B018_GrasslandHarrow.name: Grassland Harrow
messages.cardFaces.B019_MoldboardPlow.description: Place 2 field tiles on this card. Twice this game, when you use the __Farmland__ action space, you can also plow 1 field from this card.
messages.cardFaces.B019_MoldboardPlow.name: Moldboard Plow
messages.cardFaces.B020_ChainFloat.description: Add 7, 8, and 9 to the current round and place 1 <FIELD> on each corresponding round space. At the start of these rounds, you can plow the <FIELD>.
messages.cardFaces.B020_ChainFloat.name: Chain Float
messages.cardFaces.B021_HayloftBarn.description: Place 4 <FOOD> on this card. Each time you obtain at least 1 <GRAIN>, you also get 1 <FOOD> from this card. Once it is empty, you get a __Family Growth Even without Room__ action.
messages.cardFaces.B021_HayloftBarn.name: Hayloft Barn
messages.cardFaces.B022_WalkingBoots.description: You immediately get 2 <FOOD>. You must immediately place a person from your supply. If you do, in the next returning home phase, you must remove that person from play.
messages.cardFaces.B022_WalkingBoots.name: Walking Boots
messages.cardFaces.B023_FinalScenario.description: Reveal the action space card for round 14. Only you can use it until round 14 starts.
messages.cardFaces.B023_FinalScenario.name: Final Scenario
messages.cardFaces.B024_Lasso.description: You can place exactly two people immediately after one another if at least one of them uses the __Sheep Market__, __Pig Market__, or __Cattle Market__ accumulation space.
messages.cardFaces.B024_Lasso.name: Lasso
messages.cardFaces.B025_BreadPaddle.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <FOOD>. For each occupation you play, you get an additional __Bake Bread__ action.
messages.cardFaces.B025_BreadPaddle.name: Bread Paddle
messages.cardFaces.B026_AgrarianFences.descriptio: Each time you use the __Grain Utilization__ action space, you can take a __Build Fences__ action instead of one of the two actions provide by the action space.
messages.cardFaces.B026_AgrarianFences.name: Agrarian Fences
messages.cardFaces.B027_Toolbox.description: In the work phase, after each turn in which you build at least 1 room, <STABLE>, or <FENCE>, you can build the __Joinery__, __Pottery__, or __Basketmaker's Workshop__ major improvement.
messages.cardFaces.B027_Toolbox.name: Toolbox
messages.cardFaces.B028_ForestryStudies.descripti: Each time after you use the __Forest__ accumulation space, you can return 2 <WOOD> to that space to play 1 occupation without paying an occupation costs.
messages.cardFaces.B028_ForestryStudies.name: Forestry Studies
messages.cardFaces.B029_CookeryLesson.description: Each time you use a __Lessons__ action space and a cooking improvement on the same turn, you get 1 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.cardFaces.B029_CookeryLesson.name: Cookery Lesson
messages.cardFaces.B030_WoodPalisades.description: Instead of a <FENCE> piece, you can place 2 <WOOD> from your supply on the <FENCE> spaces at the edge of your farmyard. These <FENCE> spaces with 2 <WOOD> are each worth 1 <SCORE>.
messages.cardFaces.B030_WoodPalisades.name: Wood Palisades
messages.cardFaces.B031_PotteryYard.description: During the scoring, if there are at least 2 orthogonally adjacent unused spaces in your farm, you get 2 bonus <SCORE>. (You still get the negative points for those unused spaces.
messages.cardFaces.B031_PotteryYard.name: Pottery Yard
messages.cardFaces.B032_Kettle.description: At any time, you can exchange 1/3/5 <GRAIN> for 3/4/5 <FOOD> and 0/1/2 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.cardFaces.B032_Kettle.name: Kettle
messages.cardFaces.B033_Mantlepiece.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 bonus <SCORE> for each complete round left to play. You may no longer renovate your house.
messages.cardFaces.B033_Mantlepiece.name: Mantlepiece
messages.cardFaces.B034_SpecialFood.description: The next time you take animals from an accumulation space and accommodate all of them on your farm, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> for each of these animals.
messages.cardFaces.B034_SpecialFood.name: Special Food
messages.cardFaces.B035_HookKnife.description: Once this game, when you have 9/8/7/6/5/5 <SHEEP> on your farm in a 1-/2-/3-/4-/5-/6- player game, you immediately get 2 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.cardFaces.B035_HookKnife.name: Hook Knife
messages.cardFaces.B036_Bottles.description: For each person you have, you must pay an additional 1 <CLAY> and 1 <FOOD> to play this card.
messages.cardFaces.B036_Bottles.name: Bottles
messages.cardFaces.B037_Grange.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.B037_Grange.name: Grange
messages.cardFaces.B037_Grange.prerequisite: 6 Field Tiles and All Animal Types
messages.cardFaces.B038_FutureBuildingSite.descri: Up until all other farmyard spaces are used, you cannot use the unused spaces that are orthogonally adjacent to your house (not even to build rooms).
messages.cardFaces.B038_FutureBuildingSite.name: Future Building Site
messages.cardFaces.B039_Loom.description: In the field phase of each harvest, if you have at least 1/4/7 <SHEEP>, you get 1/2/3 <FOOD>. During scoring, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> for every 3 <SHEEP>.
messages.cardFaces.B039_Loom.name: Loom
messages.cardFaces.B040_BreweryPond.description: Each time you use the __Fishing__ or __Reed Bank__ accumulation space, you also get 1 <GRAIN> and 1 <WOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.B040_BreweryPond.name: Brewery Pond
messages.cardFaces.B041_Hauberg.description: Alternate placing 2 <WOOD> and 1 <PIG> on the next 4 round spaces. You decide what to start with. At the start of these rounds, you get the goods.
messages.cardFaces.B041_Hauberg.name: Hauberg
messages.cardFaces.B042_ForestInn.description: This is an action space for all. A player who uses it can exchange 5/7/9 <WOOD> for 8 <WOOD> and 2/4/7 <FOOD>. When another player uses it, they must first pay you 1 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.B042_ForestInn.name: Forest Inn
messages.cardFaces.B043_Chophouse.description: Each time you use the __Grain/Vegetable Seeds__ action space, place 1 <FOOD> on each of the next 3/2 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.B043_Chophouse.name: Chophouse
messages.cardFaces.B044_ChickStable.description: Add 3 and 4 to the current round and place 2 <FOOD> on each corresponding round space. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.B044_ChickStable.name: Chick Stable
messages.cardFaces.B045_StrawberryPatch.descripti: Place 1 <FOOD> on each of the next 3 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.B045_StrawberryPatch.name: Strawberry Patch
messages.cardFaces.B046_ClubHouse.description: Place 1 <FOOD> on each of the next 4 round spaces and 1 <STONE> on the round space after that. At the start of these rounds, you get the respective good.
messages.cardFaces.B046_ClubHouse.name: Club House
messages.cardFaces.B047_HerringPot.description: Each time you use the __Fishing__ accumulation space, place 1 <FOOD> on each of the next 3 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.B047_HerringPot.name: Herring Pot
messages.cardFaces.B048_ForestStone.description: Place 2 <FOOD> on this card. Each time you use a wood accumulation space, move 1 of these <FOOD> to your supply. Each time you use a stone accumulation space, add 2 <FOOD> to this card.
messages.cardFaces.B048_ForestStone.name: Forest Stone
messages.cardFaces.B049_Scales.description: Each time after you place an improvement or occupation in front of you, if you then have the same number of improvements and occupations in play, you get 2 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.B049_Scales.name: Scales
messages.cardFaces.B050_ButterChurn.description: In the field phase of each harvest, you get 1 <FOOD> for every 3 <SHEEP> and 1 <FOOD> for every 2 <CATTLE> you have.
messages.cardFaces.B050_ButterChurn.name: Butter Churn
messages.cardFaces.B051_DiggingSpade.description: Each time you use a <CLAY> accumulation space, you also get a number of <FOOD> equal to the number of <PIG> in your farmyard.
messages.cardFaces.B051_DiggingSpade.name: Digging Spade
messages.cardFaces.B052_GrowingFarm.description: You can only play this card if you have at least as many pasture spaces as the number of completed rounds. If you do, you get a number of <FOOD> equal to the current round.
messages.cardFaces.B052_GrowingFarm.name: Growing Farm
messages.cardFaces.B053_SculptureCourse.descripti: At the end of each round that does not end with a harvest, you can use this card to exchange your choice of 1 <WOOD> for 2 <FOOD>, or 1 <STONE> for 4 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.B053_SculptureCourse.name: Sculpture Course
messages.cardFaces.B054_Tumbrel.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 2 <FOOD>. Each time after you take an unconditional __Sow__ action, you get 1 <FOOD> for each <STABLE> you have.
messages.cardFaces.B054_Tumbrel.name: Tumbrel
messages.cardFaces.B055_MaintenancePremium.descri: Place 3 <FOOD> on this card. Each time you use a wood accumulation space, you get 1 <FOOD> from this card. Each time you renovate restock this card to 3 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.B055_MaintenancePremium.name: Maintenance Premium
messages.cardFaces.B056_Brook.description: Each time you use one of the four action spaces above the __Fishing__ accumulation space, you get 1 additional <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.B056_Brook.name: Brook
messages.cardFaces.B057_Scullery.description: At the start of each round, if you live in a wooden house, you get 1 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.B057_Scullery.name: Scullery
messages.cardFaces.B058_CrackWeeder.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <FOOD>. For each <VEGETABLE> you take from a <FIELD> in the field phase of a harvest, you also get 1 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.B058_CrackWeeder.name: Crack Weeder
messages.cardFaces.B059_FoodChest.description: If you play this card on the __Major Improvement__ action space, you immediately get 4 <FOOD>. Otherwise, you get only 2 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.B059_FoodChest.name: Food Chest
messages.cardFaces.B060_BrewingWater.description: Each time you use the __Fishing__ accumulation space, you can pay 1 <GRAIN> to place 1 <FOOD> on each of the next 6 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.B060_BrewingWater.name: Brewing Water
messages.cardFaces.B061_ThreeFieldRotation.descri: At the start of the field phase of each harvest, if you have at least 1 <GRAIN> <FIELD>, 1 <VEGETABLE> <FIELD>, and 1 empty <FIELD>, you get 3 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.B061_ThreeFieldRotation.name: Three-Field Rotation
messages.cardFaces.B062_Pitchfork.description: Each time you use the __Grain Seeds__ action space, if the __Farmland__ action space is occupied you also get 3 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.B062_Pitchfork.name: Pitchfork
messages.cardFaces.B063_Tasting.description: Each time you use a __Lessons__ action space, before paying the occupation cost, you can exchange 1 <GRAIN> for 4 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.B063_Tasting.name: Tasting
messages.cardFaces.B064_MillWheel.description: Each time you use the __Grain Utilization__ action space while the __Fishing__ accumulation space is occupied, you get an additional 2 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.B064_MillWheel.name: Mill Wheel
messages.cardFaces.B065_GrainDepot.description: If you paid <WOOD>/<CLAY>/<STONE> for this card, place 1 <GRAIN> on each of the next 2/3/4 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <GRAIN>.
messages.cardFaces.B065_GrainDepot.name: Grain Depot
messages.cardFaces.B066_SackCart.description: Place 1 <GRAIN> each on the remaining spaces for rounds 5, 8, 11, and 14. At the start of these rounds, you get the <GRAIN>.
messages.cardFaces.B066_SackCart.name: Sack Cart
messages.cardFaces.B067_HandTruck.description: Each time before you take a __Bake Bread__ action, you also get 1 <GRAIN> for each of your people occupying an accumulation space.
messages.cardFaces.B067_HandTruck.name: Hand Truck
messages.cardFaces.B068_Beanfield.description: This card is a <FIELD> that can only grow <VEGETABLE>.
messages.cardFaces.B068_Beanfield.name: Beanfield
messages.cardFaces.B069_PottersMarket.description: At any time, you can pay 3 <CLAY> and 2 <FOOD>. If you do, place 1 <VEGETABLE> on each of the next 2 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <VEGETABLE>.
messages.cardFaces.B069_PottersMarket.name: Potter's Market
messages.cardFaces.B070_NewPurchase.description: Before the start of each round that ends with a harvest, you can buy one of each of the following crops: 2 <FOOD> <ARROW> 1 <GRAIN>; 4 <FOOD> <ARROW> 1 <VEGETABLE>
messages.cardFaces.B070_NewPurchase.name: New Purchase
messages.cardFaces.B071_HarvestHouse.description: When you play this card, if the number of completed harvests is equal to the number of occupations you played, you immediately get 1 <FOOD>, 1 <GRAIN>, and 1 <VEGETABLE>.
messages.cardFaces.B071_HarvestHouse.name: Harvest House
messages.cardFaces.B072_LoveforAgriculture.descri: You can sow crops in pastures covering 1 or 2 farmyard spaces. If you do, these pastures are also considered <FIELD> and hold 1 and 2 animals less, respectively.
messages.cardFaces.B072_LoveforAgriculture.name: Love for Agriculture
messages.cardFaces.B073_GiftBasket.description: When you play this card, if you have exactly 2/3/4/5 rooms, you immediately get 1 <VEGETABLE>/<FOOD>/<GRAIN>/<VEGETABLE>.
messages.cardFaces.B073_GiftBasket.name: Gift Basket
messages.cardFaces.B074_ThickForest.description: Place 1 <WOOD> on each remaining even-numbered round space. At the start of these rounds, you get the <WOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.B074_ThickForest.name: Thick Forest
messages.cardFaces.B075_WoodWorkshop.description: Each time before you play or build an improvement, you get 1 <WOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.B075_WoodWorkshop.name: Wood Workshop
messages.cardFaces.B076_Ceilings.description: Place 1 <WOOD> on the next 5 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <WOOD>. Remove the <WOOD> promised by this card from future round spaces the next time you renovate.
messages.cardFaces.B076_Ceilings.name: Ceilings
messages.cardFaces.B077_LoamPit.description: Each time you use the __Day Laborer__ action space, you also get 3 <CLAY>.
messages.cardFaces.B077_LoamPit.name: Loam Pit
messages.cardFaces.B078_ReedBelt.description: Place 1 <REED> on each of the remaining space for rounds 5, 8, 10, and 12. At the start of these rounds, you get the <REED>.
messages.cardFaces.B078_ReedBelt.name: Reed Belt
messages.cardFaces.B079_Corf.description: Each time any player (including you) takes at least 3 <STONE> from an accumulation space, you get 1 <STONE> from the general supply.
messages.cardFaces.B079_Corf.name: Corf
messages.cardFaces.B080_HardPorcelain.description: At any time, you can exchange 2/3/4 <CLAY> for 1/2/3 <STONE>.
messages.cardFaces.B080_HardPorcelain.name: Hard Porcelain
messages.cardFaces.B081_Handcart.description: Before each work phase, you can take 1 building resource from at most one <WOOD>/<CLAY>/<REED>/<STONE> accumulation space containing at least 6/5/4/4 building resources of the same type.
messages.cardFaces.B081_Handcart.name: Handcart
messages.cardFaces.B082_ValueAssets.description: After each harvest, you can buy exactly one of the following goods: 1 <FOOD> <ARROW> 1 <WOOD>; 1 <FOOD> <ARROW> 1 <CLAY>; 2 <FOOD> <ARROW> 1 <REED>; 2 <FOOD> <ARROW> 1 <STONE>
messages.cardFaces.B082_ValueAssets.name: Value Assets
messages.cardFaces.B083_MuddyPuddles.description: Pile (from bottom to top) 1 <PIG>, 1 <FOOD>, 1 <CATTLE>, 1 <FOOD>, and 1 <SHEEP> on this card. At any time, you can pay 1 <CLAY> to take the top good.
messages.cardFaces.B083_MuddyPuddles.name: Muddy Puddles
messages.cardFaces.B084_AcornsBasket.description: Place 1 <PIG> on each of the next 2 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <PIG>.
messages.cardFaces.B084_AcornsBasket.name: Acorns Basket
messages.cardFaces.B085_FarmHand.description: Once this game, if you have 4 <FIELD> tiles in a 2x2, you can build a <STABLE> in the center of the 2x2 during a __Build Stables__ action. This <STABLE> provides room for a person but not animals.
messages.cardFaces.B085_FarmHand.name: Farm Hand
messages.cardFaces.B086_TruffleSearcher.descripti: This card can hold a number of <PIG> equal to the number of completed feeding phases.
messages.cardFaces.B086_TruffleSearcher.name: Truffle Searcher
messages.cardFaces.B087_Cottager.description: Each time you use the __Day Laborer__ action space, you can also either build exactly 1 room or renovate your house. Either way, you have to pay the cost.
messages.cardFaces.B087_Cottager.name: Cottager
messages.cardFaces.B088_EstablishedPerson.descrip: If your house has exactly 2 rooms, immediately renovate it without paying any building resources. If you do, you can immediately afterward take a __Build Fences__ action.
messages.cardFaces.B088_EstablishedPerson.name: Established Person
messages.cardFaces.B089_Groom.description: When you play this card, immediately get 1 <WOOD>. Once you live in a stone house, at the start of each round, you can build exactly 1 <STABLE> for 1 <WOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.B089_Groom.name: Groom
messages.cardFaces.B090_CooperativePlower.descrip: Each time you use the __Farmland__ action space while the __Grain Seeds__ action space is occupied, you can plow 1 additional <FIELD>.
messages.cardFaces.B090_CooperativePlower.name: Cooperative Plower
messages.cardFaces.B091_AssistantTiller.descripti: Each time you use the __Day Laborer__ action space, you can also plow 1 <FIELD>.
messages.cardFaces.B091_AssistantTiller.name: Assistant Tiller
messages.cardFaces.B092_LittleStickKnitter.descri: From Round 5 on, each time you use the __Sheep Market__ accumulation space, you can also take a __Family Growth with Room Only__ action.
messages.cardFaces.B092_LittleStickKnitter.name: Little Stick Knitter
messages.cardFaces.B093_Confidant.description: Place 1 <FOOD> from your supply on each of the next 2, 3, or 4 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD> back and your choice of a __Sow__ or __Build Fences__ action.
messages.cardFaces.B093_Confidant.name: Confidant
messages.cardFaces.B094_StockProtector.descriptio: Each time before you use the __Fencing__ action space, you get 2 <WOOD>. Immediately after that __Fencing__ action, you can place another person.
messages.cardFaces.B094_StockProtector.name: Stock Protector
messages.cardFaces.B095_MasterBricklayer.descript: Each time you build a major improvement, reduce the <STONE> cost by the number of rooms you have built onto your initial house.
messages.cardFaces.B095_MasterBricklayer.name: Master Bricklayer
messages.cardFaces.B096_TreeFarmJoiner.descriptio: Place 1 <WOOD> on each of the next 2 odd-numbered round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <WOOD> and, immediately afterward, a __Minor Improvement__ action.
messages.cardFaces.B096_TreeFarmJoiner.name: Tree Farm Joiner
messages.cardFaces.B097_Scholar.description: Once you live in a stone house, at the start of each round, you can play an occupation for an occupation cost of 1 <FOOD>, or a minor improvement (by paying its cost).
messages.cardFaces.B097_Scholar.name: Scholar
messages.cardFaces.B098_OrganicFarmer.description: During the scoring, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> for each pasture containing at least 1 animal while having unused capacity for at least three more animals.
messages.cardFaces.B098_OrganicFarmer.name: Organic Farmer
messages.cardFaces.B099_Tutor.description: During scoring, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> for each occupation played after this one.
messages.cardFaces.B099_Tutor.name: Tutor
messages.cardFaces.B100_Clutterer.description: During scoring, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> for each card played after this one that has \  in its text.
messages.cardFaces.B100_Clutterer.name: Clutterer
messages.cardFaces.B101_FurnitureCarpenter.descri: Each harvest, if any player (including you) owns the Joinery or an upgrade thereof, you can buy exactly 1 bonus <SCORE> for 2 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.B101_FurnitureCarpenter.name: Furniture Carpenter
messages.cardFaces.B102_Consultant.description: When you play this card in a 1-/2-/3-/4- player game, you immediately get 2 <GRAIN>/3 <CLAY>/2 <REED>/2 <SHEEP>.
messages.cardFaces.B102_Consultant.name: Consultant
messages.cardFaces.B103_FieldMerchant.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <WOOD> and 1 <REED>. Each time you decline a __Minor/Major Improvement__ action, you get 1 <FOOD>/<VEGETABLE> instead.
messages.cardFaces.B103_FieldMerchant.name: Field Merchant
messages.cardFaces.B104_SheepWalker.description: At any time, you can exchange 1 <SHEEP> on your farmyard for either 1 <PIG>, 1 <VEGETABLE>, or 1 <STONE>.
messages.cardFaces.B104_SheepWalker.name: Sheep Walker
messages.cardFaces.B105_CaseBuilder.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 good of each of the following types, if you have at least 2 of that good in your supply already: <FOOD>, <GRAIN>, <VEGETABLE>, <REED>, <WOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.B105_CaseBuilder.name: Case Builder
messages.cardFaces.B106_MoralCrusader.description: Immediately before the start of each round, if there are goods on the remaining round spaces that are promised to you, you get 1 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.B106_MoralCrusader.name: Moral Crusader
messages.cardFaces.B107_Manservant.description: Once you live in a stone house, place 3 <FOOD> on each remaining round space. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.B107_Manservant.name: Manservant
messages.cardFaces.B108_OvenFiringBoy.description: Each time you use a <WOOD> accumulation space, you get an additional __Bake Bread__ action.
messages.cardFaces.B108_OvenFiringBoy.name: Oven Firing Boy
messages.cardFaces.B109_PaperMaker.description: Immediately before playing each occupation after this one, you can pay 1 <WOOD> total to get 1 <FOOD> for each occupation you have in front of you.
messages.cardFaces.B109_PaperMaker.name: Paper Maker
messages.cardFaces.B110_Pavior.description: At the end of each preparation phase, if you have at least 1 <STONE> in your supply, you get 1 <FOOD>. In round 14, you get 1 <VEGETABLE> instead.
messages.cardFaces.B110_Pavior.name: Pavior
messages.cardFaces.B111_Rustic.description: For each clay room you build, you get 2 <FOOD> and 1 bonus <SCORE>. (this does not apply to stone rooms and renovated wood rooms.)
messages.cardFaces.B111_Rustic.name: Rustic
messages.cardFaces.B112_Silokeeper.description: Each time you use the action space card that has been revealed right before the most recent harvest, you also get 1 <GRAIN>.
messages.cardFaces.B112_Silokeeper.name: Silokeeper
messages.cardFaces.B113_PatchCaregiver.descriptio: When you play this card, you can choose to buy 1 <GRAIN> for 1 <FOOD>, or 1 <VEGETABLE> for 3 <FOOD>. This card is a <FIELD>.
messages.cardFaces.B113_PatchCaregiver.name: Patch Caregiver
messages.cardFaces.B114_Childless.description: At the start of each round, if you have at least 3 rooms but only 2 people, you get 1 <FOOD> and 1 crop of your choice (<GRAIN> or <VEGETABLE>)
messages.cardFaces.B114_Childless.name: Childless
messages.cardFaces.B115_TinsmithMaster.descriptio: You can hold 1 additional animal in each pasture without a stable. Each time you sow in a field, you can place 1 additional crop of the respective type in that field.
messages.cardFaces.B115_TinsmithMaster.name: Tinsmith Master
messages.cardFaces.B116_Shoreforester.description: When you play this card and each time 1 <REED> is placed on an empty __Reed Bank__ accumulation space in the preparation phase, you get 1 <WOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.B116_Shoreforester.name: Shoreforester
messages.cardFaces.B117_Informant.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <WOOD>. After each work phase, if you have more <STONE> than <CLAY> in your supply, you get 1 <WOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.B117_Informant.name: Informant
messages.cardFaces.B118_SmallscaleFarmer.descript: As long as you live in a house with exactly 2 rooms, at the start of each round, you get 1 <WOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.B118_SmallscaleFarmer.name: Small-scale Farmer
messages.cardFaces.B119_Lumberjack.description: You immediately get 1 <WOOD>. Additionally, place 1 <WOOD> on each of the next round spaces, up to the number of <FENCE> you built. At the start of these rounds, you get the <WOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.B119_Lumberjack.name: Lumberjack
messages.cardFaces.B120_Sweep.description: Each time before you use the action space above the most recent round 1-14 action space, you get 2 <CLAY>.
messages.cardFaces.B120_Sweep.name: Sweep
messages.cardFaces.B121_Geologist.description: Each time you use the __Forest__ or __Reed Bank__ accumulation space, you also get 1 <CLAY>. In games with 3 or more players, this also applies to the __Clay Pit__.
messages.cardFaces.B121_Geologist.name: Geologist
messages.cardFaces.B122_Mineralogist.description: Each time you use a <CLAY>/<STONE> accumulation space, you also get 1 of the other good, <STONE>/<CLAY>.
messages.cardFaces.B122_Mineralogist.name: Mineralogist
messages.cardFaces.B123_RoofBallaster.description: When you play this card, you can immediately pay 1 <FOOD> to get 1 <STONE> for each room you have.
messages.cardFaces.B123_RoofBallaster.name: Roof Ballaster
messages.cardFaces.B124_Trimmer.description: In each work phase, after you enclose at least one farmyard space, you get 2 <STONE>. (Subdividing an existing pasture does not count.)
messages.cardFaces.B124_Trimmer.name: Trimmer
messages.cardFaces.B125_EstateWorker.description: Place 1 <WOOD>, 1 <CLAY>, 1 <REED>, and 1 <STONE> in this order on the next 4 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the respective building resource.
messages.cardFaces.B125_EstateWorker.name: Estate Worker
messages.cardFaces.B126_Carpenter.description: Every new room only costs you 3 of the appropriate building resource and 2 <REED> (e.g. if you live in a wooden house, 3 <WOOD> and 2 <REED>).
messages.cardFaces.B126_Carpenter.name: Carpenter
messages.cardFaces.B127_Seducer.description: When you play this card in round 5 or later, you can immediately pay 1 <STONE>, 1 <GRAIN>, 1 <VEGETABLE>, and 1 <SHEEP> to take a __Family Growth Even without Room__ action.
messages.cardFaces.B127_Seducer.name: Seducer
messages.cardFaces.B128_Plumber.description: Each time after you use the __Major Improvement__ action space, you can take a __Renovation__ action, paying 2 <CLAY> or 2 <STONE> less for the renovation.
messages.cardFaces.B128_Plumber.name: Plumber
messages.cardFaces.B129_Seatmate.description: You can use the action space on round space 13 even if it is occupied by one or more people of the players to your immediate left and right.
messages.cardFaces.B129_Seatmate.name: Seatmate
messages.cardFaces.B130_FullPeasant.description: Each time after you use the __Grain Utilization__ or __Fencing__ action space while the other is unoccupied, you can pay 1 <FOOD> to use the other space with the same person.
messages.cardFaces.B130_FullPeasant.name: Full Peasant
messages.cardFaces.B131_Equipper.description: Immediately after each time you use a <WOOD> accumulation space, you can play a minor improvement.
messages.cardFaces.B131_Equipper.name: Equipper
messages.cardFaces.B132_EstateMaster.description: Once you have no unused farmyard spaces left, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> for each <VEGETABLE> that you harvest.
messages.cardFaces.B132_EstateMaster.name: Estate Master
messages.cardFaces.B133_VillagePeasant.descriptio: At the start of scoring, you get a number of <VEGETABLE> equal to the smallest of the numbers of major improvements, minor improvements, and occupations you have.
messages.cardFaces.B133_VillagePeasant.name: Village Peasant
messages.cardFaces.B134_HousebookMaster.descripti: After playing this card, if you renovate to <STONE> in round 13/12/11 or before, you immediately get 1/2/3 <FOOD> and 1/2/3 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.cardFaces.B134_HousebookMaster.name: Housebook Master
messages.cardFaces.B135_NutritionExpert.descripti: At the start of each round, you can exchange a set comprised of 1 animal of any type, 1 <GRAIN>, and 1 <VEGETABLE> for 5 <FOOD> and 2 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.cardFaces.B135_NutritionExpert.name: Nutrition Expert
messages.cardFaces.B136_HouseSteward.description: If there are still 1/3/6/9 complete rounds left to play, you immediately get 1/2/3/4 <WOOD>. During scoring, each player with the most rooms gets 3 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.cardFaces.B136_HouseSteward.name: House Steward
messages.cardFaces.B137_Wholesaler.description: Place 1 <VEGETABLE>, 1 <PIG>, 1 <STONE>, and 1 <CATTLE> on this card. Each time you use an action space card on round spaces 8 to 11, you get the corresponding good from this card.
messages.cardFaces.B137_Wholesaler.name: Wholesaler
messages.cardFaces.B138_ForestGuardian.descriptio: When you play this card, you immediately get 2 <WOOD>. Each time before another player takes at least 5 <WOOD> from an accumulation space, they must first pay you 1 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.B138_ForestGuardian.name: Forest Guardian
messages.cardFaces.B139_ForestScientist.descripti: In the returning home phase of each round, if there is no <WOOD> left on the game board, you get 1 <FOOD>—from round 5 on, even 2 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.B139_ForestScientist.name: Forest Scientist
messages.cardFaces.B140_FarmyardWorker.descriptio: At the end of each work phase in which you placed at least 1 good on 1 of your farmyard spaces, you get 2 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.B140_FarmyardWorker.name: Farmyard Worker
messages.cardFaces.B141_FieldCaretaker.descriptio: When you play this card, you can immediately exchange 0/1/3 <CLAY> for 1/2/3 <GRAIN>. This card is a <FIELD>.
messages.cardFaces.B141_FieldCaretaker.name: Field Caretaker
messages.cardFaces.B142_Greengrocer.description: Each time you use the __Grain Seeds__ action space, you also get 1 <VEGETABLE>.
messages.cardFaces.B142_Greengrocer.name: Greengrocer
messages.cardFaces.B143_ClayWarden.description: Each time another player uses the __Hollow__ accumulation space, you get 1 <CLAY>. In a 3-/4-player game, you also get 1 additional <CLAY>/<FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.B143_ClayWarden.name: Clay Warden
messages.cardFaces.B144_Collier.description: Each time after you use the __Clay Pit__ or __Hollow__ accumulation space, you get 1 <WOOD>. On __Clay Pit__ you also get 1 additional <REED>.
messages.cardFaces.B144_Collier.name: Collier
messages.cardFaces.B145_BrushwoodCollector.descri: Each time you renovate or build a room, you can replace the required 1 or 2 <REED> with a total of 1 <WOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.B145_BrushwoodCollector.name: Brushwood Collector
messages.cardFaces.B146_Illusionist.description: Each time you use a building resource accumulation space, you can discard exactly 1 card from your hand to get 1 additional building resource of the accumulating type.
messages.cardFaces.B146_Illusionist.name: Illusionist
