messages.cardFaces.B147_Huntsman.description: Each time after you use a <WOOD> accumulation space, you can pay 1 <GRAIN> to get 1 <PIG>.
messages.cardFaces.B147_Huntsman.name: Huntsman
messages.cardFaces.B148_PetBroker.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <SHEEP>. You can keep 1 <SHEEP> on this card for each occupation in front of you.
messages.cardFaces.B148_PetBroker.name: Pet Broker
messages.cardFaces.B149_OpenAirFarmer.description: When you play this card, you remove exactly 3 <STABLE> in your supply from play to build a pasture covering 2 farmyard spaces. You only need to pay a total of 2 <WOOD> for fences
messages.cardFaces.B149_OpenAirFarmer.name: Open Air Farmer
messages.cardFaces.B150_LargeScaleFarmer.descript: Each time after you use the __Farm Expansion__ or __Major Improvement__ action space while the other is unoccupied, you can pay 1 <FOOD> to use that other space with the same person.
messages.cardFaces.B150_LargeScaleFarmer.name: Large-Scale Farmer
messages.cardFaces.B151_LittlePeasant.description: You immediately get 1 <STONE>. As long as you live in a wooden house with exactly 2 rooms, actions spaces—excluding Meeting Place—are not considered occupied for you.
messages.cardFaces.B151_LittlePeasant.name: Little Peasant
messages.cardFaces.B152_JuniorArtist.description: Each time after you use the __Day Laborer__ action space, you can pay 1 <FOOD> to use an unoccupied __Traveling Players__ or __Lessons__ action space with the same person.
messages.cardFaces.B152_JuniorArtist.name: Junior Artist
messages.cardFaces.B153_Housemaster.description: During scoring, total the base point values of your major improvements. The smallest value counts double. If the total is at least 5/7/9/11, you get 1/2/3/4 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.cardFaces.B153_Housemaster.name: Housemaster
messages.cardFaces.B154_SheepKeeper.description: You can only play this card if you have less than 7 <SHEEP>. Once this game, when you have 7 <SHEEP> on your farm, you immediately get 3 bonus points and 2 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.B154_SheepKeeper.name: Sheep Keeper
messages.cardFaces.B155_ArtTeacher.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <WOOD> and 1 <REED>. Each time you pay an occupation cost, you can use <FOOD> from the __Traveling Players__ accumulation space.
messages.cardFaces.B155_ArtTeacher.name: Art Teacher
messages.cardFaces.B156_StorehouseKeeper.descript: Each time you use the __Resource Market__ action space, you also get your choice of 1 <CLAY> or 1 <GRAIN>.
messages.cardFaces.B156_StorehouseKeeper.name: Storehouse Keeper
messages.cardFaces.B157_Salter.description: At any time, you can pay 1 <SHEEP>/<PIG>/<CATTLE> from your farm. If you do, place 1 <FOOD> on each of the next 3/5/7 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.B157_Salter.name: Salter
messages.cardFaces.B158_DistrictManager.descripti: At the end of each work phase, if you used both the __Forest__ and __Grove__ accumulation spaces, you get 5 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.B158_DistrictManager.name: District Manager
messages.cardFaces.B159_LieutenantGeneral.descrip: For each <FIELD> tile that another player places next to an existing <FIELD> tile, you get 1 <FOOD> from the general supply. In round 14, you get 1 <GRAIN> instead.
messages.cardFaces.B159_LieutenantGeneral.name: Lieutenant General
messages.cardFaces.B160_PubOwner.description: When you play this card and at the end of each work phase in which the __Forest__, __Clay Pit__, and __Reed Bank__ accumulation spaces are all occupied, you get 1 <GRAIN>.
messages.cardFaces.B160_PubOwner.name: Pub Owner
messages.cardFaces.B161_Weakling.description: Each time it is your turn in the work phase, if there are one or more accumulation spaces with 5+ goods on them and you do not use any of them, you get 1 <VEGETABLE>.
messages.cardFaces.B161_Weakling.name: Weakling
messages.cardFaces.B162_ForestClearer.description: Each time you obtain exactly 2/3/4 <WOOD> from a <WOOD> accumulation space, you get 1 additional <WOOD> and 1/0/1 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.B162_ForestClearer.name: Forest Clearer
messages.cardFaces.B163_Pastor.description: Once you are the only player to live in a house with only 2 rooms, you immediately get 3 <WOOD>, 2 <CLAY>, 1 <REED>, and 1 <STONE> (only once).
messages.cardFaces.B163_Pastor.name: Pastor
messages.cardFaces.B164_SheepWhisperer.descriptio: Add 2, 5, 8, and 10 to the current round and place 1 <SHEEP> on each corresponding round space. At the start of these rounds, you get the <SHEEP>.
messages.cardFaces.B164_SheepWhisperer.name: Sheep Whisperer
messages.cardFaces.B165_GameProvider.description: Immediately before each harvest, you can discard 1/3/4 <GRAIN> from different fields to get 1/2/3 <PIG>.
messages.cardFaces.B165_GameProvider.name: Game Provider
messages.cardFaces.B166_CattleFeeder.description: Each time you use the __Grain Seeds__ action space, you can also buy 1 <CATTLE> for 1 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.B166_CattleFeeder.name: Cattle Feeder
messages.cardFaces.B167_StableSergeant.descriptio: When you play this card, you can pay 2 <FOOD> to get 1 <SHEEP>, 1 <PIG>, and 1 <CATTLE>, but only if you can accommodate all three animals on your farm.
messages.cardFaces.B167_StableSergeant.name: Stable Sergeant
messages.cardFaces.B168_PastureMaster.description: Each time you renovate, you get 2 <FOOD> and 1 additional animal of the respective type in each of your pastures with <STABLE>.
messages.cardFaces.B168_PastureMaster.name: Pasture Master
messages.cardFaces.B169_LivestockSustainer.descri: For each major improvement built by the other players, you can keep 1 animal on this card (max. 8). You can keep different types here.
messages.cardFaces.B169_LivestockSustainer.name: Livestock Sustainer
messages.cardFaces.B170_CorralBuilder.description: When the __Pig Market__ and __Cattle Market__ action space cards are each revealed (and placed on the round space), you can immediately <FENCE> exactly 1 farmyard space without playing <WOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.B170_CorralBuilder.name: Corral Builder
messages.cardFaces.B171_GreenhouseBuilder.descrip: This is an action space for you only. It provides a choice of __Fencing__, __House Redevelopment__, or __Vegetable Seeds__ if the corresponding action space is already in play.
messages.cardFaces.B171_GreenhouseBuilder.name: Greenhouse Builder
messages.cardFaces.B172_CattleCaregiver.descripti: At the start of each round, if 3/4/5+ players each have at least 1 <CATTLE>, you get 1/2/3 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.B172_CattleCaregiver.name: Cattle Caregiver
messages.cardFaces.B173_Sweeper.description: Each time you use an action space with the (meeple) symbol, place 1 <FOOD> on this card. Once this game, you can turn this card face down to get the <FOOD> on it.
messages.cardFaces.B173_Sweeper.name: Sweeper
messages.cardFaces.B174_RiverbankGardener.descrip: Each time you use the __Riverbank Forest__ accumulation space, you also get 1 <VEGETABLE>.
messages.cardFaces.B174_RiverbankGardener.name: Riverbank Gardener
messages.cardFaces.B175_FieldOverseer.description: Each time the other players harvest <GRAIN> from at least 3/4/6 <FIELD> combined, you get 1 <FOOD>/<GRAIN>/<VEGETABLE>.
messages.cardFaces.B175_FieldOverseer.name: Field Overseer
messages.cardFaces.B176_VillageIdiot.description: The Village Idiot is your lone occupation. Each time another player uses the __Meeting Place__ action space, you get 1 <WOOD> and 1 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.B176_VillageIdiot.name: Village Idiot
messages.cardFaces.B177_StoneClawer.description: Each time you plow at least 1 <FIELD>, you also get 1 <STONE>.
messages.cardFaces.B177_StoneClawer.name: Stone Clawer
messages.cardFaces.B178_TagAlong.description: Immediately after each time another player uses the __Resource Market__ action space, you can also place a person there to take the action as well.
messages.cardFaces.B178_TagAlong.name: Tag-Along
messages.cardFaces.B179_WildBoarHunter.descriptio: In the returning home phase of each round, if at least 3 <WOOD> accumulation spaces are occupied, you can pay 1 <WOOD> to get 1 <PIG>.
messages.cardFaces.B179_WildBoarHunter.name: Wild Boar Hunter
messages.cardFaces.B180_GameTeaser.description: Each time you take 1/2/3 <FOOD> from a <FOOD> accumulation space, you also get 1 <CATTLE>/<PIG>/<SHEEP>.
messages.cardFaces.B180_GameTeaser.name: Game Teaser
messages.cardFaces.C001_Overhaul.description: Immediately raze all of your fences, add up to 3 fences from your supply, and rebuild them. (You do not lose any animals during this.)
messages.cardFaces.C001_Overhaul.name: Overhaul
messages.cardFaces.C002_Stable.description: Immediately build 1 <STABLE>. (The <STABLE> costs you nothing, but you must pay the cost shown on this card.)
messages.cardFaces.C002_Stable.name: Stable
messages.cardFaces.C003_CarriageTrip.description: If you play this card in the work phase, you can immediately place another person.
messages.cardFaces.C003_CarriageTrip.name: Carriage Trip
messages.cardFaces.C004_WritingBoards.description: You immediately get 1 <WOOD> for each occupation you have in front of you.
messages.cardFaces.C004_WritingBoards.name: Writing Boards
messages.cardFaces.C005_Remodeling.description: You immediately get 1 <CLAY> for each clay room and for each major improvement you have.
messages.cardFaces.C005_Remodeling.name: Remodeling
messages.cardFaces.C006_StoneClearing.description: Immediately place 1 <STONE> on each of your empty <FIELD>. Harvest them during the next field phase. These <FIELD> are considered planted until then.
messages.cardFaces.C006_StoneClearing.name: Stone Clearing
messages.cardFaces.C007_BladeShears.description: You immediately get your choice of 3 <FOOD>, or 1 <FOOD> for each <SHEEP> you have. (Keep the <SHEEP>.)
messages.cardFaces.C007_BladeShears.name: Blade Shears
messages.cardFaces.C008_PlantFertilizer.descripti: In each field with exactly 1 good, you can immediately place 1 additional good of the same type.
messages.cardFaces.C008_PlantFertilizer.name: Plant Fertilizer
messages.cardFaces.C009_AutomaticWaterTrough.desc: If you can accommodate the animal, you can immediately buy 1 <SHEEP>/<PIG>/<CATTLE> for 0/1/2 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.C009_AutomaticWaterTrough.name: Automatic Water Trough
messages.cardFaces.C010_BunkBeds.description: Once you have 4 rooms, your house can hold 5 people.
messages.cardFaces.C010_BunkBeds.name: Bunk Beds
messages.cardFaces.C011_WildlifeReserve.descripti: This card can hold up to 1 <SHEEP>, 1 <PIG>, and 1 <CATTLE>.
messages.cardFaces.C011_WildlifeReserve.name: Wildlife Reserve
messages.cardFaces.C012_CattleFarm.description: For each pasture you have, you can keep 1 <CATTLE> on this card.
messages.cardFaces.C012_CattleFarm.name: Cattle Farm
messages.cardFaces.C013_WoodSlideHammer.descripti: On your first renovation, if you have at least 5 wood rooms, you can renovate to stone directly and you get a discount of 2 <STONE> on the renovation cost.
messages.cardFaces.C013_WoodSlideHammer.name: Wood Slide Hammer
messages.cardFaces.C014_StrawThatchedRoof.descrip: You no longer need <REED> to renovate or build a room.
messages.cardFaces.C014_StrawThatchedRoof.name: Straw-Thatched Roof
messages.cardFaces.C015_Trellis.description: Each time before you use the __Pig Market__ accumulation space, you can take a __Build Fences__ action. (You must pay <WOOD> for the <FENCE> as usual.)
messages.cardFaces.C015_Trellis.name: Trellis
messages.cardFaces.C016_FieldFences.description: You can immediately take a __Build Fences__ action, during which you do not have to pay <WOOD> for <FENCE> that you build next to <FIELD> tiles.
messages.cardFaces.C016_FieldFences.name: Field Fences
messages.cardFaces.C017_NewlyPlowedField.descript: When you play this card, you can immediately plow 1 field, which needs not be adjacent to another field.
messages.cardFaces.C017_NewlyPlowedField.name: Newly-Plowed Field
messages.cardFaces.C018_RollOverPlow.description: At any time, if you have at least 3 planted fields, you can discard all goods from one of those fields to plow 1 field.
messages.cardFaces.C018_RollOverPlow.name: Roll-Over Plow
messages.cardFaces.C019_SwingPlow.description: Place 4 field tiles on this card. Each time you use the __Farmland__ action space, you can also plow up to 2 fields from this card.
messages.cardFaces.C019_SwingPlow.name: Swing Plow
messages.cardFaces.C020_MolePlow.description: Each time you use the __Farmland__ or __Cultivation__ action space, you can plow 1 additional <FIELD>.
messages.cardFaces.C020_MolePlow.name: Mole Plow
messages.cardFaces.C021_HeartofStone.description: Each time a __Quarry__ accumulation space is revealed, if you have room in your house, you can immediately take a __Family Growth__ action without placing a person.
messages.cardFaces.C021_HeartofStone.name: Heart of Stone
messages.cardFaces.C022_BasketChair.description: When you play this card, you can immediately move the first person you placed this work phase to this card (unless it is on __Meeting Place__). If you do, immediately afterward, you can place another person.
messages.cardFaces.C022_BasketChair.name: Basket Chair
messages.cardFaces.C022_BasketChair.rules: Only an adult person can be moved to this card; a newborn remains on its action space.
messages.cardFaces.C023_JobContract.description: If both are unoccupied, you can use the __Day Laborer__ and the adjacent __Lessons__ action space with a single person (in that order). Afterward, both spaces are considered occupied.
messages.cardFaces.C023_JobContract.name: Job Contract
messages.cardFaces.C024_BedintheGrainField.descri: At the start of the next harvest, you get a __Family Growth__ action if you have room for the newborn.
messages.cardFaces.C024_BedintheGrainField.name: Bed in the Grain Field
messages.cardFaces.C025_SteamMachine.description: Each work phase, if the last action space you use is an accumulation space, you can immediately afterward take a __Bake Bread__ action.
messages.cardFaces.C025_SteamMachine.name: Steam Machine
messages.cardFaces.C026_Flail.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 2 <FOOD>. Each time you use the __Farmland__ or __Cultivation__ action space, you can also take a __Bake Bread__ action.
messages.cardFaces.C026_Flail.name: Flail
messages.cardFaces.C027_Blueprint.description: You can build the major improvements __Joinery__, __Pottery__, and __Basketmaker\\
messages.cardFaces.C027_Blueprint.name: Blueprint
messages.cardFaces.C028_TeachersDesk.description: Each time you use the __Major Improvement__ or __House Redevelopment__ action space, you can also play 1 occupation at an occupation cost of 1 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.C028_TeachersDesk.name: Teacher's Desk
messages.cardFaces.C029_BeerTable.description: At the end of the field phase of each harvest, you can pay 1 <GRAIN> from your supply to get 2 bonus <SCORE>. If you do, all other players get 1 <FOOD> each.
messages.cardFaces.C029_BeerTable.name: Beer Table
messages.cardFaces.C030_HalfTimberedHouse.descrip: During scoring, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> for each stone room you have. You can only use one card to get bonus <SCORE> for your stone house.
messages.cardFaces.C030_HalfTimberedHouse.name: Half-Timbered House
messages.cardFaces.C031_WritingChamber.descriptio: During scoring, you get a number of bonus <SCORE> equal to the total of negative points you have, to a maximum of 7 <SCORE>.
messages.cardFaces.C031_WritingChamber.name: Writing Chamber
messages.cardFaces.C032_AbortOriel.description: You can no longer play this card when any player (including you) has 5 or more cards in front of them.
messages.cardFaces.C032_AbortOriel.name: Abort Oriel
messages.cardFaces.C033_GreeningPlan.description: During scoring, if you then have at least 2/4/5/6 unplanted <FIELD>, you get 1/2/3/5 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.cardFaces.C033_GreeningPlan.name: Greening Plan
messages.cardFaces.C034_ElephantgrassPlant.descri: Immediately after each harvest, you can use this card to exchange exactly 1 <REED> for 1 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.cardFaces.C034_ElephantgrassPlant.name: Elephantgrass Plant
messages.cardFaces.C035_LanternHouse.description: During scoring, you get 1 negative <SCORE> for each card left in your hand. You cannot discard cards from your hand unplayed. If you already have, you cannot play this card.
messages.cardFaces.C035_LanternHouse.name: Lantern House
messages.cardFaces.C036_ClayDeposit.description: Immediately after each time you use a <CLAY> accumulation space, you can exchange 1 <CLAY> for 1 bonus <SCORE>. If you do, place the <CLAY> on the accumulation space.
messages.cardFaces.C036_ClayDeposit.name: Clay Deposit
messages.cardFaces.C037_DwellingMound.description: From now on, you must pay 1 <FOOD> for each new field tile that you place in your farmyard.
messages.cardFaces.C037_DwellingMound.name: Dwelling Mound
messages.cardFaces.C038_Christianity.description: When you play this card, all other players get 1 <FOOD> each.
messages.cardFaces.C038_Christianity.name: Christianity
messages.cardFaces.C039_StudioBoat.description: Each time you use the __Traveling Players__ accumulation space, you also get 1 bonus <SCORE>. In games with 1-3 players, this card is considered __Traveling Players__ (same effect as __Fishing__).
messages.cardFaces.C039_StudioBoat.name: Studio Boat
messages.cardFaces.C040_CanvasSack.description: When you play this card paying <GRAIN>/<REED> for it, you immediately get 1 <VEGETABLE>/4 <WOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.C040_CanvasSack.name: Canvas Sack
messages.cardFaces.C041_FarmStore.description: After the feeding phase of each harvest, you can exchange exactly 1 <FOOD> for 2 different building resources of your choice or 1 <VEGETABLE>.
messages.cardFaces.C041_FarmStore.name: Farm Store
messages.cardFaces.C042_RavenousHunger.descriptio: Immediately after each time you use the __Vegetable Seeds__ action space, you can place another person on an accumulation space and get 1 additional good of the accumulating type.
messages.cardFaces.C042_RavenousHunger.name: Ravenous Hunger
messages.cardFaces.C043_FarmBuilding.description: Each time you build a major improvement, place 1 <FOOD> on each of the next 3 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.C043_FarmBuilding.name: Farm Building
messages.cardFaces.C044_ChickenCoop.description: Place 1 <FOOD> on each of the next 8 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.C044_ChickenCoop.name: Chicken Coop
messages.cardFaces.C045_Stew.description: Each time you use the __Day Laborer__ action space, also place 1 <FOOD> on each of the next 4 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.C045_Stew.name: Stew
messages.cardFaces.C046_Mandoline.description: Once per round, you can pay 1 <VEGETABLE> to get 1 bonus <SCORE>. If you do, place 1 <FOOD> on each of the next 2 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.C046_Mandoline.name: Mandoline
messages.cardFaces.C047_GardenClaw.description: Place 1 <FOOD> on each remaining round space, up to three times the number of planted <FIELD> you have. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.C047_GardenClaw.name: Garden Claw
messages.cardFaces.C048_Farmstead.description: After each turn in which you make at least one unused farmyard space used, you get 1 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.C048_Farmstead.name: Farmstead
messages.cardFaces.C049_BeerStall.description: In the feeding phase of each harvest, for each empty unfenced <STABLE> you have, you can exchange 1 <GRAIN> for 5 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.C049_BeerStall.name: Beer Stall
messages.cardFaces.C050_StableYard.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <FOOD> for each completed round left to play. At any time, you can exchange 1 <SHEEP> plus 1 <PIG> for 1 <CATTLE>.
messages.cardFaces.C050_StableYard.name: Stable Yard
messages.cardFaces.C051_FishingNet.description: Each time another player uses the __Fishing__ accumulation space, they must first pay you 1 <FOOD>. Then, in the returning home phase of that round, place 2 <FOOD> on __Fishing__.
messages.cardFaces.C051_FishingNet.name: Fishing Net
messages.cardFaces.C052_HuntsmansHat.description: For each new <PIG> you get from the effect of an action space, you also get 1 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.C052_HuntsmansHat.name: Huntsman's Hat
messages.cardFaces.C053_GypsysCrock.description: Each time you use a cooking improvement to turn 2 goods into <FOOD> at the same time, you get 1 additional <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.C053_GypsysCrock.name: Gypsy's Crock
messages.cardFaces.C054_MarketBooth.description: After the field phase of each harvest, you can exchange 1 <GRAIN> plus 1 <FENCE> (both from your supply) for 5 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.C054_MarketBooth.name: Market Booth
messages.cardFaces.C055_Studio.description: In the feeding phase of each harvest, you can use this card to turn exactly 1 <WOOD>/<CLAY>/<STONE> into 2/2/3 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.C055_Studio.name: Studio
messages.cardFaces.C056_FeedFence.description: For each new <STABLE> you build, you get 1 <FOOD> —for your last one, get 3 <FOOD>. Each time you build <STABLE>, you can build exactly 1 <STABLE> for 1 <CLAY> instead of <WOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.C056_FeedFence.name: Feed Fence
messages.cardFaces.C057_Crudite.description: When you play this card, you can immediately buy exactly 1 <VEGETABLE> for 3 <FOOD>. At any time, you can discard 1 <VEGETABLE> on top of another <VEGETABLE> in a field to get 4 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.C057_Crudite.name: Crudité
messages.cardFaces.C058_Woodcraft.description: Each time you use a <WOOD> accumulation space, if immediately afterward you have at most 5 <WOOD> in your supply, you get 1 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.C058_Woodcraft.name: Woodcraft
messages.cardFaces.C059_SchnappsDistillery.descri: In each feeding phase, you can use this card to turn exactly 1 <VEGETABLE> into 5 <FOOD>. During scoring, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> each for your 5th and 6th <VEGETABLE>.
messages.cardFaces.C059_SchnappsDistillery.name: Schnapps Distillery
messages.cardFaces.C060_SmallPottersOven.descript: When you play this card, you immediately get 5 <FOOD>. Each time before you get a __Bake Bread__ action, you can build the __Clay Oven__ or __Stone Oven__ major improvement.
messages.cardFaces.C060_SmallPottersOven.name: Small Potter's Oven
messages.cardFaces.C061_BeerStein.description: Each time you take a __Bake Bread__ action, you can use this card once to turn 1 <GRAIN> into 2 <FOOD> and 1 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.cardFaces.C061_BeerStein.name: Beer Stein
messages.cardFaces.C062_CookeryExtension.descript: Each harvest, you can use each of your cooking improvements once to get double the amount of <FOOD> for 1 animal or <VEGETABLE>.
messages.cardFaces.C062_CookeryExtension.name: Cookery Extension
messages.cardFaces.C063_CraftBrewery.description: In the feeding phase of each harvest, you can use this card to exchange 1 <GRAIN> from your supply plus 1 <GRAIN> from a field for 2 bonus <SCORE> and 4 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.C063_CraftBrewery.name: Craft Brewery
messages.cardFaces.C064_CornSchnappsDistillery.de: Once per round, you can pay 1 <GRAIN> to place 1 <FOOD> on each of the next 4 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.C065_Granary.description: Place 1 <GRAIN> each on the remaining spaces for rounds 8, 10, and 12. At the start of these rounds, you get the <GRAIN>.
messages.cardFaces.C065_Granary.name: Granary
messages.cardFaces.C066_EternalRyeCultivation.des: After each harvest in which you have 2 or 3+ <GRAIN> in your supply, you get 1 <FOOD> or 1 additional <GRAIN>, respectively.
messages.cardFaces.C067_MineralFeeder.description: At the start of each round that does not end with a harvest, if you have at least 1 <SHEEP> in a pasture, you get 1 <GRAIN>.
messages.cardFaces.C067_MineralFeeder.name: Mineral Feeder
messages.cardFaces.C068_Bookcase.description: Each time after you play an occupation, you get 1 <VEGETABLE>.
messages.cardFaces.C068_Bookcase.name: Bookcase
messages.cardFaces.C069_LandConsolidation.descrip: At any time, if you have a <GRAIN> <FIELD> with exactly 3 sown <GRAIN>, you can exchange the <GRAIN> on the <FIELD> for 1 <VEGETABLE> on the <FIELD>.
messages.cardFaces.C069_LandConsolidation.name: Land Consolidation
messages.cardFaces.C070_LettucePatch.description: This card is a <FIELD> that can only grow <VEGETABLE>. You can immediately turn each <VEGETABLE> you harvested from this card into 4 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.C070_LettucePatch.name: Lettuce Patch
messages.cardFaces.C071_Slurry.description: In the breeding phase of each harvest, if you get newborn animals of at least two types, you also get a __Sow__ action.
messages.cardFaces.C071_Slurry.name: Slurry
messages.cardFaces.C072_FestivalPlanning.descript: When you play this card, immediately carry out the field phase on your farmyard only (this is not a harvest). Afterwards, you get a __Major or Minor Improvement__ action.
messages.cardFaces.C072_FestivalPlanning.name: Festival Planning
messages.cardFaces.C073_SeaweedFertilizer.descrip: Each time after you take an unconditional __Sow__ action, you get 1 <GRAIN> from the general supply. From round 11 on, you can get 1 <VEGETABLE> instead.
messages.cardFaces.C073_SeaweedFertilizer.name: Seaweed Fertilizer
messages.cardFaces.C074_PrivateForest.description: Place 1 <WOOD> on each remaining even-numbered round space. At the start of these rounds, you get the <WOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.C074_PrivateForest.name: Private Forest
messages.cardFaces.C075_Firewood.description: In the returning home phase of each round, place 1 <WOOD> on this card. Each time after you build a Fireplace, Cooking Hearth, or oven, move up to 4 <WOOD> from this card to your supply.
messages.cardFaces.C075_Firewood.name: Firewood
messages.cardFaces.C076_WoodCart.description: Each time you use a <WOOD> accumulation space, you get 2 additional <WOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.C076_WoodCart.name: Wood Cart
messages.cardFaces.C077_ClaySupply.description: Place 1 <CLAY> on each of the next 3 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <CLAY>.
messages.cardFaces.C077_ClaySupply.name: Clay Supply
messages.cardFaces.C078_ReedHattedToad.descriptio: Add 5, 7, 9, 11, and 13 to the current round and place 1 <REED> on each corresponding round space. At the start of these rounds, you get the <REED>.
messages.cardFaces.C078_ReedHattedToad.name: Reed-Hatted Toad
messages.cardFaces.C079_StoneCart.description: Place 1 <STONE> on each remaining even-numbered round space. At the start of these rounds, you get the <STONE>.
messages.cardFaces.C079_StoneCart.name: Stone Cart
messages.cardFaces.C080_RockyTerrain.description: Each time you plow a <FIELD> (tile or card), you can also buy 1 <STONE> for 1 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.C080_RockyTerrain.name: Rocky Terrain
messages.cardFaces.C081_MaterialHub.description: Immediately place 2 of each building resource on this card. Each time any player (including you) takes at least 5 <WOOD>, 4 <CLAY>, 3 <REED>, or 3 <STONE>, you get 1 of that building resource from this card.
messages.cardFaces.C081_MaterialHub.name: Material Hub
messages.cardFaces.C081_MaterialHub.prerequisite: 1 reed and 1 stone in your supply
messages.cardFaces.C082_HardwareStore.description: Each time after you use the __Day Laborer__ action space, you can pay 2 <FOOD> total to buy 1 <WOOD>, 1 <CLAY>, 1 <REED>, and 1 <STONE>.
messages.cardFaces.C082_HardwareStore.name: Hardware Store
messages.cardFaces.C083_EarlyCattle.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 2 <CATTLE>.
messages.cardFaces.C083_EarlyCattle.name: Early Cattle
messages.cardFaces.C084_PerennialRye.description: Each round that does not end with a harvest, you can pay 1 <GRAIN> to breed exactly 1 type of animal. (This is not considered a breeding phase.)
messages.cardFaces.C084_PerennialRye.name: Perennial Rye
messages.cardFaces.C085_DenBuilder.description: When you live in a clay or stone house, you can pay 1 <GRAIN> and 2 <FOOD>. If you do, for the rest of the game, this card provides room for exactly one person.
messages.cardFaces.C085_DenBuilder.name: Den Builder
messages.cardFaces.C086_LivestockFeeder.descripti: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <GRAIN>. This card can hold 1 animal of any type for each <GRAIN> in your supply.
messages.cardFaces.C086_LivestockFeeder.name: Livestock Feeder
messages.cardFaces.C087_Mason.description: Place a stone room on this card. Once you have a stone house with at least 4 rooms, at any time, you can add that room without paying any building resources.
messages.cardFaces.C087_Mason.name: Mason
messages.cardFaces.C088_CarpentersApprentice.desc: Wood rooms cost you 2 <WOOD> less. Your 3rd and 4th stable each cost you 1 <WOOD> less. Your 13th to 15th fence each cost you nothing.
messages.cardFaces.C088_CarpentersApprentice.name: Carpenter's Apprentice
messages.cardFaces.C089_StableMaster.description: When you play this card, you can immediately build exactly 1 <STABLE> for 1 <WOOD>. Exactly one of your unfenced <STABLE> can hold up to 3 animals of one type.
messages.cardFaces.C089_StableMaster.name: Stable Master
messages.cardFaces.C090_FieldWatchman.description: Each time you use the __Grain Seeds__ action space, you can also plow 1 <FIELD>.
messages.cardFaces.C090_FieldWatchman.name: Field Watchman
messages.cardFaces.C091_PlowHero.description: Each time you use the __Farmland__ or __Cultivation__ action space with the first person you place in a round, you can plow 1 additional <FIELD> for 1 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.C091_PlowHero.name: Plow Hero
messages.cardFaces.C092_AutumnMother.description: Immediately before each harvest, if you have room in your house, you can take a __Family Growth__ action for 3 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.C092_AutumnMother.name: Autumn Mother
messages.cardFaces.C093_InnerDistrictsDirector.de: Each time you use the __Forest__ or __Clay Pit__ accumulation space, you can place 1 <STONE> from the general supply on the other space. If you do, you can immediately place another person.
messages.cardFaces.C094_StableCleaner.description: At any time, you can take the __Build Stables__ action without placing a person. If you do, each <STABLE> costs you 1 <WOOD> and 1 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.C094_StableCleaner.name: Stable Cleaner
messages.cardFaces.C095_BasketWeaver.description: When you play this card, immediately build the __Basketmaker's Workshop__ major improvement for 1 <STONE> and 1 <REED>.
messages.cardFaces.C095_BasketWeaver.name: Basket Weaver
messages.cardFaces.C096_Merchant.description: Immediately after each time you take a __Major or Minor Improvement__ or __Minor Improvement__ action, you can pay 1 <FOOD> to take the action a second time.
messages.cardFaces.C096_Merchant.name: Merchant
messages.cardFaces.C097_SeedResearcher.descriptio: Each time any people return from both the __Grain Seeds__ and __Vegetable Seeds__ action spaces, you get 2 <FOOD> and you can play 1 occupation, without paying an occupation cost.
messages.cardFaces.C097_SeedResearcher.name: Seed Researcher
messages.cardFaces.C098_CubeCutter.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <WOOD>. In the field phase of each harvest, you can use this card to exchange exactly 1 <WOOD> and 1 <FOOD> for 1 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.cardFaces.C098_CubeCutter.name: Cube Cutter
messages.cardFaces.C099_GardenDesigner.descriptio: At the start of scoring, you can place <FOOD> in empty fields. You get 1/2/3 bonus <SCORE> for each field in which you place 1/4/7 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.C099_GardenDesigner.name: Garden Designer
messages.cardFaces.C100_Butler.description: If you play this card in round 11 or before, during scoring, you get 4 bonus <SCORE> if you then have more rooms than people.
messages.cardFaces.C100_Butler.name: Butler
messages.cardFaces.C101_StallHolder.description: Once per round, if you have 0/1/2/3/4 unfenced <STABLE> on your farm, you can exchange 2 <GRAIN> for 1 bonus <SCORE> and 1/2/3/4/5 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.C101_StallHolder.name: Stall Holder
messages.cardFaces.C102_TreeGuard.description: Each time after you use a <WOOD> accumulation space, you can place 4 <WOOD> from your supply on that space to get 2 <STONE>, 1 <CLAY>, 1 <REED>, and 1 <GRAIN>.
messages.cardFaces.C102_TreeGuard.name: Tree Guard
messages.cardFaces.C103_GreenGrocer.description: At the start of each round, you can make exactly one of the following exchanges: 1 <CATTLE> <ARROW> 1 <VEGETABLE>; 1 <VEGETABLE> <ARROW> 1 <CATTLE>; 2 <SHEEP> <ARROW> 1 <VEGETABLE>; 1 <VEGETABLE> <ARROW> 2 <SHEEP>; 2 <FOOD> <ARROW> 1 <GRAIN>; 1 <GRAIN> <ARROW> 2 <FOOD>
messages.cardFaces.C103_GreenGrocer.name: Green Grocer
messages.cardFaces.C104_Collector.description: This card is an action space for you only. When you use it for the 1st/2nd/3rd/4th time, you get 1 <BEGGING> marker and 6/7/8/9 different good of your choice.
messages.cardFaces.C104_Collector.name: Collector
messages.cardFaces.C105_BasketCarrier.description: Once each harvest, you can buy 1 <WOOD>, 1 <REED>, and 1 <GRAIN> for 2 <FOOD> total.
messages.cardFaces.C105_BasketCarrier.name: Basket Carrier
messages.cardFaces.C106_PotatoHarvester.descripti: When you play this card, you immediately get 3 <FOOD>. For each <VEGETABLE> you get from your <FIELD> during the field phase of the harvest, you get 1 additional <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.C106_PotatoHarvester.name: Potato Harvester
messages.cardFaces.C107_Baker.description: When you play this card and at the start of each feeding phase, you can take a __Bake Bread__ action.
messages.cardFaces.C107_Baker.name: Baker
messages.cardFaces.C108_Layabout.description: When you play this card, you must skip the next harvest. (You also do not have to feed your family that harvest.)
messages.cardFaces.C108_Layabout.name: Layabout
messages.cardFaces.C109_SchnappsDistiller.descrip: In the feeding phase of each harvest, you can use this card to turn exactly 1 <VEGETABLE> into 5 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.C109_SchnappsDistiller.name: Schnapps Distiller
messages.cardFaces.C110_HomeBrewer.description: After the field phase of each harvest, you can use this card to turn exactly 1 <GRAIN> into your choice of 3 <FOOD> or 1 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.cardFaces.C110_HomeBrewer.name: Home Brewer
messages.cardFaces.C111_SmallAnimalBreeder.descri: Before the start of each round, if you have <FOOD> equal to or higher than the upcoming round number (e.g., 8+ <FOOD> before round 8), you get 1 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.C111_SmallAnimalBreeder.name: Small Animal Breeder
messages.cardFaces.C112_Thresher.description: Immediately before each time you use the __Grain Utilization__, __Farmland__, or __Cultivation__ action space, you can buy 1 <GRAIN> for 1 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.C112_Thresher.name: Thresher
messages.cardFaces.C113_WinterCaretaker.descripti: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <GRAIN>. At the end of each harvest, you can buy exactly 1 <VEGETABLE> for 2 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.C113_WinterCaretaker.name: Winter Caretaker
messages.cardFaces.C114_SoilScientist.description: Each time after you use a <CLAY>/<STONE> accumulation space, you can place 1 <STONE>/2 <CLAY> from your supply on the space to get 2 <GRAIN>/1 <VEGETABLE>, respectively.
messages.cardFaces.C114_SoilScientist.name: Soil Scientist
messages.cardFaces.C115_Sower.description: Each time you build a major improvement, place 1 <REED> from the general supply on this card. At any time, you can move the <REED> to your supply or exchange it for a __Sow__ action.
messages.cardFaces.C115_Sower.name: Sower
messages.cardFaces.C116_FurnitureMaker.descriptio: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <WOOD>. Each time you play an occupation after this one, you get 1 <WOOD> for each <FOOD> paid as occupation cost.
messages.cardFaces.C116_FurnitureMaker.name: Furniture Maker
messages.cardFaces.C117_Legworker.description: Each time you use an action space that is orthogonally adjacent to another action space occupied by one of your people, you get 1 <WOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.C117_Legworker.name: Legworker
messages.cardFaces.C118_WoodCollector.description: Place 1 <WOOD> on each of the next 5 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <WOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.C118_WoodCollector.name: Wood Collector
messages.cardFaces.C119_SkillfulRenovator.descrip: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <WOOD> and 1 <CLAY>. Each time after you renovate, you get a number of <WOOD> equal to the number of people you placed that round.
messages.cardFaces.C119_SkillfulRenovator.name: Skillful Renovator
messages.cardFaces.C120_AgriculturalLabourer.desc: Place 8 <CLAY> on this card. For each <GRAIN> you obtain, you also get 1 <CLAY> from this card.
messages.cardFaces.C120_AgriculturalLabourer.name: Agricultural Labourer
messages.cardFaces.C121_ClayKneader.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <WOOD> and 2 <CLAY>. Each time after you use __Grain Seeds__ or __Vegetable Seeds__ action space, you get 1 <CLAY>.
messages.cardFaces.C121_ClayKneader.name: Clay Kneader
messages.cardFaces.C122_Bricklayer.description: Each improvement and each renovation cost you 1 <CLAY> less. Each room costs you 2 <CLAY> less.
messages.cardFaces.C122_Bricklayer.name: Bricklayer
messages.cardFaces.C123_Freemason.description: As long as you live in a <CLAY>/<STONE> house with exactly 2 rooms, at the start of each work phase, you get 2 <CLAY>/<STONE>.
messages.cardFaces.C123_Freemason.name: Freemason
messages.cardFaces.C124_StoneImporter.description: In the breeding phase of the 1st/2nd/3rd/4th/5th/6th harvest, you can use this card to buy exactly 2 <STONE> for 2/2/3/3/4/1 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.C124_StoneImporter.name: Stone Importer
messages.cardFaces.C125_Nightworker.description: Before the start of each work phase, you can place a person on an accumulation space of a building resource not in your supply. (Then proceed with the start player.)
messages.cardFaces.C125_Nightworker.name: Nightworker
messages.cardFaces.C126_Excavator.description: Each time after you use the __Day Laborer__ action space, you get 1 additional <WOOD> and <CLAY>, and you can buy 1 <STONE> for 1 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.C126_Excavator.name: Excavator
messages.cardFaces.C127_Lover.description: When you play this card, immediately pay an amount of <FOOD> equal to the number of complete rounds left to play to take a __Family Growth Even without Room__ action.
messages.cardFaces.C127_Lover.name: Lover
messages.cardFaces.C128_WoodenHutExtender.descrip: Wood rooms now cost you 1 <REED>, and additionally 5 <WOOD> through round 5, 4 <WOOD> in rounds 6 and 7, and 3 <WOOD> in round 8 and later.
messages.cardFaces.C128_WoodenHutExtender.name: Wooden Hut Extender
messages.cardFaces.C129_SecondSpouse.description: You can use the __Urgent Wish for Children__ action space (from round 12-13) even if it is occupied by the first person another player placed.
messages.cardFaces.C129_SecondSpouse.name: Second Spouse
messages.cardFaces.C130_OutskirtsDirector.descrip: Each time you use the __Grove__ or __Hollow__ accumulation space, you can place 2 <REED> from the general supply on the other space. If you do, you can immediately place another person.
messages.cardFaces.C130_OutskirtsDirector.name: Outskirts Director
messages.cardFaces.C131_PrivateTeacher.descriptio: Each time you use the __Grain Seeds__ action space when any __Lessons__ action space is occupied, you can also play an occupation for an occupation cost of 1 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.C131_PrivateTeacher.name: Private Teacher
messages.cardFaces.C132_TimberShingleMaker.descri: When you renovate to <STONE>, you can place up to 1 <WOOD> from your supply in each of your rooms. During scoring, each such <WOOD> is worth 1 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.cardFaces.C132_TimberShingleMaker.name: Timber Shingle Maker
messages.cardFaces.C133_Soldier.description: During scoring, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> for each <STONE> + <WOOD> pair in your supply. You cannot score additional points for the resources scored with this card.
messages.cardFaces.C133_Soldier.name: Soldier
messages.cardFaces.C134_CowPrince.description: During scoring, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> for each space in your farmyard (including rooms) holding at least 1 <CATTLE>.
messages.cardFaces.C134_CowPrince.name: Cow Prince
messages.cardFaces.C135_Constable.description: If there are still 1/3/6/9 complete rounds left to play, you immediately get 1/2/3/4 <WOOD>. During scoring, each player with no negative points in any scoring line gets 3 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.cardFaces.C135_Constable.name: Constable
messages.cardFaces.C136_RanchProvost.description: If there are still 3/6/9 complete rounds left to play, you immediately get 2/3/4 <WOOD>. During scoring, each player with a pasture of highest capacity gets 3 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.cardFaces.C136_RanchProvost.name: Ranch Provost
messages.cardFaces.C137_CharcoalBurner.descriptio: Each time any player (including you) plays or builds a <BAKE>-improvement, you get 1 <WOOD> and 1 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.C137_CharcoalBurner.name: Charcoal Burner
messages.cardFaces.C138_AnimalFeeder.description: On the __Day Laborer__ action space, you also get your choice of 1 <SHEEP> or 1 <GRAIN>. Instead of that good, you can buy 1 <PIG> for 1 <FOOD> or 1 <CATTLE> for 2 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.C138_AnimalFeeder.name: Animal Feeder
messages.cardFaces.C139_BasketmakersWife.descript: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <REED> and 1 <FOOD>. At any time, you can turn 1 <REED> into 2 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.C139_BasketmakersWife.name: Basketmaker's Wife
messages.cardFaces.C140_PackagingArtist.descripti: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <GRAIN>. Each time you get a __Minor Improvement__ action, you can take a __Bake Bread__ action instead.
messages.cardFaces.C140_PackagingArtist.name: Packaging Artist
messages.cardFaces.C141_SheepProvider.description: Each time any player (including you) uses the __Sheep Market__ accumulation space, you get 1 <GRAIN>.
messages.cardFaces.C141_SheepProvider.name: Sheep Provider
messages.cardFaces.C142_MarketCrier.description: Each time you use the __Grain Seeds__ action space, you can get an additional 1 <GRAIN> and 1 <VEGETABLE>. If you do, each other player gets 1 <GRAIN>.
messages.cardFaces.C142_MarketCrier.name: Market Crier
messages.cardFaces.C143_StoneBuyer.description: When you play this card, you can immediately buy exactly 2 <STONE> for 1 <FOOD>. From the next round on, once per round, you can buy 1 <STONE> for 2 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.C143_StoneBuyer.name: Stone Buyer
messages.cardFaces.C144_ReedRoofRenovator.descrip: Each time another player renovates, you immediately get 1 <REED> from the general supply. When you play this card in a 3-player game, you immediately get 1 <REED>.
messages.cardFaces.C144_ReedRoofRenovator.name: Reed Roof Renovator
messages.cardFaces.C145_ForestReviewer.descriptio: Each time after any player (including you) uses the unoccupied __Grove__ or __Forest__ accumulation space while the other of the two is occupied, you get 1 <REED>.
messages.cardFaces.C145_ForestReviewer.name: Forest Reviewer
messages.cardFaces.C146_WorkshopAssistant.descrip: Place unique pairs of different building resources on this card, one for each improvement you have built. Each time another player renovates, you may move one such pair to your supply.
messages.cardFaces.C146_WorkshopAssistant.name: Workshop Assistant
messages.cardFaces.C147_Cowherd.description: Each time you use the __Cattle Market__ accumulation space, you get 1 additional <CATTLE>.
messages.cardFaces.C147_Cowherd.name: Cowherd
messages.cardFaces.C148_MudWallower.description: Every fourth time you use an accumulation space, you get 1 <PIG>, held by this card.
messages.cardFaces.C148_MudWallower.name: Mud Wallower
messages.cardFaces.C149_ResourceRecycler.descript: Each time another player renovates to <STONE>, if you live in a clay house, you can pay 2 <FOOD> to build a clay room at no additional cost.
messages.cardFaces.C149_ResourceRecycler.name: Resource Recycler
messages.cardFaces.C150_ParrotBreeder.description: On your turn, if you pay 1 <GRAIN> to the general supply, you can use the same action space (unless it is the __Meeting Place__ action space) that the player to your right has just used on their turn (not retroactive).
messages.cardFaces.C150_ParrotBreeder.name: Parrot Breeder
messages.cardFaces.C151_SowingDirector.descriptio: Each time after another player uses the __Grain Utilization__ action space, you get a __Sow__ action.
messages.cardFaces.C151_SowingDirector.name: Sowing Director
messages.cardFaces.C152_Puppeteer.description: Each time another player uses the __Traveling Players__ accumulation space, you can pay them 1 <FOOD> to immediately play an occupation without paying an occupation cost.
messages.cardFaces.C152_Puppeteer.name: Puppeteer
messages.cardFaces.C153_PatternMaker.description: Each time another player renovates, you can exchange exactly 2 <WOOD> for 1 <GRAIN>, 1 <FOOD>, and 1 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.cardFaces.C153_PatternMaker.name: Pattern Maker
messages.cardFaces.C154_TwinResearcher.descriptio: Each time you use one of the two accumulation spaces for the same type of good containing exactly the same number of goods, you can also buy 1 bonus <SCORE> for 1 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.C154_TwinResearcher.name: Twin Researcher
messages.cardFaces.C155_FoodDistributor.descripti: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <GRAIN> and, at the start of this returning home phase, an amount of <FOOD> equal to the number of occupied Round 1-14 action spaces.
messages.cardFaces.C155_FoodDistributor.name: Food Distributor
messages.cardFaces.C156_HoofCaregiver.description: Immediately add 1 <CATTLE> from the general supply to the __Cattle Market__ accumulation space. Afterward, for each cattle on __Cattle Market__, you get 1 <GRAIN> plus 1 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.C156_HoofCaregiver.name: Hoof Caregiver
messages.cardFaces.C157_ResourceAnalyzer.descript: Before the start of each round, if you have more building resources than all other players of at least two types, you get 1 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.C157_ResourceAnalyzer.name: Resource Analyzer
messages.cardFaces.C158_ForestCampaigner.descript: Each time before you place a person, if there are at least 8 <WOOD> total on accumulation spaces, you get 1 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.C158_ForestCampaigner.name: Forest Campaigner
messages.cardFaces.C159_FishermansFriend.descript: At the start of each round, if there is more <FOOD> on the __Traveling Players__ than on the __Fishing__ accumulation space, you get the difference from the general supply.
messages.cardFaces.C159_FishermansFriend.name: Fisherman's Friend
messages.cardFaces.C160_Outrider.description: Each time before you use the action space on the most recently revealed action space card (after it has been placed on the round space), you get 1 <GRAIN>.
messages.cardFaces.C160_Outrider.name: Outrider
messages.cardFaces.C161_PotatoDigger.description: When you play this card, if you have at least 2/4/5 unplanted <FIELD> tiles, you immediately get 1/2/3 <VEGETABLE>.
messages.cardFaces.C161_PotatoDigger.name: Potato Digger
messages.cardFaces.C162_ForestOwner.description: This card is an action space for all. If another player uses it, they get 3 <WOOD> and must give you 1 <WOOD> from the general supply. If you use it, you get 4 <WOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.C162_ForestOwner.name: Forest Owner
messages.cardFaces.C163_MaterialDeliveryman.descr: Each time any player (including you) takes 5/6/7/8+ goods from an accumulation space, you get 1 <WOOD>/<CLAY>/<REED>/<STONE> from the general supply.
messages.cardFaces.C163_MaterialDeliveryman.name: Material Deliveryman
messages.cardFaces.C164_GermanHeathKeeper.descrip: Each time any player (including you) uses the __Pig Market__ accumulation space, you get 1 <SHEEP> from the general supply.
messages.cardFaces.C164_GermanHeathKeeper.name: German Heath Keeper
messages.cardFaces.C165_GameCatcher.description: When you play this card, pay 1 <FOOD> for each remaining harvest to immediately get 1 <CATTLE> and 1 <PIG>.
messages.cardFaces.C165_GameCatcher.name: Game Catcher
messages.cardFaces.C166_CattleWhisperer.descripti: Add 5 and 8 to the current round and place 1 <CATTLE> on each corresponding round space. At the start of these rounds, you get the <CATTLE>.
messages.cardFaces.C166_CattleWhisperer.name: Cattle Whisperer
messages.cardFaces.C167_CattleBuyer.description: Each time another player uses the __Fencing__ action space, you can buy exactly 1 <SHEEP>/<PIG>/<CATTLE> from the general supply for 1/2/2 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.C167_CattleBuyer.name: Cattle Buyer
messages.cardFaces.C168_AnimalCatcher.description: Each time you use the __Day Laborer__ action space, instead of 2 <FOOD>, you can get 3 different animals from the general supply. If you do, you must pay 1 <FOOD> each harvest left to play.
messages.cardFaces.C168_AnimalCatcher.name: Animal Catcher
messages.cardFaces.C169_FastMason.description: Immediately after each time you use a <CLAY>/<STONE> accumulation space, you can renovate your house to <CLAY>/<STONE> without paying <REED>.
messages.cardFaces.C169_FastMason.name: Fast Mason
messages.cardFaces.C170_AmateurFencer.description: When you play this card, if you have no pastures yet, you can immediately <FENCE> exactly 1 space in your farmyard without paying <WOOD> for the <FENCE>.
messages.cardFaces.C170_AmateurFencer.name: Amateur Fencer
messages.cardFaces.C171_YoungArtist.description: In the returning home phase of each round, you can pay 1 <FOOD> to either take a __Minor Improvement__ action or to draw 2 new minor improvements.
messages.cardFaces.C171_YoungArtist.name: Young Artist
messages.cardFaces.C172_FieldCounter.description: Each time another player plows a <FIELD>, place 1 <FOOD> on this card. Once this game, you can turn this card face down to get the <FOOD> on it.
messages.cardFaces.C172_FieldCounter.name: Field Counter
messages.cardFaces.C173_TopOuter.description: Each time the __House Building__ action space on the game board extension is used, you get all of the <FOOD> from the __Traveling Players__ accumulation space.
messages.cardFaces.C173_TopOuter.name: Top-Outer
messages.cardFaces.C174_StoneCustodian.descriptio: At the end of each work phase, if 1 <STONE> accumulation space has <STONE> left, you get 1 <GRAIN> If 2 <STONE> accumulation spaces have <STONE> left, you get 1 <VEGETABLE> instead.
messages.cardFaces.C174_StoneCustodian.name: Stone Custodian
messages.cardFaces.C175_VillageTeacher.descriptio: Immediately after each time you use a __Lessons__ action space, if this is the 1st/2nd/3rd occupied __Lessons__ action space that round, you get 1 <FOOD>/<GRAIN>/<VEGETABLE>.
messages.cardFaces.C175_VillageTeacher.name: Village Teacher
messages.cardFaces.C176_Cleanacre.description: Each time you use the __Farmland__, __Cultivation__, or __Farm Supplies__ action (the latter only being available with 6 players), you also get 2 <CLAY>.
messages.cardFaces.C176_Cleanacre.name: Cleanacre
messages.cardFaces.C177_MountainHiker.description: Immediately after each time you use an accumulation space on the game board extension, you can buy 1 <STONE> for 1 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.C177_MountainHiker.name: Mountain Hiker
messages.cardFaces.C178_OnSiteReverend.descriptio: At the start of each harvest, you get 1 building resource of your choice.
messages.cardFaces.C178_OnSiteReverend.name: On-Site Reverend
messages.cardFaces.C179_BovinePioneer.description: Each time you create at least one new pasture from unfenced farmyard spaces you get 1 <CATTLE>.
messages.cardFaces.C179_BovinePioneer.name: Bovine Pioneer
messages.cardFaces.C180_Trapper.description: Each time after you use a <WOOD> accumulation space, if this is the 2nd/3rd/4th occupied <WOOD> accumulation space that round, you can buy 1 <SHEEP>/<PIG>/<CATTLE> for 1 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.C180_Trapper.name: Trapper
messages.cardFaces.CUSTOM_FixtureHarvester.descri: Each harvest, gain 1 <FOOD>. (Community deck fixture card; not a real card.)
messages.cardFaces.CUSTOM_FixtureHarvester.name: Fixture Harvester
messages.cardFaces.D001_ZigzagHarrow.description: You can immediately plow 1 <FIELD> such that it completes a "zigzag" pattern.
messages.cardFaces.D001_ZigzagHarrow.name: Zigzag Harrow
messages.cardFaces.D002_DwellingPlan.description: You can immediately take a __Renovation__ action.
messages.cardFaces.D002_DwellingPlan.name: Dwelling Plan
messages.cardFaces.D003_Furrows.description: You can immediately sow in exactly 1 <FIELD>.
messages.cardFaces.D003_Furrows.name: Furrows
messages.cardFaces.D004_CrossCutWood.description: You immediately get a number of <WOOD> equal to the number of <STONE> in your supply.
messages.cardFaces.D004_CrossCutWood.name: Cross-Cut Wood
messages.cardFaces.D005_FieldClay.description: You immediately get 1 <CLAY> for each planted <FIELD> you have.
messages.cardFaces.D005_FieldClay.name: Field Clay
messages.cardFaces.D006_PetrifiedWood.description: Immediately exchange up to 3 <WOOD> for 1 <STONE> each.
messages.cardFaces.D006_PetrifiedWood.name: Petrified Wood
messages.cardFaces.D007_Trident.description: If you play this card in round 3/6/9/12, you immediately get 3/4/5/6 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.D007_Trident.name: Trident
messages.cardFaces.D008_FernSeeds.description: You get 2 <FOOD> and 1 <GRAIN>, which you must sow immediately.
messages.cardFaces.D008_FernSeeds.name: Fern Seeds
messages.cardFaces.D009_GameTrade.description: You immediately get 1 <PIG> and 1 <CATTLE>. (effectively, you are exchanging 2 <SHEEP> for 1 <PIG> and 1 <CATTLE>.)
messages.cardFaces.D009_GameTrade.name: Game Trade
messages.cardFaces.D010_StorksNest.description: In the returning home phase of each round, if you have more rooms than people, you can pay 1 <FOOD> to take a __Family Growth__ action.
messages.cardFaces.D010_StorksNest.name: Stork's Nest
messages.cardFaces.D011_LawnFertilizer.descriptio: Your pastures of size 1 can hold up to 3 animals of the same type. (With a <STABLE>, they can hold up to 6 animals of the same type.)
messages.cardFaces.D011_LawnFertilizer.name: Lawn Fertilizer
messages.cardFaces.D012_MilkingPlace.description: In the feeding phase of each harvest, you get 1 <FOOD>. You can no longer hold animals in your house (not even via another card).
messages.cardFaces.D012_MilkingPlace.name: Milking Place
messages.cardFaces.D013_Trowel.description: At any time, you can renovate your house to <STONE>. From a wooden house, this costs 1 <STONE>, 1 <REED>, and 1 <FOOD> per room. From a clay house, this costs 1 <STONE> per room.
messages.cardFaces.D013_Trowel.name: Trowel
messages.cardFaces.D014_HammerCrusher.description: Immediately before you renovate to stone, you get 2 <CLAY> and 1 <REED> and you can take a __Build Rooms__ action.
messages.cardFaces.D014_HammerCrusher.name: Hammer Crusher
messages.cardFaces.D015_ClaySupports.description: Each time you build a clay room, you can pay 2 <CLAY>, 1 <WOOD>, and 1 <REED> instead of 5 <CLAY> and 2 <REED>.
messages.cardFaces.D015_ClaySupports.name: Clay Supports
messages.cardFaces.D016_WoodenWheyBucket.descript: Each time before you use the __Sheep Market__/__Cattle Market__ accumulation space, you can build exactly 1 <STABLE> for 1 <WOOD>/at no cost.
messages.cardFaces.D016_WoodenWheyBucket.name: Wooden Whey Bucket
messages.cardFaces.D017_DrillHarrow.description: Each time before you take an unconditional __Sow__ action, you can pay 3 <FOOD> to plow 1 <FIELD>.
messages.cardFaces.D017_DrillHarrow.name: Drill Harrow
messages.cardFaces.D018_SteamPlow.description: Immediately after each returning home phase, you can pay 2 <WOOD> and 1 <FOOD> to use the __Farmland__ action space without placing a person.
messages.cardFaces.D018_SteamPlow.name: Steam Plow
messages.cardFaces.D019_PulverizerPlow.descriptio: Immediately after each time you use a <CLAY> accumulation space, you can pay 1 <CLAY> to plow 1 <FIELD>. If you do, place that 1 <CLAY> on the accumulation space.
messages.cardFaces.D019_PulverizerPlow.name: Pulverizer Plow
messages.cardFaces.D020_TurnwrestPlow.description: Place 2 field tiles on this card. Each time you use the __Farmland__ or __Cultivation__ action space, you can also plow up to 2 fields from this card.
messages.cardFaces.D020_TurnwrestPlow.name: Turnwrest Plow
messages.cardFaces.D021_Recruitment.description: From round 5 on, provided you have room in your house, each time you get a __Minor Improvement__ action, you can take a __Family Growth__ action instead.
messages.cardFaces.D021_Recruitment.name: Recruitment
messages.cardFaces.D021_Recruitment.prerequisite: No People Left in the House
messages.cardFaces.D022_WorkPermit.description: Add 1 to the current round for each building resource you have and place 1 person from your supply on the corresponding round space. In that round, you can use the person.
messages.cardFaces.D022_WorkPermit.name: Work Permit
messages.cardFaces.D023_PioneeringSpirit.descript: This card is an action space for you only. In rounds 3-5, it provides a __Renovation__ action. In rounds 6-8, it provides your choice of 1 <VEGETABLE>, <PIG>, or <CATTLE>.
messages.cardFaces.D023_PioneeringSpirit.name: Pioneering Spirit
messages.cardFaces.D024_BrotherlyLove.description: As long as you have exactly 4 people, in the work phase of each round, you can place your third and fourth person immediately after one another, even on the same action space.
messages.cardFaces.D024_BrotherlyLove.name: Brotherly Love
messages.cardFaces.D025_WitchesDanceFloor.descrip: This card is a field that you can sow in, an occupation, and the "Fireplace" major improvement with all of its effects. You can play it only via a __Minor Improvement__ action.
messages.cardFaces.D025_WitchesDanceFloor.name: Witches' Dance Floor
messages.cardFaces.D026_CarpentersYard.descriptio: You can build the __Joinery__ and __Well__ major improvement even when taking a __Minor Improvement__ action, or you can build both with a single __Major Improvement__ action.
messages.cardFaces.D026_CarpentersYard.name: Carpenter's Yard
messages.cardFaces.D027_Retraining.description: At the end of each turn in which you renovate, you can exchange your __Joinery__ for the __Pottery__ or your __Pottery__ for the __Basketmaker\\
messages.cardFaces.D027_Retraining.name: Retraining
messages.cardFaces.D028_WritingDesk.description: Each time you use a __Lessons__ action space, you can play 1 additional occupation for an occupation cost of 2 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.D028_WritingDesk.name: Writing Desk
messages.cardFaces.D029_MuckRake.description: During scoring, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> for exactly 1 unfenced <STABLE> holding exactly 1 <SHEEP>. The same applies to <PIG> and <CATTLE>, if held in different unfenced <STABLE>.
messages.cardFaces.D029_MuckRake.name: Muck Rake
messages.cardFaces.D030_ArtisanDistrict.descripti: During scoring, you get 2/5/8 bonus <SCORE> for having 3/4/5 major improvements from the bottom row of the supply board.
messages.cardFaces.D030_ArtisanDistrict.name: Artisan District
messages.cardFaces.D031_Storeroom.description: During scoring, you get ½ bonus <SCORE> for each pair of <GRAIN> plus <VEGETABLE> you have (considering all crops in your supply and <FIELD>), rounded up.
messages.cardFaces.D031_Storeroom.name: Storeroom
messages.cardFaces.D032_WoodRake.description: During scoring, if you had at least 7 goods in your <FIELD> before the final harvest, you get 2 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.cardFaces.D032_WoodRake.name: Wood Rake
messages.cardFaces.D033_SummerHouse.description: During scoring, if you live in a stone house, you get 2 bonus <SCORE> for each unused farmyard space orthogonally adjacent to your house. (You still lose the points for these unused spaces.)
messages.cardFaces.D033_SummerHouse.name: Summer House
messages.cardFaces.D034_LuxuriousHostel.descripti: During scoring, if you then have more stone rooms than people, you get 4 bonus <SCORE>. You can only use one card to get bonus <SCORE> for your stone house.
messages.cardFaces.D034_LuxuriousHostel.name: Luxurious Hostel
messages.cardFaces.D035_FodderChamber.description: During scoring in a game with 1/2/3/4+ players, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> for every 7th/5th/4th/3rd animal on your farm.
messages.cardFaces.D035_FodderChamber.name: Fodder Chamber
messages.cardFaces.D036_BreedRegistry.description: During scoring, if you gained at most 2 <SHEEP> from sources other than breeding during the game and have not turned any sheep into food, you get 3 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.cardFaces.D036_BreedRegistry.name: Breed Registry
messages.cardFaces.D037_Sculpture.description: You can only play this card if there are more complete rounds left to play than you have unused farmyard spaces.
messages.cardFaces.D037_Sculpture.name: Sculpture
messages.cardFaces.D038_MilkingStool.description: In the field phase of each harvest, if you have at least 1/3/5 <CATTLE>, you get 1/2/3 <FOOD>. During scoring, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> for every 2 <CATTLE> you have.
messages.cardFaces.D038_MilkingStool.name: Milking Stool
messages.cardFaces.D039_TruffleSlicer.description: Each time you use a <WOOD> accumulation space, if you have at least 1 <PIG>, you can pay 1 <FOOD> for 1 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.cardFaces.D039_TruffleSlicer.name: Truffle Slicer
messages.cardFaces.D040_Cesspit.description: Alternate placing 1 <CLAY> and 1 <PIG> on each remaining round space, starting with <CLAY>. At the start of these rounds, you get the respective good.
messages.cardFaces.D040_Cesspit.name: Cesspit
messages.cardFaces.D041_HorseDrawnBoat.descriptio: Alternate placing 1 <FOOD> and 1 <SHEEP> on each remaining round space, starting with <FOOD>. At the start of these rounds, you get the respective good.
messages.cardFaces.D041_HorseDrawnBoat.name: Horse-Drawn Boat
messages.cardFaces.D042_EducationBonus.descriptio: After you play your 1st/2nd/3rd/4th/5th/6th occupation this game, you immediately get 1 <GRAIN>/<CLAY>/<REED>/<STONE>/<VEGETABLE>/<FIELD> (not retroactively).
messages.cardFaces.D042_EducationBonus.name: Education Bonus
messages.cardFaces.D043_Hutch.description: Place 0, 1, 2, and 3 <FOOD> in this order on the next 4 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.D043_Hutch.name: Hutch
messages.cardFaces.D044_ForestWell.description: Place 1 <FOOD> on each remaining round space, up to the amount of <WOOD> in your supply. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.D044_ForestWell.name: Forest Well
messages.cardFaces.D045_SheepWell.description: Place 1 <FOOD> on each of the next round spaces, up to the number of <SHEEP> you have. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.D045_SheepWell.name: Sheep Well
messages.cardFaces.D046_PelletPress.description: Once per round, you can pay 1 <REED>. If you do, place 1 <FOOD> on each of the next 4 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.D046_PelletPress.name: Pellet Press
messages.cardFaces.D047_Churchyard.description: Place 2 <FOOD> on each remaining round space. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>. (*Occupations and Improvements)
messages.cardFaces.D047_Churchyard.name: Churchyard
messages.cardFaces.D048_CivicFacade.description: Before the start of each round, if you have more occupations than improvements in your hand, you get 1 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.D048_CivicFacade.name: Civic Facade
messages.cardFaces.D049_Bookshelf.description: Immediately before each time you play an occupation (even before paying the occupation cost), you get 3 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.D049_Bookshelf.name: Bookshelf
messages.cardFaces.D050_ForeignAid.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 6 <FOOD>. You may no longer use the action spaces of rounds 12 to 14.
messages.cardFaces.D050_ForeignAid.name: Foreign Aid
messages.cardFaces.D051_Archway.description: This card is an action space for all. A player who uses it immediately gets 1 <FOOD>. Immediately before the returning home phase, they can use an unoccupied action space with the person from this card.
messages.cardFaces.D051_Archway.name: Archway
messages.cardFaces.D052_RollingPin.description: In the returning home phase of each round, if you have more <CLAY> than <WOOD> in your supply, you get 1 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.D052_RollingPin.name: Rolling Pin
messages.cardFaces.D053_TeaHouse.description: Once per round, you can skip placing your second person and get 1 <FOOD> instead. (You can place the person later that round.)
messages.cardFaces.D053_TeaHouse.name: Tea House
messages.cardFaces.D054_TroutPool.description: At the start of each work phase, if there are at least 3 <FOOD> on the __Fishing__ accumulation space, you get 1 <FOOD> from the general supply.
messages.cardFaces.D054_TroutPool.name: Trout Pool
messages.cardFaces.D055_NewMarket.description: Each time you use an action space card on round spaces 8 to 11, you get 1 additional <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.D055_NewMarket.name: New Market
messages.cardFaces.D056_FatstockStretcher.descrip: Each time you turn a <SHEEP> or <PIG> into <FOOD> using a cooking improvement, you get 1 additional <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.D056_FatstockStretcher.name: Fatstock Stretcher
messages.cardFaces.D057_WholesaleMarket.descripti: Place 1 <FOOD> on each remaining round space. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.D057_WholesaleMarket.name: Wholesale Market
messages.cardFaces.D058_Gritter.description: At the end of each action in which you sow <VEGETABLE> in a <FIELD>, you get 1 <FOOD> for each <VEGETABLE> <FIELD> you have (including the new ones).
messages.cardFaces.D058_Gritter.name: Gritter
messages.cardFaces.D059_EarthOven.name: Earth Oven
messages.cardFaces.D060_LargePottery.name: Large Pottery
messages.cardFaces.D061_BaleofStraw.description: At the start of each harvest, if you have at least 3 <GRAIN> <FIELD> (including <FIELD> cards with planted <GRAIN>), you get 2 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.D061_BaleofStraw.name: Bale of Straw
messages.cardFaces.D062_BeerTap.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 2 <FOOD>. In the feeding phase of each harvest, you can turn 2/3/4 <GRAIN> into 3/6/9 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.D062_BeerTap.name: Beer Tap
messages.cardFaces.D063_Lynchet.description: In the field phase of each harvest, you get 1 <FOOD> for each harvested <FIELD> tile that is orthogonally adjacent to your house.
messages.cardFaces.D063_Lynchet.name: Lynchet
messages.cardFaces.D064_BakingCourse.description:
[__Bake Bread__ action:]
<GRAIN> <ARROW> 2<FOOD>
At the end of each round that does not end with a harvest, you can take a __Bake Bread__ action.
messages.cardFaces.D064_BakingCourse.name: Baking Course
messages.cardFaces.D065_GrainSieve.description: In the field phase of each harvest, if you harvest at least 2 <GRAIN>, you get 1 additional <GRAIN> from the general supply.
messages.cardFaces.D065_GrainSieve.name: Grain Sieve
messages.cardFaces.D066_PotterCeramics.descriptio: Each time before you take a __Bake Bread__ action, you can exchange 1 <CLAY> for 1 <GRAIN>.
messages.cardFaces.D066_PotterCeramics.name: Potter Ceramics
messages.cardFaces.D067_ReapHook.description: Place 1 <GRAIN> on each of the next 3 of the round spaces 4, 7, 9, 11, 13, and 14. At the start of these rounds, you get the <GRAIN>.
messages.cardFaces.D067_ReapHook.name: Reap Hook
messages.cardFaces.D068_SmallBasket.description: Each time after you use the __Reed Bank__ accumulation space, you can pay 1 <REED> to get 1 <VEGETABLE>. If you do in a game with 4+ players, place that 1 <REED> on the accumulation space.
messages.cardFaces.D068_SmallBasket.name: Small Basket
messages.cardFaces.D069_SmallGreenhouse.descripti: Add 4 and 7 to the current round and place 1 <VEGETABLE> on each corresponding round space. At the start of these rounds, you can buy the <VEGETABLE> for 1 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.D069_SmallGreenhouse.name: Small Greenhouse
messages.cardFaces.D070_StrawManure.description: Before the field phase of each harvest, you can pay 1 <GRAIN> from your supply to add 1 <VEGETABLE> to each of up to 2 vegetable fields.
messages.cardFaces.D070_StrawManure.name: Straw Manure
messages.cardFaces.D071_Changeover.description: At any time, if a field contains exactly 1 good as a result of a harvest, you can discard that good and immediately take a __Sow__ action limited to that field.
messages.cardFaces.D071_Changeover.name: Changeover
messages.cardFaces.D072_StableManure.description: In the field phase of each harvest, you can harvest 1 additional good from a number of fields equal to the number of unfenced stables you have.
messages.cardFaces.D072_StableManure.name: Stable Manure
messages.cardFaces.D073_SupplyBoat.description: Each time after you use the __Fishing__ accumulation space, you can choose to buy 1 <GRAIN> for 1 <FOOD>, or 1 <VEGETABLE> for 3 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.D073_SupplyBoat.name: Supply Boat
messages.cardFaces.D074_RoyalWood.description: At the end of each turn in which you use the __Farm Expansion__ action space or build an improvement, you get 1 <WOOD> back for every 2 <WOOD> paid during those actions (rounded down).
messages.cardFaces.D074_RoyalWood.name: Royal Wood
messages.cardFaces.D075_WoodField.description: You can plant <WOOD> on this card as though it were 2 <FIELD>, but it is considered 1 <FIELD>. Sow and harvest <WOOD> on this card as you would <GRAIN>.
messages.cardFaces.D075_WoodField.name: Wood Field
messages.cardFaces.D076_SocialBenefits.descriptio: Immediately after the feeding phase of each harvest, if you have no <FOOD> left, you get 1 <WOOD> and 1 <CLAY>.
messages.cardFaces.D076_SocialBenefits.name: Social Benefits
messages.cardFaces.D077_RecycledBrick.description: Each time any player (including you) renovates to <STONE>, you get 1 <CLAY> for each newly renovated room.
messages.cardFaces.D077_RecycledBrick.name: Recycled Brick
messages.cardFaces.D078_ReedPond.description: Place 1 <REED> on each of the next 3 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <REED>.
messages.cardFaces.D078_ReedPond.name: Reed Pond
messages.cardFaces.D079_CarrotMuseum.description: At the end of rounds 8, 10, and 12, you get 1 <STONE> for each <VEGETABLE> <FIELD> you have and a number of <WOOD> equal to the number of <VEGETABLE> in your supply.
messages.cardFaces.D079_CarrotMuseum.name: Carrot Museum
messages.cardFaces.D080_BrickHammer.description: Each time after you build an improvement costing at least 2 <CLAY>, you get 1 <STONE>.
messages.cardFaces.D080_BrickHammer.name: Brick Hammer
messages.cardFaces.D081_RoofLadder.description: Each time you renovate, you pay 1 fewer <REED> and, at the end of the action, you get 1 <STONE>.
messages.cardFaces.D081_RoofLadder.name: Roof Ladder
messages.cardFaces.D082_HuntingTrophy.description:
To play this card, you must return or cook 1 <PIG>.
Improvements built on __House Redevelopment__ cost you 1 building resource of your choice less. <FENCE> built on __Farm Redevelopment__ cost you a total of 3 <WOOD> less.
messages.cardFaces.D082_HuntingTrophy.name: Hunting Trophy
messages.cardFaces.D083_Pigswill.description: Each time you use the __Fencing__ action space, you also get 1 <PIG>.
messages.cardFaces.D083_Pigswill.name: Pigswill
messages.cardFaces.D084_FeedPellets.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <SHEEP>. In the feeding phase of each harvest, you can exchange exactly 1 <VEGETABLE> for 1 animal of a type you already have.
messages.cardFaces.D084_FeedPellets.name: Feed Pellets
messages.cardFaces.D085_Reader.description: As soon as you have 6 (7 in draft mode) occupations in front of you (including this one), this card provides room for one person.
messages.cardFaces.D085_Reader.name: Reader
messages.cardFaces.D085_Reader.rules: In simultaneous draft mode, the occupation threshold is fixed at 7, regardless of draft pool size.
messages.cardFaces.D086_SheepAgent.description: You can keep 1 <SHEEP> on this card for each occupation card in front of you (including this one), unless it is already able to hold animals.
messages.cardFaces.D086_SheepAgent.name: Sheep Agent
messages.cardFaces.D087_MasterBuilder.description: Once your house has at least 5 rooms, at any time, but only once this game, you can add another room at no cost.
messages.cardFaces.D087_MasterBuilder.name: Master Builder
messages.cardFaces.D088_Millwright.description: You immediately get 1 <GRAIN>. Each time you build <FENCE>, <STABLE>, and rooms, or renovate your house, you can replace up to 2 building resources of any type with 1 <GRAIN> each.
messages.cardFaces.D088_Millwright.name: Millwright
messages.cardFaces.D089_Stablehand.description: Each time you build at least 1 <FENCE>, you can also build a <STABLE> without paying <WOOD> for the <STABLE>.
messages.cardFaces.D089_Stablehand.name: Stablehand
messages.cardFaces.D090_PlowMaker.description: Each time you use the __Farmland__ or __Cultivation__ action space, you can pay 1 <FOOD> to plow 1 additional <FIELD>.
messages.cardFaces.D090_PlowMaker.name: Plow Maker
messages.cardFaces.D091_Plowman.description: Add 4, 7, and 10 to the current round and place a <FIELD> tile on each corresponding round space. At the start of these rounds, you can plow the <FIELD> for 1 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.D091_Plowman.name: Plowman
messages.cardFaces.D092_ChildOmbudsman.descriptio: From round 5 on, if you have room in your house, at the end of each person action, you can take a __Family Growth__ action with that person. If you do, you get 2 negative <SCORE>.
messages.cardFaces.D092_ChildOmbudsman.name: Child Ombudsman
messages.cardFaces.D093_SheepInspector.descriptio: Once per work phase, after you complete a person action, you can pay 1 <SHEEP> and 2 <FOOD> to return another person you placed home, unless it is on the __Meeting Place__ action space.
messages.cardFaces.D093_SheepInspector.name: Sheep Inspector
messages.cardFaces.D094_HenpeckedHusband.descript: Each time you take a __Build Rooms__ action with the second person you place, return the first person you placed home, unless it is on the __Meeting Place__ action space.
messages.cardFaces.D094_HenpeckedHusband.name: Henpecked Husband
messages.cardFaces.D095_SiteManager.description: When you play this card, immediately build a major improvement. When paying its cost, you can replace up to 1 building resource of each type with 1 <FOOD> each.
messages.cardFaces.D095_SiteManager.name: Site Manager
messages.cardFaces.D096_Furnisher.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 2 <WOOD>. Each time after you build at least one new room, you can build or play a number of improvements equal to the number of new rooms you built, paying up to 1 <WOOD> less for each such improvement.
messages.cardFaces.D096_Furnisher.name: Furnisher
messages.cardFaces.D097_BeggingStudent.descriptio: When you play this card, you must immediately take 1 <BEGGING> marker. At the start of each harvest, you can play 1 occupation without paying an occupation cost.
messages.cardFaces.D097_BeggingStudent.name: Begging Student
messages.cardFaces.D098_Transactor.description: Immediately before the final harvest at the end of round 14, you can take all the building resources that are left on the entire game board.
messages.cardFaces.D098_Transactor.name: Transactor
messages.cardFaces.D099_EarthenwarePotter.descrip: If you play this card in round 4 or before, after the final harvest, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> for each person for which you then pay 1 <CLAY>.
messages.cardFaces.D099_EarthenwarePotter.name: Earthenware Potter
messages.cardFaces.D100_LordoftheManor.descriptio: During scoring, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> for each scoring category in which you score the maximum 4 points. (The bonus point is also awarded for 4 fenced stables.)
messages.cardFaces.D100_LordoftheManor.name: Lord of the Manor
messages.cardFaces.D101_SugarBaker.description: Each time after you use the __Grain Utilization__ action space, you can buy 1 bonus <SCORE> for 1 <FOOD>. Place the <FOOD> on the action space (for the next visitor).
messages.cardFaces.D101_SugarBaker.name: Sugar Baker
messages.cardFaces.D102_SampleStableMaker.descrip: At the start of each returning home phase, you can return a built stable to your supply to get 1 <WOOD>, 1 <GRAIN>, 1 <FOOD>, and a __Minor Improvement__ action.
messages.cardFaces.D102_SampleStableMaker.name: Sample Stable Maker
messages.cardFaces.D103_CanalBoatman.description: Each time you use __Fishing__ or __Reed Bank__, you can pay 1 <FOOD> to immediately place another person on this card. If you do, you get your choice of 3 <STONE> or 1 <GRAIN> plus 1 <VEGETABLE>.
messages.cardFaces.D103_CanalBoatman.name: Canal Boatman
messages.cardFaces.D104_Cultivator.description: For each new <FIELD> tile you get, you also get 1 <WOOD> and 1 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.D104_Cultivator.name: Cultivator
messages.cardFaces.D105_Sculptor.description: Each time you use a <CLAY> accumulation space, you also get 1 <FOOD>. Each time you use a <STONE> accumulation space, you also get 1 <GRAIN>.
messages.cardFaces.D105_Sculptor.name: Sculptor
messages.cardFaces.D106_WhiskyDistiller.descripti: At any time, you can pay 1 <GRAIN>. If you do, add 2 to the current round and place 4 <FOOD> on the corresponding round space. At the start of that round, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.D106_WhiskyDistiller.name: Whisky Distiller
messages.cardFaces.D107_Bellfounder.description: In the returning home phase of each round, if you have at least 1 <CLAY>, you can use this card to discard all of your <CLAY> and get your choice of 3 <FOOD> or 1 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.cardFaces.D107_Bellfounder.name: Bellfounder
messages.cardFaces.D108_StoneCarver.description: Each harvest, you can use this card to turn exactly 1 <STONE> into 3 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.D108_StoneCarver.name: Stone Carver
messages.cardFaces.D109_SowingMaster.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <WOOD>. Each time after you use the __Grain Utilization__ or __Cultivation__ action space, you get 2 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.D109_SowingMaster.name: Sowing Master
messages.cardFaces.D110_FishFarmer.description: Each time there is 1/2/3+ <FOOD> on the __Fishing__ accumulation space, you get an additional 2 <FOOD> on the __Reed Bank__/ __Clay Pit__/ __Forest__ accumulation spaces.
messages.cardFaces.D110_FishFarmer.name: Fish Farmer
messages.cardFaces.D111_InteriorDecorator.descrip: Each time you renovate, place 1 <FOOD> on each of the next 6 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.D111_InteriorDecorator.name: Interior Decorator
messages.cardFaces.D112_YoungFarmer.description: Each time you use the __Major Improvement__ action space, you also get 1 <GRAIN> and, afterward, you can take a __Sow__ action.
messages.cardFaces.D112_YoungFarmer.name: Young Farmer
messages.cardFaces.D113_FoodMerchant.description: For each <GRAIN> you harvest from a <FIELD>, you can buy 1 <VEGETABLE> for 3 <FOOD>. If you harvest the last <GRAIN> from a <FIELD>, the <VEGETABLE> costs you only 2 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.D113_FoodMerchant.name: Food Merchant
messages.cardFaces.D114_SeedTrader.description: Place 2 <GRAIN> and 2 <VEGETABLE> on this card. You can buy them at any time. Each <GRAIN> costs 2 <FOOD>; each <VEGETABLE> costs 3 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.D114_SeedTrader.name: Seed Trader
