messages.cardFaces.D115_FodderPlanter.description: In the breeding phase of each harvest, for each newborn animal you get, you can sow crops in exactly 1 field.
messages.cardFaces.D115_FodderPlanter.name: Fodder Planter
messages.cardFaces.D116_TreeInspector.description: This card is a 1 <WOOD> accumulation space for you only. Each time the newly revealed action space card is a __Quarry__ accumulation space, you must discard all <WOOD> from this card.
messages.cardFaces.D116_TreeInspector.name: Tree Inspector
messages.cardFaces.D117_WoodExpert.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 2 <WOOD>. Each improvement costs you up to 2 <WOOD> less, if you pay 1 <FOOD> instead.
messages.cardFaces.D117_WoodExpert.name: Wood Expert
messages.cardFaces.D118_Bonehead.description: When you play this card, immediately place 6 <WOOD> on it. Immediately after each time you play a card from your hand, including this one, you get 1 <WOOD> from this card.
messages.cardFaces.D118_Bonehead.name: Bonehead
messages.cardFaces.D119_WoodBarterer.description: Each time before you use an action space with a __Build Fences__ or __Build Rooms__ action, you can choose to either get 2 <WOOD> or exchange up to 2 <WOOD> for 1 <REED> each.
messages.cardFaces.D119_WoodBarterer.name: Wood Barterer
messages.cardFaces.D120_ClayDeliveryman.descripti: Place 1 <CLAY> on each remaining space for rounds 6 to 14. At the start of these rounds, you get the <CLAY>.
messages.cardFaces.D120_ClayDeliveryman.name: Clay Deliveryman
messages.cardFaces.D121_ClayPlasterer.description: Renovating to <CLAY> only costs you exactly 1 <CLAY> and 1 <REED>. Each clay room only costs you 3 <CLAY> and 2 <REED> to build.
messages.cardFaces.D121_ClayPlasterer.name: Clay Plasterer
messages.cardFaces.D122_ClayCarrier.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 2 <CLAY>. At any time, but only once per round, you can buy 2 <CLAY> for 2 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.D122_ClayCarrier.name: Clay Carrier
messages.cardFaces.D123_RenovationPreparer.descri: For each new <WOOD>/clay room you build, you get 2 <CLAY>/2 <STONE>.
messages.cardFaces.D123_RenovationPreparer.name: Renovation Preparer
messages.cardFaces.D124_Emissary.description: At any time, you can place a good from your supply on this card to get 1 <STONE>. You must place different goods on this card. (<FOOD> is also considered a good.)
messages.cardFaces.D124_Emissary.name: Emissary
messages.cardFaces.D125_ForestTrader.description: Each time you use a <WOOD> or <CLAY> accumulation space, you can also buy exactly 1 building resource. <WOOD>, <CLAY>, and <REED> cost 1 <FOOD> each; <STONE> costs 2 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.D125_ForestTrader.name: Forest Trader
messages.cardFaces.D126_FieldCultivator.descripti: Pile 1 <WOOD>, 1 <CLAY>, 1 <REED>, 1 <STONE>, 1 <REED>, 1 <CLAY>, and 1 <WOOD> on this card. Each time you harvest a field tile, you can also take the top good from the pile.
messages.cardFaces.D126_FieldCultivator.name: Field Cultivator
messages.cardFaces.D127_HardworkingMan.descriptio: This card is an action space for you only. If each other player has more rooms than you, it provides the __Day Laborer__, __Build Rooms__, and __Major Improvement__ actions (all three).
messages.cardFaces.D127_HardworkingMan.name: Hardworking Man
messages.cardFaces.D128_BuildingTycoon.descriptio: Each time after another player builds 1 or more rooms, you can give them 1 <FOOD> to build exactly 1 room yourself. (You must pay the building cost of the room.)
messages.cardFaces.D128_BuildingTycoon.name: Building Tycoon
messages.cardFaces.D129_LumberVirtuoso.descriptio: Each harvest in which you have at least 5 <WOOD> in your supply, you can discard down to 5 <WOOD> to take a __Build Stables__ or __Build Wood Rooms__ action by paying the usual costs.
messages.cardFaces.D129_LumberVirtuoso.name: Lumber Virtuoso
messages.cardFaces.D130_RecreationalCarpenter.des: At the end of each work phase in which you did not use the __Meeting Place__ action space, you can take a __Build Rooms__ action without placing a person.
messages.cardFaces.D131_CraftsmanshipPromoter.des: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <STONE>. You can build any of the major improvements in the bottom row of the supply board even when taking a __Minor Improvement__ action.
messages.cardFaces.D132_HideFarmer.description: During scoring, you can pay 1 <FOOD> each for any number of unused farmyard spaces. You do not lose points for these spaces.
messages.cardFaces.D132_HideFarmer.name: Hide Farmer
messages.cardFaces.D133_BeerTentOperator.descript: In the feeding phase of each harvest, you can use this card to turn 1 <WOOD> plus 1 <GRAIN> into 1 bonus <SCORE> and 2 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.D133_BeerTentOperator.name: Beer Tent Operator
messages.cardFaces.D134_OysterEater.description: Each time the __Fishing__ accumulation space is used, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> and must skip placing your next person that round. (You can place the person on a later turn.)
messages.cardFaces.D134_OysterEater.name: Oyster Eater
messages.cardFaces.D135_GardeningHeadOfficial.des: If there are still 3/6/9 complete rounds left to play, you immediately get 2/3/4 <WOOD>. During scoring, each player with the most <VEGETABLE> in their <FIELD> gets 2 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.cardFaces.D136_AnimalActivist.descriptio: If there are still 3/6/9 complete rounds left to play, you immediately get 2/3/4 <WOOD>. During scoring, each player with the most fenced <STABLE> gets 2 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.cardFaces.D136_AnimalActivist.name: Animal Activist
messages.cardFaces.D137_TradeTeacher.description: Each time after you use a __Lessons__ action space, you can buy up to 2 different goods: <GRAIN>, <STONE>, <SHEEP>, and <PIG> for 1 <FOOD> each; <CATTLE> and <VEGETABLE> for 2 <FOOD> each.
messages.cardFaces.D137_TradeTeacher.name: Trade Teacher
messages.cardFaces.D138_PetLover.description: Each time you use an accumulation space providing exactly 1 animal, you can leave it on the space and get one from the general supply instead, as well as 3 <FOOD> and 1 <GRAIN>.
messages.cardFaces.D138_PetLover.name: Pet Lover
messages.cardFaces.D139_Chairman.description: Each time another player uses the __Meeting Place__ action space, both they and you get 1 <FOOD> (before taking the actions). If you use it, you get 1 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.D139_Chairman.name: Chairman
messages.cardFaces.D140_Loudmouth.description: Each time you take at least 4 building resources or 4 animals from an accumulation space, you also get 1 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.D140_Loudmouth.name: Loudmouth
messages.cardFaces.D141_SeedSeller.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <GRAIN>. Each time you use the __Grain Seeds__ action space, you get 1 additional <GRAIN>.
messages.cardFaces.D141_SeedSeller.name: Seed Seller
messages.cardFaces.D142_PotatoPlanter.description: At the end of each work phase in which you occupy the __Clay Pit__ or __Reed Bank__ accumulation space while the respective other is unoccupied, you get 1 <VEGETABLE>.
messages.cardFaces.D142_PotatoPlanter.name: Potato Planter
messages.cardFaces.D143_TreeCutter.description: Each time you use an accumulation space providing at least 3 goods of the same type except <WOOD>, you get an additional 1 <WOOD>. (<FOOD> is also considered a good.)
messages.cardFaces.D143_TreeCutter.name: Tree Cutter
messages.cardFaces.D144_WaterWorker.description: Each time after you use any of the __Fishing__, __Reed Bank__, __Day Laborer__ spaces or the action space of round 4, you get 1 additional <REED>.
messages.cardFaces.D144_WaterWorker.name: Water Worker
messages.cardFaces.D145_RoofExaminer.description: When you play this card, if you have 1/2/3/4 major improvements, you immediately get 2/3/4/5 <REED>.
messages.cardFaces.D145_RoofExaminer.name: Roof Examiner
messages.cardFaces.D146_Porter.description: Each time you take at least 4 of the same building resource from an accumulation space, you get 1 additional building resource of the accumulating type and 1 <FOOD>
messages.cardFaces.D146_Porter.name: Porter
messages.cardFaces.D147_TrapBuilder.description: Each time you use the __Day Laborer__ action space, place 1 <FOOD>, 1 <FOOD>, and 1 <PIG> on the next 3 round spaces, respectively. At the start of these rounds, you get the good.
messages.cardFaces.D147_TrapBuilder.name: Trap Builder
messages.cardFaces.D148_DomesticianExpert.descrip: You can keep 2 <SHEEP> on the border between each pair of orthogonally adjacent rooms.
messages.cardFaces.D148_DomesticianExpert.name: Domestician Expert
messages.cardFaces.D149_CasualWorker.description: Each time another player uses a __Quarry__ accumulation space, you can choose to get 1 <FOOD> or build a <STABLE> without paying <WOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.D149_CasualWorker.name: Casual Worker
messages.cardFaces.D150_GodlySpouse.description: Each time you take a __Family Growth__ action with the second person you place in a round, return the first person you placed home, unless it is on the __Meeting Place__ action space.
messages.cardFaces.D150_GodlySpouse.name: Godly Spouse
messages.cardFaces.D151_SpinDoctor.description: Immediately after each time you use the __Traveling Players__ accumulation space, you can place another person on an action space of your choice, regardless whether or not the action space is occupied.
messages.cardFaces.D151_SpinDoctor.name: Spin Doctor
messages.cardFaces.D151_SpinDoctor.rules: No card, including this one, can allow you to use __Meeting Place__ if it is already occupied.
messages.cardFaces.D152_Patron.description: Immediately before each time you play an occupation after this one (even before paying the occupation cost), you get 2 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.D152_Patron.name: Patron
messages.cardFaces.D153_WealthyMan.description: At the start of each of the 1st/2nd/3rd/4th/5th/6th harvest, if you have at least 1/2/3/4/5/6 <GRAIN> <FIELD>, you get 1 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.cardFaces.D153_WealthyMan.name: Wealthy Man
messages.cardFaces.D154_ChimneySweep.description: Renovating to <STONE> costs you 2 <STONE> less. During scoring, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> for each other player living in a stone house.
messages.cardFaces.D154_ChimneySweep.name: Chimney Sweep
messages.cardFaces.D155_Ebonist.description: Each harvest, you can use this card to turn exactly 1 <WOOD> into 1 <FOOD> and 1 <GRAIN>.
messages.cardFaces.D155_Ebonist.name: Ebonist
messages.cardFaces.D156_RetailDealer.description: Place 3 <GRAIN> and 3 <FOOD> on this card. Each time you use the __Resource Market__ action space, you also get 1 <GRAIN> and 1 <FOOD> from this card.
messages.cardFaces.D156_RetailDealer.name: Retail Dealer
messages.cardFaces.D157_PartyOrganizer.descriptio: As soon as the next player but you gains their 5th person, you immediately get 8 <FOOD> (not retroactively). During scoring, if only you have 5 people, you get 3 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.cardFaces.D157_PartyOrganizer.name: Party Organizer
messages.cardFaces.D158_BeanCounter.description: Each time you use an action space on round spaces 1 to 8, place 1 <FOOD> on this card. Each time this cards has 3 <FOOD> on it, move the <FOOD> to your supply.
messages.cardFaces.D158_BeanCounter.name: Bean Counter
messages.cardFaces.D159_ReedSeller.description: At any time, you can turn 1 <REED> into 3 <FOOD>. Any other player can prevent this by buying the <REED> for 2 <FOOD> from you. If multiple players are interested, choose one.
messages.cardFaces.D159_ReedSeller.name: Reed Seller
messages.cardFaces.D160_Midwife.description: Each time another player uses the first person they place in a round to take a __Family Growth__ action, you get 1 <GRAIN> from the general supply.
messages.cardFaces.D160_Midwife.name: Midwife
messages.cardFaces.D161_CabbageBuyer.description: Each time any player (including you) renovates and then builds no/1 minor/1 major improvement, you can buy 1 <VEGETABLE> for 3/2/1 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.D161_CabbageBuyer.name: Cabbage Buyer
messages.cardFaces.D162_ClayFirer.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 2 <CLAY>. At any time, you can turn <CLAY> into <STONE>: you get 1 <STONE> for 2 <CLAY>, and 2 <STONE> for 3 <CLAY>.
messages.cardFaces.D162_ClayFirer.name: Clay Firer
messages.cardFaces.D163_JourneymanBricklayer.desc: When you play this card, you immediately get 2 <STONE>. Each time another player renovates to <STONE> or builds a stone room, you get 1 <STONE>.
messages.cardFaces.D163_JourneymanBricklayer.name: Journeyman Bricklayer
messages.cardFaces.D164_PetGrower.description: Each time you use an animal accumulation space, if afterward you have no animal in your house, you also get 1 <SHEEP>.
messages.cardFaces.D164_PetGrower.name: Pet Grower
messages.cardFaces.D165_PigStalker.description: Each time you use an animal accumulation space, you get an additional 1 <PIG> if you occupy a Round 1-14 action space which is immediately to the left or right of that accumulation space.
messages.cardFaces.D165_PigStalker.name: Pig Stalker
messages.cardFaces.D166_StableMilker.description: Each time you build at least 2 <STABLE> on the same turn, you also get 1 <CATTLE>.
messages.cardFaces.D166_StableMilker.name: Stable Milker
messages.cardFaces.D167_PureBreeder.description: You immediately get 1 <WOOD>. After each round that does not end with a harvest, you can breed exactly one type of animal. (This is not considered a breeding phase.)
messages.cardFaces.D167_PureBreeder.name: Pure Breeder
messages.cardFaces.D168_Stockman.description: When you build your 2nd/3rd/4th <STABLE>, you immediately get 1 <CATTLE>/<PIG>/<SHEEP>, even if built on the same turn (but not retroactively).
messages.cardFaces.D168_Stockman.name: Stockman
messages.cardFaces.D169_Plowsmith.description: Each time another player takes at least 4 <WOOD> from an accumulation space, you can immediately pay 1 <FOOD> to plow 1 <FIELD>.
messages.cardFaces.D169_Plowsmith.name: Plowsmith
messages.cardFaces.D170_FoldBuilder.description: This card is an action space for all. It provides a __Build Fences__ action and then 1 <SHEEP>. If another player uses it, they must first pay you 1 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.D170_FoldBuilder.name: Fold Builder
messages.cardFaces.D171_SeniorTeacher.description: Each time another player pays <FOOD> on a __Lessons__ action space, you get exactly 1 of that <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.D171_SeniorTeacher.name: Senior Teacher
messages.cardFaces.D172_PutcherMaker.description: At any time, you can exchange 1 <REED> for 2 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.D172_PutcherMaker.name: Putcher Maker
messages.cardFaces.D173_TownClerk.description: Each time a major improvement is built, place 1 <FOOD> on this card. Once this game, you can turn this card face down to get the <FOOD> on it.
messages.cardFaces.D173_TownClerk.name: Town Clerk
messages.cardFaces.D174_LoessGardener.description: Each time you use the __Clay Pit__ accumulation space, you can also buy 1 <VEGETABLE> for 1 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.D174_LoessGardener.name: Loess Gardener
messages.cardFaces.D175_Countryman.description: Each time any player (including you) takes a __Renovation__ action on an action space, you can sow crops in exactly 1 <FIELD>.
messages.cardFaces.D175_Countryman.name: Countryman
messages.cardFaces.D176_Woodshacker.description: In the work phase of each round, the first and the second time you use a <WOOD> accumulation space, you also get 1 and 2 <CLAY> respectively.
messages.cardFaces.D176_Woodshacker.name: Woodshacker
messages.cardFaces.D177_Graduate.description: When you play this card you immediately pay 1 <FOOD>. If you do, you get 2 <STONE> and 2 <REED>.
messages.cardFaces.D177_Graduate.name: Graduate
messages.cardFaces.D178_SubstituteTeacher.descrip: Each time all three __Lessons__ action spaces are occupied, you can use this card with a person to get your choice of 1 building resource or 1 crop of each type.
messages.cardFaces.D178_SubstituteTeacher.name: Substitute Teacher
messages.cardFaces.D179_Bullcatcher.description: When both action spaces on round spaces 3 and 6 are occupied, you can use this card with a person to get 1 <CATTLE> and 2 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.D179_Bullcatcher.name: Bullcatcher
messages.cardFaces.D180_PartTimeWorker.descriptio: Each time you use an accumulation space with exactly 2/4/6 goods on it, you can leave 1/2/3 goods on the space. If you do, you get 1 <SHEEP>/<PIG>/<CATTLE>.
messages.cardFaces.D180_PartTimeWorker.name: Part-Time Worker
messages.cardFaces.E001_PoleBarns.description: You can immediately build up to 3 <STABLE> at no cost. (You must pay the cost of this card though.)
messages.cardFaces.E001_PoleBarns.name: Pole Barns
messages.cardFaces.E002_RenovationMaterials.descr: Immediately renovate to <CLAY> at no cost. (You must pay the cost of this card though.)
messages.cardFaces.E002_RenovationMaterials.name: Renovation Materials
messages.cardFaces.E003_TeaTime.description: Immediately return your person on the __Grain Utilization__ action space home; you can place it again later this round.
messages.cardFaces.E003_TeaTime.name: Tea Time
messages.cardFaces.E004_Thunderbolt.description: Immediately remove all <GRAIN> from one of your fields to the general supply. Gain 2 <WOOD> for each <GRAIN> you just removed.
messages.cardFaces.E004_Thunderbolt.name: Thunderbolt
messages.cardFaces.E005_NightLoot.description: Immediately remove 2 different building resources total from accumulation spaces and place them in your supply.
messages.cardFaces.E005_NightLoot.name: Night Loot
messages.cardFaces.E006_Recount.description: You immediately get 1 building resource of each type of which you have 4 or more resources in your supply already.
messages.cardFaces.E006_Recount.name: Recount
messages.cardFaces.E007_Pumpernickel.description: You immediately get 4 <FOOD>. (Effectively, you are turning 1 <GRAIN> into 4 <FOOD>.)
messages.cardFaces.E007_Pumpernickel.name: Pumpernickel
messages.cardFaces.E008_FarmersMarket.description: You immediately get 1 <VEGETABLE>. (Effectively, you are buying 1 <VEGETABLE> for 2 <FOOD>.)
messages.cardFaces.E008_FarmersMarket.name: Farmer's Market
messages.cardFaces.E009_BarteringHut.description: Up to two times: Immediately spend any 2/3/4 building resources for 1 <SHEEP>/<PIG>/<CATTLE> from the general supply.
messages.cardFaces.E009_BarteringHut.name: Bartering Hut
messages.cardFaces.E010_StrawHat.description: At the end of the work phases of rounds 3 and 6, you can move your person from the __Farmland__ action space to an unoccupied action space and take that action, or get 1 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.E010_StrawHat.name: Straw Hat
messages.cardFaces.E011_PettingZoo.description: As long as you have a pasture orthogonally adjacent to your house, you can keep animals of any type on this card, up to the number of rooms in your house.
messages.cardFaces.E011_PettingZoo.name: Petting Zoo
messages.cardFaces.E012_AnimalBedding.description: You can keep 1 additional animal (of the same type) in each of your unfenced <STABLE>, and 2 additional animals (of the same type) in each pasture with <STABLE>.
messages.cardFaces.E012_AnimalBedding.name: Animal Bedding
At any time, you can renovate your clay house to a stone house without placing a person. (You must pay the normal renovation cost.)
messages.cardFaces.E014_WoodSaw.description: Each time all other players have more people than you, you can take a __Build Rooms__ action without placing a person.
messages.cardFaces.E014_WoodSaw.name: Wood Saw
messages.cardFaces.E015_NailBasket.description: Each time after you use a <WOOD> accumulation space, you can place 1 <STONE> from your supply on that space (for the next visitor) to take a __Build Fences__ action.
messages.cardFaces.E015_NailBasket.name: Nail Basket
messages.cardFaces.E016_BriarHedge.description: You do not need to pay wood for fences that you build on the edge of your farmyard board.
messages.cardFaces.E016_BriarHedge.name: Briar Hedge
messages.cardFaces.E017_SkimmerPlow.description: Each time you use the __Farmland__ or __Cultivation__  action space, you can plow 2 <FIELD> instead of 1. Each time you sow, you must place 1 fewer good on each <FIELD> you sow.
messages.cardFaces.E017_SkimmerPlow.name: Skimmer Plow
messages.cardFaces.E018_SeedAlmanac.description: Each time after you play a minor improvement after this one, you can pay 1 <FOOD> to plow 1 <FIELD>.
messages.cardFaces.E018_SeedAlmanac.name: Seed Almanac
messages.cardFaces.E019_OxGoad.description: Each time after you use the __Cattle Market__ accumulation space, you can pay 2 <FOOD> to plow 1 <FIELD>.
messages.cardFaces.E019_OxGoad.name: Ox Goad
messages.cardFaces.E020_IronHoe.description: At the end of each work phase, if you occupy both the __Grain Seeds__ and __Vegetable Seeds__ action spaces, you can plow 1 <FIELD>.
messages.cardFaces.E020_IronHoe.name: Iron Hoe
messages.cardFaces.E021_SheepRug.description: You can use any __Wish for Children__ action space, even if it is occupied by another player's person.
messages.cardFaces.E021_SheepRug.name: Sheep Rug
messages.cardFaces.E022_GuestRoom.description: Immediately place any amount of <FOOD> from your supply on this card. Once per round, you can discard 1 <FOOD> from this card to place a person from your supply in that round.
messages.cardFaces.E022_GuestRoom.name: Guest Room
messages.cardFaces.E023_Apiary.description: At the end of each work phase, you can sow exactly 1 crop on 1 <FIELD>.
messages.cardFaces.E023_Apiary.name: Apiary
messages.cardFaces.E024_Ambition.description: Each time you get a __Minor Improvement__ action on an action space, you can build a major improvement instead of playing a minor one.
messages.cardFaces.E024_Ambition.name: Ambition
messages.cardFaces.E025_BumperCrop.description: When you play this card, immediately carry out the field phase on your farmyard only. (This is not a harvest.)
messages.cardFaces.E025_BumperCrop.name: Bumper Crop
messages.cardFaces.E026_Sundial.description: At the end of the work phases of rounds 7 and 9, you can take a __Sow__ action without placing a person.
messages.cardFaces.E026_Sundial.name: Sundial
messages.cardFaces.E027_PiggyBank.description: At the end of each work phase, you can place 1 <FOOD> on this card, irretrievably. At any time, you can discard 6 <FOOD> from this card to build a major improvement at no cost.
messages.cardFaces.E027_PiggyBank.name: Piggy Bank
messages.cardFaces.E028_Bookmark.description: Add 3 to the current round and mark the corresponding round space. At the start of that round, you can play 1 occupation without paying an occupation cost.
messages.cardFaces.E028_Bookmark.name: Bookmark
messages.cardFaces.E029_Heirloom.name: Heirloom
messages.cardFaces.E030_ChildsToy.description: During the feeding phase of each harvest, your newborns require 2 <FOOD> (instead of 1).
messages.cardFaces.E030_ChildsToy.name: Child's Toy
messages.cardFaces.E031_Upholstery.description: Each time you build or play an improvement after this one, you can place 1 <REED> on this card, irretrievably, to get 1 bonus <SCORE>, up to the number of rooms in your house.
messages.cardFaces.E031_Upholstery.name: Upholstery
messages.cardFaces.E032_Nave.description: During scoring, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> for each of the 5 columns of your farmyard board containing at least one room.
messages.cardFaces.E032_Nave.name: Nave
messages.cardFaces.E033_BeaverColony.description: From now on, one of your pastures with stable cannot hold animals. Each time you get <REED> from an action space, you get 1 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.cardFaces.E033_BeaverColony.name: Beaver Colony
messages.cardFaces.E034_LandRegister.description: During scoring, if your farm has no unused spaces, you get 2 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.cardFaces.E034_LandRegister.name: Land Register
messages.cardFaces.E035_Misanthropy.description: During scoring, if you have exactly 4/3/2 people, you get 2/3/5 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.cardFaces.E035_Misanthropy.name: Misanthropy
messages.cardFaces.E036_HerbalGarden.description: From now on, at least one of your pastures must contain no animals.
messages.cardFaces.E036_HerbalGarden.name: Herbal Garden
messages.cardFaces.E037_OxSkull.description: During scoring, if you have no <CATTLE>, you get 3 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.cardFaces.E037_OxSkull.name: Ox Skull
messages.cardFaces.E038_RodCollection.description: Each time you use __Fishing__, you can place up to 2 <WOOD> on this card, irretrievably. During scoring, each such <WOOD> is worth 1 bonus <SCORE>, except the 1st, 4th, 7th, and 10th.
messages.cardFaces.E038_RodCollection.name: Rod Collection
messages.cardFaces.E039_Paintbrush.description: Each harvest, you can exchange exactly 1 <CLAY> for your choice of 2 <FOOD> or 1 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.cardFaces.E039_Paintbrush.name: Paintbrush
messages.cardFaces.E040_BeeStatue.description: Pile (from bottom to top) 1 <VEGETABLE>, 1 <STONE>, 1 <GRAIN>, 1 <STONE>, 1 <GRAIN> on this card. Each time you use the __Day Laborer__ action space, you get the top good.
messages.cardFaces.E040_BeeStatue.name: Bee Statue
messages.cardFaces.E041_MuddyWaters.description: Alternate placing 1 <FOOD> and 1 <CLAY> on each remaining even-numbered round space, starting with <FOOD>. At the start of these rounds, you get the respective good.
messages.cardFaces.E041_MuddyWaters.name: Muddy Waters
messages.cardFaces.E042_WaterGully.description: Place 1 <CATTLE>, 1 <GRAIN>, and 1 <CATTLE> on the next 3 round spaces (in that order). At the start of these rounds, you get the respective good.
messages.cardFaces.E042_WaterGully.name: Water Gully
messages.cardFaces.E043_BarnCats.description: If you have 1/2/3/4 <STABLE>, place 1 <FOOD> on each of the next 2/3/4/5 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.E043_BarnCats.name: Barn Cats
messages.cardFaces.E044_FodderBeets.description: Place 1 <FOOD> on each remaining odd-numbered round space. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.E044_FodderBeets.name: Fodder Beets
messages.cardFaces.E045_FruitLadder.description: Place 1 <FOOD> on each remaining even-numbered round space. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.E045_FruitLadder.name: Fruit Ladder
messages.cardFaces.E046_WaterlilyPond.description: Place 1 <FOOD> on each of the next 2 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.E046_WaterlilyPond.name: Waterlily Pond
messages.cardFaces.E047_SyrupTap.description: Each time you get at least 1 <WOOD> from an action space, place 1 <FOOD> on the next round space. At the start of that round, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.E047_SyrupTap.name: Syrup Tap
messages.cardFaces.E048_TownHall.description: In the feeding phase of each harvest, if you live in a <CLAY> or stone house, you get 1 or 2 <FOOD>, respectively.
messages.cardFaces.E048_TownHall.name: Town Hall
messages.cardFaces.E049_Twibil.description: Each time after any player (including you) builds at least 1 wood room, you get 1 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.E049_Twibil.name: Twibil
messages.cardFaces.E050_WildGreens.description: Each time you sow, you get 1 <FOOD> for every different type of good that you sow.
messages.cardFaces.E050_WildGreens.name: Wild Greens
messages.cardFaces.E051_WhaleOil.description: Each time you use __Fishing__, place 1 <FOOD> from the general supply on this card. Each time before you play an occupation, you get <FOOD> equal to the amount on this card.
messages.cardFaces.E051_WhaleOil.name: Whale Oil
messages.cardFaces.E052_Cubbyhole.description: For each room that you add to your house, place 1 <FOOD> from the general supply on this card. At the start of each feeding phase, you get <FOOD> equal to the amount on this card.
messages.cardFaces.E052_Cubbyhole.name: Cubbyhole
messages.cardFaces.E053_BoarSpear.description: Each time you get at least 1 <PIG> outside of the breeding phase of a harvest, you can immediately turn them into 4 <FOOD> each.
messages.cardFaces.E053_BoarSpear.name: Boar Spear
messages.cardFaces.E054_Contraband.description: Each time you play or build an improvement after this, you can pay 1 additional building resource of a type in the printed cost to get 3 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.E054_Contraband.name: Contraband
messages.cardFaces.E055_StoneWeir.description: Each time you use the __Fishing__ accumulation space, if there are 0/1/2/3 <FOOD> on the space, you get an additional 4/3/2/1 <FOOD> from the general supply.
messages.cardFaces.E055_StoneWeir.name: Stone Weir
messages.cardFaces.E056_RomanPot.description: Place 4 <FOOD> from the general supply on this card. At the start of each work phase, if you are the last player in turn order, move 1 <FOOD> from this card to your supply.
messages.cardFaces.E056_RomanPot.name: Roman Pot
messages.cardFaces.E057_CheeseFondue.description: Each time you bake at least 1 <GRAIN> into bread, you get 1 additional <FOOD> if you have at least 1 <SHEEP> and (another) 1 additional <FOOD> if you have at least 1 <CATTLE>.
messages.cardFaces.E057_CheeseFondue.name: Cheese Fondue
messages.cardFaces.E058_LunchtimeBeer.description: At the start of each harvest, you can choose to skip the <FIELD> and breeding phase of that harvest and get exactly 1 <FOOD> instead.
messages.cardFaces.E058_LunchtimeBeer.name: Lunchtime Beer
messages.cardFaces.E059_CombandCutter.description: Each time you use the __Day Laborer__ action space, you get 1 additional <FOOD> for each <SHEEP> on the __Sheep Market__ accumulation space, up to a maximum of 4 additional <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.E059_CombandCutter.name: Comb and Cutter
messages.cardFaces.E060_WorkingGloves.description: When you play this card, you get 1 <FOOD>. Each time you pay an occupation cost, you can pay 1 building resource of your choice in place of (up to) 2 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.E060_WorkingGloves.name: Working Gloves
messages.cardFaces.E061_RaisedBed.description: At the start of each harvest, you get 4 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.E061_RaisedBed.name: Raised Bed
messages.cardFaces.E062_SourDough.description: Once per round, if all players have at least 1 person left to place, you can skip placing a person and take a __Bake Bread__ action instead.
messages.cardFaces.E062_SourDough.name: Sour Dough
messages.cardFaces.E063_IronOven.name: Iron Oven
messages.cardFaces.E064_SimpleOven.name: Simple Oven
messages.cardFaces.E065_Almsbag.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <GRAIN> for every 2 completed rounds.
messages.cardFaces.E065_Almsbag.name: Almsbag
messages.cardFaces.E066_BarnShed.description: Each time another player (or, in a solo game, you) uses the __Forest__ accumulation space, you get 1 <GRAIN>.
messages.cardFaces.E066_BarnShed.name: Barn Shed
messages.cardFaces.E067_GrainBag.description: Each time you use the __Grain Seeds__ action space, you get 1 additional <GRAIN> for each <BAKE>-improvement you have.
messages.cardFaces.E067_GrainBag.name: Grain Bag
messages.cardFaces.E068_CherryOrchard.description: This card is a <FIELD> on which you can only sow and harvest <WOOD> as you would <GRAIN>. Each time you harvest the last <WOOD> from this card, you also receive 1 <VEGETABLE>.
messages.cardFaces.E068_CherryOrchard.name: Cherry Orchard
messages.cardFaces.E069_MelonPatch.description: This card is a <FIELD> that can only grow <VEGETABLE>. Each time you harvest the last <VEGETABLE> from this card, you can plow 1 <FIELD>.
messages.cardFaces.E069_MelonPatch.name: Melon Patch
messages.cardFaces.E070_CropRotationField.descrip: This card is a <FIELD>. Each time you remove the last <GRAIN> or <VEGETABLE> from this card, you can immediately sow <VEGETABLE> or <GRAIN> on this card, respectively.
messages.cardFaces.E070_CropRotationField.name: Crop Rotation Field
messages.cardFaces.E071_CowPatty.description: Each time you sow in a field that is orthogonally adjacent to a pasture, you can place 1 additional good of the planted type in it.
messages.cardFaces.E071_CowPatty.name: Cow Patty
messages.cardFaces.E072_ArtichokeField.descriptio: This card is a <FIELD>. During the field phase of each harvest, if you harvest at least 1 good from this card, you also get 1 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.E072_ArtichokeField.name: Artichoke Field
messages.cardFaces.E073_Scythe.description: During the field phase of each harvest, you can select exactly one of your fields and harvest all the crops planted in it.
messages.cardFaces.E073_Scythe.name: Scythe
messages.cardFaces.E074_AshTrees.description: When you play this card, immediately place (up to) 5 fences from your supply on it. When you build fences, fences taken from this card cost you nothing.
messages.cardFaces.E074_AshTrees.name: Ash Trees
messages.cardFaces.E075_StoneAxe.description: Each time you use a wood accumulation space, you can return 1 <STONE> to the general supply to get an additional 3 <WOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.E075_StoneAxe.name: Stone Axe
messages.cardFaces.E076_LumberPile.description: When you play this card, you can immediately return up to 3 <STABLE> from your farmyard board to your supply and get 3 <WOOD> for each.
messages.cardFaces.E076_LumberPile.name: Lumber Pile
messages.cardFaces.E077_Mattock.description: Each time you get <REED> and/or <STONE> from an action space, you get 1 additional <CLAY>.
messages.cardFaces.E077_Mattock.name: Mattock
messages.cardFaces.E078_SleightofHand.description: When you play this card, you can immediately exchange up to 4 building resources for an equal number of other building resources.
messages.cardFaces.E078_SleightofHand.name: Sleight of Hand
messages.cardFaces.E079_FieldSpade.description: Each time after you sow in at least 1 <FIELD>, you get 1 <STONE>.
messages.cardFaces.E079_FieldSpade.name: Field Spade
messages.cardFaces.E080_RockGarden.description: You can only plant <STONE> on this card. Plant as though it were 3 <FIELD>, but it is considered 1 <FIELD>. Sow and harvest <STONE> on this card as you would <VEGETABLE>.
messages.cardFaces.E080_RockGarden.name: Rock Garden
messages.cardFaces.E081_AlchemistsLab.description: This card is an action space for all. A player who uses it gets 1 building resource of each type they already have. If another player uses it, they must first pay you 1 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.E081_AlchemistsLab.name: Alchemists Lab
messages.cardFaces.E082_Profiteering.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <FOOD>. Each time you use the __Day Laborer__ action space, you can exchange 1 building resource for another building resource.
messages.cardFaces.E082_Profiteering.name: Profiteering
messages.cardFaces.E083_ShepherdsWhistle.descript: At the start of the breeding phase of each harvest, if you have at least 1 unfenced <STABLE> without an animal, you get 1 <SHEEP>.
messages.cardFaces.E083_ShepherdsWhistle.name: Shepherd's Whistle
messages.cardFaces.E084_DollysMother.description: You only require 1 <SHEEP> to breed sheep during the breeding phase of a harvest. This card can hold 1 <SHEEP>.
messages.cardFaces.E084_DollysMother.name: Dolly's Mother
messages.cardFaces.E085_MasterTanner.description: For each <PIG> or <CATTLE> you turn into <FOOD>, you can place 1 of that <FOOD> on this card. While its <FOOD> equals your number of rooms, this card provides room for 1 person.
messages.cardFaces.E085_MasterTanner.name: Master Tanner
messages.cardFaces.E086_PenBuilder.description: At any time, you can discard 1 <WOOD> from your supply. This card can hold two animals of any type for each <WOOD> discarded this way.
messages.cardFaces.E086_PenBuilder.name: Pen Builder
messages.cardFaces.E087_MasterRenovator.descripti: At the end of the work phases of rounds 7 and 9, you can take a __Renovation__ action without placing a person and pay 1 building resource of your choice less.
messages.cardFaces.E087_MasterRenovator.name: Master Renovator
messages.cardFaces.E088_MasterFencer.description: Once you live in a stone house, at the start of each round, you can pay 2 or 3 <WOOD> to build up to 3 or 4 <FENCE>, respectively.
messages.cardFaces.E088_MasterFencer.name: Master Fencer
messages.cardFaces.E089_Stallwright.description: After you play your 2nd, 3rd, 5th, and 7th occupation (including this one), you can build 1 <STABLE> at no cost.
messages.cardFaces.E089_Stallwright.name: Stallwright
messages.cardFaces.E090_DungCollector.description: Each time you get 2 or more newborn animals, you can pay 1 <FOOD> to plow 1 field.
messages.cardFaces.E090_DungCollector.name: Dung Collector
messages.cardFaces.E091_PlowBuilder.description: You can build the Joinery when taking a __Minor Improvement__ action. If you use the Joinery (or an upgrade thereof) during the harvest, you can pay 1 <FOOD> to plow 1 field.
messages.cardFaces.E091_PlowBuilder.name: Plow Builder
messages.cardFaces.E092_FieldDoctor.description: Once this game, if you live in a house with exactly 2 rooms surrounded by 4 field tiles, you can use any __Wish for Children__ action space even without room.
messages.cardFaces.E092_FieldDoctor.name: Field Doctor
messages.cardFaces.E093_Motivator.description: On your first turn each round, if you have no unused farmyard spaces, you can place a person from your supply.
messages.cardFaces.E093_Motivator.name: Motivator
messages.cardFaces.E094_Prophet.description: When you play this card, immediately take a __Renovation__ action. Afterward, you can take a __Build Fences__ action. (Both actions require their usual cost.)
messages.cardFaces.E094_Prophet.name: Prophet
messages.cardFaces.E095_Miller.description: You can immediately build a <BAKE>-improvement by paying its cost. Each time another player uses the __Grain Seeds__ action space, you can take a __Bake Bread__ action.
messages.cardFaces.E095_Miller.name: Miller
messages.cardFaces.E096_Elder.description: You can play this card at the start of the work phase of round 1 without placing a person. (This card has no effect other than counting as a played occupation.)
messages.cardFaces.E096_Elder.name: Elder
messages.cardFaces.E097_Beneficiary.description: If this is your 3rd occupation, you can immediately play another occupation for an occupation cost of 1 <FOOD> and/or play 1 minor improvement by paying its cost.
messages.cardFaces.E097_Beneficiary.name: Beneficiary
messages.cardFaces.E098_Prodigy.description: If this is your 1st occupation, you immediately get 1 <SCORE> for each improvement you have. (This will not apply to improvements played after this card.)
messages.cardFaces.E098_Prodigy.name: Prodigy
messages.cardFaces.E099_UncaringParents.descripti: At the end of each harvest, if you live in a stone house, you get 1 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.cardFaces.E099_UncaringParents.name: Uncaring Parents
messages.cardFaces.E100_MuseumCaretaker.descripti: At the start of each work phase, if you have at least 1 <WOOD>, 1 <CLAY>, 1 <REED>, 1 <STONE>, 1 <GRAIN>, and 1 <VEGETABLE> in your supply, you get 1 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.cardFaces.E100_MuseumCaretaker.name: Museum Caretaker
messages.cardFaces.E101_Blighter.description: When you play this card, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> for each complete stage left to play. You may not play any more occupations.
messages.cardFaces.E101_Blighter.name: Blighter
messages.cardFaces.E102_Acquirer.description: At the start of each round, you can pay <FOOD> equal to the number of people you have to buy 1 good of your choice from the general supply.
messages.cardFaces.E102_Acquirer.name: Acquirer
messages.cardFaces.E103_Wolf.description: Pile (from bottom to top) 1 <CLAY>, 1 <WOOD>, and 1 <GRAIN> on this card. Each time you get a good matching the top item, you can move that item to your supply and get 1 <PIG>.
messages.cardFaces.E103_Wolf.name: Wolf
messages.cardFaces.E104_SpiceTrader.description: If you play this card in round 4 or before, place 3 <VEGETABLE> on the space for round 11. At the start of that round, you get the <VEGETABLE>.
messages.cardFaces.E104_SpiceTrader.name: Spice Trader
messages.cardFaces.E105_Pioneer.description: When you play this card and each time before you use the most recent action space card, you get 1 building resource of your choice and 1 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.E105_Pioneer.name: Pioneer
messages.cardFaces.E106_EmergencySeller.descripti:
When you play this card, you can immediately turn as many building resources into <FOOD> as you have people:
<WOOD>/<CLAY> <ARROW> 2 <FOOD>
<REED>/<STONE> <ARROW> 3 <FOOD>
messages.cardFaces.E106_EmergencySeller.name: Emergency Seller
messages.cardFaces.E107_LandSurveyor.description: In the field phase of each harvest, if you have at least 2/4/6/7 <FIELD>, you get 1/2/3/4 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.E107_LandSurveyor.name: Land Surveyor
messages.cardFaces.E108_BlackberryFarmer.descript: Each time you build <FENCE>, place 1 <FOOD> on each remaining round space, up to the number of <FENCE> just built. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.E108_BlackberryFarmer.name: Blackberry Farmer
messages.cardFaces.E109_BraidMaker.description: Each harvest, you can use this card to exchange 1 <REED> for 2 <FOOD>. You can build the  __Basketmaker\\
messages.cardFaces.E109_BraidMaker.name: Braid Maker
messages.cardFaces.E110_Dentist.description: At the start of each harvest, you can place 1 <WOOD> from your supply on this card, irretrievably. In each feeding phase, you get 1 <FOOD> for each <WOOD> on this card.
messages.cardFaces.E110_Dentist.name: Dentist
messages.cardFaces.E111_Recluse.description: As long as you have no minor improvements in front of you, you get 1 <FOOD> at the start of each round and 1 <WOOD> at the start of each harvest.
messages.cardFaces.E111_Recluse.name: Recluse
messages.cardFaces.E112_GrainThief.description: Each time you would harvest a grain field, you can leave the grain on the field and take 1 <GRAIN> from the general supply instead.
messages.cardFaces.E112_GrainThief.name: Grain Thief
messages.cardFaces.E113_Godmother.description: Each time you take a __Family Growth__ action, you also get 1 <VEGETABLE>.
messages.cardFaces.E113_Godmother.name: Godmother
messages.cardFaces.E114_ShedBuilder.description: When you build your 1st and 2nd <STABLE>, you get 1 <GRAIN>. When you build your 3rd and 4th <STABLE>, you get 1 <VEGETABLE>. (This does not apply to <STABLE> you have already built.)
messages.cardFaces.E114_ShedBuilder.name: Shed Builder
messages.cardFaces.E115_SeedServant.description: Each time after you use the __Grain Seeds__ action space, you can take a __Bake Bread__ action. Each time after you use the __Vegetable Seeds__ action space, you can take a __Sow__ action.
messages.cardFaces.E115_SeedServant.name: Seed Servant
messages.cardFaces.E116_FirCutter.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <FOOD>. Each time after you use an animal accumulation space with your 1st/2nd/3rd/4th/5th person, you get 1/1/2/2/3 <WOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.E116_FirCutter.name: Fir Cutter
messages.cardFaces.E117_PipeSmoker.description: At the start of each harvest, if you have at least 1 <GRAIN> <FIELD>, you get 2 <WOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.E117_PipeSmoker.name: Pipe Smoker
messages.cardFaces.E118_KindlingGatherer.descript: Each time you get <FOOD> from an action space, you get 1 additional <WOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.E118_KindlingGatherer.name: Kindling Gatherer
messages.cardFaces.E119_LandHeir.description: If you play this card in round 4 or before, place 4 <WOOD> and 4 <CLAY> on the space for round 9. At the start of this round, you get the resources.
messages.cardFaces.E119_LandHeir.name: Land Heir
messages.cardFaces.E120_ScrapCollector.descriptio: Alternate placing 1 <WOOD> and 1 <CLAY> on each of the next 6 round spaces, starting with <WOOD>. At the start of these rounds, you get the respective resource.
messages.cardFaces.E120_ScrapCollector.name: Scrap Collector
messages.cardFaces.E121_HillCultivator.descriptio: Each time you use the __Grain Seeds__ or __Vegetable Seeds__ action space, you also get 2 or 3 <CLAY>, respectively.
messages.cardFaces.E121_HillCultivator.name: Hill Cultivator
messages.cardFaces.E122_Cottar.description: Each time you play or build an improvement, you get your choice of 1 <WOOD> or 1 <CLAY> immediately after paying its cost.
messages.cardFaces.E122_Cottar.name: Cottar
messages.cardFaces.E123_ResourceHoarder.descripti: Pile resources as depicted on this card. You can use the top item(s) when building a room, playing/building an improvement, or renovating. (From bottom to top: <STONE>, <CLAY>, <STONE>, <REED>, <WOOD>, <CLAY>)
messages.cardFaces.E123_ResourceHoarder.name: Resource Hoarder
messages.cardFaces.E124_MayorCandidate.descriptio: You immediately get 2 <WOOD> and 2 <STONE>. During scoring, you get 1 negative point for each <WOOD> and each <STONE> in your supply. You can no longer discard <WOOD> or <STONE>.
messages.cardFaces.E124_MayorCandidate.name: Mayor Candidate
messages.cardFaces.E125_DelayedWayfarer.descripti: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 building resource of your choice and, once all people have been placed this round, you can place a person from your supply.
messages.cardFaces.E125_DelayedWayfarer.name: Delayed Wayfarer
messages.cardFaces.E126_TaxCollector.description: Once you live in a stone house, at the start of each round, you get your choice of 2 <WOOD>, 2 <CLAY>, 1 <REED>, or 1 <STONE>.
messages.cardFaces.E126_TaxCollector.name: Tax Collector
messages.cardFaces.E127_DiligentFarmer.descriptio: When you play this card, if you would score the maximum 4 points in 3 scoring categories (including fenced <STABLE>), you can extend your house by 1 room at no cost.
messages.cardFaces.E127_DiligentFarmer.name: Diligent Farmer
messages.cardFaces.E128_Saddler.description: Each time after you build a major improvement, you can pay 1 <FOOD> to plow 1 <FIELD>.
messages.cardFaces.E128_Saddler.name: Saddler
messages.cardFaces.E129_Imitator.description: If you have a person on the __Day Laborer__ action space, you can use non-accumulating round 1-9 action spaces even if they are occupied.
messages.cardFaces.E129_Imitator.name: Imitator
messages.cardFaces.E130_Overachiever.description: Each time you use a __Wish for Children__ action space, you can play 1 additional improvement by paying its cost minus 1 resource of your choice.
messages.cardFaces.E130_Overachiever.name: Overachiever
messages.cardFaces.E131_MarketMaster.description: Immediately after each time you place your last person in a round on the __Traveling Players__ accumulation space, you can play 1 occupation for an occupation cost of 1 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.E131_MarketMaster.name: Market Master
messages.cardFaces.E132_VeggieLover.name: Veggie Lover
messages.cardFaces.E133_ChampionBreeder.descripti: Each time you place 2 or 3+ newborn animals on your farm during the breeding phase of the harvest, you get 1 or 2 bonus <SCORE>, respectively.
messages.cardFaces.E133_ChampionBreeder.name: Champion Breeder
messages.cardFaces.E134_Omnifarmer.description: Each harvest, you can place 1 harvested crop or 1 newborn animal on this card, irretrievably. Once this game, if there are 2/3/4/5 different goods on this, you get 3/5/7/9 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.cardFaces.E134_Omnifarmer.name: Omnifarmer
messages.cardFaces.E135_Pickler.description: If there are still 1/3/6/9 complete rounds left to play, you immediately get 1/2/3/4 <WOOD>. During scoring, each player with the most total <VEGETABLE> gets 3 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.cardFaces.E135_Pickler.name: Pickler
messages.cardFaces.E136_AnimalHusbandryWorker.des: If there are still 3/6/9 complete rounds left to play, you immediately get 2/3/4 <WOOD> and a __Build Fences__ action. During scoring, each player with the most pastures gets 2 <SCORE>.
messages.cardFaces.E137_FlaxFarmer.description: Each time you use the __Reed Bank__ accumulation space, you also get 1 <GRAIN>. Each time you use the __Grain Seeds__ action space, you also get 1 <REED>.
messages.cardFaces.E137_FlaxFarmer.name: Flax Farmer
messages.cardFaces.E138_LivestockExpert.descripti: If you play this card in round 11 or before, choose an animal type: you immediately get a number of animals of that type equal to the number you already have on your farm.
messages.cardFaces.E138_LivestockExpert.name: Livestock Expert
messages.cardFaces.E139_BunnyBreeder.description: Select a future round space, subtract the number of the current round from it, and place this many <FOOD> on that space. At the start of that round, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.E139_BunnyBreeder.name: Bunny Breeder
messages.cardFaces.E140_Carter.description: Next round, each time you use a building resource accumulation space, you also get 1 <FOOD> for each building resource that you take from the space.
messages.cardFaces.E140_Carter.name: Carter
messages.cardFaces.E141_VegetableVendor.descripti: Each time you use the __Major Improvement__ or __Vegetable Seeds__ action space, you also get 1 <VEGETABLE> or a __Major or Minor Improvement__ action, respectively.
messages.cardFaces.E141_VegetableVendor.name: Vegetable Vendor
messages.cardFaces.E142_Smuggler.description:
In the feeding phase of each harvest, you can exchange up to 2 goods as follows:
[<WOOD> <ARROW> <GRAIN>]
or
[<GRAIN> <ARROW> <STONE>]
messages.cardFaces.E142_Smuggler.name: Smuggler
messages.cardFaces.E143_Hewer.description: From round 3 on, at the end of each work phase in which all <CLAY> accumulation spaces are unoccupied, you get 1 <STONE> and 1 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.E143_Hewer.name: Hewer
messages.cardFaces.E144_WaresSalesman.description: Each time any player (including you) plays or builds a card that lets them turn building resources into <FOOD>, you get exactly 1 corresponding building resource and 1 <REED>.
messages.cardFaces.E144_WaresSalesman.name: Wares Salesman
messages.cardFaces.E145_Parvenu.description: If you play this card in round 7 or before, choose <CLAY> or <REED>: you immediately get a number of that building resource equal to the number you already have in your supply.
messages.cardFaces.E145_Parvenu.name: Parvenu
messages.cardFaces.E146_Reseller.description: Once this game, immediately after playing or building an improvement, you can choose to get its printed cost from the general supply.
messages.cardFaces.E146_Reseller.name: Reseller
messages.cardFaces.E147_AnimalDriver.description: At the start of each harvest, if you have 1/2/3+ fenced <STABLE>, you get 1 <SHEEP>/<PIG>/<CATTLE>.
messages.cardFaces.E147_AnimalDriver.name: Animal Driver
messages.cardFaces.E148_Lazybones.description: Place (up to) 1 <STABLE> each on __Grain Seeds__, __Farmland__, __Day Laborer__, and __Farm Expansion__. Build the <STABLE> at no cost when another player uses that action space.
messages.cardFaces.E148_Lazybones.name: Lazybones
messages.cardFaces.E149_MidnightFencer.descriptio: At the start of the last harvest, you can take up to 2 of each other player's unbuilt <FENCE> and build them on your farm at no cost. (Your farm can then have over 15 <FENCE>.)
messages.cardFaces.E149_MidnightFencer.name: Midnight Fencer
messages.cardFaces.E150_RockBeater.description: You can use an action space providing both <STONE> and a different building resource even if it is occupied by another player. Stone rooms cost you 2 <STONE> less each.
messages.cardFaces.E150_RockBeater.name: Rock Beater
messages.cardFaces.E151_DeliveryNurse.description: Once this game, if you have all types of animals, you can use any __Wish for Children__ action space even without room.
messages.cardFaces.E151_DeliveryNurse.name: Delivery Nurse
messages.cardFaces.E152_BargainHunter.description: At the start of each round, you can place 1 <FOOD> from your supply on the __Traveling Players__ accumulation space to play a minor improvement by paying its cost.
messages.cardFaces.E152_BargainHunter.name: Bargain Hunter
messages.cardFaces.E153_StoneSculptor.description: Each harvest, you can use this card to exchange exactly 1 <STONE> for 1 bonus <SCORE> and 1 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.E153_StoneSculptor.name: Stone Sculptor
messages.cardFaces.E154_Margrave.description: Once you live in a stone house, you get 2 <FOOD> each time any player renovates and, during scoring, 1 bonus <SCORE> for each wood house and clay house.
messages.cardFaces.E154_Margrave.name: Margrave
messages.cardFaces.E155_Visionary.description: If you play this card in round 4 or before, you get 1 <STONE>, 1 <VEGETABLE>, and 2 <PIG>. You cannot grow your family until round 11, unless all other players already have.
messages.cardFaces.E155_Visionary.name: Visionary
messages.cardFaces.E156_ClaypitOwner.description: Each time another player plays or builds an improvement with a printed <CLAY> cost, you get 1 <FOOD> and 1 <CLAY>.
messages.cardFaces.E156_ClaypitOwner.name: Claypit Owner
messages.cardFaces.E157_Usufructuary.description: When you play this card as your first occupation, you immediately get 1 <FOOD> for every other occupation in play (by any player), up to a maximum of 7 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.E157_Usufructuary.name: Usufructuary
messages.cardFaces.E158_StoneCustodian.descriptio: At the end of each work phase, you get 1 <FOOD> for each <STONE> accumulation space with <STONE> on it.
messages.cardFaces.E158_StoneCustodian.name: Stone Custodian
messages.cardFaces.E159_OldMiser.description: In the feeding phase of each harvest, each of your people requires 1 less <FOOD>. During scoring, your people are worth 2 points each instead of 3.
messages.cardFaces.E159_OldMiser.name: Old Miser
messages.cardFaces.E160_KelpGatherer.description: Each time another player uses the __Fishing__ accumulation space, they get 1 additional <FOOD> and you get 1 <VEGETABLE>.
messages.cardFaces.E160_KelpGatherer.name: Kelp Gatherer
messages.cardFaces.E161_ElderBaker.description: This card is an action space for you only. When you use it, you get 3 <GRAIN>. You can build the __Stone Oven__ major improvement even when taking a __Minor Improvement__ action.
messages.cardFaces.E161_ElderBaker.name: Elder Baker
messages.cardFaces.E162_Entrepreneur.description: At the start of each round, you can move 1 <FOOD> to this card or discard 1 <FOOD> from it. If you do either, you get 1 building resource of a type you currently do not have.
messages.cardFaces.E162_Entrepreneur.name: Entrepreneur
messages.cardFaces.E163_Patroness.description: Each time after you play an occupation after this one, you get 1 building resource of your choice.
messages.cardFaces.E163_Patroness.name: Patroness
messages.cardFaces.E164_MountainPlowman.descripti: Each time you plow at least 1 <FIELD>, you get 1 <SHEEP> for each <FIELD> that you just plowed.
messages.cardFaces.E164_MountainPlowman.name: Mountain Plowman
messages.cardFaces.E165_MasterHuntsman.descriptio: When you play this card and each time you build a major improvement, you get 1 <PIG>.
messages.cardFaces.E165_MasterHuntsman.name: Master Huntsman
messages.cardFaces.E166_Roastmaster.description: Each time you use the __Traveling Players__ or __Fishing__ accumulation spaces, you can move exactly 1 <FOOD> from that space to the other to get 1 <CATTLE>.
messages.cardFaces.E166_Roastmaster.name: Roastmaster
messages.cardFaces.E167_DairyCrier.description: When you play this card, each player (including you) can choose to get 2 <SHEEP> or 2 <FOOD>; you also get 1 <CATTLE>.
messages.cardFaces.E167_DairyCrier.name: Dairy Crier
messages.cardFaces.E168_AnimalTamersApprentice.de: At the start of each round, you get 1 <SHEEP>/<PIG>/<CATTLE> for each unoccupied <WOOD>/<CLAY>/stone room in your house.
messages.cardFaces.M015_PeatBurnOff.description: You immediately get 1 <FUEL>. Additionally, you can immediately exchange 1 <MOOR> for 1 <FIELD> tile.
messages.cardFaces.M015_PeatBurnOff.name: Peat Burn-off
messages.cardFaces.M016_ClearFelling.description: You immediately get 2 <WOOD>. On each of up to 2 farmyard spaces containing nothing but exactly 1 <FOREST>, you can immediately turn that <FOREST> to the <MOOR> side.
messages.cardFaces.M016_ClearFelling.name: Clear Felling
messages.cardFaces.M017_Reforestation.description: Place 1 <FOREST> on an unused farmyard space.
messages.cardFaces.M017_Reforestation.name: Reforestation
messages.cardFaces.M018_RegisterOfCraftsmen.descr: Immediately acquire your choice of the Joinery, Pottery, or Basketmaker's Workshop without placing a person. You pay 1 <STONE> less for it.
messages.cardFaces.M018_RegisterOfCraftsmen.name: Register of Craftsmen
messages.cardFaces.M019_LawnTurf.description: If you have exactly 3/4/5/6/7 unused farmyard spaces, you immediately get 1/2/3/4/5 <FUEL>.
messages.cardFaces.M019_LawnTurf.name: Lawn Turf
messages.cardFaces.M020_PeatPellets.description: You immediately get 1 <FUEL> for each visible <MOOR> that you have.
messages.cardFaces.M020_PeatPellets.name: Peat Pellets
messages.cardFaces.M021_PeatCuttingExpedition.des: Immediately remove any number of visible <MOOR> from your farmyard and get 1 bonus <SCORE> and 2 <FUEL> each. Additionally, if you have at least 2/4/5/6 <HORSE>, you immediately get 1/2/3/4 <FUEL>.
messages.cardFaces.M022_EcologicalNiche.descripti: You immediately get 2 <FOOD> if you have an animal type that no one else has; 1 <FOOD> each if only you are growing <GRAIN> and/or <VEGETABLE>; 1 <FUEL> each if you have the single most <FOREST> and/or <MOOR>.
messages.cardFaces.M022_EcologicalNiche.name: Ecological Niche
messages.cardFaces.M023_EdgeOfTheForest.descripti: You immediately get 1 <FOOD> for each of your <FENCE> spaces between a <FOREST> and a <FIELD>, and 1 <FUEL> for each of your <FENCE> spaces between a <FOREST> and a <MOOR>.
messages.cardFaces.M023_EdgeOfTheForest.name: Edge of the Forest
messages.cardFaces.M024_BasicSupplies.description: You immediately get goods until you have at least 1 <FUEL>, 1 <FOOD>, 1 <WOOD>, 1 <CLAY>, 1 <REED>, 1 <STONE>, and 1 <GRAIN> in your supply.
messages.cardFaces.M024_BasicSupplies.name: Basic Supplies
messages.cardFaces.M025_HouseholdInventory.descri: If you have exactly 5/6/7/8/9/10 unused farmyard spaces, you immediately get the following 1/2/3/4/5/6 goods (in this order): 1 <REED>, 1 <GRAIN>, 1 <CATTLE>, 1 <STONE>, 1 <VEGETABLE>, 1 <HORSE>.
messages.cardFaces.M025_HouseholdInventory.name: Household Inventory
messages.cardFaces.M026_ChimneyHood.description: You immediately get as much <FOOD> as you would get from one of your baking improvements if you baked 1 <GRAIN>.
messages.cardFaces.M026_ChimneyHood.name: Chimney Hood
messages.cardFaces.M027_GardenPath.description: You immediately get 3 <WOOD>. The player to your left must immediately place the "Garden Path" token in front of them.
messages.cardFaces.M027_GardenPath.name: Garden Path
messages.cardFaces.M027_GardenPath.rules: During scoring, the player holding the __Garden Path__ token loses 1 <SCORE>. There is only one token: each time this card is played, move it to the player to the left. The previous holder no longer has it.
messages.cardFaces.M028_OutOnTheWallaby.descripti: You immediately get goods for each craft building that you have: 3 <WOOD> for the Joinery, 3 <CLAY> for the Pottery, 2 <REED> for the Basketmaker's Workshop.
messages.cardFaces.M028_OutOnTheWallaby.name: Out on the Wallaby
messages.cardFaces.M029_Tinker.description: If you have at least one of the "Joinery", "Pottery", or "Basketmaker's Workshop" major improvements, you immediately get 1 <WOOD>, 1 <CLAY>, 1 <REED>, and 1 <STONE>.
messages.cardFaces.M029_Tinker.name: Tinker
messages.cardFaces.M030_FarmAnimalMarket.descript: You can immediately exchange exactly 2 <SHEEP> for 1 <CATTLE> and 1 <HORSE>. You may not exchange only 1 <SHEEP>.
messages.cardFaces.M030_FarmAnimalMarket.name: Farm Animal Market
messages.cardFaces.M031_LivestockMarket.descripti: You can immediately exchange up to 3 animals of any type at the same time, if you can accommodate them: <SHEEP> <ARROW> <PIG> <ARROW> <CATTLE> <ARROW> <HORSE>.
messages.cardFaces.M031_LivestockMarket.name: Livestock Market
messages.cardFaces.M032_PeatHut.description: This card provides room for one person. In the feeding phase of each harvest, it must be heated with 1 <FUEL>. Instead of a __Renovation__ action, you can remove this card from play and add 1 wooden room to your wood house at no cost.
messages.cardFaces.M032_PeatHut.name: Peat Hut
messages.cardFaces.M033_NightPasture.description: You can keep up to 3 animals of any type on this card; the other players can each keep an additional 1 animal on it. The animals on this card count as only yours when animals breed. You are always the last player to breed in the breeding phase.
messages.cardFaces.M033_NightPasture.name: Night Pasture
messages.cardFaces.M034_HomeWood.description: You can keep exactly 1 animal, except <SHEEP>, on each farmyard space containing at least 1 <FOREST>.
messages.cardFaces.M034_HomeWood.name: Home Wood
messages.cardFaces.M035_HorseTrough.description: You can keep up to 2 <HORSE> in an unused farmyard space adjacent to your house. Even if you do, this farmyard space is still considered unused. You can change in which farmyard space you keep the <HORSE>.
messages.cardFaces.M035_HorseTrough.name: Horse Trough
messages.cardFaces.M036_PeatMoss.description: Wooden rooms only cost you 3 <WOOD> and 1 <REED> each.
messages.cardFaces.M036_PeatMoss.name: Peat Moss
messages.cardFaces.M037_BuildingPlan.description: Each time after you build at least 2 rooms at once, you can build up to 2 <STABLE> without paying <WOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.M037_BuildingPlan.name: Building Plan
messages.cardFaces.M038_NatureReserve.description: Immediately <FENCE> a farmyard space containing at least 1 <FOREST> or <MOOR> that is adjacent to a pasture, without paying <WOOD> for the <FENCE>. Once there are no tiles left in the fenced area, the farmyard space becomes a pasture.
messages.cardFaces.M038_NatureReserve.name: Nature Reserve
messages.cardFaces.M039_SpecialPasture.descriptio: Immediately <FENCE> a farmyard space that is not adjacent to an existing pasture, without paying <WOOD> for the <FENCE>. You can connect your pastures later. All future pastures must be adjacent to at least one existing pasture.
messages.cardFaces.M039_SpecialPasture.name: Special Pasture
messages.cardFaces.M040_MoorFire.description: Once you only have 1 remaining <MOOR>, at any time, you can exchange it for 1 <FIELD> tile.
messages.cardFaces.M040_MoorFire.name: Moor Fire
messages.cardFaces.M041_CattleCollar.description: Each time after you use the __Farmland__ or __Cultivation__ action space or take the __Slash and Burn__ special action, if you have at least 1 <CATTLE>, you can plow 1 additional <FIELD>.
messages.cardFaces.M041_CattleCollar.name: Cattle Collar
messages.cardFaces.M042_DeepPlow.description: You can immediately place 1 <MOOR> on an unused farmyard space. Each time you use the __Farmland__ or __Cultivation__ action space, you can also exchange 1 <MOOR> for 1 <FIELD> tile.
messages.cardFaces.M042_DeepPlow.name: Deep Plow
messages.cardFaces.M043_WildFields.description: You can immediately place up to 2 <FIELD> tiles, one at a time, on unused farmyard spaces that are not adjacent to existing <FIELD>. You can connect your <FIELD> later. All future <FIELD> must be adjacent to at least one existing <FIELD>.
messages.cardFaces.M043_WildFields.name: Wild Fields
messages.cardFaces.M044_Swamp.description: Place 1 <MOOR> on round space 12. At the start of that round, you can place the <MOOR> on an unused farmyard space.
messages.cardFaces.M044_Swamp.name: Swamp
messages.cardFaces.M045_TreeNursery.description: Place 1 <FOREST> each on the round spaces 12 and 13. At the start of these rounds, you can place the <FOREST> on an unused farmyard space.
messages.cardFaces.M045_TreeNursery.name: Tree Nursery
messages.cardFaces.M046_Thicket.description: Choose up to 2 of your <FOREST> and place 1 additional <FOREST> on top of each of them. You cannot take the __Slash and Burn__ special action on these farmyard spaces unless you remove a tile with a __Fell Trees__ special action first.
messages.cardFaces.M046_Thicket.name: Thicket
messages.cardFaces.M047_BogForest.description: Place 1 <FOREST> each on as many of your <MOOR> as you wish. You cannot take the __Slash and Burn__ special action or use the covered <MOOR> on these farmyard spaces unless you remove the <FOREST> with a __Fell Trees__ special action first.
messages.cardFaces.M047_BogForest.name: Bog Forest
messages.cardFaces.M048_ForestSwamp.description: Each time you take the __Cut Peat__ special action, add 4 to the current round and place 1 <FOREST> on the corresponding round space. At the start of that round, you can place the <FOREST> on an unused farmyard space.
messages.cardFaces.M048_ForestSwamp.name: Forest Swamp
messages.cardFaces.M049_SurveyorsMap.description: Place a <FIELD> tile on round space 11, a <MOOR> on round space 12, and a <FOREST> on round space 13. At the start of these rounds, you can place the respective tile on an unused farmyard space per the normal rules.
messages.cardFaces.M049_SurveyorsMap.name: Surveyor's Map
messages.cardFaces.M050_FarmExtension.description: Place a farmyard extension at one of the four sides of your farmyard board. Both new farmyard spaces must be adjacent to existing farmyard spaces.
messages.cardFaces.M050_FarmExtension.name: Farm Extension
messages.cardFaces.M051_MoorEnclosures.descriptio: Place a farmyard extension at one of the four sides of your farmyard board and place 1 <MOOR> on each of the 2 new farmyard spaces. Both new farmyard spaces must be adjacent to existing farmyard spaces.
messages.cardFaces.M051_MoorEnclosures.name: Moor Enclosures
messages.cardFaces.M052_WeddingCoach.description: When you play this card, you can immediately take a "Family Growth without Room" action without placing a person. Place the newborn on this card until the returning home phase.
messages.cardFaces.M052_WeddingCoach.name: Wedding Coach
messages.cardFaces.M053_ForestHut.description: Place 1 person from your supply on a <FOREST>. Once you remove the <FOREST>, you can place the person that round. In the returning home phase of that round, return the person to your supply. Until then, you cannot use it for family growth.
messages.cardFaces.M053_ForestHut.name: Forest Hut
messages.cardFaces.M054_AgriculturalImplement.des: Immediately after each time you use the __Farmland__ or __Cultivation__ action space, you can take a face-up special action card. The special action card costs 0 or 2 <FOOD>, as usual.
messages.cardFaces.M055_ToolShed.description: Once per round, immediately before or after you take the __Slash and Burn__ or __Cut Peat__ special action, you can also take the respective other special action.
messages.cardFaces.M055_ToolShed.name: Tool Shed
messages.cardFaces.M056_PeatCuttingRights.descrip: Add 4 and 7 to the current round and place 1 <FUEL> on each corresponding round space. At the start of these rounds, you can discard the <FUEL> and take the __Cut Peat__ special action by taking the appropriate special action card.
messages.cardFaces.M056_PeatCuttingRights.name: Peat-Cutting Rights
messages.cardFaces.M057_Taps.description: In each work phase, after you have placed all of your people, when it would be your turn again, you get exactly one more turn in which you can take a face-up special action card. The special action card costs 0 or 2 <FOOD>, as usual.
messages.cardFaces.M057_Taps.name: Taps
messages.cardFaces.M058_PeatFertilizer.descriptio: Each time after you take the __Cut Peat__ special action, you can also take a __Sow__ action.
messages.cardFaces.M058_PeatFertilizer.name: Peat Fertilizer
messages.cardFaces.M059_NaturesFertilizer.descrip: Each time after you take the __Slash and Burn__ special action, you also get a __Sow__ action for the new <FIELD> only. This also applies when you exchange 1 <MOOR> for 1 <FIELD> tile via a minor improvement.
messages.cardFaces.M059_NaturesFertilizer.name: Nature's Fertilizer
messages.cardFaces.M060_SowingMachine.description: Each time after you take a special action, if you then have at least 2 <HORSE>, you can also take a __Sow__ action.
messages.cardFaces.M060_SowingMachine.name: Sowing Machine
messages.cardFaces.M061_HayWagon.description: Each time after you take at least 3 <WOOD>, 3 <CLAY>, 2 <REED>, or 2 <STONE> from an accumulation space, you can take a __Build Rooms__ or __Renovation__ action without placing a person.
messages.cardFaces.M061_HayWagon.name: Hay Wagon
messages.cardFaces.M062_HearthBrush.description: You can immediately move up the Tiled Oven. From the next round on, you can build it immediately after a person action by paying its cost. During scoring, it is worth 1 additional bonus <SCORE> for you.
messages.cardFaces.M062_HearthBrush.name: Hearth Brush
messages.cardFaces.M063_PastoralLetter.descriptio: You can immediately move up the Village Church. From the next round on, you can build it immediately after a person action by paying its cost. During scoring, the Church and Village Church are each worth 1 additional bonus <SCORE> for you.
messages.cardFaces.M063_PastoralLetter.name: Pastoral Letter
messages.cardFaces.M064_FamilyBurialPlot.descript: When you play this card, you can immediately place the "Tombstone" token on an unused farmyard space. That space counts as used but it is blocked for the rest of the game. During scoring, it is worth 1 additional bonus <SCORE>.
messages.cardFaces.M064_FamilyBurialPlot.name: Family Burial Plot
messages.cardFaces.M065_FireBrigade.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 2 <FOOD>. Additionally, if there are <FOREST> on at least 2/3/4/5 of your farmyard spaces, you immediately get 1/2/3/4 bonus <SCORE>. Crops and <WOOD> do not count but you can exchange them.
messages.cardFaces.M065_FireBrigade.name: Fire Brigade
messages.cardFaces.M066_LandParcel.description: Place 1 <FOREST> on an unused farmyard space. During scoring, if you have 1/2/3+ unused farmyard spaces, you get +2/-1/-3 bonus <SCORE> on top of the negative points for the unused spaces.
messages.cardFaces.M066_LandParcel.name: Land Parcel
messages.cardFaces.M067_ChamberOfCommerce.descrip: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <WOOD> and 1 <REED>. During scoring, you get 1 additional bonus <SCORE> for each of the "Joinery", "Pottery", and "Basketmaker's Workshop" major improvements that you have.
messages.cardFaces.M067_ChamberOfCommerce.name: Chamber of Commerce
messages.cardFaces.M068_Church.description: Returning home phase: once, you can pay 1 <FUEL> to get 1 bonus <SCORE>. When you build this upgrade, you immediately get 2 <FOOD>. The Village Church starts under the Well.
messages.cardFaces.M068_Church.name: Church
messages.cardFaces.M068_Church.prerequisite: Remove Your Village Church from Play
messages.cardFaces.M069_LeatherSaddle.description: Each time you have at least 3 <HORSE>, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> for each <CATTLE> that you turn into <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.M069_LeatherSaddle.name: Leather Saddle
messages.cardFaces.M070_MoorArchaeology.descripti: Each time you take the __Cut Peat__ special action, you can place 1 <FENCE> from your supply on the emptied farmyard space. That space counts as used but it is blocked for the rest of the game. During scoring, it is worth 1 additional bonus <SCORE>.
messages.cardFaces.M070_MoorArchaeology.name: Moor Archaeology
messages.cardFaces.M071_BogBody.description: During scoring, the owner of the Museum of the Moors and the owner of the Living History Museum each get 1 bonus <SCORE>. The Museum of the Moors is a major improvement; the Living History Museum is a minor improvement.
messages.cardFaces.M071_BogBody.name: Bog Body
messages.cardFaces.M072_OvenDamper.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 3 <FUEL>. During scoring, you get 1 additional bonus <SCORE> each for the "Clay Oven", "Stone Oven", "Heating Oven", and "Tiled Oven" major improvements and the "Oven Installation" upgrade.
messages.cardFaces.M072_OvenDamper.name: Oven Damper
messages.cardFaces.M073_StockBreedingPrize.descri: During scoring, if you have at least 1 animal of each of the 4 types, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> for each other player in the game. These points are doubled or tripled if you have 2 or 3 animals of each type, respectively.
messages.cardFaces.M073_StockBreedingPrize.name: Stock-Breeding Prize
messages.cardFaces.M074_Administration.descriptio: When you play this card, you immediately get 2 <FOOD>. In the harvest at the end of round 14, for each major improvement you have, you can exchange 1 <FOOD> for 1 bonus <SCORE>. This card counts as an improvement in hand for its prerequisite.
messages.cardFaces.M074_Administration.name: Administration
messages.cardFaces.M075_FuelStorage.description: Add 1, 3, 5, 7, 9, and 11 to the current round. Alternate placing 1 <WOOD> and 1 <FUEL> on the corresponding round spaces, starting with <WOOD>. At the start of these rounds, you get the good.
messages.cardFaces.M075_FuelStorage.name: Fuel Storage
messages.cardFaces.M076_Flatboat.description: Alternate placing 1 <FUEL> and 1 <HORSE> on each of the next 7 round spaces, starting with <FUEL>. At the start of these rounds, you get the respective good.
messages.cardFaces.M076_Flatboat.name: Flatboat
messages.cardFaces.M077_DryingField.description: Each time you take the __Cut Peat__ special action, add 3 to the current round and place 2 <FUEL> on the corresponding round space. At the start of that round, you get the <FUEL>.
messages.cardFaces.M077_DryingField.name: Drying Field
messages.cardFaces.M078_Barge.description: Alternate placing 1 <FUEL> and 1 <FOOD> on each remaining round space, starting with <FUEL>. At the start of these rounds, you get the respective good.
messages.cardFaces.M078_Barge.name: Barge
messages.cardFaces.M079_PeatSled.description: Add your choice of 2/4/7/10 to the current round and place 3/4/5/6 <FUEL> on the corresponding round space. At the start of that round, you get the <FUEL>.
messages.cardFaces.M079_PeatSled.name: Peat Sled
messages.cardFaces.M080_AdvancePayment.name: Advance Payment
messages.cardFaces.M081_PeatBoat.description: At any time: 3 <FUEL> <ARROW> 2 <WOOD> or 2 <CLAY>; 4 <FUEL> <ARROW> 2 <REED> or 2 <STONE>; 2 <FUEL> <ARROW> 1 <SHEEP>; 3 <FUEL> <ARROW> 1 <FOOD>. You cannot get only one of a building resource from this.
messages.cardFaces.M081_PeatBoat.name: Peat Boat
messages.cardFaces.M082_Firewood.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <FUEL>. During each harvest, if you exchange at least 1 <WOOD> for 1 <FUEL> to heat your house, you need a total of 1 <FUEL> less to heat it.
messages.cardFaces.M082_Firewood.name: Firewood
messages.cardFaces.M083_CoalSeam.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <FUEL>. Each time you take the __Hiring Fair__ special action or use the __Day Laborer__ action space, you also get 1 <FUEL>.
messages.cardFaces.M083_CoalSeam.name: Coal Seam
messages.cardFaces.M084_BogPony.description: At any time, you can lie a standing <HORSE> on its side to get 2 <FUEL>. Lying <HORSE> do not count for breeding and are only worth 1/2 point during scoring. They can, however, be turned into <FOOD> with an appropriate improvement.
messages.cardFaces.M084_BogPony.name: Bog Pony
messages.cardFaces.M085_OvenInstallation.descript: You no longer need to heat your house. The Heating Oven starts under the Clay Oven.
messages.cardFaces.M085_OvenInstallation.name: Oven Installation
messages.cardFaces.M086_SpinningMill.description: For every 2 <SHEEP> that you have in the field phase of each harvest, you pay 1 <FUEL> less to heat your house in the feeding phase of that harvest, but not less than 0 <FUEL>.
messages.cardFaces.M086_SpinningMill.name: Spinning Mill
messages.cardFaces.M087_PeatBarge.description: Each time you use the __Fishing__ accumulation space, you also get 2 <FUEL>.
messages.cardFaces.M087_PeatBarge.name: Peat Barge
messages.cardFaces.M088_PeatIron.description: At the start of each harvest, if you have at least 2 <MOOR>, you get 1 <FUEL>.
messages.cardFaces.M088_PeatIron.name: Peat Iron
messages.cardFaces.M089_BirthingHouse.description: Immediately after each time you take a "Family Growth" action with or without room, you get 1 <FUEL>, 1 <FOOD>, and 1 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.cardFaces.M089_BirthingHouse.name: Birthing House
messages.cardFaces.M090_WinterStorehouse.descript: Place 3 usage counters on this card. At any time, you can return 1 usage counter from this card to get as much <FUEL> and <FOOD> until you have at least 2 <FUEL> and 2 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.M090_WinterStorehouse.name: Winter Storehouse
messages.cardFaces.M091_RoutineWork.description: Each harvest, you get your choice of 1 <FUEL> or 1 <FOOD> for each of your craft buildings (Joinery, Pottery, and Basketmaker's Workshop) that you choose not to use to turn a building resource into <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.M091_RoutineWork.name: Routine Work
messages.cardFaces.M092_AridField.description: Each time you take the __Cut Peat__ special action, place 1 <FUEL> and 1 <FOOD> on the emptied farmyard space. This farmyard space is still considered unused. You get the goods once the farmyard space is no longer unused.
messages.cardFaces.M092_AridField.name: Arid Field
messages.cardFaces.M093_FarmhandsQuarters.descrip: Each time you build a major improvement, you can replace 1 building resource of your choice with 1 <FUEL>. Each time you get an improvement in your hand from the player to your right, you also get 1 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.M093_FarmhandsQuarters.name: Farmhands' Quarters
messages.cardFaces.M094_PeatBath.description: Each time you use the "Infirmary" action space, place 1 <FOOD> on as many of the next round spaces as there are <MOOR> visible on your farmyard board. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.M094_PeatBath.name: Peat Bath
messages.cardFaces.M095_FallowFields.description: Place 2 <FOOD> on each of up to 3 of your empty <FIELD>. You cannot harvest the <FOOD>. You get it when you sow in these <FIELD>.
messages.cardFaces.M095_FallowFields.name: Fallow Fields
messages.cardFaces.M096_FallowLand.description: Each time you take the __Fell Trees__ or __Cut Peat__ special action, place 1 <FOOD> on the emptied farmyard space. This farmyard space is still considered unused. Once the farmyard space is no longer unused, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.M096_FallowLand.name: Fallow Land
messages.cardFaces.M097_VillageHall.description: At the start of each returning home phase in which there is no special action card in front of you, you get 2 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.M097_VillageHall.name: Village Hall
messages.cardFaces.M098_FishSmokehouse.descriptio: Each time you use the __Fishing__ accumulation space, you can pay 1 <FUEL> to get an additional 3 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.M098_FishSmokehouse.name: Fish Smoke-house
messages.cardFaces.M099_HealingClay.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <FOOD>. Each time you use the "Infirmary" action space with a person lying in bed, you get 1 additional <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.M099_HealingClay.name: Healing Clay
messages.cardFaces.M100_Pheromones.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <FOOD>. Additionally, each player, including you, with at least 1 <STABLE> or pasture immediately gets 2 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.M100_Pheromones.name: Pheromones
messages.cardFaces.M101_ButchersBlock.description: You cannot play this card in rounds 4, 7, 9, 11, 13, and 14. All other players must and you can turn any 1 animal into <FOOD>: <SHEEP> <ARROW> 1 <FOOD>, <PIG> <ARROW> 2 <FOOD>, <CATTLE> <ARROW> 3 <FOOD>, <HORSE> <ARROW> 2 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.M101_ButchersBlock.name: Butcher's Block
