messages.cardFaces.M102_SavingsDeposit.descriptio: At the start of each harvest, shuffle all start cards and draw one. If its number is equal to or lower than the amount of <CLAY> you have, you immediately get 6 <FOOD>. Then pass this card to the player on your left, who adds it to their hand.
messages.cardFaces.M102_SavingsDeposit.name: Savings Deposit
messages.cardFaces.M103_ForestKindergarten.descri: Immediately after each time you take a "Family Growth" action with or without room, you get 1 <FOOD> for each of your farmyard spaces containing at least 1 <FOREST>.
messages.cardFaces.M103_ForestKindergarten.name: Forest Kindergarten
messages.cardFaces.M104_WildHarvest.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <FOOD>. At the start of each harvest, shuffle all start cards and draw one. If its number is equal to or lower than the number of <FOREST> you have, you immediately get 1 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.M104_WildHarvest.name: Wild Harvest
messages.cardFaces.M105_OpenGrill.name: Open Grill
messages.cardFaces.M106_HorseButchery.description: At any time: <SHEEP> <ARROW> 1 <FOOD>; <PIG> <ARROW> 2 <FOOD>; <CATTLE> <ARROW> 3 <FOOD>; <HORSE> <ARROW> 2 <FOOD>; 2 <HORSE> <ARROW> 5 <FOOD>. The Horse Slaughterhouses start under the Fireplaces.
messages.cardFaces.M106_HorseButchery.name: Horse Butchery
messages.cardFaces.M107_PotRoastRecipe.descriptio: At any time, you can use your "Fireplace" and "Cooking Hearth" major improvements to turn 1 <HORSE> into 2 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.M107_PotRoastRecipe.name: Pot Roast Recipe
messages.cardFaces.M108_GrainDistillery.descripti: Harvest: once, you can turn 1 <FUEL> and 1 <GRAIN> into 5 <FOOD>. Any number of times during scoring: 1 <FUEL> and 1 <GRAIN> <ARROW> 1 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.cardFaces.M108_GrainDistillery.name: Grain Distillery
messages.cardFaces.M109_Malthouse.description: Each time you take the __Cut Peat__ special action, you can also turn exactly 1 <GRAIN> into 4 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.M109_Malthouse.name: Malthouse
messages.cardFaces.M110_FarmCart.description: Each time you take at least 5 <WOOD>, 4 <CLAY>, 3 <REED>, or 2 <STONE> from an accumulation space, you also get 1 <GRAIN>.
messages.cardFaces.M110_FarmCart.name: Farm Cart
messages.cardFaces.M111_NoTillFarming.description: You can plant <GRAIN> or <VEGETABLE> on up to 2 unused farmyard spaces. Even if you do, these farmyard spaces are not considered <FIELD> but still unused. You can discard crops from these farmyard spaces at any time.
messages.cardFaces.M111_NoTillFarming.name: No-Till Farming
messages.cardFaces.M112_PeatAshFertilizer.descrip: Each time before you take the __Cut Peat__ special action, you can place 1 additional crop of the same type on all <FIELD> and farmyard spaces containing <GRAIN> or <VEGETABLE>. Do not place any crops on empty <FIELD> and farmyard spaces.
messages.cardFaces.M112_PeatAshFertilizer.name: Peat Ash Fertilizer
messages.cardFaces.M113_LivingHistoryMuseum.descr: These major improvements cost you 1 building resource less: Heating Oven 1 <CLAY>, Tiled Oven 1 <STONE>, Riding Stables 1 <WOOD>, Village Church 1 <STONE>, Furniture Stall 1 <WOOD>, Basket Stall 1 <REED>, Ceramics Stall 1 <CLAY>. It starts under the Peat-charcoal Kiln.
messages.cardFaces.M113_LivingHistoryMuseum.name: Living History Museum
messages.cardFaces.M114_RiversideWoods.descriptio: With this card, each time you use the __Fishing__ accumulation space, you also get 1 <WOOD> for each of your farmyard spaces containing at least 1 <FOREST>, up to a maximum of 3 <WOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.M114_RiversideWoods.name: Riverside Woods
messages.cardFaces.M115_OakBark.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 2 <WOOD>. Each time you turn <PIG>, <CATTLE>, or <HORSE> into <FOOD>, you get 1 additional <WOOD> for each of these animals that you turn.
messages.cardFaces.M115_OakBark.name: Oak Bark
messages.cardFaces.M116_MoorBirchTrees.descriptio: Each time you take the __Cut Peat__ special action, you also get 2 <WOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.M116_MoorBirchTrees.name: Moor Birch Trees
messages.cardFaces.M117_DraughtHorses.description: Each time you take exactly 3 or at least 4 <WOOD> from an accumulation space, if you have at least 1 <HORSE>, you can pay exactly 1 <FOOD> to get 1 or 2 additional <WOOD>, respectively.
messages.cardFaces.M117_DraughtHorses.name: Draught-horses
messages.cardFaces.M118_TimberMill.description: Each time you take the __Fell Trees__ special action or take at least 4 <WOOD> from an accumulation space, you get 1 additional <WOOD>. If you pay 1 <FUEL>, you get 2 additional <WOOD> instead of 1.
messages.cardFaces.M118_TimberMill.name: Timber Mill
messages.cardFaces.M119_AlderSwamp.description: Each time you take the __Fell Trees__ special action, you also get your choice of 1 <WOOD> or 1 <REED>.
messages.cardFaces.M119_AlderSwamp.name: Alder Swamp
messages.cardFaces.M120_RiverClay.description: Each time you use the __Fishing__ accumulation space, you also get 2 <CLAY>.
messages.cardFaces.M120_RiverClay.name: River Clay
messages.cardFaces.M121_Loam.description: In each work phase, if you have placed all but one of your people when taking the __Hiring Fair__ special action, you also get 1 <CLAY>.
messages.cardFaces.M121_Loam.name: Loam
messages.cardFaces.M122_WillowBank.description: Each time you take the __Fell Trees__ special action, you also get 1 <REED>.
messages.cardFaces.M122_WillowBank.name: Willow Bank
messages.cardFaces.M123_StoneQuarry.description: Place 5 <STONE>--only 3 <STONE> in 3-player games--on this card. Each time you take the __Hiring Fair__ special action, you also get 1 <STONE> from this card.
messages.cardFaces.M123_StoneQuarry.name: Stone Quarry
messages.cardFaces.M124_StoneWagon.description: Each time you use the __Day Laborer__ action space, you also get 1 <STONE>.
messages.cardFaces.M124_StoneWagon.name: Stone Wagon
messages.cardFaces.M125_HardwareStore.description: Place 3 usage counters on this card. At any time, you can return 1 usage counter from this card to take 1 of each building resource that you have none of in your supply.
messages.cardFaces.M125_HardwareStore.name: Hardware Store
messages.cardFaces.M126_CooperativeStore.descript: Place 4 usage counters on this card. At any time, you can return 1 usage counter from this card plus 1 building resource of your choice to get 1 of any other building resource except <STONE>.
messages.cardFaces.M126_CooperativeStore.name: Cooperative Store
messages.cardFaces.M127_Wheelbarrow.description: Each time you take at least 4 of the same building resource from an accumulation space, you also get 1 <FUEL>. Each time you take the __Cut Peat__ special action, you also get 1 building resource of your choice.
messages.cardFaces.M127_Wheelbarrow.name: Wheelbarrow
messages.cardFaces.M128_Workbench.description: In the field phase of each harvest at the end of rounds 13 and 14, you get 3 <WOOD>, 2 <CLAY>, and 1 <REED>. You can use these, for example, to earn bonus <SCORE> from the Joinery, Pottery, or Basketmaker's Workshop.
messages.cardFaces.M128_Workbench.name: Workbench
messages.cardFaces.M129_PlowhorseMarket.descripti: Each time you use the __Farmland__ or __Cultivation__ action space, you can also buy exactly 1 <HORSE> for 1 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.M129_PlowhorseMarket.name: Plowhorse Market
messages.cardFaces.M130_Nosebag.description: Each time you use the __Grain Seeds__ action space, you also get 1 <HORSE>.
messages.cardFaces.M130_Nosebag.name: Nosebag
messages.cardFaces.M131_CattleStall.description: Add 2, 4, 6, and 8 to the current round and place 1 animal of your choice on each corresponding round space. All the animals must be different. At the start of these rounds, you can buy the respective animal for 1 <FOOD>.
messages.cardFaces.M131_CattleStall.name: Cattle Stall
messages.cardFaces.Major_Basket.name: Basketmaker
messages.cardFaces.Major_Basket2.name: Basketmaker
messages.cardFaces.Major_ClayOven.description:
[__Bake Bread__ action:]
<GRAIN> <ARROW-1X> 5<FOOD>
[When you build it, you can Bake immediately]
messages.cardFaces.Major_ClayOven.name: Clay Oven
messages.cardFaces.Major_ClayOven2.description:
[__Bake Bread__ action:]
<GRAIN> <ARROW-1X> 5<FOOD>
[When you build it, you can Bake immediately]
messages.cardFaces.Major_ClayOven2.name: Clay Oven
messages.cardFaces.Major_CookingHearth1.name: Cooking Hearth
messages.cardFaces.Major_CookingHearth2.name: Cooking Hearth
messages.cardFaces.Major_CookingHearth3.name: Cooking Hearth
messages.cardFaces.Major_Fireplace1.name: Fireplace
messages.cardFaces.Major_Fireplace2.name: Fireplace
messages.cardFaces.Major_Fireplace3.name: Fireplace
messages.cardFaces.Major_Joinery.name: Joinery
messages.cardFaces.Major_Joinery2.name: Joinery
messages.cardFaces.Major_Moor_BasketStall.name: Basket Stall
messages.cardFaces.Major_Moor_CeramicsStall.name: Ceramics Stall
messages.cardFaces.Major_Moor_Cookhouse1.name: Cookhouse
messages.cardFaces.Major_Moor_Cookhouse2.name: Cookhouse
messages.cardFaces.Major_Moor_ForestersLodge.desc:
[Special action: __Fell Trees__]
Gain 1 extra <WOOD>, or 2 extra <WOOD> if you have at least 1<HORSE>.
[Scoring]
Gain 1 <SCORE> for each <FOREST> in your farmyard.
messages.cardFaces.Major_Moor_ForestersLodge.name: Forester's Lodge
messages.cardFaces.Major_Moor_FurnitureStall.name: Furniture Stall
messages.cardFaces.Major_Moor_HeatingOven.descrip:
Immediately gain 2<FUEL>.
When heating, heat 1 fewer room than you have.
messages.cardFaces.Major_Moor_HeatingOven.name: Heating Oven
messages.cardFaces.Major_Moor_MuseumOfTheMoors.de:
These major improvements cost you 1 building resource less:
Well 1 <STONE>      Clay Oven 1 <CLAY>
Joinery 1 <WOOD>      Stone Oven 1 <STONE>
Pottery 1 <CLAY>      Forester's Lodge 1 <CLAY>
Basketmaker's Workshop 1 <REED>
messages.cardFaces.Major_Moor_PeatCharcoalKiln.de:
[Special action: __Cut Peat__]
+1<FUEL> if you have 0<HORSE>; +2<FUEL> if you have at least 1<HORSE>.

messages.minorImprovements.A001_Shelter.descripti: You can immediately build a <STABLE> at no cost, but only if you place it in a pasture covering exactly 1 farmyard space.
messages.minorImprovements.A001_Shelter.name: Shelter
messages.minorImprovements.A003_PaperKnife.descri: Select 3 occupations in your hand. Select one of them randomly, which you can play immediately without paying an occupation cost.
messages.minorImprovements.A003_PaperKnife.name: Paper Knife
messages.minorImprovements.A004_Baseboards.descri: You immediately get 1 <WOOD> for each room you have. If you have more rooms than people, you get 1 additional <WOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.A004_Baseboards.name: Baseboards
messages.minorImprovements.A005_ClayEmbankment.de: You immediately get 1 <CLAY> for every 2 <CLAY> you already have in your supply.
messages.minorImprovements.A006_StorageBarn.descr: If you have the Well, Joinery, Pottery, and/or Basketmaker's Workshop, you immediately get 1 <STONE>, 1 <WOOD>, 1 <CLAY>, and/or 1 <REED>, respectively.
messages.minorImprovements.A006_StorageBarn.name: Storage Barn
messages.minorImprovements.A007_GardenersKnife.de: You immediately get 1 <FOOD> for each <GRAIN> <FIELD> you have and 1 <GRAIN> for each <VEGETABLE> <FIELD> you have.
messages.minorImprovements.A008_FoodBasket.name: Food Basket
messages.minorImprovements.A009_YoungAnimalMarket: You immediately get 1 <CATTLE>. (Effectively, you are exchanging 1 <SHEEP> for 1 <CATTLE>.)
messages.minorImprovements.A010_WoodenShed.descri: This card can only be played via a __Major Improvement__ action. It provides room for one person. You may no longer renovate.
messages.minorImprovements.A010_WoodenShed.name: Wooden Shed
messages.minorImprovements.A011_MudPatch.descript: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <PIG>. You can hold 1 <PIG> on each of your unplanted <FIELD> tiles.
messages.minorImprovements.A011_MudPatch.name: Mud Patch
messages.minorImprovements.A012_DrinkingTrough.de: Each of your pastures (with or without a <STABLE>) can hold up to 2 more animals.
messages.minorImprovements.A013_RenovationCompany: When you play this card, you immediately get 3 <CLAY>. Immediately after, you can renovate without paying any building resources.
In Wooden House with Exactly 2 Rooms
Each time you build at least 2 wood/clay/stone rooms at once, you get a total discount of 2 <REED> as well as 2 <WOOD>/3 <CLAY>/4 <STONE>.
messages.minorImprovements.A015_CarpentersAxe.des: Each time after you use a <WOOD> accumulation space, if you then have at least 7 <WOOD> in your supply, you can build exactly 1 <STABLE> for 1 <WOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.A016_RammedClay.descri: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <CLAY>. You can use <CLAY> instead of <WOOD> to build <FENCE>.
messages.minorImprovements.A016_RammedClay.name: Rammed Clay
messages.minorImprovements.A017_ReclamationPlow.d: After the next time you take animals from an accumulation space and accommodate all of them on your farm, you can plow 1 field.
messages.minorImprovements.A018_WheelPlow.descrip: Once this game, when you use the __Farmland__ or __Cultivation__ action space with the first person you place in a round, you can plow 2 additional <FIELD>.
messages.minorImprovements.A018_WheelPlow.name: Wheel Plow
messages.minorImprovements.A019_Handplow.descript: Add 5 to the current round and place 1 <FIELD> tile on the corresponding round space. At the start of that round, you can plow the <FIELD>.
messages.minorImprovements.A019_Handplow.name: Handplow
messages.minorImprovements.A020_DoubleTurnPlow.de: When you play this card, you can immediately plow up to 2 <FIELD>.
Each time you take a __Build Rooms__ action while having more rooms than people already, you also get a __Family Growth__ action and 1 <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.A022_Telegram.descript: Add 1 to the current round for each fence in your supply and mark the corresponding round space. In that round only, you can place a person from your supply.
messages.minorImprovements.A022_Telegram.name: Telegram
messages.minorImprovements.A023_StoneCompany.desc: Immediately after each time you use a __Quarry__ accumulation space, you get a __Major or Minor Improvement__ action during which you must spend at least 1 <STONE>.
messages.minorImprovements.A023_StoneCompany.name: Stone Company
messages.minorImprovements.A024_ThreshingBoard.de: Each time you use the __Farmland__ or __Cultivation__ action space, you get an additional __Bake Bread__ action.
messages.minorImprovements.A025_Bassinet.descript: You can place a(nother) person on the first non-accumulating action space used in each work phase, if there is only 1 person, including newborns, on that space. (There can never be two people on __Meeting Place__.)
messages.minorImprovements.A025_Bassinet.name: Bassinet
messages.minorImprovements.A026_SleepingCorner.de: You can use any __Wish for Children__ action space even if it is occupied by one other player's person.
messages.minorImprovements.A027_OvenSite.descript: When you play this card, you get 2 <WOOD> and you can immediately build the __Clay Oven__ or __Stone Oven__ major improvement. Either way, it only costs you 1 <CLAY> and 1 <STONE>.
messages.minorImprovements.A027_OvenSite.name: Oven Site
messages.minorImprovements.A028_ForestSchool.desc: You can consider the __Lessons__ action spaces not occupied. You can replace each <FOOD> that an occupation costs with <WOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.A028_ForestSchool.name: Forest School
messages.minorImprovements.A029_AleBenches.descri: In the returning home phase of each round, you can pay exactly 1 <GRAIN> from your supply to get 1 bonus <SCORE>. If you do, each other player gets 1 <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.A029_AleBenches.name: Ale-Benches
messages.minorImprovements.A030_BakingSheet.descr: Each time you take a __Bake Bread__ action, you can use this card to exchange exactly 1 <GRAIN> for 2 <FOOD> and 1 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.minorImprovements.A030_BakingSheet.name: Baking Sheet
messages.minorImprovements.A031_DebtSecurity.desc: During scoring, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> for each major improvement you have, up to the number of your unused farmyard spaces.
messages.minorImprovements.A031_DebtSecurity.name: Debt Security
messages.minorImprovements.A032_Manger.descriptio: During scoring, if your pastures cover at least 6/7/8/10 farmyard spaces, you get 1/2/3/4 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.minorImprovements.A032_Manger.name: Manger
messages.minorImprovements.A033_BigCountry.descri: For each complete round left to play, you immediately get 1 bonus <SCORE> and 2 <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.A033_BigCountry.name: Big Country
messages.minorImprovements.A034_Loppers.descripti: Each time you build 1 or more <FENCE>, you can also use this card to exchange 1 <WOOD> and 1 <FENCE> in your supply for 2 <FOOD> and 1 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.minorImprovements.A034_Loppers.name: Loppers
messages.minorImprovements.A035_SwimmingClass.des: In the returning home phase of each round, if you return a person from the __Fishing__ accumulation space, you get 2 bonus <SCORE> for each newborn that you return home.
messages.minorImprovements.A036_FacadesCarving.de: When you play this card, you can exchange any number of <FOOD> for 1 bonus <SCORE> each, up to the number of completed harvests.
messages.minorImprovements.A036_FacadesCarving.pr: Wood in Your Supply >= Current Round
messages.minorImprovements.A037_Bucksaw.descripti: Each time you renovate, you can also pay 1 <WOOD> to get 1 bonus <SCORE> and 1 <GRAIN>.
messages.minorImprovements.A037_Bucksaw.name: Bucksaw
messages.minorImprovements.A038_WoolBlankets.desc: During scoring, if you live in a wooden/<CLAY>/stone house by then, you get 3/2/0 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.minorImprovements.A038_WoolBlankets.name: Wool Blankets
messages.minorImprovements.A039_Chapel.descriptio: This is an action space for all. A player who uses it gets 3 bonus <SCORE>. If another player uses it, they must first pay you 1 <GRAIN>.
messages.minorImprovements.A039_Chapel.name: Chapel
messages.minorImprovements.A040_PottersYard.descr: Immediately place 1 <CLAY> on each unused space in your farmyard. Each time you turn a space into a used space, you get the clay and you can immediately exchange it for 2 <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.A040_PottersYard.name: Potter's Yard
messages.minorImprovements.A041_VegetableSlicer.d: Each time you upgrade a Fireplace to a Cooking Hearth, you immediately get 2 <WOOD> and 1 <VEGETABLE> (not retroactively).
messages.minorImprovements.A042_ForestLakeHut.des: Each time you use the __Fishing__/__Forest__ accumulation space, you also get 1 <WOOD>/<FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.A043_FarmyardManure.de: Each time you build 1 or more <STABLE> in one turn, you place 1 <FOOD> on each of the next 3 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.A044_PondHut.descripti: Place 1 <FOOD> on each of the next 3 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.A044_PondHut.name: Pond Hut
messages.minorImprovements.A045_FireProtectionPon: Once you no longer live in a wooden house, place 1 <FOOD> on each of the next 6 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.A046_ClawKnife.descrip: Each time you use the __Sheep Market__ accumulation space, place 1 <FOOD> on each of the next 2 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.A046_ClawKnife.name: Claw Knife
messages.minorImprovements.A047_Trellises.descrip: Immediately place 1 <FOOD> on each of the next round spaces, up to the number of <FENCE> you have built. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.A047_Trellises.name: Trellises
messages.minorImprovements.A048_ShavingHorse.desc: Each time after you obtain at least 1 <WOOD>, if you then have 5 or more <WOOD> in your supply, you can exchange 1 <WOOD> for 3 <FOOD>. With 7 or more <WOOD>, you must do so.
messages.minorImprovements.A048_ShavingHorse.name: Shaving Horse
messages.minorImprovements.A049_NestSite.descript: Each time 1 <REED> is placed on a non-empty __Reed Bank__ accumulation space during the preparation phase, you get 1 <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.A049_NestSite.name: Nest Site
messages.minorImprovements.A050_MilkJug.descripti: Each time any player (including you) uses the __Cattle Market__ accumulation space, you get 3 <FOOD>, and each other player gets 1 <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.A050_MilkJug.name: Milk Jug
messages.minorImprovements.A051_DriftNetBoat.desc: Each time you use the __Fishing__ accumulation space, you get an additional 2 <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.A051_DriftNetBoat.name: Drift-Net Boat
messages.minorImprovements.A052_ThrowingAxe.descr: Each time you use a <WOOD> accumulation space while there is at least 1 <PIG> on the __Pig Market__ accumulation space, you also get 2 <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.A052_ThrowingAxe.name: Throwing Axe
messages.minorImprovements.A053_Claypipe.descript: In the returning home phase of each round, if you gained at least 7 building resources in the preceding work phase, you get 2 <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.A053_Claypipe.name: Claypipe
messages.minorImprovements.A054_Credit.descriptio: When you play this card, you immediately get 5 <FOOD>. At the end of each round that does not end with a harvest, you must pay 1 <FOOD>, or else take a <BEGGING> marker.
messages.minorImprovements.A054_Credit.name: Credit
messages.minorImprovements.A055_JunkRoom.descript: Each time after you build an improvement, including this one, you get 1 <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.A055_JunkRoom.name: Junk Room
messages.minorImprovements.A056_Basket.descriptio: Immediately after each time you use a <WOOD> accumulation space, you can exchange 2 <WOOD> for 3 <FOOD>. If you do, place those 2 <WOOD> on the accumulation space.
messages.minorImprovements.A056_Basket.name: Basket
messages.minorImprovements.A057_MilkingParlor.des: When you play this card, if you have at least 1/3/4 <SHEEP>, you immediately get 2/3/4 <FOOD>. The same applies if you have at least 1/2/3 <CATTLE>.
messages.minorImprovements.A058_AsparagusKnife.de: In the returning home phase of rounds 8, 10, and 12, you can take 1 <VEGETABLE> from exactly 1 vegetable field. You can immediately exchange it for 3 <FOOD> and 1 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.minorImprovements.A059_PotatoRidger.desc: Each time after you harvest 1+ <VEGETABLE>, if you then have 3+ <VEGETABLE> in your supply, you can turn exactly 1 <VEGETABLE> into 6 <FOOD>. With 4+ <VEGETABLE>, you must do so.
messages.minorImprovements.A059_PotatoRidger.name: Potato Ridger
messages.minorImprovements.A061_WinnowingFan.desc: After the field phase of each harvest, you can use a <BAKE>-improvement but only to turn exactly 1 <GRAIN> into <FOOD>. (This is not considered a __Bake Bread__ action.)
messages.minorImprovements.A061_WinnowingFan.name: Winnowing Fan
messages.minorImprovements.A062_BeerKeg.descripti: In the feeding phase of each harvest, you can use this card to exchange 1/2/3 <GRAIN> for 0/1/2 bonus <SCORE> and exactly 3 <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.A062_BeerKeg.name: Beer Keg
messages.minorImprovements.A063_DutchWindmill.des: Each time you take a __Bake Bread__ action in a round immediately following a harvest, you get 3 additional <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.A064_BarleyMill.descri: In the field phase of each harvest, you get 1 <FOOD> for each grain field that you harvest.
messages.minorImprovements.A064_BarleyMill.name: Barley Mill
messages.minorImprovements.A065_SeedPellets.descr: Each time before you take an unconditional __Sow__ action, you get 1 <GRAIN>.
messages.minorImprovements.A065_SeedPellets.name: Seed Pellets
messages.minorImprovements.A066_FeedingDish.descr: Each time you use an animal accumulation space while already having an animal of that type, you get 1 <GRAIN>.
messages.minorImprovements.A066_FeedingDish.name: Feeding Dish
messages.minorImprovements.A067_CornScoop.descrip: Each time you use the __Grain Seeds__ action space, you get 1 additional <GRAIN>.
messages.minorImprovements.A067_CornScoop.name: Corn Scoop
messages.minorImprovements.A068_AsparagusGift.des: Each time you build a number of <FENCE> equal to or greater than the current round, you immediately get 1 <VEGETABLE>.
messages.minorImprovements.A069_LargeGreenhouse.d: Add 4, 7, and 9 to the current round and place 1 <VEGETABLE> on each corresponding round space. At the start of these rounds, you get the <VEGETABLE>.
messages.minorImprovements.A070_LiftingMachine.de: At the end of each round that does not end with a harvest, you can move 1 <VEGETABLE> from one of your fields to your supply. (This is not considered a field phase.)
messages.minorImprovements.A071_ClearingSpade.des: At any time, you can move 1 crop from a planted field containing at least 2 crops to an empty field.
messages.minorImprovements.A072_CalciumFertilizer: Each time you use a __Quarry__ accumulation space, add 1 additional good of the respective type to each of your planted fields growing a single type of crop.
messages.minorImprovements.A073_AgriculturalFerti: Each time after you turn at least 2 unused spaces into used spaces in one action, you get an additional __Sow__ action.
messages.minorImprovements.A074_StableTree.descri: Each time you build 1 or more stables on your turn, place 1 <WOOD> on each of the next 3 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <WOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.A074_StableTree.name: Stable Tree
messages.minorImprovements.A075_LumberMill.name: Lumber Mill
messages.minorImprovements.A076_Cob.description: At the start of each work phase, if you have at least 1 <CLAY> in your supply, you can exchange exactly 1 <GRAIN> for 2 <CLAY> and 1 <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.A076_Cob.name: Cob
messages.minorImprovements.A077_Hod.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <CLAY>. Each time any player (including you) uses the __Pig Market__ accumulation space, you immediately get 2 <CLAY>.
messages.minorImprovements.A077_Hod.name: Hod
messages.minorImprovements.A078_Canoe.description: Each time you use the __Fishing__ accumulation space, you get an additional 1 <FOOD> and 1 <REED>.
messages.minorImprovements.A078_Canoe.name: Canoe
messages.minorImprovements.A079_GardenHoe.descrip: Each time you take an unconditional __Sow__ action planting <VEGETABLE> in at least 1 field, you get 1 <CLAY> and 1 <STONE>.
messages.minorImprovements.A079_GardenHoe.name: Garden Hoe
messages.minorImprovements.A080_StoneTongs.descri: Each time you use a <STONE> accumulation space, you get 1 additional <STONE>.
messages.minorImprovements.A080_StoneTongs.name: Stone Tongs
messages.minorImprovements.A081_InterimStorage.de: Each time you use a clay/reed/stone accumulation space, place 1 <WOOD>/<CLAY>/<REED> on this card. At the start of rounds 7, 11, and 14, move all the goods on this card to your supply.
messages.minorImprovements.A082_WorkCertificate.d: Each time after you use an action space, you can take 1 building resource from a building resource accumulation space with at least 4 building resources on it.
messages.minorImprovements.A083_ShepherdsCrook.de: Each time you fence a new pasture covering at least 4 farmyard spaces, you immediately get 2 sheep on this pasture.
messages.minorImprovements.A084_Silage.descriptio: In each returning home phase after which there is no harvest, you can pay exactly 1 <GRAIN> - even from a field - to breed exactly one type of animal.
messages.minorImprovements.A084_Silage.name: Silage
messages.minorImprovements.A092_AdoptiveParents.d: For 1 <FOOD>, you can take an action with offspring in the same round you get it. If you do, the offspring does not count as \ .
messages.minorImprovements.A106_SlurrySpreader.de: In the field phase of each harvest, each time you take the last <GRAIN>/<VEGETABLE> from a field, you also get 2 <FOOD>/1 <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.A128_RiparianBuilder.d: Each time another player uses the __Reed Bank__ accumulation space, you can build a room: if you build a clay/stone room, you get a discount of 1 <CLAY>/2 <STONE>.
messages.minorImprovements.A136_DrudgeryReeve.des: If there are still 1/3/6/9 complete rounds left to play, you immediately get 1/2/3/4 <WOOD>. During scoring, each player with 1+/2+/3+ building resources of each type gets 1/3/5 bonus <SCORE>.
You immediately get 5 <CLAY> and a __Renovation__ action. If you take the action, you must pay the renovation cost.
messages.minorImprovements.B002_MiniPasture.descr: Immediately fence a farmyard space, without paying <WOOD> for the fences. (If you already have pastures, the new one must be adjacent to an existing one.)
messages.minorImprovements.B002_MiniPasture.name: Mini Pasture
messages.minorImprovements.B003_Moonshine.descrip: Randomly select an occupation in your hand. Either play it for an occupation cost of 2 <FOOD>, or give it to the next player.
messages.minorImprovements.B003_Moonshine.name: Moonshine
messages.minorImprovements.B004_WoodPile.descript: You immediately get a number of <WOOD> equal to the number of people you have on accumulation spaces.
messages.minorImprovements.B004_WoodPile.name: Wood Pile
messages.minorImprovements.B005_StoreofExperience: If you have 0-4/5/6/7 occupations left in hand, you immediately get 1 <STONE>/<REED>/<CLAY>/<WOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.B006_ExcursiontotheQua: You immediately get a number of <STONE> equal to the number of people you have.
messages.minorImprovements.B007_Wage.description: You immediately get 2 <FOOD> and 1 additional <FOOD> for each major improvement you have from the bottom row of the supply board.
messages.minorImprovements.B007_Wage.name: Wage
messages.minorImprovements.B008_MarketStall.descr: You immediately get 1 <VEGETABLE>. (Effectively, you are exchanging 1 <GRAIN> for 1 <VEGETABLE>).
messages.minorImprovements.B008_MarketStall.name: Market Stall
messages.minorImprovements.B009_BeatingRod.descri: You can immediately choose to either get 1 <REED> or exchange 1 <REED> for 1 <CATTLE>.
messages.minorImprovements.B009_BeatingRod.name: Beating Rod
messages.minorImprovements.B010_Caravan.descripti: This card provides room for 1 person.
messages.minorImprovements.B010_Caravan.name: Caravan
messages.minorImprovements.B011_Feedyard.descript: This card can hold 1 animal for each pasture you have, even different types. After the breeding phase of each harvest, you get 1 <FOOD> for each unused spot on this card.
messages.minorImprovements.B011_Feedyard.name: Feedyard
messages.minorImprovements.B012_Stockyard.descrip: This card can hold up to 3 animals of the same type. (It is not considered a pasture).
messages.minorImprovements.B012_Stockyard.name: Stockyard
Wooden rooms only cost you 2 <WOOD> and 2 <REED> each.
messages.minorImprovements.B014_Hawktower.descrip: Place a stone room on round space 12. If you live in a stone house at the start of the round, you can build the stone room at no cost. Otherwise, discard the stone room.
messages.minorImprovements.B014_Hawktower.name: Hawktower
messages.minorImprovements.B015_CarpentersBench.d: Immediately after each time you use a wood accumulation space, you can use the taken wood (and only that) to build exactly 1 pasture. If you do, one of the fences is free.
messages.minorImprovements.B016_MiningHammer.desc: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <FOOD>. Each time you renovate, you can also build a <STABLE> without paying <WOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.B016_MiningHammer.name: Mining Hammer
messages.minorImprovements.B017_ForestPlow.descri: Each time after you use a <WOOD> accumulation space, you can pay 2 <WOOD> to plow 1 <FIELD>. Place the paid <WOOD> on the accumulation space (for the next visitor).
messages.minorImprovements.B017_ForestPlow.name: Forest Plow
messages.minorImprovements.B018_GrasslandHarrow.d: Add 1 to the current round for each building resource in your supply and place 1 <FIELD> on the corresponding round space. At the start of the round, you can plow the <FIELD>.
messages.minorImprovements.B019_MoldboardPlow.des: Place 2 field tiles on this card. Twice this game, when you use the __Farmland__ action space, you can also plow 1 field from this card.
messages.minorImprovements.B020_ChainFloat.descri: Add 7, 8, and 9 to the current round and place 1 <FIELD> on each corresponding round space. At the start of these rounds, you can plow the <FIELD>.
messages.minorImprovements.B020_ChainFloat.name: Chain Float
messages.minorImprovements.B021_HayloftBarn.descr: Place 4 <FOOD> on this card. Each time you obtain at least 1 <GRAIN>, you also get 1 <FOOD> from this card. Once it is empty, you get a __Family Growth Even without Room__ action.
messages.minorImprovements.B021_HayloftBarn.name: Hayloft Barn
messages.minorImprovements.B022_WalkingBoots.desc: You immediately get 2 <FOOD>. You must immediately place a person from your supply. If you do, in the next returning home phase, you must remove that person from play.
messages.minorImprovements.B022_WalkingBoots.name: Walking Boots
messages.minorImprovements.B023_FinalScenario.des: Reveal the action space card for round 14. Only you can use it until round 14 starts.
messages.minorImprovements.B024_Lasso.description: You can place exactly two people immediately after one another if at least one of them uses the __Sheep Market__, __Pig Market__, or __Cattle Market__ accumulation space.
messages.minorImprovements.B024_Lasso.name: Lasso
messages.minorImprovements.B025_BreadPaddle.descr: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <FOOD>. For each occupation you play, you get an additional __Bake Bread__ action.
messages.minorImprovements.B025_BreadPaddle.name: Bread Paddle
messages.minorImprovements.B026_AgrarianFences.de: Each time you use the __Grain Utilization__ action space, you can take a __Build Fences__ action instead of one of the two actions provide by the action space.
messages.minorImprovements.B027_Toolbox.descripti: In the work phase, after each turn in which you build at least 1 room, <STABLE>, or <FENCE>, you can build the __Joinery__, __Pottery__, or __Basketmaker's Workshop__ major improvement.
messages.minorImprovements.B027_Toolbox.name: Toolbox
messages.minorImprovements.B028_ForestryStudies.d: Each time after you use the __Forest__ accumulation space, you can return 2 <WOOD> to that space to play 1 occupation without paying an occupation costs.
messages.minorImprovements.B029_CookeryLesson.des: Each time you use a __Lessons__ action space and a cooking improvement on the same turn, you get 1 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.minorImprovements.B030_WoodPalisades.des: Instead of a <FENCE> piece, you can place 2 <WOOD> from your supply on the <FENCE> spaces at the edge of your farmyard. These <FENCE> spaces with 2 <WOOD> are each worth 1 <SCORE>.
messages.minorImprovements.B031_PotteryYard.descr: During the scoring, if there are at least 2 orthogonally adjacent unused spaces in your farm, you get 2 bonus <SCORE>. (You still get the negative points for those unused spaces.
messages.minorImprovements.B031_PotteryYard.name: Pottery Yard
messages.minorImprovements.B032_Kettle.descriptio: At any time, you can exchange 1/3/5 <GRAIN> for 3/4/5 <FOOD> and 0/1/2 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.minorImprovements.B032_Kettle.name: Kettle
messages.minorImprovements.B033_Mantlepiece.descr: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 bonus <SCORE> for each complete round left to play. You may no longer renovate your house.
messages.minorImprovements.B033_Mantlepiece.name: Mantlepiece
messages.minorImprovements.B034_SpecialFood.descr: The next time you take animals from an accumulation space and accommodate all of them on your farm, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> for each of these animals.
messages.minorImprovements.B034_SpecialFood.name: Special Food
messages.minorImprovements.B035_HookKnife.descrip: Once this game, when you have 9/8/7/6/5/5 <SHEEP> on your farm in a 1-/2-/3-/4-/5-/6- player game, you immediately get 2 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.minorImprovements.B035_HookKnife.name: Hook Knife
messages.minorImprovements.B036_Bottles.descripti: For each person you have, you must pay an additional 1 <CLAY> and 1 <FOOD> to play this card.
messages.minorImprovements.B036_Bottles.name: Bottles
messages.minorImprovements.B037_Grange.descriptio: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.B037_Grange.name: Grange
messages.minorImprovements.B037_Grange.prerequisi: 6 Field Tiles and All Animal Types
messages.minorImprovements.B038_FutureBuildingSit: Up until all other farmyard spaces are used, you cannot use the unused spaces that are orthogonally adjacent to your house (not even to build rooms).
messages.minorImprovements.B039_Loom.description: In the field phase of each harvest, if you have at least 1/4/7 <SHEEP>, you get 1/2/3 <FOOD>. During scoring, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> for every 3 <SHEEP>.
messages.minorImprovements.B039_Loom.name: Loom
messages.minorImprovements.B040_BreweryPond.descr: Each time you use the __Fishing__ or __Reed Bank__ accumulation space, you also get 1 <GRAIN> and 1 <WOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.B040_BreweryPond.name: Brewery Pond
messages.minorImprovements.B041_Hauberg.descripti: Alternate placing 2 <WOOD> and 1 <PIG> on the next 4 round spaces. You decide what to start with. At the start of these rounds, you get the goods.
messages.minorImprovements.B041_Hauberg.name: Hauberg
messages.minorImprovements.B042_ForestInn.descrip: This is an action space for all. A player who uses it can exchange 5/7/9 <WOOD> for 8 <WOOD> and 2/4/7 <FOOD>. When another player uses it, they must first pay you 1 <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.B042_ForestInn.name: Forest Inn
messages.minorImprovements.B043_Chophouse.descrip: Each time you use the __Grain/Vegetable Seeds__ action space, place 1 <FOOD> on each of the next 3/2 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.B043_Chophouse.name: Chophouse
messages.minorImprovements.B044_ChickStable.descr: Add 3 and 4 to the current round and place 2 <FOOD> on each corresponding round space. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.B044_ChickStable.name: Chick Stable
messages.minorImprovements.B045_StrawberryPatch.d: Place 1 <FOOD> on each of the next 3 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.B046_ClubHouse.descrip: Place 1 <FOOD> on each of the next 4 round spaces and 1 <STONE> on the round space after that. At the start of these rounds, you get the respective good.
messages.minorImprovements.B046_ClubHouse.name: Club House
messages.minorImprovements.B047_HerringPot.descri: Each time you use the __Fishing__ accumulation space, place 1 <FOOD> on each of the next 3 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.B047_HerringPot.name: Herring Pot
messages.minorImprovements.B048_ForestStone.descr: Place 2 <FOOD> on this card. Each time you use a wood accumulation space, move 1 of these <FOOD> to your supply. Each time you use a stone accumulation space, add 2 <FOOD> to this card.
messages.minorImprovements.B048_ForestStone.name: Forest Stone
messages.minorImprovements.B049_Scales.descriptio: Each time after you place an improvement or occupation in front of you, if you then have the same number of improvements and occupations in play, you get 2 <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.B049_Scales.name: Scales
messages.minorImprovements.B050_ButterChurn.descr: In the field phase of each harvest, you get 1 <FOOD> for every 3 <SHEEP> and 1 <FOOD> for every 2 <CATTLE> you have.
messages.minorImprovements.B050_ButterChurn.name: Butter Churn
messages.minorImprovements.B051_DiggingSpade.desc: Each time you use a <CLAY> accumulation space, you also get a number of <FOOD> equal to the number of <PIG> in your farmyard.
messages.minorImprovements.B051_DiggingSpade.name: Digging Spade
messages.minorImprovements.B052_GrowingFarm.descr: You can only play this card if you have at least as many pasture spaces as the number of completed rounds. If you do, you get a number of <FOOD> equal to the current round.
messages.minorImprovements.B052_GrowingFarm.name: Growing Farm
messages.minorImprovements.B053_SculptureCourse.d: At the end of each round that does not end with a harvest, you can use this card to exchange your choice of 1 <WOOD> for 2 <FOOD>, or 1 <STONE> for 4 <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.B054_Tumbrel.descripti: When you play this card, you immediately get 2 <FOOD>. Each time after you take an unconditional __Sow__ action, you get 1 <FOOD> for each <STABLE> you have.
messages.minorImprovements.B054_Tumbrel.name: Tumbrel
messages.minorImprovements.B055_MaintenancePremiu: Place 3 <FOOD> on this card. Each time you use a wood accumulation space, you get 1 <FOOD> from this card. Each time you renovate restock this card to 3 <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.B056_Brook.description: Each time you use one of the four action spaces above the __Fishing__ accumulation space, you get 1 additional <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.B056_Brook.name: Brook
messages.minorImprovements.B057_Scullery.descript: At the start of each round, if you live in a wooden house, you get 1 <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.B057_Scullery.name: Scullery
messages.minorImprovements.B058_CrackWeeder.descr: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <FOOD>. For each <VEGETABLE> you take from a <FIELD> in the field phase of a harvest, you also get 1 <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.B058_CrackWeeder.name: Crack Weeder
messages.minorImprovements.B059_FoodChest.descrip: If you play this card on the __Major Improvement__ action space, you immediately get 4 <FOOD>. Otherwise, you get only 2 <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.B059_FoodChest.name: Food Chest
messages.minorImprovements.B060_BrewingWater.desc: Each time you use the __Fishing__ accumulation space, you can pay 1 <GRAIN> to place 1 <FOOD> on each of the next 6 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.B060_BrewingWater.name: Brewing Water
messages.minorImprovements.B061_ThreeFieldRotatio: At the start of the field phase of each harvest, if you have at least 1 <GRAIN> <FIELD>, 1 <VEGETABLE> <FIELD>, and 1 empty <FIELD>, you get 3 <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.B062_Pitchfork.descrip: Each time you use the __Grain Seeds__ action space, if the __Farmland__ action space is occupied you also get 3 <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.B062_Pitchfork.name: Pitchfork
messages.minorImprovements.B063_Tasting.descripti: Each time you use a __Lessons__ action space, before paying the occupation cost, you can exchange 1 <GRAIN> for 4 <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.B063_Tasting.name: Tasting
messages.minorImprovements.B064_MillWheel.descrip: Each time you use the __Grain Utilization__ action space while the __Fishing__ accumulation space is occupied, you get an additional 2 <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.B064_MillWheel.name: Mill Wheel
messages.minorImprovements.B065_GrainDepot.descri: If you paid <WOOD>/<CLAY>/<STONE> for this card, place 1 <GRAIN> on each of the next 2/3/4 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <GRAIN>.
messages.minorImprovements.B065_GrainDepot.name: Grain Depot
messages.minorImprovements.B066_SackCart.descript: Place 1 <GRAIN> each on the remaining spaces for rounds 5, 8, 11, and 14. At the start of these rounds, you get the <GRAIN>.
messages.minorImprovements.B066_SackCart.name: Sack Cart
messages.minorImprovements.B067_HandTruck.descrip: Each time before you take a __Bake Bread__ action, you also get 1 <GRAIN> for each of your people occupying an accumulation space.
messages.minorImprovements.B067_HandTruck.name: Hand Truck
messages.minorImprovements.B068_Beanfield.descrip: This card is a <FIELD> that can only grow <VEGETABLE>.
messages.minorImprovements.B068_Beanfield.name: Beanfield
messages.minorImprovements.B069_PottersMarket.des: At any time, you can pay 3 <CLAY> and 2 <FOOD>. If you do, place 1 <VEGETABLE> on each of the next 2 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <VEGETABLE>.
messages.minorImprovements.B070_NewPurchase.descr: Before the start of each round that ends with a harvest, you can buy one of each of the following crops: 2 <FOOD> <ARROW> 1 <GRAIN>; 4 <FOOD> <ARROW> 1 <VEGETABLE>
messages.minorImprovements.B070_NewPurchase.name: New Purchase
messages.minorImprovements.B071_HarvestHouse.desc: When you play this card, if the number of completed harvests is equal to the number of occupations you played, you immediately get 1 <FOOD>, 1 <GRAIN>, and 1 <VEGETABLE>.
messages.minorImprovements.B071_HarvestHouse.name: Harvest House
messages.minorImprovements.B072_LoveforAgricultur: You can sow crops in pastures covering 1 or 2 farmyard spaces. If you do, these pastures are also considered <FIELD> and hold 1 and 2 animals less, respectively.
messages.minorImprovements.B073_GiftBasket.descri: When you play this card, if you have exactly 2/3/4/5 rooms, you immediately get 1 <VEGETABLE>/<FOOD>/<GRAIN>/<VEGETABLE>.
messages.minorImprovements.B073_GiftBasket.name: Gift Basket
messages.minorImprovements.B074_ThickForest.descr: Place 1 <WOOD> on each remaining even-numbered round space. At the start of these rounds, you get the <WOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.B074_ThickForest.name: Thick Forest
messages.minorImprovements.B075_WoodWorkshop.desc: Each time before you play or build an improvement, you get 1 <WOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.B075_WoodWorkshop.name: Wood Workshop
messages.minorImprovements.B076_Ceilings.descript: Place 1 <WOOD> on the next 5 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <WOOD>. Remove the <WOOD> promised by this card from future round spaces the next time you renovate.
messages.minorImprovements.B076_Ceilings.name: Ceilings
messages.minorImprovements.B077_LoamPit.descripti: Each time you use the __Day Laborer__ action space, you also get 3 <CLAY>.
messages.minorImprovements.B077_LoamPit.name: Loam Pit
messages.minorImprovements.B078_ReedBelt.descript: Place 1 <REED> on each of the remaining space for rounds 5, 8, 10, and 12. At the start of these rounds, you get the <REED>.
messages.minorImprovements.B078_ReedBelt.name: Reed Belt
messages.minorImprovements.B079_Corf.description: Each time any player (including you) takes at least 3 <STONE> from an accumulation space, you get 1 <STONE> from the general supply.
messages.minorImprovements.B079_Corf.name: Corf
messages.minorImprovements.B080_HardPorcelain.des: At any time, you can exchange 2/3/4 <CLAY> for 1/2/3 <STONE>.
messages.minorImprovements.B081_Handcart.descript: Before each work phase, you can take 1 building resource from at most one <WOOD>/<CLAY>/<REED>/<STONE> accumulation space containing at least 6/5/4/4 building resources of the same type.
messages.minorImprovements.B081_Handcart.name: Handcart
messages.minorImprovements.B082_ValueAssets.descr: After each harvest, you can buy exactly one of the following goods: 1 <FOOD> <ARROW> 1 <WOOD>; 1 <FOOD> <ARROW> 1 <CLAY>; 2 <FOOD> <ARROW> 1 <REED>; 2 <FOOD> <ARROW> 1 <STONE>
messages.minorImprovements.B082_ValueAssets.name: Value Assets
messages.minorImprovements.B083_MuddyPuddles.desc: Pile (from bottom to top) 1 <PIG>, 1 <FOOD>, 1 <CATTLE>, 1 <FOOD>, and 1 <SHEEP> on this card. At any time, you can pay 1 <CLAY> to take the top good.
messages.minorImprovements.B083_MuddyPuddles.name: Muddy Puddles
messages.minorImprovements.B084_AcornsBasket.desc: Place 1 <PIG> on each of the next 2 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <PIG>.
messages.minorImprovements.B084_AcornsBasket.name: Acorns Basket
messages.minorImprovements.B094_StockProtector.de: Each time before you use the __Fencing__ action space, you get 2 <WOOD>. Immediately after that __Fencing__ action, you can place another person.
messages.minorImprovements.C001_Overhaul.descript: Immediately raze all of your fences, add up to 3 fences from your supply, and rebuild them. (You do not lose any animals during this.)
messages.minorImprovements.C001_Overhaul.name: Overhaul
messages.minorImprovements.C002_Stable.descriptio: Immediately build 1 <STABLE>. (The <STABLE> costs you nothing, but you must pay the cost shown on this card.)
messages.minorImprovements.C002_Stable.name: Stable
messages.minorImprovements.C003_CarriageTrip.desc: If you play this card in the work phase, you can immediately place another person.
messages.minorImprovements.C003_CarriageTrip.name: Carriage Trip
messages.minorImprovements.C004_WritingBoards.des: You immediately get 1 <WOOD> for each occupation you have in front of you.
messages.minorImprovements.C005_Remodeling.descri: You immediately get 1 <CLAY> for each clay room and for each major improvement you have.
messages.minorImprovements.C005_Remodeling.name: Remodeling
messages.minorImprovements.C006_StoneClearing.des: Immediately place 1 <STONE> on each of your empty <FIELD>. Harvest them during the next field phase. These <FIELD> are considered planted until then.
messages.minorImprovements.C007_BladeShears.descr: You immediately get your choice of 3 <FOOD>, or 1 <FOOD> for each <SHEEP> you have. (Keep the <SHEEP>.)
messages.minorImprovements.C007_BladeShears.name: Blade Shears
messages.minorImprovements.C008_PlantFertilizer.d: In each field with exactly 1 good, you can immediately place 1 additional good of the same type.
messages.minorImprovements.C009_AutomaticWaterTro: If you can accommodate the animal, you can immediately buy 1 <SHEEP>/<PIG>/<CATTLE> for 0/1/2 <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.C010_BunkBeds.descript: Once you have 4 rooms, your house can hold 5 people.
messages.minorImprovements.C010_BunkBeds.name: Bunk Beds
messages.minorImprovements.C011_WildlifeReserve.d: This card can hold up to 1 <SHEEP>, 1 <PIG>, and 1 <CATTLE>.
messages.minorImprovements.C012_CattleFarm.descri: For each pasture you have, you can keep 1 <CATTLE> on this card.
messages.minorImprovements.C012_CattleFarm.name: Cattle Farm
messages.minorImprovements.C013_WoodSlideHammer.d: On your first renovation, if you have at least 5 wood rooms, you can renovate to stone directly and you get a discount of 2 <STONE> on the renovation cost.
messages.minorImprovements.C014_StrawThatchedRoof: You no longer need <REED> to renovate or build a room.
messages.minorImprovements.C015_Trellis.descripti: Each time before you use the __Pig Market__ accumulation space, you can take a __Build Fences__ action. (You must pay <WOOD> for the <FENCE> as usual.)
messages.minorImprovements.C015_Trellis.name: Trellis
messages.minorImprovements.C016_FieldFences.descr: You can immediately take a __Build Fences__ action, during which you do not have to pay <WOOD> for <FENCE> that you build next to <FIELD> tiles.
messages.minorImprovements.C016_FieldFences.name: Field Fences
When you play this card, you can immediately plow 1 field, which needs not be adjacent to another field.
messages.minorImprovements.C018_RollOverPlow.desc: At any time, if you have at least 3 planted fields, you can discard all goods from one of those fields to plow 1 field.
messages.minorImprovements.C018_RollOverPlow.name: Roll-Over Plow
messages.minorImprovements.C019_SwingPlow.descrip: Place 4 field tiles on this card. Each time you use the __Farmland__ action space, you can also plow up to 2 fields from this card.
messages.minorImprovements.C019_SwingPlow.name: Swing Plow
messages.minorImprovements.C020_MolePlow.descript: Each time you use the __Farmland__ or __Cultivation__ action space, you can plow 1 additional <FIELD>.
messages.minorImprovements.C020_MolePlow.name: Mole Plow
messages.minorImprovements.C021_HeartofStone.desc: Each time a __Quarry__ accumulation space is revealed, if you have room in your house, you can immediately take a __Family Growth__ action without placing a person.
messages.minorImprovements.C021_HeartofStone.name: Heart of Stone
messages.minorImprovements.C022_BasketChair.descr: When you play this card, you can immediately move the first person you placed this work phase to this card (unless it is on __Meeting Place__). If you do, immediately afterward, you can place another person.
messages.minorImprovements.C022_BasketChair.name: Basket Chair
messages.minorImprovements.C022_BasketChair.rules: Only an adult person can be moved to this card; a newborn remains on its action space.
messages.minorImprovements.C023_JobContract.descr: If both are unoccupied, you can use the __Day Laborer__ and the adjacent __Lessons__ action space with a single person (in that order). Afterward, both spaces are considered occupied.
messages.minorImprovements.C023_JobContract.name: Job Contract
messages.minorImprovements.C024_BedintheGrainFiel: At the start of the next harvest, you get a __Family Growth__ action if you have room for the newborn.
messages.minorImprovements.C025_SteamMachine.desc: Each work phase, if the last action space you use is an accumulation space, you can immediately afterward take a __Bake Bread__ action.
messages.minorImprovements.C025_SteamMachine.name: Steam Machine
messages.minorImprovements.C026_Flail.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 2 <FOOD>. Each time you use the __Farmland__ or __Cultivation__ action space, you can also take a __Bake Bread__ action.
messages.minorImprovements.C026_Flail.name: Flail
messages.minorImprovements.C027_Blueprint.descrip: You can build the major improvements __Joinery__, __Pottery__, and __Basketmaker\\
messages.minorImprovements.C027_Blueprint.name: Blueprint
messages.minorImprovements.C028_TeachersDesk.desc: Each time you use the __Major Improvement__ or __House Redevelopment__ action space, you can also play 1 occupation at an occupation cost of 1 <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.C028_TeachersDesk.name: Teacher's Desk
messages.minorImprovements.C029_BeerTable.descrip: At the end of the field phase of each harvest, you can pay 1 <GRAIN> from your supply to get 2 bonus <SCORE>. If you do, all other players get 1 <FOOD> each.
messages.minorImprovements.C029_BeerTable.name: Beer Table
messages.minorImprovements.C030_HalfTimberedHouse: During scoring, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> for each stone room you have. You can only use one card to get bonus <SCORE> for your stone house.
messages.minorImprovements.C031_WritingChamber.de: During scoring, you get a number of bonus <SCORE> equal to the total of negative points you have, to a maximum of 7 <SCORE>.
messages.minorImprovements.C032_AbortOriel.descri: You can no longer play this card when any player (including you) has 5 or more cards in front of them.
messages.minorImprovements.C032_AbortOriel.name: Abort Oriel
messages.minorImprovements.C033_GreeningPlan.desc: During scoring, if you then have at least 2/4/5/6 unplanted <FIELD>, you get 1/2/3/5 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.minorImprovements.C033_GreeningPlan.name: Greening Plan
messages.minorImprovements.C034_ElephantgrassPlan: Immediately after each harvest, you can use this card to exchange exactly 1 <REED> for 1 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.minorImprovements.C035_LanternHouse.desc: During scoring, you get 1 negative <SCORE> for each card left in your hand. You cannot discard cards from your hand unplayed. If you already have, you cannot play this card.
messages.minorImprovements.C035_LanternHouse.name: Lantern House
messages.minorImprovements.C036_ClayDeposit.descr: Immediately after each time you use a <CLAY> accumulation space, you can exchange 1 <CLAY> for 1 bonus <SCORE>. If you do, place the <CLAY> on the accumulation space.
messages.minorImprovements.C036_ClayDeposit.name: Clay Deposit
messages.minorImprovements.C037_DwellingMound.des: From now on, you must pay 1 <FOOD> for each new field tile that you place in your farmyard.
messages.minorImprovements.C038_Christianity.desc: When you play this card, all other players get 1 <FOOD> each.
messages.minorImprovements.C038_Christianity.name: Christianity
messages.minorImprovements.C039_StudioBoat.descri: Each time you use the __Traveling Players__ accumulation space, you also get 1 bonus <SCORE>. In games with 1-3 players, this card is considered __Traveling Players__ (same effect as __Fishing__).
messages.minorImprovements.C039_StudioBoat.name: Studio Boat
messages.minorImprovements.C040_CanvasSack.descri: When you play this card paying <GRAIN>/<REED> for it, you immediately get 1 <VEGETABLE>/4 <WOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.C040_CanvasSack.name: Canvas Sack
messages.minorImprovements.C041_FarmStore.descrip: After the feeding phase of each harvest, you can exchange exactly 1 <FOOD> for 2 different building resources of your choice or 1 <VEGETABLE>.
messages.minorImprovements.C041_FarmStore.name: Farm Store
messages.minorImprovements.C042_RavenousHunger.de: Immediately after each time you use the __Vegetable Seeds__ action space, you can place another person on an accumulation space and get 1 additional good of the accumulating type.
messages.minorImprovements.C043_FarmBuilding.desc: Each time you build a major improvement, place 1 <FOOD> on each of the next 3 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.C043_FarmBuilding.name: Farm Building
messages.minorImprovements.C044_ChickenCoop.descr: Place 1 <FOOD> on each of the next 8 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.C044_ChickenCoop.name: Chicken Coop
messages.minorImprovements.C045_Stew.description: Each time you use the __Day Laborer__ action space, also place 1 <FOOD> on each of the next 4 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.C045_Stew.name: Stew
messages.minorImprovements.C046_Mandoline.descrip: Once per round, you can pay 1 <VEGETABLE> to get 1 bonus <SCORE>. If you do, place 1 <FOOD> on each of the next 2 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.C046_Mandoline.name: Mandoline
messages.minorImprovements.C047_GardenClaw.descri: Place 1 <FOOD> on each remaining round space, up to three times the number of planted <FIELD> you have. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.C047_GardenClaw.name: Garden Claw
messages.minorImprovements.C048_Farmstead.descrip: After each turn in which you make at least one unused farmyard space used, you get 1 <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.C048_Farmstead.name: Farmstead
messages.minorImprovements.C049_BeerStall.descrip: In the feeding phase of each harvest, for each empty unfenced <STABLE> you have, you can exchange 1 <GRAIN> for 5 <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.C049_BeerStall.name: Beer Stall
messages.minorImprovements.C050_StableYard.descri: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <FOOD> for each completed round left to play. At any time, you can exchange 1 <SHEEP> plus 1 <PIG> for 1 <CATTLE>.
messages.minorImprovements.C050_StableYard.name: Stable Yard
messages.minorImprovements.C051_FishingNet.descri: Each time another player uses the __Fishing__ accumulation space, they must first pay you 1 <FOOD>. Then, in the returning home phase of that round, place 2 <FOOD> on __Fishing__.
messages.minorImprovements.C051_FishingNet.name: Fishing Net
messages.minorImprovements.C052_HuntsmansHat.desc: For each new <PIG> you get from the effect of an action space, you also get 1 <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.C052_HuntsmansHat.name: Huntsman's Hat
messages.minorImprovements.C053_GypsysCrock.descr: Each time you use a cooking improvement to turn 2 goods into <FOOD> at the same time, you get 1 additional <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.C053_GypsysCrock.name: Gypsy's Crock
messages.minorImprovements.C054_MarketBooth.descr: After the field phase of each harvest, you can exchange 1 <GRAIN> plus 1 <FENCE> (both from your supply) for 5 <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.C054_MarketBooth.name: Market Booth
messages.minorImprovements.C055_Studio.descriptio: In the feeding phase of each harvest, you can use this card to turn exactly 1 <WOOD>/<CLAY>/<STONE> into 2/2/3 <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.C055_Studio.name: Studio
messages.minorImprovements.C056_FeedFence.descrip: For each new <STABLE> you build, you get 1 <FOOD> —for your last one, get 3 <FOOD>. Each time you build <STABLE>, you can build exactly 1 <STABLE> for 1 <CLAY> instead of <WOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.C056_FeedFence.name: Feed Fence
messages.minorImprovements.C057_Crudite.descripti: When you play this card, you can immediately buy exactly 1 <VEGETABLE> for 3 <FOOD>. At any time, you can discard 1 <VEGETABLE> on top of another <VEGETABLE> in a field to get 4 <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.C057_Crudite.name: Crudité
messages.minorImprovements.C058_Woodcraft.descrip: Each time you use a <WOOD> accumulation space, if immediately afterward you have at most 5 <WOOD> in your supply, you get 1 <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.C058_Woodcraft.name: Woodcraft
messages.minorImprovements.C059_SchnappsDistiller: In each feeding phase, you can use this card to turn exactly 1 <VEGETABLE> into 5 <FOOD>. During scoring, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> each for your 5th and 6th <VEGETABLE>.
When you play this card, you immediately get 5 <FOOD>. Each time before you get a __Bake Bread__ action, you can build the __Clay Oven__ or __Stone Oven__ major improvement.
messages.minorImprovements.C061_BeerStein.descrip: Each time you take a __Bake Bread__ action, you can use this card once to turn 1 <GRAIN> into 2 <FOOD> and 1 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.minorImprovements.C061_BeerStein.name: Beer Stein
Each harvest, you can use each of your cooking improvements once to get double the amount of <FOOD> for 1 animal or <VEGETABLE>.
messages.minorImprovements.C063_CraftBrewery.desc: In the feeding phase of each harvest, you can use this card to exchange 1 <GRAIN> from your supply plus 1 <GRAIN> from a field for 2 bonus <SCORE> and 4 <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.C063_CraftBrewery.name: Craft Brewery
messages.minorImprovements.C064_CornSchnappsDisti: Once per round, you can pay 1 <GRAIN> to place 1 <FOOD> on each of the next 4 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.C065_Granary.descripti: Place 1 <GRAIN> each on the remaining spaces for rounds 8, 10, and 12. At the start of these rounds, you get the <GRAIN>.
messages.minorImprovements.C065_Granary.name: Granary
messages.minorImprovements.C066_EternalRyeCultiva: After each harvest in which you have 2 or 3+ <GRAIN> in your supply, you get 1 <FOOD> or 1 additional <GRAIN>, respectively.
messages.minorImprovements.C067_MineralFeeder.des: At the start of each round that does not end with a harvest, if you have at least 1 <SHEEP> in a pasture, you get 1 <GRAIN>.
messages.minorImprovements.C068_Bookcase.descript: Each time after you play an occupation, you get 1 <VEGETABLE>.
messages.minorImprovements.C068_Bookcase.name: Bookcase
messages.minorImprovements.C069_LandConsolidation: At any time, if you have a <GRAIN> <FIELD> with exactly 3 sown <GRAIN>, you can exchange the <GRAIN> on the <FIELD> for 1 <VEGETABLE> on the <FIELD>.
messages.minorImprovements.C070_LettucePatch.desc: This card is a <FIELD> that can only grow <VEGETABLE>. You can immediately turn each <VEGETABLE> you harvested from this card into 4 <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.C070_LettucePatch.name: Lettuce Patch
messages.minorImprovements.C071_Slurry.descriptio: In the breeding phase of each harvest, if you get newborn animals of at least two types, you also get a __Sow__ action.
messages.minorImprovements.C071_Slurry.name: Slurry
When you play this card, immediately carry out the field phase on your farmyard only (this is not a harvest). Afterwards, you get a __Major or Minor Improvement__ action.
messages.minorImprovements.C073_SeaweedFertilizer: Each time after you take an unconditional __Sow__ action, you get 1 <GRAIN> from the general supply. From round 11 on, you can get 1 <VEGETABLE> instead.
messages.minorImprovements.C074_PrivateForest.des: Place 1 <WOOD> on each remaining even-numbered round space. At the start of these rounds, you get the <WOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.C075_Firewood.descript: In the returning home phase of each round, place 1 <WOOD> on this card. Each time after you build a Fireplace, Cooking Hearth, or oven, move up to 4 <WOOD> from this card to your supply.
messages.minorImprovements.C075_Firewood.name: Firewood
messages.minorImprovements.C076_WoodCart.descript: Each time you use a <WOOD> accumulation space, you get 2 additional <WOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.C076_WoodCart.name: Wood Cart
messages.minorImprovements.C077_ClaySupply.descri: Place 1 <CLAY> on each of the next 3 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <CLAY>.
messages.minorImprovements.C077_ClaySupply.name: Clay Supply
messages.minorImprovements.C078_ReedHattedToad.de: Add 5, 7, 9, 11, and 13 to the current round and place 1 <REED> on each corresponding round space. At the start of these rounds, you get the <REED>.
messages.minorImprovements.C079_StoneCart.descrip: Place 1 <STONE> on each remaining even-numbered round space. At the start of these rounds, you get the <STONE>.
messages.minorImprovements.C079_StoneCart.name: Stone Cart
messages.minorImprovements.C080_RockyTerrain.desc: Each time you plow a <FIELD> (tile or card), you can also buy 1 <STONE> for 1 <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.C080_RockyTerrain.name: Rocky Terrain
messages.minorImprovements.C081_MaterialHub.descr: Immediately place 2 of each building resource on this card. Each time any player (including you) takes at least 5 <WOOD>, 4 <CLAY>, 3 <REED>, or 3 <STONE>, you get 1 of that building resource from this card.
messages.minorImprovements.C081_MaterialHub.name: Material Hub
messages.minorImprovements.C081_MaterialHub.prere: 1 reed and 1 stone in your supply
messages.minorImprovements.C082_HardwareStore.des: Each time after you use the __Day Laborer__ action space, you can pay 2 <FOOD> total to buy 1 <WOOD>, 1 <CLAY>, 1 <REED>, and 1 <STONE>.
messages.minorImprovements.C083_EarlyCattle.descr: When you play this card, you immediately get 2 <CATTLE>.
messages.minorImprovements.C083_EarlyCattle.name: Early Cattle
messages.minorImprovements.C084_PerennialRye.desc: Each round that does not end with a harvest, you can pay 1 <GRAIN> to breed exactly 1 type of animal. (This is not considered a breeding phase.)
messages.minorImprovements.C084_PerennialRye.name: Perennial Rye
messages.minorImprovements.C130_OutskirtsDirector: Each time you use the __Grove__ or __Hollow__ accumulation space, you can place 2 <REED> from the general supply on the other space. If you do, you can immediately place another person.
messages.minorImprovements.C168_AnimalCatcher.des: Each time you use the __Day Laborer__ action space, instead of 2 <FOOD>, you can get 3 different animals from the general supply. If you do, you must pay 1 <FOOD> each harvest left to play.
messages.minorImprovements.CUSTOM_FixtureHarveste: Each harvest, gain 1 <FOOD>. (Community deck fixture card; not a real card.)
messages.minorImprovements.D001_ZigzagHarrow.desc: You can immediately plow 1 <FIELD> such that it completes a "zigzag" pattern.
messages.minorImprovements.D001_ZigzagHarrow.name: Zigzag Harrow
messages.minorImprovements.D002_DwellingPlan.desc: You can immediately take a __Renovation__ action.
messages.minorImprovements.D002_DwellingPlan.name: Dwelling Plan
messages.minorImprovements.D003_Furrows.descripti: You can immediately sow in exactly 1 <FIELD>.
messages.minorImprovements.D003_Furrows.name: Furrows
messages.minorImprovements.D004_CrossCutWood.desc: You immediately get a number of <WOOD> equal to the number of <STONE> in your supply.
messages.minorImprovements.D004_CrossCutWood.name: Cross-Cut Wood
messages.minorImprovements.D005_FieldClay.descrip: You immediately get 1 <CLAY> for each planted <FIELD> you have.
messages.minorImprovements.D005_FieldClay.name: Field Clay
messages.minorImprovements.D006_PetrifiedWood.des: Immediately exchange up to 3 <WOOD> for 1 <STONE> each.
messages.minorImprovements.D007_Trident.descripti: If you play this card in round 3/6/9/12, you immediately get 3/4/5/6 <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.D007_Trident.name: Trident
messages.minorImprovements.D008_FernSeeds.descrip: You get 2 <FOOD> and 1 <GRAIN>, which you must sow immediately.
messages.minorImprovements.D008_FernSeeds.name: Fern Seeds
messages.minorImprovements.D009_GameTrade.descrip: You immediately get 1 <PIG> and 1 <CATTLE>. (effectively, you are exchanging 2 <SHEEP> for 1 <PIG> and 1 <CATTLE>.)
messages.minorImprovements.D009_GameTrade.name: Game Trade
messages.minorImprovements.D010_StorksNest.descri: In the returning home phase of each round, if you have more rooms than people, you can pay 1 <FOOD> to take a __Family Growth__ action.
messages.minorImprovements.D010_StorksNest.name: Stork's Nest
messages.minorImprovements.D011_LawnFertilizer.de: Your pastures of size 1 can hold up to 3 animals of the same type. (With a <STABLE>, they can hold up to 6 animals of the same type.)
messages.minorImprovements.D012_MilkingPlace.desc: In the feeding phase of each harvest, you get 1 <FOOD>. You can no longer hold animals in your house (not even via another card).
messages.minorImprovements.D012_MilkingPlace.name: Milking Place
messages.minorImprovements.D013_Trowel.descriptio: At any time, you can renovate your house to <STONE>. From a wooden house, this costs 1 <STONE>, 1 <REED>, and 1 <FOOD> per room. From a clay house, this costs 1 <STONE> per room.
messages.minorImprovements.D013_Trowel.name: Trowel
messages.minorImprovements.D014_HammerCrusher.des: Immediately before you renovate to stone, you get 2 <CLAY> and 1 <REED> and you can take a __Build Rooms__ action.
messages.minorImprovements.D015_ClaySupports.desc: Each time you build a clay room, you can pay 2 <CLAY>, 1 <WOOD>, and 1 <REED> instead of 5 <CLAY> and 2 <REED>.
messages.minorImprovements.D015_ClaySupports.name: Clay Supports
Each time before you use the __Sheep Market__/__Cattle Market__ accumulation space, you can build exactly 1 <STABLE> for 1 <WOOD>/at no cost.
messages.minorImprovements.D017_DrillHarrow.descr: Each time before you take an unconditional __Sow__ action, you can pay 3 <FOOD> to plow 1 <FIELD>.
messages.minorImprovements.D017_DrillHarrow.name: Drill Harrow
messages.minorImprovements.D018_SteamPlow.descrip: Immediately after each returning home phase, you can pay 2 <WOOD> and 1 <FOOD> to use the __Farmland__ action space without placing a person.
messages.minorImprovements.D018_SteamPlow.name: Steam Plow
messages.minorImprovements.D019_PulverizerPlow.de: Immediately after each time you use a <CLAY> accumulation space, you can pay 1 <CLAY> to plow 1 <FIELD>. If you do, place that 1 <CLAY> on the accumulation space.
messages.minorImprovements.D020_TurnwrestPlow.des: Place 2 field tiles on this card. Each time you use the __Farmland__ or __Cultivation__ action space, you can also plow up to 2 fields from this card.
messages.minorImprovements.D021_Recruitment.descr: From round 5 on, provided you have room in your house, each time you get a __Minor Improvement__ action, you can take a __Family Growth__ action instead.
messages.minorImprovements.D021_Recruitment.name: Recruitment
messages.minorImprovements.D021_Recruitment.prere: No People Left in the House
messages.minorImprovements.D022_WorkPermit.descri: Add 1 to the current round for each building resource you have and place 1 person from your supply on the corresponding round space. In that round, you can use the person.
messages.minorImprovements.D022_WorkPermit.name: Work Permit
This card is an action space for you only. In rounds 3-5, it provides a __Renovation__ action. In rounds 6-8, it provides your choice of 1 <VEGETABLE>, <PIG>, or <CATTLE>.
messages.minorImprovements.D024_BrotherlyLove.des: As long as you have exactly 4 people, in the work phase of each round, you can place your third and fourth person immediately after one another, even on the same action space.
messages.minorImprovements.D025_WitchesDanceFloor: This card is a field that you can sow in, an occupation, and the "Fireplace" major improvement with all of its effects. You can play it only via a __Minor Improvement__ action.
messages.minorImprovements.D026_CarpentersYard.de: You can build the __Joinery__ and __Well__ major improvement even when taking a __Minor Improvement__ action, or you can build both with a single __Major Improvement__ action.
messages.minorImprovements.D027_Retraining.descri: At the end of each turn in which you renovate, you can exchange your __Joinery__ for the __Pottery__ or your __Pottery__ for the __Basketmaker\\
messages.minorImprovements.D027_Retraining.name: Retraining
messages.minorImprovements.D028_WritingDesk.descr: Each time you use a __Lessons__ action space, you can play 1 additional occupation for an occupation cost of 2 <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.D028_WritingDesk.name: Writing Desk
messages.minorImprovements.D029_MuckRake.descript: During scoring, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> for exactly 1 unfenced <STABLE> holding exactly 1 <SHEEP>. The same applies to <PIG> and <CATTLE>, if held in different unfenced <STABLE>.
messages.minorImprovements.D029_MuckRake.name: Muck Rake
messages.minorImprovements.D030_ArtisanDistrict.d: During scoring, you get 2/5/8 bonus <SCORE> for having 3/4/5 major improvements from the bottom row of the supply board.
messages.minorImprovements.D031_Storeroom.descrip: During scoring, you get ½ bonus <SCORE> for each pair of <GRAIN> plus <VEGETABLE> you have (considering all crops in your supply and <FIELD>), rounded up.
messages.minorImprovements.D031_Storeroom.name: Storeroom
messages.minorImprovements.D032_WoodRake.descript: During scoring, if you had at least 7 goods in your <FIELD> before the final harvest, you get 2 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.minorImprovements.D032_WoodRake.name: Wood Rake
messages.minorImprovements.D033_SummerHouse.descr: During scoring, if you live in a stone house, you get 2 bonus <SCORE> for each unused farmyard space orthogonally adjacent to your house. (You still lose the points for these unused spaces.)
messages.minorImprovements.D033_SummerHouse.name: Summer House
messages.minorImprovements.D034_LuxuriousHostel.d: During scoring, if you then have more stone rooms than people, you get 4 bonus <SCORE>. You can only use one card to get bonus <SCORE> for your stone house.
messages.minorImprovements.D035_FodderChamber.des: During scoring in a game with 1/2/3/4+ players, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> for every 7th/5th/4th/3rd animal on your farm.
messages.minorImprovements.D036_BreedRegistry.des: During scoring, if you gained at most 2 <SHEEP> from sources other than breeding during the game and have not turned any sheep into food, you get 3 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.minorImprovements.D037_Sculpture.descrip: You can only play this card if there are more complete rounds left to play than you have unused farmyard spaces.
messages.minorImprovements.D037_Sculpture.name: Sculpture
messages.minorImprovements.D038_MilkingStool.desc: In the field phase of each harvest, if you have at least 1/3/5 <CATTLE>, you get 1/2/3 <FOOD>. During scoring, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> for every 2 <CATTLE> you have.
messages.minorImprovements.D038_MilkingStool.name: Milking Stool
messages.minorImprovements.D039_TruffleSlicer.des: Each time you use a <WOOD> accumulation space, if you have at least 1 <PIG>, you can pay 1 <FOOD> for 1 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.minorImprovements.D040_Cesspit.descripti: Alternate placing 1 <CLAY> and 1 <PIG> on each remaining round space, starting with <CLAY>. At the start of these rounds, you get the respective good.
messages.minorImprovements.D040_Cesspit.name: Cesspit
messages.minorImprovements.D041_HorseDrawnBoat.de: Alternate placing 1 <FOOD> and 1 <SHEEP> on each remaining round space, starting with <FOOD>. At the start of these rounds, you get the respective good.
messages.minorImprovements.D042_EducationBonus.de: After you play your 1st/2nd/3rd/4th/5th/6th occupation this game, you immediately get 1 <GRAIN>/<CLAY>/<REED>/<STONE>/<VEGETABLE>/<FIELD> (not retroactively).
messages.minorImprovements.D043_Hutch.description: Place 0, 1, 2, and 3 <FOOD> in this order on the next 4 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.D043_Hutch.name: Hutch
messages.minorImprovements.D044_ForestWell.descri: Place 1 <FOOD> on each remaining round space, up to the amount of <WOOD> in your supply. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.D044_ForestWell.name: Forest Well
messages.minorImprovements.D045_SheepWell.descrip: Place 1 <FOOD> on each of the next round spaces, up to the number of <SHEEP> you have. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.D045_SheepWell.name: Sheep Well
messages.minorImprovements.D046_PelletPress.descr: Once per round, you can pay 1 <REED>. If you do, place 1 <FOOD> on each of the next 4 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.D046_PelletPress.name: Pellet Press
messages.minorImprovements.D047_Churchyard.descri: Place 2 <FOOD> on each remaining round space. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>. (*Occupations and Improvements)
messages.minorImprovements.D047_Churchyard.name: Churchyard
messages.minorImprovements.D048_CivicFacade.descr: Before the start of each round, if you have more occupations than improvements in your hand, you get 1 <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.D048_CivicFacade.name: Civic Facade
messages.minorImprovements.D049_Bookshelf.descrip: Immediately before each time you play an occupation (even before paying the occupation cost), you get 3 <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.D049_Bookshelf.name: Bookshelf
messages.minorImprovements.D050_ForeignAid.descri: When you play this card, you immediately get 6 <FOOD>. You may no longer use the action spaces of rounds 12 to 14.
messages.minorImprovements.D050_ForeignAid.name: Foreign Aid
messages.minorImprovements.D051_Archway.descripti: This card is an action space for all. A player who uses it immediately gets 1 <FOOD>. Immediately before the returning home phase, they can use an unoccupied action space with the person from this card.
messages.minorImprovements.D051_Archway.name: Archway
messages.minorImprovements.D052_RollingPin.descri: In the returning home phase of each round, if you have more <CLAY> than <WOOD> in your supply, you get 1 <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.D052_RollingPin.name: Rolling Pin
messages.minorImprovements.D053_TeaHouse.descript: Once per round, you can skip placing your second person and get 1 <FOOD> instead. (You can place the person later that round.)
messages.minorImprovements.D053_TeaHouse.name: Tea House
messages.minorImprovements.D054_TroutPool.descrip: At the start of each work phase, if there are at least 3 <FOOD> on the __Fishing__ accumulation space, you get 1 <FOOD> from the general supply.
messages.minorImprovements.D054_TroutPool.name: Trout Pool
messages.minorImprovements.D055_NewMarket.descrip: Each time you use an action space card on round spaces 8 to 11, you get 1 additional <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.D055_NewMarket.name: New Market
messages.minorImprovements.D056_FatstockStretcher: Each time you turn a <SHEEP> or <PIG> into <FOOD> using a cooking improvement, you get 1 additional <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.D057_WholesaleMarket.d: Place 1 <FOOD> on each remaining round space. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.D058_Gritter.descripti: At the end of each action in which you sow <VEGETABLE> in a <FIELD>, you get 1 <FOOD> for each <VEGETABLE> <FIELD> you have (including the new ones).
