messages.minorImprovements.D058_Gritter.name: Gritter
messages.minorImprovements.D059_EarthOven.name: Earth Oven
messages.minorImprovements.D060_LargePottery.name: Large Pottery
messages.minorImprovements.D061_BaleofStraw.descr: At the start of each harvest, if you have at least 3 <GRAIN> <FIELD> (including <FIELD> cards with planted <GRAIN>), you get 2 <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.D061_BaleofStraw.name: Bale of Straw
messages.minorImprovements.D062_BeerTap.descripti: When you play this card, you immediately get 2 <FOOD>. In the feeding phase of each harvest, you can turn 2/3/4 <GRAIN> into 3/6/9 <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.D062_BeerTap.name: Beer Tap
messages.minorImprovements.D063_Lynchet.descripti: In the field phase of each harvest, you get 1 <FOOD> for each harvested <FIELD> tile that is orthogonally adjacent to your house.
messages.minorImprovements.D063_Lynchet.name: Lynchet
messages.minorImprovements.D064_BakingCourse.desc:
[__Bake Bread__ action:]
<GRAIN> <ARROW> 2<FOOD>
At the end of each round that does not end with a harvest, you can take a __Bake Bread__ action.
messages.minorImprovements.D064_BakingCourse.name: Baking Course
messages.minorImprovements.D065_GrainSieve.descri: In the field phase of each harvest, if you harvest at least 2 <GRAIN>, you get 1 additional <GRAIN> from the general supply.
messages.minorImprovements.D065_GrainSieve.name: Grain Sieve
messages.minorImprovements.D066_PotterCeramics.de: Each time before you take a __Bake Bread__ action, you can exchange 1 <CLAY> for 1 <GRAIN>.
messages.minorImprovements.D067_ReapHook.descript: Place 1 <GRAIN> on each of the next 3 of the round spaces 4, 7, 9, 11, 13, and 14. At the start of these rounds, you get the <GRAIN>.
messages.minorImprovements.D067_ReapHook.name: Reap Hook
messages.minorImprovements.D068_SmallBasket.descr: Each time after you use the __Reed Bank__ accumulation space, you can pay 1 <REED> to get 1 <VEGETABLE>. If you do in a game with 4+ players, place that 1 <REED> on the accumulation space.
messages.minorImprovements.D068_SmallBasket.name: Small Basket
messages.minorImprovements.D069_SmallGreenhouse.d: Add 4 and 7 to the current round and place 1 <VEGETABLE> on each corresponding round space. At the start of these rounds, you can buy the <VEGETABLE> for 1 <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.D070_StrawManure.descr: Before the field phase of each harvest, you can pay 1 <GRAIN> from your supply to add 1 <VEGETABLE> to each of up to 2 vegetable fields.
messages.minorImprovements.D070_StrawManure.name: Straw Manure
messages.minorImprovements.D071_Changeover.descri: At any time, if a field contains exactly 1 good as a result of a harvest, you can discard that good and immediately take a __Sow__ action limited to that field.
messages.minorImprovements.D071_Changeover.name: Changeover
messages.minorImprovements.D072_StableManure.desc: In the field phase of each harvest, you can harvest 1 additional good from a number of fields equal to the number of unfenced stables you have.
messages.minorImprovements.D072_StableManure.name: Stable Manure
messages.minorImprovements.D073_SupplyBoat.descri: Each time after you use the __Fishing__ accumulation space, you can choose to buy 1 <GRAIN> for 1 <FOOD>, or 1 <VEGETABLE> for 3 <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.D073_SupplyBoat.name: Supply Boat
messages.minorImprovements.D074_RoyalWood.descrip: At the end of each turn in which you use the __Farm Expansion__ action space or build an improvement, you get 1 <WOOD> back for every 2 <WOOD> paid during those actions (rounded down).
messages.minorImprovements.D074_RoyalWood.name: Royal Wood
messages.minorImprovements.D075_WoodField.descrip: You can plant <WOOD> on this card as though it were 2 <FIELD>, but it is considered 1 <FIELD>. Sow and harvest <WOOD> on this card as you would <GRAIN>.
messages.minorImprovements.D075_WoodField.name: Wood Field
messages.minorImprovements.D076_SocialBenefits.de: Immediately after the feeding phase of each harvest, if you have no <FOOD> left, you get 1 <WOOD> and 1 <CLAY>.
messages.minorImprovements.D077_RecycledBrick.des: Each time any player (including you) renovates to <STONE>, you get 1 <CLAY> for each newly renovated room.
messages.minorImprovements.D078_ReedPond.descript: Place 1 <REED> on each of the next 3 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <REED>.
messages.minorImprovements.D078_ReedPond.name: Reed Pond
messages.minorImprovements.D079_CarrotMuseum.desc: At the end of rounds 8, 10, and 12, you get 1 <STONE> for each <VEGETABLE> <FIELD> you have and a number of <WOOD> equal to the number of <VEGETABLE> in your supply.
messages.minorImprovements.D079_CarrotMuseum.name: Carrot Museum
messages.minorImprovements.D080_BrickHammer.descr: Each time after you build an improvement costing at least 2 <CLAY>, you get 1 <STONE>.
messages.minorImprovements.D080_BrickHammer.name: Brick Hammer
messages.minorImprovements.D081_RoofLadder.descri: Each time you renovate, you pay 1 fewer <REED> and, at the end of the action, you get 1 <STONE>.
messages.minorImprovements.D081_RoofLadder.name: Roof Ladder
messages.minorImprovements.D082_HuntingTrophy.des:
To play this card, you must return or cook 1 <PIG>.
Improvements built on __House Redevelopment__ cost you 1 building resource of your choice less. <FENCE> built on __Farm Redevelopment__ cost you a total of 3 <WOOD> less.
messages.minorImprovements.D083_Pigswill.descript: Each time you use the __Fencing__ action space, you also get 1 <PIG>.
messages.minorImprovements.D083_Pigswill.name: Pigswill
messages.minorImprovements.D084_FeedPellets.descr: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <SHEEP>. In the feeding phase of each harvest, you can exchange exactly 1 <VEGETABLE> for 1 animal of a type you already have.
messages.minorImprovements.D084_FeedPellets.name: Feed Pellets
messages.minorImprovements.D092_ChildOmbudsman.de: From round 5 on, if you have room in your house, at the end of each person action, you can take a __Family Growth__ action with that person. If you do, you get 2 negative <SCORE>.
messages.minorImprovements.D164_PetGrower.descrip: Each time you use an animal accumulation space, if afterward you have no animal in your house, you also get 1 <SHEEP>.
messages.minorImprovements.D164_PetGrower.name: Pet Grower
messages.minorImprovements.E001_PoleBarns.descrip: You can immediately build up to 3 <STABLE> at no cost. (You must pay the cost of this card though.)
messages.minorImprovements.E001_PoleBarns.name: Pole Barns
messages.minorImprovements.E002_RenovationMateria: Immediately renovate to <CLAY> at no cost. (You must pay the cost of this card though.)
messages.minorImprovements.E003_TeaTime.descripti: Immediately return your person on the __Grain Utilization__ action space home; you can place it again later this round.
messages.minorImprovements.E003_TeaTime.name: Tea Time
messages.minorImprovements.E004_Thunderbolt.descr: Immediately remove all <GRAIN> from one of your fields to the general supply. Gain 2 <WOOD> for each <GRAIN> you just removed.
messages.minorImprovements.E004_Thunderbolt.name: Thunderbolt
messages.minorImprovements.E005_NightLoot.descrip: Immediately remove 2 different building resources total from accumulation spaces and place them in your supply.
messages.minorImprovements.E005_NightLoot.name: Night Loot
messages.minorImprovements.E006_Recount.descripti: You immediately get 1 building resource of each type of which you have 4 or more resources in your supply already.
messages.minorImprovements.E006_Recount.name: Recount
messages.minorImprovements.E007_Pumpernickel.desc: You immediately get 4 <FOOD>. (Effectively, you are turning 1 <GRAIN> into 4 <FOOD>.)
messages.minorImprovements.E007_Pumpernickel.name: Pumpernickel
messages.minorImprovements.E008_FarmersMarket.des: You immediately get 1 <VEGETABLE>. (Effectively, you are buying 1 <VEGETABLE> for 2 <FOOD>.)
messages.minorImprovements.E009_BarteringHut.desc: Up to two times: Immediately spend any 2/3/4 building resources for 1 <SHEEP>/<PIG>/<CATTLE> from the general supply.
messages.minorImprovements.E009_BarteringHut.name: Bartering Hut
messages.minorImprovements.E010_StrawHat.descript: At the end of the work phases of rounds 3 and 6, you can move your person from the __Farmland__ action space to an unoccupied action space and take that action, or get 1 <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.E010_StrawHat.name: Straw Hat
messages.minorImprovements.E011_PettingZoo.descri: As long as you have a pasture orthogonally adjacent to your house, you can keep animals of any type on this card, up to the number of rooms in your house.
messages.minorImprovements.E011_PettingZoo.name: Petting Zoo
messages.minorImprovements.E012_AnimalBedding.des: You can keep 1 additional animal (of the same type) in each of your unfenced <STABLE>, and 2 additional animals (of the same type) in each pasture with <STABLE>.
messages.minorImprovements.E013_StoneHouseReconst: At any time, you can renovate your clay house to a stone house without placing a person. (You must pay the normal renovation cost.)
messages.minorImprovements.E014_WoodSaw.descripti: Each time all other players have more people than you, you can take a __Build Rooms__ action without placing a person.
messages.minorImprovements.E014_WoodSaw.name: Wood Saw
messages.minorImprovements.E015_NailBasket.descri: Each time after you use a <WOOD> accumulation space, you can place 1 <STONE> from your supply on that space (for the next visitor) to take a __Build Fences__ action.
messages.minorImprovements.E015_NailBasket.name: Nail Basket
messages.minorImprovements.E016_BriarHedge.descri: You do not need to pay wood for fences that you build on the edge of your farmyard board.
messages.minorImprovements.E016_BriarHedge.name: Briar Hedge
messages.minorImprovements.E017_SkimmerPlow.descr: Each time you use the __Farmland__ or __Cultivation__  action space, you can plow 2 <FIELD> instead of 1. Each time you sow, you must place 1 fewer good on each <FIELD> you sow.
messages.minorImprovements.E017_SkimmerPlow.name: Skimmer Plow
messages.minorImprovements.E018_SeedAlmanac.descr: Each time after you play a minor improvement after this one, you can pay 1 <FOOD> to plow 1 <FIELD>.
messages.minorImprovements.E018_SeedAlmanac.name: Seed Almanac
messages.minorImprovements.E019_OxGoad.descriptio: Each time after you use the __Cattle Market__ accumulation space, you can pay 2 <FOOD> to plow 1 <FIELD>.
messages.minorImprovements.E019_OxGoad.name: Ox Goad
messages.minorImprovements.E020_IronHoe.descripti: At the end of each work phase, if you occupy both the __Grain Seeds__ and __Vegetable Seeds__ action spaces, you can plow 1 <FIELD>.
messages.minorImprovements.E020_IronHoe.name: Iron Hoe
messages.minorImprovements.E021_SheepRug.descript: You can use any __Wish for Children__ action space, even if it is occupied by another player's person.
messages.minorImprovements.E021_SheepRug.name: Sheep Rug
messages.minorImprovements.E022_GuestRoom.descrip: Immediately place any amount of <FOOD> from your supply on this card. Once per round, you can discard 1 <FOOD> from this card to place a person from your supply in that round.
messages.minorImprovements.E022_GuestRoom.name: Guest Room
messages.minorImprovements.E023_Apiary.descriptio: At the end of each work phase, you can sow exactly 1 crop on 1 <FIELD>.
messages.minorImprovements.E023_Apiary.name: Apiary
messages.minorImprovements.E024_Ambition.descript: Each time you get a __Minor Improvement__ action on an action space, you can build a major improvement instead of playing a minor one.
messages.minorImprovements.E024_Ambition.name: Ambition
messages.minorImprovements.E025_BumperCrop.descri: When you play this card, immediately carry out the field phase on your farmyard only. (This is not a harvest.)
messages.minorImprovements.E025_BumperCrop.name: Bumper Crop
messages.minorImprovements.E026_Sundial.descripti: At the end of the work phases of rounds 7 and 9, you can take a __Sow__ action without placing a person.
messages.minorImprovements.E026_Sundial.name: Sundial
messages.minorImprovements.E027_PiggyBank.descrip: At the end of each work phase, you can place 1 <FOOD> on this card, irretrievably. At any time, you can discard 6 <FOOD> from this card to build a major improvement at no cost.
messages.minorImprovements.E027_PiggyBank.name: Piggy Bank
messages.minorImprovements.E028_Bookmark.descript: Add 3 to the current round and mark the corresponding round space. At the start of that round, you can play 1 occupation without paying an occupation cost.
messages.minorImprovements.E028_Bookmark.name: Bookmark
messages.minorImprovements.E029_Heirloom.name: Heirloom
messages.minorImprovements.E030_ChildsToy.descrip: During the feeding phase of each harvest, your newborns require 2 <FOOD> (instead of 1).
messages.minorImprovements.E030_ChildsToy.name: Child's Toy
messages.minorImprovements.E031_Upholstery.descri: Each time you build or play an improvement after this one, you can place 1 <REED> on this card, irretrievably, to get 1 bonus <SCORE>, up to the number of rooms in your house.
messages.minorImprovements.E031_Upholstery.name: Upholstery
messages.minorImprovements.E032_Nave.description: During scoring, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> for each of the 5 columns of your farmyard board containing at least one room.
messages.minorImprovements.E032_Nave.name: Nave
messages.minorImprovements.E033_BeaverColony.desc: From now on, one of your pastures with stable cannot hold animals. Each time you get <REED> from an action space, you get 1 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.minorImprovements.E033_BeaverColony.name: Beaver Colony
messages.minorImprovements.E034_LandRegister.desc: During scoring, if your farm has no unused spaces, you get 2 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.minorImprovements.E034_LandRegister.name: Land Register
messages.minorImprovements.E035_Misanthropy.descr: During scoring, if you have exactly 4/3/2 people, you get 2/3/5 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.minorImprovements.E035_Misanthropy.name: Misanthropy
messages.minorImprovements.E036_HerbalGarden.desc: From now on, at least one of your pastures must contain no animals.
messages.minorImprovements.E036_HerbalGarden.name: Herbal Garden
messages.minorImprovements.E037_OxSkull.descripti: During scoring, if you have no <CATTLE>, you get 3 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.minorImprovements.E037_OxSkull.name: Ox Skull
messages.minorImprovements.E038_RodCollection.des: Each time you use __Fishing__, you can place up to 2 <WOOD> on this card, irretrievably. During scoring, each such <WOOD> is worth 1 bonus <SCORE>, except the 1st, 4th, 7th, and 10th.
messages.minorImprovements.E039_Paintbrush.descri: Each harvest, you can exchange exactly 1 <CLAY> for your choice of 2 <FOOD> or 1 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.minorImprovements.E039_Paintbrush.name: Paintbrush
messages.minorImprovements.E040_BeeStatue.descrip: Pile (from bottom to top) 1 <VEGETABLE>, 1 <STONE>, 1 <GRAIN>, 1 <STONE>, 1 <GRAIN> on this card. Each time you use the __Day Laborer__ action space, you get the top good.
messages.minorImprovements.E040_BeeStatue.name: Bee Statue
messages.minorImprovements.E041_MuddyWaters.descr: Alternate placing 1 <FOOD> and 1 <CLAY> on each remaining even-numbered round space, starting with <FOOD>. At the start of these rounds, you get the respective good.
messages.minorImprovements.E041_MuddyWaters.name: Muddy Waters
messages.minorImprovements.E042_WaterGully.descri: Place 1 <CATTLE>, 1 <GRAIN>, and 1 <CATTLE> on the next 3 round spaces (in that order). At the start of these rounds, you get the respective good.
messages.minorImprovements.E042_WaterGully.name: Water Gully
messages.minorImprovements.E043_BarnCats.descript: If you have 1/2/3/4 <STABLE>, place 1 <FOOD> on each of the next 2/3/4/5 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.E043_BarnCats.name: Barn Cats
messages.minorImprovements.E044_FodderBeets.descr: Place 1 <FOOD> on each remaining odd-numbered round space. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.E044_FodderBeets.name: Fodder Beets
messages.minorImprovements.E045_FruitLadder.descr: Place 1 <FOOD> on each remaining even-numbered round space. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.E045_FruitLadder.name: Fruit Ladder
messages.minorImprovements.E046_WaterlilyPond.des: Place 1 <FOOD> on each of the next 2 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.E047_SyrupTap.descript: Each time you get at least 1 <WOOD> from an action space, place 1 <FOOD> on the next round space. At the start of that round, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.E047_SyrupTap.name: Syrup Tap
messages.minorImprovements.E048_TownHall.descript: In the feeding phase of each harvest, if you live in a <CLAY> or stone house, you get 1 or 2 <FOOD>, respectively.
messages.minorImprovements.E048_TownHall.name: Town Hall
messages.minorImprovements.E049_Twibil.descriptio: Each time after any player (including you) builds at least 1 wood room, you get 1 <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.E049_Twibil.name: Twibil
messages.minorImprovements.E050_WildGreens.descri: Each time you sow, you get 1 <FOOD> for every different type of good that you sow.
messages.minorImprovements.E050_WildGreens.name: Wild Greens
messages.minorImprovements.E051_WhaleOil.descript: Each time you use __Fishing__, place 1 <FOOD> from the general supply on this card. Each time before you play an occupation, you get <FOOD> equal to the amount on this card.
messages.minorImprovements.E051_WhaleOil.name: Whale Oil
messages.minorImprovements.E052_Cubbyhole.descrip: For each room that you add to your house, place 1 <FOOD> from the general supply on this card. At the start of each feeding phase, you get <FOOD> equal to the amount on this card.
messages.minorImprovements.E052_Cubbyhole.name: Cubbyhole
messages.minorImprovements.E053_BoarSpear.descrip: Each time you get at least 1 <PIG> outside of the breeding phase of a harvest, you can immediately turn them into 4 <FOOD> each.
messages.minorImprovements.E053_BoarSpear.name: Boar Spear
messages.minorImprovements.E054_Contraband.descri: Each time you play or build an improvement after this, you can pay 1 additional building resource of a type in the printed cost to get 3 <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.E054_Contraband.name: Contraband
messages.minorImprovements.E055_StoneWeir.descrip: Each time you use the __Fishing__ accumulation space, if there are 0/1/2/3 <FOOD> on the space, you get an additional 4/3/2/1 <FOOD> from the general supply.
messages.minorImprovements.E055_StoneWeir.name: Stone Weir
messages.minorImprovements.E056_RomanPot.descript: Place 4 <FOOD> from the general supply on this card. At the start of each work phase, if you are the last player in turn order, move 1 <FOOD> from this card to your supply.
messages.minorImprovements.E056_RomanPot.name: Roman Pot
messages.minorImprovements.E057_CheeseFondue.desc: Each time you bake at least 1 <GRAIN> into bread, you get 1 additional <FOOD> if you have at least 1 <SHEEP> and (another) 1 additional <FOOD> if you have at least 1 <CATTLE>.
messages.minorImprovements.E057_CheeseFondue.name: Cheese Fondue
messages.minorImprovements.E058_LunchtimeBeer.des: At the start of each harvest, you can choose to skip the <FIELD> and breeding phase of that harvest and get exactly 1 <FOOD> instead.
messages.minorImprovements.E059_CombandCutter.des: Each time you use the __Day Laborer__ action space, you get 1 additional <FOOD> for each <SHEEP> on the __Sheep Market__ accumulation space, up to a maximum of 4 additional <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.E060_WorkingGloves.des: When you play this card, you get 1 <FOOD>. Each time you pay an occupation cost, you can pay 1 building resource of your choice in place of (up to) 2 <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.E061_RaisedBed.descrip: At the start of each harvest, you get 4 <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.E061_RaisedBed.name: Raised Bed
messages.minorImprovements.E062_SourDough.descrip: Once per round, if all players have at least 1 person left to place, you can skip placing a person and take a __Bake Bread__ action instead.
messages.minorImprovements.E062_SourDough.name: Sour Dough
messages.minorImprovements.E063_IronOven.name: Iron Oven
messages.minorImprovements.E064_SimpleOven.name: Simple Oven
messages.minorImprovements.E065_Almsbag.descripti: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <GRAIN> for every 2 completed rounds.
messages.minorImprovements.E065_Almsbag.name: Almsbag
messages.minorImprovements.E066_BarnShed.descript: Each time another player (or, in a solo game, you) uses the __Forest__ accumulation space, you get 1 <GRAIN>.
messages.minorImprovements.E066_BarnShed.name: Barn Shed
messages.minorImprovements.E067_GrainBag.descript: Each time you use the __Grain Seeds__ action space, you get 1 additional <GRAIN> for each <BAKE>-improvement you have.
messages.minorImprovements.E067_GrainBag.name: Grain Bag
messages.minorImprovements.E068_CherryOrchard.des: This card is a <FIELD> on which you can only sow and harvest <WOOD> as you would <GRAIN>. Each time you harvest the last <WOOD> from this card, you also receive 1 <VEGETABLE>.
messages.minorImprovements.E069_MelonPatch.descri: This card is a <FIELD> that can only grow <VEGETABLE>. Each time you harvest the last <VEGETABLE> from this card, you can plow 1 <FIELD>.
messages.minorImprovements.E069_MelonPatch.name: Melon Patch
messages.minorImprovements.E070_CropRotationField: This card is a <FIELD>. Each time you remove the last <GRAIN> or <VEGETABLE> from this card, you can immediately sow <VEGETABLE> or <GRAIN> on this card, respectively.
messages.minorImprovements.E071_CowPatty.descript: Each time you sow in a field that is orthogonally adjacent to a pasture, you can place 1 additional good of the planted type in it.
messages.minorImprovements.E071_CowPatty.name: Cow Patty
messages.minorImprovements.E072_ArtichokeField.de: This card is a <FIELD>. During the field phase of each harvest, if you harvest at least 1 good from this card, you also get 1 <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.E073_Scythe.descriptio: During the field phase of each harvest, you can select exactly one of your fields and harvest all the crops planted in it.
messages.minorImprovements.E073_Scythe.name: Scythe
messages.minorImprovements.E074_AshTrees.descript: When you play this card, immediately place (up to) 5 fences from your supply on it. When you build fences, fences taken from this card cost you nothing.
messages.minorImprovements.E074_AshTrees.name: Ash Trees
messages.minorImprovements.E075_StoneAxe.descript: Each time you use a wood accumulation space, you can return 1 <STONE> to the general supply to get an additional 3 <WOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.E075_StoneAxe.name: Stone Axe
messages.minorImprovements.E076_LumberPile.descri: When you play this card, you can immediately return up to 3 <STABLE> from your farmyard board to your supply and get 3 <WOOD> for each.
messages.minorImprovements.E076_LumberPile.name: Lumber Pile
messages.minorImprovements.E077_Mattock.descripti: Each time you get <REED> and/or <STONE> from an action space, you get 1 additional <CLAY>.
messages.minorImprovements.E077_Mattock.name: Mattock
messages.minorImprovements.E078_SleightofHand.des: When you play this card, you can immediately exchange up to 4 building resources for an equal number of other building resources.
messages.minorImprovements.E079_FieldSpade.descri: Each time after you sow in at least 1 <FIELD>, you get 1 <STONE>.
messages.minorImprovements.E079_FieldSpade.name: Field Spade
messages.minorImprovements.E080_RockGarden.descri: You can only plant <STONE> on this card. Plant as though it were 3 <FIELD>, but it is considered 1 <FIELD>. Sow and harvest <STONE> on this card as you would <VEGETABLE>.
messages.minorImprovements.E080_RockGarden.name: Rock Garden
messages.minorImprovements.E081_AlchemistsLab.des: This card is an action space for all. A player who uses it gets 1 building resource of each type they already have. If another player uses it, they must first pay you 1 <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.E082_Profiteering.desc: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <FOOD>. Each time you use the __Day Laborer__ action space, you can exchange 1 building resource for another building resource.
messages.minorImprovements.E082_Profiteering.name: Profiteering
At the start of the breeding phase of each harvest, if you have at least 1 unfenced <STABLE> without an animal, you get 1 <SHEEP>.
messages.minorImprovements.E084_DollysMother.desc: You only require 1 <SHEEP> to breed sheep during the breeding phase of a harvest. This card can hold 1 <SHEEP>.
messages.minorImprovements.E084_DollysMother.name: Dolly's Mother
messages.minorImprovements.M015_PeatBurnOff.descr: You immediately get 1 <FUEL>. Additionally, you can immediately exchange 1 <MOOR> for 1 <FIELD> tile.
messages.minorImprovements.M015_PeatBurnOff.name: Peat Burn-off
messages.minorImprovements.M016_ClearFelling.desc: You immediately get 2 <WOOD>. On each of up to 2 farmyard spaces containing nothing but exactly 1 <FOREST>, you can immediately turn that <FOREST> to the <MOOR> side.
messages.minorImprovements.M016_ClearFelling.name: Clear Felling
messages.minorImprovements.M017_Reforestation.des: Place 1 <FOREST> on an unused farmyard space.
messages.minorImprovements.M018_RegisterOfCraftsm: Immediately acquire your choice of the Joinery, Pottery, or Basketmaker's Workshop without placing a person. You pay 1 <STONE> less for it.
messages.minorImprovements.M019_LawnTurf.descript: If you have exactly 3/4/5/6/7 unused farmyard spaces, you immediately get 1/2/3/4/5 <FUEL>.
messages.minorImprovements.M019_LawnTurf.name: Lawn Turf
messages.minorImprovements.M020_PeatPellets.descr: You immediately get 1 <FUEL> for each visible <MOOR> that you have.
messages.minorImprovements.M020_PeatPellets.name: Peat Pellets
messages.minorImprovements.M021_PeatCuttingExpedi: Immediately remove any number of visible <MOOR> from your farmyard and get 1 bonus <SCORE> and 2 <FUEL> each. Additionally, if you have at least 2/4/5/6 <HORSE>, you immediately get 1/2/3/4 <FUEL>.
messages.minorImprovements.M022_EcologicalNiche.d: You immediately get 2 <FOOD> if you have an animal type that no one else has; 1 <FOOD> each if only you are growing <GRAIN> and/or <VEGETABLE>; 1 <FUEL> each if you have the single most <FOREST> and/or <MOOR>.
messages.minorImprovements.M023_EdgeOfTheForest.d: You immediately get 1 <FOOD> for each of your <FENCE> spaces between a <FOREST> and a <FIELD>, and 1 <FUEL> for each of your <FENCE> spaces between a <FOREST> and a <MOOR>.
messages.minorImprovements.M024_BasicSupplies.des: You immediately get goods until you have at least 1 <FUEL>, 1 <FOOD>, 1 <WOOD>, 1 <CLAY>, 1 <REED>, 1 <STONE>, and 1 <GRAIN> in your supply.
messages.minorImprovements.M025_HouseholdInventor: If you have exactly 5/6/7/8/9/10 unused farmyard spaces, you immediately get the following 1/2/3/4/5/6 goods (in this order): 1 <REED>, 1 <GRAIN>, 1 <CATTLE>, 1 <STONE>, 1 <VEGETABLE>, 1 <HORSE>.
messages.minorImprovements.M026_ChimneyHood.descr: You immediately get as much <FOOD> as you would get from one of your baking improvements if you baked 1 <GRAIN>.
messages.minorImprovements.M026_ChimneyHood.name: Chimney Hood
messages.minorImprovements.M027_GardenPath.descri: You immediately get 3 <WOOD>. The player to your left must immediately place the "Garden Path" token in front of them.
messages.minorImprovements.M027_GardenPath.name: Garden Path
messages.minorImprovements.M027_GardenPath.rules: During scoring, the player holding the __Garden Path__ token loses 1 <SCORE>. There is only one token: each time this card is played, move it to the player to the left. The previous holder no longer has it.
messages.minorImprovements.M028_OutOnTheWallaby.d: You immediately get goods for each craft building that you have: 3 <WOOD> for the Joinery, 3 <CLAY> for the Pottery, 2 <REED> for the Basketmaker's Workshop.
messages.minorImprovements.M029_Tinker.descriptio: If you have at least one of the "Joinery", "Pottery", or "Basketmaker's Workshop" major improvements, you immediately get 1 <WOOD>, 1 <CLAY>, 1 <REED>, and 1 <STONE>.
messages.minorImprovements.M029_Tinker.name: Tinker
You can immediately exchange exactly 2 <SHEEP> for 1 <CATTLE> and 1 <HORSE>. You may not exchange only 1 <SHEEP>.
messages.minorImprovements.M031_LivestockMarket.d: You can immediately exchange up to 3 animals of any type at the same time, if you can accommodate them: <SHEEP> <ARROW> <PIG> <ARROW> <CATTLE> <ARROW> <HORSE>.
messages.minorImprovements.M032_PeatHut.descripti: This card provides room for one person. In the feeding phase of each harvest, it must be heated with 1 <FUEL>. Instead of a __Renovation__ action, you can remove this card from play and add 1 wooden room to your wood house at no cost.
messages.minorImprovements.M032_PeatHut.name: Peat Hut
messages.minorImprovements.M033_NightPasture.desc: You can keep up to 3 animals of any type on this card; the other players can each keep an additional 1 animal on it. The animals on this card count as only yours when animals breed. You are always the last player to breed in the breeding phase.
messages.minorImprovements.M033_NightPasture.name: Night Pasture
messages.minorImprovements.M034_HomeWood.descript: You can keep exactly 1 animal, except <SHEEP>, on each farmyard space containing at least 1 <FOREST>.
messages.minorImprovements.M034_HomeWood.name: Home Wood
messages.minorImprovements.M035_HorseTrough.descr: You can keep up to 2 <HORSE> in an unused farmyard space adjacent to your house. Even if you do, this farmyard space is still considered unused. You can change in which farmyard space you keep the <HORSE>.
messages.minorImprovements.M035_HorseTrough.name: Horse Trough
messages.minorImprovements.M036_PeatMoss.descript: Wooden rooms only cost you 3 <WOOD> and 1 <REED> each.
messages.minorImprovements.M036_PeatMoss.name: Peat Moss
messages.minorImprovements.M037_BuildingPlan.desc: Each time after you build at least 2 rooms at once, you can build up to 2 <STABLE> without paying <WOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.M037_BuildingPlan.name: Building Plan
messages.minorImprovements.M038_NatureReserve.des: Immediately <FENCE> a farmyard space containing at least 1 <FOREST> or <MOOR> that is adjacent to a pasture, without paying <WOOD> for the <FENCE>. Once there are no tiles left in the fenced area, the farmyard space becomes a pasture.
messages.minorImprovements.M039_SpecialPasture.de: Immediately <FENCE> a farmyard space that is not adjacent to an existing pasture, without paying <WOOD> for the <FENCE>. You can connect your pastures later. All future pastures must be adjacent to at least one existing pasture.
messages.minorImprovements.M040_MoorFire.descript: Once you only have 1 remaining <MOOR>, at any time, you can exchange it for 1 <FIELD> tile.
messages.minorImprovements.M040_MoorFire.name: Moor Fire
messages.minorImprovements.M041_CattleCollar.desc: Each time after you use the __Farmland__ or __Cultivation__ action space or take the __Slash and Burn__ special action, if you have at least 1 <CATTLE>, you can plow 1 additional <FIELD>.
messages.minorImprovements.M041_CattleCollar.name: Cattle Collar
messages.minorImprovements.M042_DeepPlow.descript: You can immediately place 1 <MOOR> on an unused farmyard space. Each time you use the __Farmland__ or __Cultivation__ action space, you can also exchange 1 <MOOR> for 1 <FIELD> tile.
messages.minorImprovements.M042_DeepPlow.name: Deep Plow
messages.minorImprovements.M043_WildFields.descri: You can immediately place up to 2 <FIELD> tiles, one at a time, on unused farmyard spaces that are not adjacent to existing <FIELD>. You can connect your <FIELD> later. All future <FIELD> must be adjacent to at least one existing <FIELD>.
messages.minorImprovements.M043_WildFields.name: Wild Fields
messages.minorImprovements.M044_Swamp.description: Place 1 <MOOR> on round space 12. At the start of that round, you can place the <MOOR> on an unused farmyard space.
messages.minorImprovements.M044_Swamp.name: Swamp
messages.minorImprovements.M045_TreeNursery.descr: Place 1 <FOREST> each on the round spaces 12 and 13. At the start of these rounds, you can place the <FOREST> on an unused farmyard space.
messages.minorImprovements.M045_TreeNursery.name: Tree Nursery
messages.minorImprovements.M046_Thicket.descripti: Choose up to 2 of your <FOREST> and place 1 additional <FOREST> on top of each of them. You cannot take the __Slash and Burn__ special action on these farmyard spaces unless you remove a tile with a __Fell Trees__ special action first.
messages.minorImprovements.M046_Thicket.name: Thicket
messages.minorImprovements.M047_BogForest.descrip: Place 1 <FOREST> each on as many of your <MOOR> as you wish. You cannot take the __Slash and Burn__ special action or use the covered <MOOR> on these farmyard spaces unless you remove the <FOREST> with a __Fell Trees__ special action first.
messages.minorImprovements.M047_BogForest.name: Bog Forest
messages.minorImprovements.M048_ForestSwamp.descr: Each time you take the __Cut Peat__ special action, add 4 to the current round and place 1 <FOREST> on the corresponding round space. At the start of that round, you can place the <FOREST> on an unused farmyard space.
messages.minorImprovements.M048_ForestSwamp.name: Forest Swamp
messages.minorImprovements.M049_SurveyorsMap.desc: Place a <FIELD> tile on round space 11, a <MOOR> on round space 12, and a <FOREST> on round space 13. At the start of these rounds, you can place the respective tile on an unused farmyard space per the normal rules.
messages.minorImprovements.M049_SurveyorsMap.name: Surveyor's Map
messages.minorImprovements.M050_FarmExtension.des: Place a farmyard extension at one of the four sides of your farmyard board. Both new farmyard spaces must be adjacent to existing farmyard spaces.
messages.minorImprovements.M051_MoorEnclosures.de: Place a farmyard extension at one of the four sides of your farmyard board and place 1 <MOOR> on each of the 2 new farmyard spaces. Both new farmyard spaces must be adjacent to existing farmyard spaces.
messages.minorImprovements.M052_WeddingCoach.desc: When you play this card, you can immediately take a "Family Growth without Room" action without placing a person. Place the newborn on this card until the returning home phase.
messages.minorImprovements.M052_WeddingCoach.name: Wedding Coach
messages.minorImprovements.M053_ForestHut.descrip: Place 1 person from your supply on a <FOREST>. Once you remove the <FOREST>, you can place the person that round. In the returning home phase of that round, return the person to your supply. Until then, you cannot use it for family growth.
messages.minorImprovements.M053_ForestHut.name: Forest Hut
messages.minorImprovements.M054_AgriculturalImple: Immediately after each time you use the __Farmland__ or __Cultivation__ action space, you can take a face-up special action card. The special action card costs 0 or 2 <FOOD>, as usual.
messages.minorImprovements.M055_ToolShed.descript: Once per round, immediately before or after you take the __Slash and Burn__ or __Cut Peat__ special action, you can also take the respective other special action.
messages.minorImprovements.M055_ToolShed.name: Tool Shed
messages.minorImprovements.M056_PeatCuttingRights: Add 4 and 7 to the current round and place 1 <FUEL> on each corresponding round space. At the start of these rounds, you can discard the <FUEL> and take the __Cut Peat__ special action by taking the appropriate special action card.
messages.minorImprovements.M057_Taps.description: In each work phase, after you have placed all of your people, when it would be your turn again, you get exactly one more turn in which you can take a face-up special action card. The special action card costs 0 or 2 <FOOD>, as usual.
messages.minorImprovements.M057_Taps.name: Taps
messages.minorImprovements.M058_PeatFertilizer.de: Each time after you take the __Cut Peat__ special action, you can also take a __Sow__ action.
messages.minorImprovements.M059_NaturesFertilizer: Each time after you take the __Slash and Burn__ special action, you also get a __Sow__ action for the new <FIELD> only. This also applies when you exchange 1 <MOOR> for 1 <FIELD> tile via a minor improvement.
messages.minorImprovements.M060_SowingMachine.des: Each time after you take a special action, if you then have at least 2 <HORSE>, you can also take a __Sow__ action.
messages.minorImprovements.M061_HayWagon.descript: Each time after you take at least 3 <WOOD>, 3 <CLAY>, 2 <REED>, or 2 <STONE> from an accumulation space, you can take a __Build Rooms__ or __Renovation__ action without placing a person.
messages.minorImprovements.M061_HayWagon.name: Hay Wagon
messages.minorImprovements.M062_HearthBrush.descr: You can immediately move up the Tiled Oven. From the next round on, you can build it immediately after a person action by paying its cost. During scoring, it is worth 1 additional bonus <SCORE> for you.
messages.minorImprovements.M062_HearthBrush.name: Hearth Brush
messages.minorImprovements.M063_PastoralLetter.de: You can immediately move up the Village Church. From the next round on, you can build it immediately after a person action by paying its cost. During scoring, the Church and Village Church are each worth 1 additional bonus <SCORE> for you.
When you play this card, you can immediately place the "Tombstone" token on an unused farmyard space. That space counts as used but it is blocked for the rest of the game. During scoring, it is worth 1 additional bonus <SCORE>.
messages.minorImprovements.M065_FireBrigade.descr: When you play this card, you immediately get 2 <FOOD>. Additionally, if there are <FOREST> on at least 2/3/4/5 of your farmyard spaces, you immediately get 1/2/3/4 bonus <SCORE>. Crops and <WOOD> do not count but you can exchange them.
messages.minorImprovements.M065_FireBrigade.name: Fire Brigade
messages.minorImprovements.M066_LandParcel.descri: Place 1 <FOREST> on an unused farmyard space. During scoring, if you have 1/2/3+ unused farmyard spaces, you get +2/-1/-3 bonus <SCORE> on top of the negative points for the unused spaces.
messages.minorImprovements.M066_LandParcel.name: Land Parcel
messages.minorImprovements.M067_ChamberOfCommerce: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <WOOD> and 1 <REED>. During scoring, you get 1 additional bonus <SCORE> for each of the "Joinery", "Pottery", and "Basketmaker's Workshop" major improvements that you have.
messages.minorImprovements.M068_Church.descriptio: Returning home phase: once, you can pay 1 <FUEL> to get 1 bonus <SCORE>. When you build this upgrade, you immediately get 2 <FOOD>. The Village Church starts under the Well.
messages.minorImprovements.M068_Church.name: Church
messages.minorImprovements.M068_Church.prerequisi: Remove Your Village Church from Play
messages.minorImprovements.M069_LeatherSaddle.des: Each time you have at least 3 <HORSE>, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> for each <CATTLE> that you turn into <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.M070_MoorArchaeology.d: Each time you take the __Cut Peat__ special action, you can place 1 <FENCE> from your supply on the emptied farmyard space. That space counts as used but it is blocked for the rest of the game. During scoring, it is worth 1 additional bonus <SCORE>.
messages.minorImprovements.M071_BogBody.descripti: During scoring, the owner of the Museum of the Moors and the owner of the Living History Museum each get 1 bonus <SCORE>. The Museum of the Moors is a major improvement; the Living History Museum is a minor improvement.
messages.minorImprovements.M071_BogBody.name: Bog Body
messages.minorImprovements.M072_OvenDamper.descri: When you play this card, you immediately get 3 <FUEL>. During scoring, you get 1 additional bonus <SCORE> each for the "Clay Oven", "Stone Oven", "Heating Oven", and "Tiled Oven" major improvements and the "Oven Installation" upgrade.
messages.minorImprovements.M072_OvenDamper.name: Oven Damper
messages.minorImprovements.M073_StockBreedingPriz: During scoring, if you have at least 1 animal of each of the 4 types, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> for each other player in the game. These points are doubled or tripled if you have 2 or 3 animals of each type, respectively.
messages.minorImprovements.M074_Administration.de: When you play this card, you immediately get 2 <FOOD>. In the harvest at the end of round 14, for each major improvement you have, you can exchange 1 <FOOD> for 1 bonus <SCORE>. This card counts as an improvement in hand for its prerequisite.
messages.minorImprovements.M075_FuelStorage.descr: Add 1, 3, 5, 7, 9, and 11 to the current round. Alternate placing 1 <WOOD> and 1 <FUEL> on the corresponding round spaces, starting with <WOOD>. At the start of these rounds, you get the good.
messages.minorImprovements.M075_FuelStorage.name: Fuel Storage
messages.minorImprovements.M076_Flatboat.descript: Alternate placing 1 <FUEL> and 1 <HORSE> on each of the next 7 round spaces, starting with <FUEL>. At the start of these rounds, you get the respective good.
messages.minorImprovements.M076_Flatboat.name: Flatboat
messages.minorImprovements.M077_DryingField.descr: Each time you take the __Cut Peat__ special action, add 3 to the current round and place 2 <FUEL> on the corresponding round space. At the start of that round, you get the <FUEL>.
messages.minorImprovements.M077_DryingField.name: Drying Field
messages.minorImprovements.M078_Barge.description: Alternate placing 1 <FUEL> and 1 <FOOD> on each remaining round space, starting with <FUEL>. At the start of these rounds, you get the respective good.
messages.minorImprovements.M078_Barge.name: Barge
messages.minorImprovements.M079_PeatSled.descript: Add your choice of 2/4/7/10 to the current round and place 3/4/5/6 <FUEL> on the corresponding round space. At the start of that round, you get the <FUEL>.
messages.minorImprovements.M079_PeatSled.name: Peat Sled
messages.minorImprovements.M081_PeatBoat.descript: At any time: 3 <FUEL> <ARROW> 2 <WOOD> or 2 <CLAY>; 4 <FUEL> <ARROW> 2 <REED> or 2 <STONE>; 2 <FUEL> <ARROW> 1 <SHEEP>; 3 <FUEL> <ARROW> 1 <FOOD>. You cannot get only one of a building resource from this.
messages.minorImprovements.M081_PeatBoat.name: Peat Boat
messages.minorImprovements.M082_Firewood.descript: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <FUEL>. During each harvest, if you exchange at least 1 <WOOD> for 1 <FUEL> to heat your house, you need a total of 1 <FUEL> less to heat it.
messages.minorImprovements.M082_Firewood.name: Firewood
messages.minorImprovements.M083_CoalSeam.descript: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <FUEL>. Each time you take the __Hiring Fair__ special action or use the __Day Laborer__ action space, you also get 1 <FUEL>.
messages.minorImprovements.M083_CoalSeam.name: Coal Seam
messages.minorImprovements.M084_BogPony.descripti: At any time, you can lie a standing <HORSE> on its side to get 2 <FUEL>. Lying <HORSE> do not count for breeding and are only worth 1/2 point during scoring. They can, however, be turned into <FOOD> with an appropriate improvement.
messages.minorImprovements.M084_BogPony.name: Bog Pony
You no longer need to heat your house. The Heating Oven starts under the Clay Oven.
messages.minorImprovements.M086_SpinningMill.desc: For every 2 <SHEEP> that you have in the field phase of each harvest, you pay 1 <FUEL> less to heat your house in the feeding phase of that harvest, but not less than 0 <FUEL>.
messages.minorImprovements.M086_SpinningMill.name: Spinning Mill
messages.minorImprovements.M087_PeatBarge.descrip: Each time you use the __Fishing__ accumulation space, you also get 2 <FUEL>.
messages.minorImprovements.M087_PeatBarge.name: Peat Barge
messages.minorImprovements.M088_PeatIron.descript: At the start of each harvest, if you have at least 2 <MOOR>, you get 1 <FUEL>.
messages.minorImprovements.M088_PeatIron.name: Peat Iron
messages.minorImprovements.M089_BirthingHouse.des: Immediately after each time you take a "Family Growth" action with or without room, you get 1 <FUEL>, 1 <FOOD>, and 1 bonus <SCORE>.
Place 3 usage counters on this card. At any time, you can return 1 usage counter from this card to get as much <FUEL> and <FOOD> until you have at least 2 <FUEL> and 2 <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.M091_RoutineWork.descr: Each harvest, you get your choice of 1 <FUEL> or 1 <FOOD> for each of your craft buildings (Joinery, Pottery, and Basketmaker's Workshop) that you choose not to use to turn a building resource into <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.M091_RoutineWork.name: Routine Work
messages.minorImprovements.M092_AridField.descrip: Each time you take the __Cut Peat__ special action, place 1 <FUEL> and 1 <FOOD> on the emptied farmyard space. This farmyard space is still considered unused. You get the goods once the farmyard space is no longer unused.
messages.minorImprovements.M092_AridField.name: Arid Field
messages.minorImprovements.M093_FarmhandsQuarters: Each time you build a major improvement, you can replace 1 building resource of your choice with 1 <FUEL>. Each time you get an improvement in your hand from the player to your right, you also get 1 <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.M094_PeatBath.descript: Each time you use the "Infirmary" action space, place 1 <FOOD> on as many of the next round spaces as there are <MOOR> visible on your farmyard board. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.M094_PeatBath.name: Peat Bath
messages.minorImprovements.M095_FallowFields.desc: Place 2 <FOOD> on each of up to 3 of your empty <FIELD>. You cannot harvest the <FOOD>. You get it when you sow in these <FIELD>.
messages.minorImprovements.M095_FallowFields.name: Fallow Fields
messages.minorImprovements.M096_FallowLand.descri: Each time you take the __Fell Trees__ or __Cut Peat__ special action, place 1 <FOOD> on the emptied farmyard space. This farmyard space is still considered unused. Once the farmyard space is no longer unused, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.M096_FallowLand.name: Fallow Land
messages.minorImprovements.M097_VillageHall.descr: At the start of each returning home phase in which there is no special action card in front of you, you get 2 <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.M097_VillageHall.name: Village Hall
messages.minorImprovements.M098_FishSmokehouse.de: Each time you use the __Fishing__ accumulation space, you can pay 1 <FUEL> to get an additional 3 <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.M099_HealingClay.descr: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <FOOD>. Each time you use the "Infirmary" action space with a person lying in bed, you get 1 additional <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.M099_HealingClay.name: Healing Clay
messages.minorImprovements.M100_Pheromones.descri: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <FOOD>. Additionally, each player, including you, with at least 1 <STABLE> or pasture immediately gets 2 <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.M100_Pheromones.name: Pheromones
messages.minorImprovements.M101_ButchersBlock.des: You cannot play this card in rounds 4, 7, 9, 11, 13, and 14. All other players must and you can turn any 1 animal into <FOOD>: <SHEEP> <ARROW> 1 <FOOD>, <PIG> <ARROW> 2 <FOOD>, <CATTLE> <ARROW> 3 <FOOD>, <HORSE> <ARROW> 2 <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.M102_SavingsDeposit.de: At the start of each harvest, shuffle all start cards and draw one. If its number is equal to or lower than the amount of <CLAY> you have, you immediately get 6 <FOOD>. Then pass this card to the player on your left, who adds it to their hand.
messages.minorImprovements.M103_ForestKindergarte: Immediately after each time you take a "Family Growth" action with or without room, you get 1 <FOOD> for each of your farmyard spaces containing at least 1 <FOREST>.
messages.minorImprovements.M104_WildHarvest.descr: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <FOOD>. At the start of each harvest, shuffle all start cards and draw one. If its number is equal to or lower than the number of <FOREST> you have, you immediately get 1 <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.M104_WildHarvest.name: Wild Harvest
messages.minorImprovements.M105_OpenGrill.name: Open Grill
messages.minorImprovements.M106_HorseButchery.des: At any time: <SHEEP> <ARROW> 1 <FOOD>; <PIG> <ARROW> 2 <FOOD>; <CATTLE> <ARROW> 3 <FOOD>; <HORSE> <ARROW> 2 <FOOD>; 2 <HORSE> <ARROW> 5 <FOOD>. The Horse Slaughterhouses start under the Fireplaces.
messages.minorImprovements.M107_PotRoastRecipe.de: At any time, you can use your "Fireplace" and "Cooking Hearth" major improvements to turn 1 <HORSE> into 2 <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.M108_GrainDistillery.d: Harvest: once, you can turn 1 <FUEL> and 1 <GRAIN> into 5 <FOOD>. Any number of times during scoring: 1 <FUEL> and 1 <GRAIN> <ARROW> 1 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.minorImprovements.M109_Malthouse.descrip: Each time you take the __Cut Peat__ special action, you can also turn exactly 1 <GRAIN> into 4 <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.M109_Malthouse.name: Malthouse
messages.minorImprovements.M110_FarmCart.descript: Each time you take at least 5 <WOOD>, 4 <CLAY>, 3 <REED>, or 2 <STONE> from an accumulation space, you also get 1 <GRAIN>.
messages.minorImprovements.M110_FarmCart.name: Farm Cart
messages.minorImprovements.M111_NoTillFarming.des: You can plant <GRAIN> or <VEGETABLE> on up to 2 unused farmyard spaces. Even if you do, these farmyard spaces are not considered <FIELD> but still unused. You can discard crops from these farmyard spaces at any time.
messages.minorImprovements.M112_PeatAshFertilizer: Each time before you take the __Cut Peat__ special action, you can place 1 additional crop of the same type on all <FIELD> and farmyard spaces containing <GRAIN> or <VEGETABLE>. Do not place any crops on empty <FIELD> and farmyard spaces.
messages.minorImprovements.M113_LivingHistoryMuse: These major improvements cost you 1 building resource less: Heating Oven 1 <CLAY>, Tiled Oven 1 <STONE>, Riding Stables 1 <WOOD>, Village Church 1 <STONE>, Furniture Stall 1 <WOOD>, Basket Stall 1 <REED>, Ceramics Stall 1 <CLAY>. It starts under the Peat-charcoal Kiln.
messages.minorImprovements.M114_RiversideWoods.de: With this card, each time you use the __Fishing__ accumulation space, you also get 1 <WOOD> for each of your farmyard spaces containing at least 1 <FOREST>, up to a maximum of 3 <WOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.M115_OakBark.descripti: When you play this card, you immediately get 2 <WOOD>. Each time you turn <PIG>, <CATTLE>, or <HORSE> into <FOOD>, you get 1 additional <WOOD> for each of these animals that you turn.
messages.minorImprovements.M115_OakBark.name: Oak Bark
messages.minorImprovements.M116_MoorBirchTrees.de: Each time you take the __Cut Peat__ special action, you also get 2 <WOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.M117_DraughtHorses.des: Each time you take exactly 3 or at least 4 <WOOD> from an accumulation space, if you have at least 1 <HORSE>, you can pay exactly 1 <FOOD> to get 1 or 2 additional <WOOD>, respectively.
messages.minorImprovements.M118_TimberMill.descri: Each time you take the __Fell Trees__ special action or take at least 4 <WOOD> from an accumulation space, you get 1 additional <WOOD>. If you pay 1 <FUEL>, you get 2 additional <WOOD> instead of 1.
messages.minorImprovements.M118_TimberMill.name: Timber Mill
messages.minorImprovements.M119_AlderSwamp.descri: Each time you take the __Fell Trees__ special action, you also get your choice of 1 <WOOD> or 1 <REED>.
messages.minorImprovements.M119_AlderSwamp.name: Alder Swamp
messages.minorImprovements.M120_RiverClay.descrip: Each time you use the __Fishing__ accumulation space, you also get 2 <CLAY>.
messages.minorImprovements.M120_RiverClay.name: River Clay
messages.minorImprovements.M121_Loam.description: In each work phase, if you have placed all but one of your people when taking the __Hiring Fair__ special action, you also get 1 <CLAY>.
messages.minorImprovements.M121_Loam.name: Loam
messages.minorImprovements.M122_WillowBank.descri: Each time you take the __Fell Trees__ special action, you also get 1 <REED>.
messages.minorImprovements.M122_WillowBank.name: Willow Bank
messages.minorImprovements.M123_StoneQuarry.descr: Place 5 <STONE>--only 3 <STONE> in 3-player games--on this card. Each time you take the __Hiring Fair__ special action, you also get 1 <STONE> from this card.
messages.minorImprovements.M123_StoneQuarry.name: Stone Quarry
messages.minorImprovements.M124_StoneWagon.descri: Each time you use the __Day Laborer__ action space, you also get 1 <STONE>.
messages.minorImprovements.M124_StoneWagon.name: Stone Wagon
messages.minorImprovements.M125_HardwareStore.des: Place 3 usage counters on this card. At any time, you can return 1 usage counter from this card to take 1 of each building resource that you have none of in your supply.
Place 4 usage counters on this card. At any time, you can return 1 usage counter from this card plus 1 building resource of your choice to get 1 of any other building resource except <STONE>.
messages.minorImprovements.M127_Wheelbarrow.descr: Each time you take at least 4 of the same building resource from an accumulation space, you also get 1 <FUEL>. Each time you take the __Cut Peat__ special action, you also get 1 building resource of your choice.
messages.minorImprovements.M127_Wheelbarrow.name: Wheelbarrow
messages.minorImprovements.M128_Workbench.descrip: In the field phase of each harvest at the end of rounds 13 and 14, you get 3 <WOOD>, 2 <CLAY>, and 1 <REED>. You can use these, for example, to earn bonus <SCORE> from the Joinery, Pottery, or Basketmaker's Workshop.
messages.minorImprovements.M128_Workbench.name: Workbench
messages.minorImprovements.M129_PlowhorseMarket.d: Each time you use the __Farmland__ or __Cultivation__ action space, you can also buy exactly 1 <HORSE> for 1 <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.M130_Nosebag.descripti: Each time you use the __Grain Seeds__ action space, you also get 1 <HORSE>.
messages.minorImprovements.M130_Nosebag.name: Nosebag
messages.minorImprovements.M131_CattleStall.descr: Add 2, 4, 6, and 8 to the current round and place 1 animal of your choice on each corresponding round space. All the animals must be different. At the start of these rounds, you can buy the respective animal for 1 <FOOD>.
messages.minorImprovements.M131_CattleStall.name: Cattle Stall
messages.minorImprovements.STUB_BeforeBakeGainCla: Test stub: before you bake bread, gain 1 clay.
messages.moor.specialActions.effects.black-market: Pay {fuelCost} fuel to buy 1 minor improvement
messages.moor.specialActions.effects.illicit-work: Pay {foodCost} food and {fuelCost} fuel to buy 1 major improvement
messages.moor.specialActions.title: Special Actions
messages.occupations.A085_Homekeeper.description: Exactly one clay or stone room in your house can hold an additional person if the room is adjacent to both a field and a pasture.
messages.occupations.A085_Homekeeper.name: Homekeeper
messages.occupations.A086_AnimalTamer.description: When you play this card, you immediately get your choice of 1 <WOOD> or 1 <GRAIN>. Instead of just 1 animal total, you can keep any 1 animal in each room of your house.
messages.occupations.A086_AnimalTamer.name: Animal Tamer
messages.occupations.A087_Conservator.description: You can renovate your wooden house directly to stone without renovating it to clay first.
messages.occupations.A087_Conservator.name: Conservator
messages.occupations.A088_HedgeKeeper.description: Each time you take a __Build Fences__ action, you do not have to pay <WOOD> for 3 of the fences you build.
messages.occupations.A088_HedgeKeeper.name: Hedge Keeper
messages.occupations.A089_StablePlanner.descripti: Add 3, 6, and 9 to the current round. You can place 1 stable on each corresponding round space. At the start of these rounds (not earlier), you can build the stable at no cost.
messages.occupations.A089_StablePlanner.name: Stable Planner
messages.occupations.A090_PlowDriver.description: Once you live in a stone house, at the start of each round, you can pay 1 <FOOD> to plow 1 <FIELD>.
messages.occupations.A090_PlowDriver.name: Plow Driver
messages.occupations.A091_ShiftingCultivator.desc: Each time you use a <WOOD> accumulation space, you can also pay 3 <FOOD> to plow 1 <FIELD>.
messages.occupations.A091_ShiftingCultivator.name: Shifting Cultivator
messages.occupations.A092_AdoptiveParents.descrip: For 1 <FOOD>, you can take an action with offspring in the same round you get it. If you do, the offspring does not count as "newborn".
messages.occupations.A092_AdoptiveParents.name: Adoptive Parents
messages.occupations.A093_BedMaker.description: Each time you add rooms to your house, you can also pay 1 <WOOD> and 1 <GRAIN> to immediately get a __Family Growth with Room Only__ action.
messages.occupations.A093_BedMaker.name: Bed Maker
messages.occupations.A094_LazySowman.description: Each time you decline an unconditional __Sow__ action on your turn, you can immediately place another person on an action space of your choice (even if it is occupied).
messages.occupations.A094_LazySowman.name: Lazy Sowman
messages.occupations.A094_LazySowman.rules: The additional person cannot be placed on __Meeting Place__.
messages.occupations.A095_Angler.description: Each time after you use the __Fishing__ Accumulation space while there are at most 2 <FOOD> on that space, you get a __Major or Minor Improvement__ action.
messages.occupations.A095_Angler.name: Angler
messages.occupations.A096_TaskArtisan.description: When you play this card and each time a <STONE> accumulation space appears on a round space in the preparation phase, you get 1 <WOOD> and a __Minor Improvement__ action.
messages.occupations.A096_TaskArtisan.name: Task Artisan
messages.occupations.A097_Freshman.description: Each time you get a __Bake Bread__ action, instead of taking the action, you can play an occupation without paying an occupation cost (at most once per turn).
messages.occupations.A097_Freshman.name: Freshman
messages.occupations.A098_StableArchitect.descrip: During scoring, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> for each unfenced <STABLE> in your farmyard.
messages.occupations.A098_StableArchitect.name: Stable Architect
messages.occupations.A099_FellowGrazer.descriptio: During scoring, you get 2 bonus <SCORE> for each pasture you have covering at least 3 farmyard spaces.
messages.occupations.A099_FellowGrazer.name: Fellow Grazer
messages.occupations.A100_Curator.description: In the returning home phase of each round, if you return at least 3 people from accumulation spaces, you can buy 1 bonus <SCORE> for 1 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.A100_Curator.name: Curator
messages.occupations.A101_CookeryOutfitter.descri: During scoring, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> for each cooking improvement you have. (Ovens are not considered cooking improvements.)
messages.occupations.A101_CookeryOutfitter.name: Cookery Outfitter
messages.occupations.A102_Grocer.description: Pile the following goods on this card (<WOOD>, <GRAIN>, <REED>, <STONE>, <VEGETABLE>, <CLAY>, <REED>, <VEGETABLE>). At any time, you can buy the top good for 1 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.A102_Grocer.name: Grocer
messages.occupations.A103_Portmonger.description: Each time you take 1/2/3+ <FOOD> from a <FOOD> accumulation space, you also get 1 <VEGETABLE>/<GRAIN>/<REED>.
messages.occupations.A103_Portmonger.name: Portmonger
messages.occupations.A104_WoodHarvester.descripti: In the field phase of each harvest, you get 1 <WOOD>/1 <FOOD> for each <WOOD> accumulation space with exactly 2 <WOOD>/at least 3 <WOOD>.
messages.occupations.A104_WoodHarvester.name: Wood Harvester
messages.occupations.A105_BarrowPusher.descriptio: For each new field tile you get, you also get 1 <CLAY> and 1 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.A105_BarrowPusher.name: Barrow Pusher
messages.occupations.A106_SlurrySpreader.descript: In the field phase of each harvest, each time you take the last <GRAIN>/<VEGETABLE> from a <FIELD>, you also get 2 <FOOD>/1 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.A106_SlurrySpreader.name: Slurry Spreader
messages.occupations.A107_Catcher.description: Each time you place your 1st/2nd/3rd person in a round on a building resource accumulation space with exactly 5/4/3 building resources, you get 1 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.A107_Catcher.name: Catcher
messages.occupations.A108_MushroomCollector.descr: Immediately after each time you use a wood accumulation space, you can exchange 1 <WOOD> for 2 <FOOD>. If you do, place the <WOOD> on the accumulation space.
messages.occupations.A108_MushroomCollector.name: Mushroom Collector
messages.occupations.A109_SmallTrader.description: Each time you take a __Major or Minor Improvement__ action, if you play a card from your hand instead of taking a major improvement from the board, you also get 3 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.A109_SmallTrader.name: Small Trader
messages.occupations.A110_Roughcaster.description: Each time you build at least 1 clay room or renovate your house from clay to stone, you also get 3 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.A110_Roughcaster.name: Roughcaster
messages.occupations.A111_WallBuilder.description: Each time you build at least 1 room, you can place 1 <FOOD> on each of the next 4 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.A111_WallBuilder.name: Wall Builder
messages.occupations.A112_ScytheWorker.descriptio: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <GRAIN>. In the field phase of each harvest, you can harvest 1 additional <GRAIN> from each of your grain fields.
messages.occupations.A112_ScytheWorker.name: Scythe Worker
messages.occupations.A113_HeresyTeacher.descripti: Each time you use a __Lessons__ action space, you get 1 <VEGETABLE> in each of your <FIELD> with at least 3 <GRAIN> and no <VEGETABLE>. Place the <VEGETABLE> below the <GRAIN>.
messages.occupations.A113_HeresyTeacher.name: Heresy Teacher
messages.occupations.A114_SeasonalWorker.descript: Each time you use the __Day Laborer__ action space, you get 1 additional <GRAIN>. From round 6 on, you can choose to get 1 <VEGETABLE> instead.
messages.occupations.A114_SeasonalWorker.name: Seasonal Worker
messages.occupations.A115_ChiefForester.descripti: Each time you use a <WOOD> accumulation space, you also get a __Sow__ action for exactly 1 <FIELD>.
messages.occupations.A115_ChiefForester.name: Chief Forester
messages.occupations.A116_WoodCutter.description: Each time you use a <WOOD> accumulation space, you get 1 additional <WOOD>.
messages.occupations.A116_WoodCutter.name: Wood Cutter
messages.occupations.A117_WoodCarrier.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <WOOD> for each improvement in front of you.
messages.occupations.A117_WoodCarrier.name: Wood Carrier
messages.occupations.A118_Treegardener.descriptio: In the field phase of each harvest, you get 1 <WOOD> and you can buy up to 2 additional <WOOD> for 1 <FOOD> each.
messages.occupations.A118_Treegardener.name: Treegardener
messages.occupations.A119_FirewoodCollector.descr: Each time you use the __Farmland__, __Grain Seeds__, __Grain Utilization__, or __Cultivation__ action space, at the end of that turn, you get 1 <WOOD>.
messages.occupations.A119_FirewoodCollector.name: Firewood Collector
messages.occupations.A120_ClayHutBuilder.descript: Once you no longer live in a wooden house, place 2 <CLAY> on each of the next 5 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <CLAY>.
messages.occupations.A120_ClayHutBuilder.name: Clay Hut Builder
messages.occupations.A121_ClayPuncher.description: When you play this card and each time after you use a __Lessons__ action space or the __Clay Pit__ accumulation space, you get 1 <CLAY>.
messages.occupations.A121_ClayPuncher.name: Clay Puncher
messages.occupations.A122_PanBaker.description: Each time you use the __Grain Utilization__ action space, you also get 2 <CLAY> and 1 <WOOD>.
messages.occupations.A122_PanBaker.name: Pan Baker
messages.occupations.A123_FrameBuilder.descriptio: Each time you build a room/renovate, but only once per room/action, you can replace exactly 2 <CLAY> or 2 <STONE> with 1 <WOOD>.
messages.occupations.A123_FrameBuilder.name: Frame Builder
messages.occupations.A124_Knapper.description: Each time before you use an action space card on round spaces 5 to 7, you get 1 <STONE>.
messages.occupations.A124_Knapper.name: Knapper
messages.occupations.A125_Priest.description: When you play this card, if you live in a clay house with exactly 2 rooms, you immediately get 3 <CLAY>, 2 <REED> and 2 <STONE>.
messages.occupations.A125_Priest.name: Priest
messages.occupations.A126_MasterWorkman.descripti: Each time before you use an action space card on round spaces 1/2/3/4, you get 1 <WOOD>/<CLAY>/<REED>/<STONE>.
messages.occupations.A126_MasterWorkman.name: Master Workman
messages.occupations.A127_Lodger.description: This card provides room for one person, but only until the returning home phase of round 9. If, by then, there is no room elsewhere for that person, remove it from play.
messages.occupations.A127_Lodger.name: Lodger
messages.occupations.A128_RiparianBuilder.descrip: Each time another player uses the __Reed Bank__ accumulation space, you can build a room: if you build a <CLAY>/stone room, you get a discount of 1 <CLAY>/2 <STONE>.
messages.occupations.A128_RiparianBuilder.name: Riparian Builder
messages.occupations.A129_Swagman.description: Immediately after each time you use the __Farm Expansion__ or __Grain Seeds__ action space, you can use the respective other space with the same person (even if it is occupied).
messages.occupations.A129_Swagman.name: Swagman
messages.occupations.A130_MummysBoy.description: Once per round, when placing a person after your first two, you can place it on the action space with your 2nd person and use that space again, unless it is on the __Meeting Place__ action space.
messages.occupations.A130_MummysBoy.name: Mummy's Boy
messages.occupations.A131_CraftTeacher.descriptio: Each time after you build the major improvement __Joinery__, __Pottery__, and __Basketmaker's Workshop__, you can play up to 2 occupations without paying an occupation cost.
messages.occupations.A131_CraftTeacher.name: Craft Teacher
messages.occupations.A132_Publican.description: Each time before another player takes an unconditional __Sow__ action, you can give them 1 <GRAIN> from your supply to get 1 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.occupations.A132_Publican.name: Publican
messages.occupations.A133_Braggart.description: During the scoring, you get 2/3/4/5/7/9 bonus <SCORE> for having at least 5/6/7/8/9/10 improvements in front of you.
messages.occupations.A133_Braggart.name: Braggart
messages.occupations.A134_FullFarmer.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <WOOD> and 1 <CLAY>. During scoring, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> for each pasture you have holding the maximum number of animals.
messages.occupations.A134_FullFarmer.name: Full Farmer
messages.occupations.A135_AnimalReeve.description: If there are still 1/3/6/9 complete rounds left to play, you immediately get 1/2/3/4 <WOOD>. During scoring, each player with 2/3/4+ animals of each type gets 1/3/5 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.occupations.A135_AnimalReeve.name: Animal Reeve
messages.occupations.A136_DrudgeryReeve.descripti: If there are still 1/3/6/9 complete rounds left to play, you immediately get 1/2/3/4 <WOOD>. During scoring, each player with 1+/2+/3+ building resources of each type gets 1/3/5 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.occupations.A136_DrudgeryReeve.name: Drudgery Reeve
messages.occupations.A137_RiverineShepherd.descri: Each time you use the __Sheep Market__ or __Reed Bank__ accumulation space, you can also take 1 good from the respective other accumulation space, if possible.
messages.occupations.A137_RiverineShepherd.name: Riverine Shepherd
messages.occupations.A138_Harpooner.description: Each time you use the __Fishing__ space you can also pay 1 <WOOD> to get 1 <FOOD> for each person you have, and 1 <REED>
messages.occupations.A138_Harpooner.name: Harpooner
messages.occupations.A139_HollowWarden.descriptio: When you play this card, you immediately get a __Major Improvement__ action to build a Fireplace. Each time you use the __Hollow__ accumulation space, you also get 1 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.A139_HollowWarden.name: Hollow Warden
messages.occupations.A140_ShovelBearer.descriptio: Each time you use the __Clay Pit__ or __Hollow__ accumulation space, you also get a number of <FOOD> equal to the amount of <CLAY> on the respective other accumulation space.
messages.occupations.A140_ShovelBearer.name: Shovel Bearer
messages.occupations.A141_TurnipFarmer.descriptio: At the start of the returning home phase of each round, if both the __Day Laborer__ and __Grain Seeds__ action spaces are occupied, you get 1 <VEGETABLE>.
messages.occupations.A141_TurnipFarmer.name: Turnip Farmer
messages.occupations.A142_Cordmaker.description: Each time any player (including you) takes at least 2 <REED> from the __Reed Bank__ accumulation space, you can choose to take 1 <GRAIN> or buy 1 <VEGETABLE> for 2 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.A142_Cordmaker.name: Cordmaker
messages.occupations.A143_Stonecutter.description: Every improvement, room, and renovation costs you 1 <STONE> less.
messages.occupations.A143_Stonecutter.name: Stonecutter
messages.occupations.A144_Sequestrator.descriptio: Place 3 <REED> and 4 <CLAY> on this card. The next player to have 3 pastures/5 field tiles gets the 3 <REED>/4 <CLAY> (not retroactively).
messages.occupations.A144_Sequestrator.name: Sequestrator
messages.occupations.A145_Ropemaker.description: At the end of each harvest, you get 1 <REED> from the general supply.
messages.occupations.A145_Ropemaker.name: Ropemaker
messages.occupations.A146_StorehouseSteward.descr: Each time you take exactly 2/3/4/5 <FOOD> from a <FOOD> accumulation space, you also get 1 <STONE>/<REED>/<CLAY>/<WOOD>. (If you take 6 or more <FOOD>, you do not get a bonus good).
messages.occupations.A146_StorehouseSteward.name: Storehouse Steward
messages.occupations.A147_AnimalDealer.descriptio: Each time you use the __Sheep Market__, __Pig Market__, or __Cattle Market__ accumulation space, you can buy 1 additional animal of the respective type for 1 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.A147_AnimalDealer.name: Animal Dealer
messages.occupations.A148_Woolgrower.description: This card can hold a number of <SHEEP> equal to the number of completed feeding phases.
messages.occupations.A148_Woolgrower.name: Woolgrower
messages.occupations.A149_HouseArtist.description: Each time you use the __Traveling Players__ accumulation space, you also get a __Build Rooms__ action. Each room you build during the action costs you 1 <REED> less.
messages.occupations.A149_HouseArtist.name: House Artist
messages.occupations.A150_Stagehand.description: Each time another player uses the __Traveling Players__ accumulation space, you can take your choice of a __Build Fences__, __Build Stables__, or __Build Rooms__ action.
messages.occupations.A150_Stagehand.name: Stagehand
messages.occupations.A151_Minstrel.description: At the start of each returning home phase, if only one action space card on round space 1 to 4 is unoccupied, you can use that action space.
messages.occupations.A151_Minstrel.name: Minstrel
messages.occupations.A152_NightSchoolStudent.desc: Each returning home phase in which no player returns a person from a __Lessons__ action space, you can play an occupation for an occupation cost of 1 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.A152_NightSchoolStudent.name: Night-School Student
messages.occupations.A153_PigOwner.description: The first time after you play this card that you have 5 <PIG> on your farm, you immediately get 3 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.occupations.A153_PigOwner.name: Pig Owner
messages.occupations.A154_Paymaster.description: Each time another player uses a <FOOD> accumulation space, you can give them 1 <GRAIN> from your supply to get 1 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.occupations.A154_Paymaster.name: Paymaster
messages.occupations.A155_Conjurer.description: Each time you use the __Traveling Players__ accumulation space, you get an additional 1 <WOOD> and 1 <GRAIN>.
messages.occupations.A155_Conjurer.name: Conjurer
messages.occupations.A156_Buyer.description: Each time another player uses a <REED>, <STONE>, <SHEEP>, or <PIG> accumulation space, you can pay them 1 <FOOD> to get 1 good of the respective type from the general supply.
messages.occupations.A156_Buyer.name: Buyer
messages.occupations.A157_Bohemian.description: At the start of each returning home phase, if at least one __Lessons__ action space is unoccupied, you get 1 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.A157_Bohemian.name: Bohemian
messages.occupations.A158_CulinaryArtist.descript: Each time another player uses the __Traveling Players__ accumulation space, you can exchange your choice of 1 <GRAIN>/<SHEEP>/<VEGETABLE> for 4/5/7 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.A158_CulinaryArtist.name: Culinary Artist
messages.occupations.A159_JoineroftheSea.descript: Each time another player uses the __Fishing__/__Reed Bank__ accumulation space, you can give them 1 <WOOD> to get 2 <FOOD>/3 <FOOD> from the general supply.
messages.occupations.A159_JoineroftheSea.name: Joiner of the Sea
messages.occupations.A160_Lutenist.description: Each time another player uses the __Traveling Players__ accumulation space, you get 1 <FOOD> and 1 <WOOD>. Immediately after, you can buy exactly 1 <VEGETABLE> for 2 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.A160_Lutenist.name: Lutenist
messages.occupations.A161_PatchCaretaker.descript: Each time you use an accumulation space while already having used another accumulation space for the same type of good that work phase, you also get 1 <VEGETABLE>.
messages.occupations.A161_PatchCaretaker.name: Patch Caretaker
messages.occupations.A162_ForestTallyman.descript: Each time both the __Forest__ and __Clay Pit__ accumulation spaces are occupied, you can use this card as an action space to get 2 <CLAY> and 3 <WOOD>.
messages.occupations.A162_ForestTallyman.name: Forest Tallyman
messages.occupations.A163_BuildingExpert.descript: Each time you use the __Resource Market__ action space with the 1st/2nd/3rd/4th/5th person you place, you also get 1 <WOOD>/<CLAY>/<REED>/<STONE>/<STONE>.
messages.occupations.A163_BuildingExpert.name: Building Expert
messages.occupations.A164_WoodWorker.description: Each time you take <WOOD> from an accumulation space, you can exchange 1 <WOOD> for 1 <SHEEP>. Place the <WOOD> on the accumulation space.
messages.occupations.A164_WoodWorker.name: Wood Worker
messages.occupations.A165_PigBreeder.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <PIG>. Your <PIG> breed at the end of round 12 (if there is room for the new <PIG>).
messages.occupations.A165_PigBreeder.name: Pig Breeder
messages.occupations.A166_Haydryer.description: Immediately before each harvest, you can buy 1 <CATTLE> for 4 <FOOD> minus 1 <FOOD> for each pasture you have. (The minimum cost is 0).
messages.occupations.A166_Haydryer.name: Haydryer
messages.occupations.A167_BreederBuyer.descriptio: Each time you build at least 1 <WOOD>/<CLAY>/stone room and at least 1 <STABLE> on the same turn, you also get 1 <SHEEP>/<PIG>/<CATTLE>.
messages.occupations.A167_BreederBuyer.name: Breeder Buyer
messages.occupations.A168_AnimalTeacher.descripti: Immediately after each time you use a __Lessons__ action space, you can also buy 1 <SHEEP>/<PIG>/<CATTLE> for 0/1/2 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.A168_AnimalTeacher.name: Animal Teacher
messages.occupations.A169_OffSiter.description: Once the total printed building cost of all the major improvements you have is at least 9 building resources, this card provides room for 1 person for the rest of the game.
messages.occupations.A169_OffSiter.name: Off-Siter
messages.occupations.A170_Hayward.description: You can build <FENCE> at any time without placing a person. (This is not considered a __Build Fences__ action.)
messages.occupations.A170_Hayward.name: Hayward
messages.occupations.A171_Sidekick.description: Immediately after each time you place a person on an action space card, you can pay 1 <FOOD> to place another person on the card immediately left to it (and so on).
messages.occupations.A171_Sidekick.name: Sidekick
messages.occupations.A172_BoatPainter.description: At the end of each work phase, if both the __Fishing__ and __Traveling Players__ accumulation spaces are occupied, you get your choice of 1 <GRAIN> or 2 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.A172_BoatPainter.name: Boat Painter
messages.occupations.A173_ClayThief.description: Once this game, at the start of a work phase of your choice, you can turn this card face down to get all of the <CLAY> on the "Hollow" action space.
messages.occupations.A173_ClayThief.name: Clay Thief
messages.occupations.A174_MasterHora.description: Immediately before each time you place a person on an action space with the (meeple) symbol on the game board extension, you can buy 1 <VEGETABLE> for 1 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.A174_MasterHora.name: Master Hora
messages.occupations.A175_HollowGardener.descript: Each time you take at least 3 <CLAY> from the "Hollow" accumulation space, you also get 1 <GRAIN>. If you take at least 6 <CLAY> from it, you also get 1 <VEGETABLE> (instead of <GRAIN>).
messages.occupations.A175_HollowGardener.name: Hollow Gardener
messages.occupations.A176_Wheelmaker.description: When you play this card, if you have another occupation in play and more <WOOD> than all other players combined, you immediately get <WOOD> from the general supply until you have 15 <WOOD>.
messages.occupations.A176_Wheelmaker.name: Wheelmaker
messages.occupations.A177_Middleman.description: Place 1 <STONE> and 1 <FOOD> on all action spaces with the (meeple) symbol on the game board extension. Next time you place a person on them, you get the goods.
messages.occupations.A177_Middleman.name: Middleman
messages.occupations.A178_CarpentersBoy.descripti: Each time another player builds a room, you immediately get 1 <WOOD>.
messages.occupations.A178_CarpentersBoy.name: Carpenter's Boy
messages.occupations.A179_MountainShepherd.descri: Each time you use either __Quarry__ accumulation space, you immediately get an additional 1 <SHEEP> from the general supply.
messages.occupations.A179_MountainShepherd.name: Mountain Shepherd
messages.occupations.A180_AnimalBrander.descripti: Each time you use the __Animal Market__ action space, you can pay 1 <FOOD> to use the same option twice (instead of once).
messages.occupations.A180_AnimalBrander.name: Animal Brander
messages.occupations.B085_FarmHand.description: Once this game, if you have 4 <FIELD> tiles in a 2x2, you can build a <STABLE> in the center of the 2x2 during a __Build Stables__ action. This <STABLE> provides room for a person but not animals.
messages.occupations.B085_FarmHand.name: Farm Hand
messages.occupations.B086_TruffleSearcher.descrip: This card can hold a number of <PIG> equal to the number of completed feeding phases.
messages.occupations.B086_TruffleSearcher.name: Truffle Searcher
messages.occupations.B087_Cottager.description: Each time you use the __Day Laborer__ action space, you can also either build exactly 1 room or renovate your house. Either way, you have to pay the cost.
messages.occupations.B087_Cottager.name: Cottager
messages.occupations.B088_EstablishedPerson.descr: If your house has exactly 2 rooms, immediately renovate it without paying any building resources. If you do, you can immediately afterward take a __Build Fences__ action.
messages.occupations.B088_EstablishedPerson.name: Established Person
