messages.occupations.B089_Groom.description: When you play this card, immediately get 1 <WOOD>. Once you live in a stone house, at the start of each round, you can build exactly 1 <STABLE> for 1 <WOOD>.
messages.occupations.B089_Groom.name: Groom
messages.occupations.B090_CooperativePlower.descr: Each time you use the __Farmland__ action space while the __Grain Seeds__ action space is occupied, you can plow 1 additional <FIELD>.
messages.occupations.B090_CooperativePlower.name: Cooperative Plower
messages.occupations.B091_AssistantTiller.descrip: Each time you use the __Day Laborer__ action space, you can also plow 1 <FIELD>.
messages.occupations.B091_AssistantTiller.name: Assistant Tiller
messages.occupations.B092_LittleStickKnitter.desc: From Round 5 on, each time you use the __Sheep Market__ accumulation space, you can also take a __Family Growth with Room Only__ action.
messages.occupations.B092_LittleStickKnitter.name: Little Stick Knitter
messages.occupations.B093_Confidant.description: Place 1 <FOOD> from your supply on each of the next 2, 3, or 4 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD> back and your choice of a __Sow__ or __Build Fences__ action.
messages.occupations.B093_Confidant.name: Confidant
messages.occupations.B094_StockProtector.descript: Each time before you use the __Fencing__ action space, you get 2 <WOOD>. Immediately after that __Fencing__ action, you can place another person.
messages.occupations.B094_StockProtector.name: Stock Protector
messages.occupations.B095_MasterBricklayer.descri: Each time you build a major improvement, reduce the <STONE> cost by the number of rooms you have built onto your initial house.
messages.occupations.B095_MasterBricklayer.name: Master Bricklayer
messages.occupations.B096_TreeFarmJoiner.descript: Place 1 <WOOD> on each of the next 2 odd-numbered round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <WOOD> and, immediately afterward, a __Minor Improvement__ action.
messages.occupations.B096_TreeFarmJoiner.name: Tree Farm Joiner
messages.occupations.B097_Scholar.description: Once you live in a stone house, at the start of each round, you can play an occupation for an occupation cost of 1 <FOOD>, or a minor improvement (by paying its cost).
messages.occupations.B097_Scholar.name: Scholar
messages.occupations.B098_OrganicFarmer.descripti: During the scoring, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> for each pasture containing at least 1 animal while having unused capacity for at least three more animals.
messages.occupations.B098_OrganicFarmer.name: Organic Farmer
messages.occupations.B099_Tutor.description: During scoring, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> for each occupation played after this one.
messages.occupations.B099_Tutor.name: Tutor
messages.occupations.B100_Clutterer.description: During scoring, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> for each card played after this one that has \  in its text.
messages.occupations.B100_Clutterer.name: Clutterer
messages.occupations.B101_FurnitureCarpenter.desc: Each harvest, if any player (including you) owns the Joinery or an upgrade thereof, you can buy exactly 1 bonus <SCORE> for 2 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.B101_FurnitureCarpenter.name: Furniture Carpenter
messages.occupations.B102_Consultant.description: When you play this card in a 1-/2-/3-/4- player game, you immediately get 2 <GRAIN>/3 <CLAY>/2 <REED>/2 <SHEEP>.
messages.occupations.B102_Consultant.name: Consultant
messages.occupations.B103_FieldMerchant.descripti: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <WOOD> and 1 <REED>. Each time you decline a __Minor/Major Improvement__ action, you get 1 <FOOD>/<VEGETABLE> instead.
messages.occupations.B103_FieldMerchant.name: Field Merchant
messages.occupations.B104_SheepWalker.description: At any time, you can exchange 1 <SHEEP> on your farmyard for either 1 <PIG>, 1 <VEGETABLE>, or 1 <STONE>.
messages.occupations.B104_SheepWalker.name: Sheep Walker
messages.occupations.B105_CaseBuilder.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 good of each of the following types, if you have at least 2 of that good in your supply already: <FOOD>, <GRAIN>, <VEGETABLE>, <REED>, <WOOD>.
messages.occupations.B105_CaseBuilder.name: Case Builder
messages.occupations.B106_MoralCrusader.descripti: Immediately before the start of each round, if there are goods on the remaining round spaces that are promised to you, you get 1 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.B106_MoralCrusader.name: Moral Crusader
messages.occupations.B107_Manservant.description: Once you live in a stone house, place 3 <FOOD> on each remaining round space. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.B107_Manservant.name: Manservant
messages.occupations.B108_OvenFiringBoy.descripti: Each time you use a <WOOD> accumulation space, you get an additional __Bake Bread__ action.
messages.occupations.B108_OvenFiringBoy.name: Oven Firing Boy
messages.occupations.B109_PaperMaker.description: Immediately before playing each occupation after this one, you can pay 1 <WOOD> total to get 1 <FOOD> for each occupation you have in front of you.
messages.occupations.B109_PaperMaker.name: Paper Maker
messages.occupations.B110_Pavior.description: At the end of each preparation phase, if you have at least 1 <STONE> in your supply, you get 1 <FOOD>. In round 14, you get 1 <VEGETABLE> instead.
messages.occupations.B110_Pavior.name: Pavior
messages.occupations.B111_Rustic.description: For each clay room you build, you get 2 <FOOD> and 1 bonus <SCORE>. (this does not apply to stone rooms and renovated wood rooms.)
messages.occupations.B111_Rustic.name: Rustic
messages.occupations.B112_Silokeeper.description: Each time you use the action space card that has been revealed right before the most recent harvest, you also get 1 <GRAIN>.
messages.occupations.B112_Silokeeper.name: Silokeeper
messages.occupations.B113_PatchCaregiver.descript: When you play this card, you can choose to buy 1 <GRAIN> for 1 <FOOD>, or 1 <VEGETABLE> for 3 <FOOD>. This card is a <FIELD>.
messages.occupations.B113_PatchCaregiver.name: Patch Caregiver
messages.occupations.B114_Childless.description: At the start of each round, if you have at least 3 rooms but only 2 people, you get 1 <FOOD> and 1 crop of your choice (<GRAIN> or <VEGETABLE>)
messages.occupations.B114_Childless.name: Childless
messages.occupations.B115_TinsmithMaster.descript: You can hold 1 additional animal in each pasture without a stable. Each time you sow in a field, you can place 1 additional crop of the respective type in that field.
messages.occupations.B115_TinsmithMaster.name: Tinsmith Master
messages.occupations.B116_Shoreforester.descripti: When you play this card and each time 1 <REED> is placed on an empty __Reed Bank__ accumulation space in the preparation phase, you get 1 <WOOD>.
messages.occupations.B116_Shoreforester.name: Shoreforester
messages.occupations.B117_Informant.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <WOOD>. After each work phase, if you have more <STONE> than <CLAY> in your supply, you get 1 <WOOD>.
messages.occupations.B117_Informant.name: Informant
messages.occupations.B118_SmallscaleFarmer.descri: As long as you live in a house with exactly 2 rooms, at the start of each round, you get 1 <WOOD>.
messages.occupations.B118_SmallscaleFarmer.name: Small-scale Farmer
messages.occupations.B119_Lumberjack.description: You immediately get 1 <WOOD>. Additionally, place 1 <WOOD> on each of the next round spaces, up to the number of <FENCE> you built. At the start of these rounds, you get the <WOOD>.
messages.occupations.B119_Lumberjack.name: Lumberjack
messages.occupations.B120_Sweep.description: Each time before you use the action space above the most recent round 1-14 action space, you get 2 <CLAY>.
messages.occupations.B120_Sweep.name: Sweep
messages.occupations.B121_Geologist.description: Each time you use the __Forest__ or __Reed Bank__ accumulation space, you also get 1 <CLAY>. In games with 3 or more players, this also applies to the __Clay Pit__.
messages.occupations.B121_Geologist.name: Geologist
messages.occupations.B122_Mineralogist.descriptio: Each time you use a <CLAY>/<STONE> accumulation space, you also get 1 of the other good, <STONE>/<CLAY>.
messages.occupations.B122_Mineralogist.name: Mineralogist
messages.occupations.B123_RoofBallaster.descripti: When you play this card, you can immediately pay 1 <FOOD> to get 1 <STONE> for each room you have.
messages.occupations.B123_RoofBallaster.name: Roof Ballaster
messages.occupations.B124_Trimmer.description: In each work phase, after you enclose at least one farmyard space, you get 2 <STONE>. (Subdividing an existing pasture does not count.)
messages.occupations.B124_Trimmer.name: Trimmer
messages.occupations.B125_EstateWorker.descriptio: Place 1 <WOOD>, 1 <CLAY>, 1 <REED>, and 1 <STONE> in this order on the next 4 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the respective building resource.
messages.occupations.B125_EstateWorker.name: Estate Worker
messages.occupations.B126_Carpenter.description: Every new room only costs you 3 of the appropriate building resource and 2 <REED> (e.g. if you live in a wooden house, 3 <WOOD> and 2 <REED>).
messages.occupations.B126_Carpenter.name: Carpenter
messages.occupations.B127_Seducer.description: When you play this card in round 5 or later, you can immediately pay 1 <STONE>, 1 <GRAIN>, 1 <VEGETABLE>, and 1 <SHEEP> to take a __Family Growth Even without Room__ action.
messages.occupations.B127_Seducer.name: Seducer
messages.occupations.B128_Plumber.description: Each time after you use the __Major Improvement__ action space, you can take a __Renovation__ action, paying 2 <CLAY> or 2 <STONE> less for the renovation.
messages.occupations.B128_Plumber.name: Plumber
messages.occupations.B129_Seatmate.description: You can use the action space on round space 13 even if it is occupied by one or more people of the players to your immediate left and right.
messages.occupations.B129_Seatmate.name: Seatmate
messages.occupations.B130_FullPeasant.description: Each time after you use the __Grain Utilization__ or __Fencing__ action space while the other is unoccupied, you can pay 1 <FOOD> to use the other space with the same person.
messages.occupations.B130_FullPeasant.name: Full Peasant
messages.occupations.B131_Equipper.description: Immediately after each time you use a <WOOD> accumulation space, you can play a minor improvement.
messages.occupations.B131_Equipper.name: Equipper
messages.occupations.B132_EstateMaster.descriptio: Once you have no unused farmyard spaces left, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> for each <VEGETABLE> that you harvest.
messages.occupations.B132_EstateMaster.name: Estate Master
messages.occupations.B133_VillagePeasant.descript: At the start of scoring, you get a number of <VEGETABLE> equal to the smallest of the numbers of major improvements, minor improvements, and occupations you have.
messages.occupations.B133_VillagePeasant.name: Village Peasant
messages.occupations.B134_HousebookMaster.descrip: After playing this card, if you renovate to <STONE> in round 13/12/11 or before, you immediately get 1/2/3 <FOOD> and 1/2/3 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.occupations.B134_HousebookMaster.name: Housebook Master
messages.occupations.B135_NutritionExpert.descrip: At the start of each round, you can exchange a set comprised of 1 animal of any type, 1 <GRAIN>, and 1 <VEGETABLE> for 5 <FOOD> and 2 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.occupations.B135_NutritionExpert.name: Nutrition Expert
messages.occupations.B136_HouseSteward.descriptio: If there are still 1/3/6/9 complete rounds left to play, you immediately get 1/2/3/4 <WOOD>. During scoring, each player with the most rooms gets 3 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.occupations.B136_HouseSteward.name: House Steward
messages.occupations.B137_Wholesaler.description: Place 1 <VEGETABLE>, 1 <PIG>, 1 <STONE>, and 1 <CATTLE> on this card. Each time you use an action space card on round spaces 8 to 11, you get the corresponding good from this card.
messages.occupations.B137_Wholesaler.name: Wholesaler
messages.occupations.B138_ForestGuardian.descript: When you play this card, you immediately get 2 <WOOD>. Each time before another player takes at least 5 <WOOD> from an accumulation space, they must first pay you 1 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.B138_ForestGuardian.name: Forest Guardian
messages.occupations.B139_ForestScientist.descrip: In the returning home phase of each round, if there is no <WOOD> left on the game board, you get 1 <FOOD>—from round 5 on, even 2 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.B139_ForestScientist.name: Forest Scientist
messages.occupations.B140_FarmyardWorker.descript: At the end of each work phase in which you placed at least 1 good on 1 of your farmyard spaces, you get 2 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.B140_FarmyardWorker.name: Farmyard Worker
messages.occupations.B141_FieldCaretaker.descript: When you play this card, you can immediately exchange 0/1/3 <CLAY> for 1/2/3 <GRAIN>. This card is a <FIELD>.
messages.occupations.B141_FieldCaretaker.name: Field Caretaker
messages.occupations.B142_Greengrocer.description: Each time you use the __Grain Seeds__ action space, you also get 1 <VEGETABLE>.
messages.occupations.B142_Greengrocer.name: Greengrocer
messages.occupations.B143_ClayWarden.description: Each time another player uses the __Hollow__ accumulation space, you get 1 <CLAY>. In a 3-/4-player game, you also get 1 additional <CLAY>/<FOOD>.
messages.occupations.B143_ClayWarden.name: Clay Warden
messages.occupations.B144_Collier.description: Each time after you use the __Clay Pit__ or __Hollow__ accumulation space, you get 1 <WOOD>. On __Clay Pit__ you also get 1 additional <REED>.
messages.occupations.B144_Collier.name: Collier
messages.occupations.B145_BrushwoodCollector.desc: Each time you renovate or build a room, you can replace the required 1 or 2 <REED> with a total of 1 <WOOD>.
messages.occupations.B145_BrushwoodCollector.name: Brushwood Collector
messages.occupations.B146_Illusionist.description: Each time you use a building resource accumulation space, you can discard exactly 1 card from your hand to get 1 additional building resource of the accumulating type.
messages.occupations.B146_Illusionist.name: Illusionist
messages.occupations.B147_Huntsman.description: Each time after you use a <WOOD> accumulation space, you can pay 1 <GRAIN> to get 1 <PIG>.
messages.occupations.B147_Huntsman.name: Huntsman
messages.occupations.B148_PetBroker.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <SHEEP>. You can keep 1 <SHEEP> on this card for each occupation in front of you.
messages.occupations.B148_PetBroker.name: Pet Broker
messages.occupations.B149_OpenAirFarmer.descripti: When you play this card, you remove exactly 3 <STABLE> in your supply from play to build a pasture covering 2 farmyard spaces. You only need to pay a total of 2 <WOOD> for fences
messages.occupations.B149_OpenAirFarmer.name: Open Air Farmer
messages.occupations.B150_LargeScaleFarmer.descri: Each time after you use the __Farm Expansion__ or __Major Improvement__ action space while the other is unoccupied, you can pay 1 <FOOD> to use that other space with the same person.
messages.occupations.B150_LargeScaleFarmer.name: Large-Scale Farmer
messages.occupations.B151_LittlePeasant.descripti: You immediately get 1 <STONE>. As long as you live in a wooden house with exactly 2 rooms, actions spaces—excluding Meeting Place—are not considered occupied for you.
messages.occupations.B151_LittlePeasant.name: Little Peasant
messages.occupations.B152_JuniorArtist.descriptio: Each time after you use the __Day Laborer__ action space, you can pay 1 <FOOD> to use an unoccupied __Traveling Players__ or __Lessons__ action space with the same person.
messages.occupations.B152_JuniorArtist.name: Junior Artist
messages.occupations.B153_Housemaster.description: During scoring, total the base point values of your major improvements. The smallest value counts double. If the total is at least 5/7/9/11, you get 1/2/3/4 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.occupations.B153_Housemaster.name: Housemaster
messages.occupations.B154_SheepKeeper.description: You can only play this card if you have less than 7 <SHEEP>. Once this game, when you have 7 <SHEEP> on your farm, you immediately get 3 bonus points and 2 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.B154_SheepKeeper.name: Sheep Keeper
messages.occupations.B155_ArtTeacher.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <WOOD> and 1 <REED>. Each time you pay an occupation cost, you can use <FOOD> from the __Traveling Players__ accumulation space.
messages.occupations.B155_ArtTeacher.name: Art Teacher
messages.occupations.B156_StorehouseKeeper.descri: Each time you use the __Resource Market__ action space, you also get your choice of 1 <CLAY> or 1 <GRAIN>.
messages.occupations.B156_StorehouseKeeper.name: Storehouse Keeper
messages.occupations.B157_Salter.description: At any time, you can pay 1 <SHEEP>/<PIG>/<CATTLE> from your farm. If you do, place 1 <FOOD> on each of the next 3/5/7 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.B157_Salter.name: Salter
messages.occupations.B158_DistrictManager.descrip: At the end of each work phase, if you used both the __Forest__ and __Grove__ accumulation spaces, you get 5 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.B158_DistrictManager.name: District Manager
messages.occupations.B159_LieutenantGeneral.descr: For each <FIELD> tile that another player places next to an existing <FIELD> tile, you get 1 <FOOD> from the general supply. In round 14, you get 1 <GRAIN> instead.
messages.occupations.B159_LieutenantGeneral.name: Lieutenant General
messages.occupations.B160_PubOwner.description: When you play this card and at the end of each work phase in which the __Forest__, __Clay Pit__, and __Reed Bank__ accumulation spaces are all occupied, you get 1 <GRAIN>.
messages.occupations.B160_PubOwner.name: Pub Owner
messages.occupations.B161_Weakling.description: Each time it is your turn in the work phase, if there are one or more accumulation spaces with 5+ goods on them and you do not use any of them, you get 1 <VEGETABLE>.
messages.occupations.B161_Weakling.name: Weakling
messages.occupations.B162_ForestClearer.descripti: Each time you obtain exactly 2/3/4 <WOOD> from a <WOOD> accumulation space, you get 1 additional <WOOD> and 1/0/1 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.B162_ForestClearer.name: Forest Clearer
messages.occupations.B163_Pastor.description: Once you are the only player to live in a house with only 2 rooms, you immediately get 3 <WOOD>, 2 <CLAY>, 1 <REED>, and 1 <STONE> (only once).
messages.occupations.B163_Pastor.name: Pastor
messages.occupations.B164_SheepWhisperer.descript: Add 2, 5, 8, and 10 to the current round and place 1 <SHEEP> on each corresponding round space. At the start of these rounds, you get the <SHEEP>.
messages.occupations.B164_SheepWhisperer.name: Sheep Whisperer
messages.occupations.B165_GameProvider.descriptio: Immediately before each harvest, you can discard 1/3/4 <GRAIN> from different fields to get 1/2/3 <PIG>.
messages.occupations.B165_GameProvider.name: Game Provider
messages.occupations.B166_CattleFeeder.descriptio: Each time you use the __Grain Seeds__ action space, you can also buy 1 <CATTLE> for 1 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.B166_CattleFeeder.name: Cattle Feeder
messages.occupations.B167_StableSergeant.descript: When you play this card, you can pay 2 <FOOD> to get 1 <SHEEP>, 1 <PIG>, and 1 <CATTLE>, but only if you can accommodate all three animals on your farm.
messages.occupations.B167_StableSergeant.name: Stable Sergeant
messages.occupations.B168_PastureMaster.descripti: Each time you renovate, you get 2 <FOOD> and 1 additional animal of the respective type in each of your pastures with <STABLE>.
messages.occupations.B168_PastureMaster.name: Pasture Master
messages.occupations.B169_LivestockSustainer.desc: For each major improvement built by the other players, you can keep 1 animal on this card (max. 8). You can keep different types here.
messages.occupations.B169_LivestockSustainer.name: Livestock Sustainer
messages.occupations.B170_CorralBuilder.descripti: When the __Pig Market__ and __Cattle Market__ action space cards are each revealed (and placed on the round space), you can immediately <FENCE> exactly 1 farmyard space without playing <WOOD>.
messages.occupations.B170_CorralBuilder.name: Corral Builder
messages.occupations.B171_GreenhouseBuilder.descr: This is an action space for you only. It provides a choice of __Fencing__, __House Redevelopment__, or __Vegetable Seeds__ if the corresponding action space is already in play.
messages.occupations.B171_GreenhouseBuilder.name: Greenhouse Builder
messages.occupations.B172_CattleCaregiver.descrip: At the start of each round, if 3/4/5+ players each have at least 1 <CATTLE>, you get 1/2/3 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.B172_CattleCaregiver.name: Cattle Caregiver
messages.occupations.B173_Sweeper.description: Each time you use an action space with the (meeple) symbol, place 1 <FOOD> on this card. Once this game, you can turn this card face down to get the <FOOD> on it.
messages.occupations.B173_Sweeper.name: Sweeper
messages.occupations.B174_RiverbankGardener.descr: Each time you use the __Riverbank Forest__ accumulation space, you also get 1 <VEGETABLE>.
messages.occupations.B174_RiverbankGardener.name: Riverbank Gardener
messages.occupations.B175_FieldOverseer.descripti: Each time the other players harvest <GRAIN> from at least 3/4/6 <FIELD> combined, you get 1 <FOOD>/<GRAIN>/<VEGETABLE>.
messages.occupations.B175_FieldOverseer.name: Field Overseer
messages.occupations.B176_VillageIdiot.descriptio: The Village Idiot is your lone occupation. Each time another player uses the __Meeting Place__ action space, you get 1 <WOOD> and 1 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.B176_VillageIdiot.name: Village Idiot
messages.occupations.B177_StoneClawer.description: Each time you plow at least 1 <FIELD>, you also get 1 <STONE>.
messages.occupations.B177_StoneClawer.name: Stone Clawer
messages.occupations.B178_TagAlong.description: Immediately after each time another player uses the __Resource Market__ action space, you can also place a person there to take the action as well.
messages.occupations.B178_TagAlong.name: Tag-Along
messages.occupations.B179_WildBoarHunter.descript: In the returning home phase of each round, if at least 3 <WOOD> accumulation spaces are occupied, you can pay 1 <WOOD> to get 1 <PIG>.
messages.occupations.B179_WildBoarHunter.name: Wild Boar Hunter
messages.occupations.B180_GameTeaser.description: Each time you take 1/2/3 <FOOD> from a <FOOD> accumulation space, you also get 1 <CATTLE>/<PIG>/<SHEEP>.
messages.occupations.B180_GameTeaser.name: Game Teaser
messages.occupations.C085_DenBuilder.description: When you live in a clay or stone house, you can pay 1 <GRAIN> and 2 <FOOD>. If you do, for the rest of the game, this card provides room for exactly one person.
messages.occupations.C085_DenBuilder.name: Den Builder
messages.occupations.C086_LivestockFeeder.descrip: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <GRAIN>. This card can hold 1 animal of any type for each <GRAIN> in your supply.
messages.occupations.C086_LivestockFeeder.name: Livestock Feeder
messages.occupations.C087_Mason.description: Place a stone room on this card. Once you have a stone house with at least 4 rooms, at any time, you can add that room without paying any building resources.
messages.occupations.C087_Mason.name: Mason
messages.occupations.C088_CarpentersApprentice.de: Wood rooms cost you 2 <WOOD> less. Your 3rd and 4th stable each cost you 1 <WOOD> less. Your 13th to 15th fence each cost you nothing.
messages.occupations.C089_StableMaster.descriptio: When you play this card, you can immediately build exactly 1 <STABLE> for 1 <WOOD>. Exactly one of your unfenced <STABLE> can hold up to 3 animals of one type.
messages.occupations.C089_StableMaster.name: Stable Master
messages.occupations.C090_FieldWatchman.descripti: Each time you use the __Grain Seeds__ action space, you can also plow 1 <FIELD>.
messages.occupations.C090_FieldWatchman.name: Field Watchman
messages.occupations.C091_PlowHero.description: Each time you use the __Farmland__ or __Cultivation__ action space with the first person you place in a round, you can plow 1 additional <FIELD> for 1 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.C091_PlowHero.name: Plow Hero
messages.occupations.C092_AutumnMother.descriptio: Immediately before each harvest, if you have room in your house, you can take a __Family Growth__ action for 3 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.C092_AutumnMother.name: Autumn Mother
Each time you use the __Forest__ or __Clay Pit__ accumulation space, you can place 1 <STONE> from the general supply on the other space. If you do, you can immediately place another person.
messages.occupations.C094_StableCleaner.descripti: At any time, you can take the __Build Stables__ action without placing a person. If you do, each <STABLE> costs you 1 <WOOD> and 1 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.C094_StableCleaner.name: Stable Cleaner
messages.occupations.C095_BasketWeaver.descriptio: When you play this card, immediately build the __Basketmaker's Workshop__ major improvement for 1 <STONE> and 1 <REED>.
messages.occupations.C095_BasketWeaver.name: Basket Weaver
messages.occupations.C096_Merchant.description: Immediately after each time you take a __Major or Minor Improvement__ or __Minor Improvement__ action, you can pay 1 <FOOD> to take the action a second time.
messages.occupations.C096_Merchant.name: Merchant
messages.occupations.C097_SeedResearcher.descript: Each time any people return from both the __Grain Seeds__ and __Vegetable Seeds__ action spaces, you get 2 <FOOD> and you can play 1 occupation, without paying an occupation cost.
messages.occupations.C097_SeedResearcher.name: Seed Researcher
messages.occupations.C098_CubeCutter.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <WOOD>. In the field phase of each harvest, you can use this card to exchange exactly 1 <WOOD> and 1 <FOOD> for 1 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.occupations.C098_CubeCutter.name: Cube Cutter
messages.occupations.C099_GardenDesigner.descript: At the start of scoring, you can place <FOOD> in empty fields. You get 1/2/3 bonus <SCORE> for each field in which you place 1/4/7 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.C099_GardenDesigner.name: Garden Designer
messages.occupations.C100_Butler.description: If you play this card in round 11 or before, during scoring, you get 4 bonus <SCORE> if you then have more rooms than people.
messages.occupations.C100_Butler.name: Butler
messages.occupations.C101_StallHolder.description: Once per round, if you have 0/1/2/3/4 unfenced <STABLE> on your farm, you can exchange 2 <GRAIN> for 1 bonus <SCORE> and 1/2/3/4/5 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.C101_StallHolder.name: Stall Holder
messages.occupations.C102_TreeGuard.description: Each time after you use a <WOOD> accumulation space, you can place 4 <WOOD> from your supply on that space to get 2 <STONE>, 1 <CLAY>, 1 <REED>, and 1 <GRAIN>.
messages.occupations.C102_TreeGuard.name: Tree Guard
messages.occupations.C103_GreenGrocer.description: At the start of each round, you can make exactly one of the following exchanges: 1 <CATTLE> <ARROW> 1 <VEGETABLE>; 1 <VEGETABLE> <ARROW> 1 <CATTLE>; 2 <SHEEP> <ARROW> 1 <VEGETABLE>; 1 <VEGETABLE> <ARROW> 2 <SHEEP>; 2 <FOOD> <ARROW> 1 <GRAIN>; 1 <GRAIN> <ARROW> 2 <FOOD>
messages.occupations.C103_GreenGrocer.name: Green Grocer
messages.occupations.C104_Collector.description: This card is an action space for you only. When you use it for the 1st/2nd/3rd/4th time, you get 1 <BEGGING> marker and 6/7/8/9 different good of your choice.
messages.occupations.C104_Collector.name: Collector
messages.occupations.C105_BasketCarrier.descripti: Once each harvest, you can buy 1 <WOOD>, 1 <REED>, and 1 <GRAIN> for 2 <FOOD> total.
messages.occupations.C105_BasketCarrier.name: Basket Carrier
messages.occupations.C106_PotatoHarvester.descrip: When you play this card, you immediately get 3 <FOOD>. For each <VEGETABLE> you get from your <FIELD> during the field phase of the harvest, you get 1 additional <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.C106_PotatoHarvester.name: Potato Harvester
messages.occupations.C107_Baker.description: When you play this card and at the start of each feeding phase, you can take a __Bake Bread__ action.
messages.occupations.C107_Baker.name: Baker
messages.occupations.C108_Layabout.description: When you play this card, you must skip the next harvest. (You also do not have to feed your family that harvest.)
messages.occupations.C108_Layabout.name: Layabout
messages.occupations.C109_SchnappsDistiller.descr: In the feeding phase of each harvest, you can use this card to turn exactly 1 <VEGETABLE> into 5 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.C109_SchnappsDistiller.name: Schnapps Distiller
messages.occupations.C110_HomeBrewer.description: After the field phase of each harvest, you can use this card to turn exactly 1 <GRAIN> into your choice of 3 <FOOD> or 1 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.occupations.C110_HomeBrewer.name: Home Brewer
messages.occupations.C111_SmallAnimalBreeder.desc: Before the start of each round, if you have <FOOD> equal to or higher than the upcoming round number (e.g., 8+ <FOOD> before round 8), you get 1 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.C111_SmallAnimalBreeder.name: Small Animal Breeder
messages.occupations.C112_Thresher.description: Immediately before each time you use the __Grain Utilization__, __Farmland__, or __Cultivation__ action space, you can buy 1 <GRAIN> for 1 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.C112_Thresher.name: Thresher
messages.occupations.C113_WinterCaretaker.descrip: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <GRAIN>. At the end of each harvest, you can buy exactly 1 <VEGETABLE> for 2 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.C113_WinterCaretaker.name: Winter Caretaker
messages.occupations.C114_SoilScientist.descripti: Each time after you use a <CLAY>/<STONE> accumulation space, you can place 1 <STONE>/2 <CLAY> from your supply on the space to get 2 <GRAIN>/1 <VEGETABLE>, respectively.
messages.occupations.C114_SoilScientist.name: Soil Scientist
messages.occupations.C115_Sower.description: Each time you build a major improvement, place 1 <REED> from the general supply on this card. At any time, you can move the <REED> to your supply or exchange it for a __Sow__ action.
messages.occupations.C115_Sower.name: Sower
messages.occupations.C116_FurnitureMaker.descript: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <WOOD>. Each time you play an occupation after this one, you get 1 <WOOD> for each <FOOD> paid as occupation cost.
messages.occupations.C116_FurnitureMaker.name: Furniture Maker
messages.occupations.C117_Legworker.description: Each time you use an action space that is orthogonally adjacent to another action space occupied by one of your people, you get 1 <WOOD>.
messages.occupations.C117_Legworker.name: Legworker
messages.occupations.C118_WoodCollector.descripti: Place 1 <WOOD> on each of the next 5 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <WOOD>.
messages.occupations.C118_WoodCollector.name: Wood Collector
messages.occupations.C119_SkillfulRenovator.descr: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <WOOD> and 1 <CLAY>. Each time after you renovate, you get a number of <WOOD> equal to the number of people you placed that round.
messages.occupations.C119_SkillfulRenovator.name: Skillful Renovator
messages.occupations.C120_AgriculturalLabourer.de: Place 8 <CLAY> on this card. For each <GRAIN> you obtain, you also get 1 <CLAY> from this card.
messages.occupations.C121_ClayKneader.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <WOOD> and 2 <CLAY>. Each time after you use __Grain Seeds__ or __Vegetable Seeds__ action space, you get 1 <CLAY>.
messages.occupations.C121_ClayKneader.name: Clay Kneader
messages.occupations.C122_Bricklayer.description: Each improvement and each renovation cost you 1 <CLAY> less. Each room costs you 2 <CLAY> less.
messages.occupations.C122_Bricklayer.name: Bricklayer
messages.occupations.C123_Freemason.description: As long as you live in a <CLAY>/<STONE> house with exactly 2 rooms, at the start of each work phase, you get 2 <CLAY>/<STONE>.
messages.occupations.C123_Freemason.name: Freemason
messages.occupations.C124_StoneImporter.descripti: In the breeding phase of the 1st/2nd/3rd/4th/5th/6th harvest, you can use this card to buy exactly 2 <STONE> for 2/2/3/3/4/1 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.C124_StoneImporter.name: Stone Importer
messages.occupations.C125_Nightworker.description: Before the start of each work phase, you can place a person on an accumulation space of a building resource not in your supply. (Then proceed with the start player.)
messages.occupations.C125_Nightworker.name: Nightworker
messages.occupations.C126_Excavator.description: Each time after you use the __Day Laborer__ action space, you get 1 additional <WOOD> and <CLAY>, and you can buy 1 <STONE> for 1 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.C126_Excavator.name: Excavator
messages.occupations.C127_Lover.description: When you play this card, immediately pay an amount of <FOOD> equal to the number of complete rounds left to play to take a __Family Growth Even without Room__ action.
messages.occupations.C127_Lover.name: Lover
messages.occupations.C128_WoodenHutExtender.descr: Wood rooms now cost you 1 <REED>, and additionally 5 <WOOD> through round 5, 4 <WOOD> in rounds 6 and 7, and 3 <WOOD> in round 8 and later.
messages.occupations.C128_WoodenHutExtender.name: Wooden Hut Extender
messages.occupations.C129_SecondSpouse.descriptio: You can use the __Urgent Wish for Children__ action space (from round 12-13) even if it is occupied by the first person another player placed.
messages.occupations.C129_SecondSpouse.name: Second Spouse
messages.occupations.C130_OutskirtsDirector.descr: Each time you use the __Grove__ or __Hollow__ accumulation space, you can place 2 <REED> from the general supply on the other space. If you do, you can immediately place another person.
messages.occupations.C130_OutskirtsDirector.name: Outskirts Director
messages.occupations.C131_PrivateTeacher.descript: Each time you use the __Grain Seeds__ action space when any __Lessons__ action space is occupied, you can also play an occupation for an occupation cost of 1 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.C131_PrivateTeacher.name: Private Teacher
messages.occupations.C132_TimberShingleMaker.desc: When you renovate to <STONE>, you can place up to 1 <WOOD> from your supply in each of your rooms. During scoring, each such <WOOD> is worth 1 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.occupations.C132_TimberShingleMaker.name: Timber Shingle Maker
messages.occupations.C133_Soldier.description: During scoring, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> for each <STONE> + <WOOD> pair in your supply. You cannot score additional points for the resources scored with this card.
messages.occupations.C133_Soldier.name: Soldier
messages.occupations.C134_CowPrince.description: During scoring, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> for each space in your farmyard (including rooms) holding at least 1 <CATTLE>.
messages.occupations.C134_CowPrince.name: Cow Prince
messages.occupations.C135_Constable.description: If there are still 1/3/6/9 complete rounds left to play, you immediately get 1/2/3/4 <WOOD>. During scoring, each player with no negative points in any scoring line gets 3 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.occupations.C135_Constable.name: Constable
messages.occupations.C136_RanchProvost.descriptio: If there are still 3/6/9 complete rounds left to play, you immediately get 2/3/4 <WOOD>. During scoring, each player with a pasture of highest capacity gets 3 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.occupations.C136_RanchProvost.name: Ranch Provost
messages.occupations.C137_CharcoalBurner.descript: Each time any player (including you) plays or builds a <BAKE>-improvement, you get 1 <WOOD> and 1 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.C137_CharcoalBurner.name: Charcoal Burner
messages.occupations.C138_AnimalFeeder.descriptio: On the __Day Laborer__ action space, you also get your choice of 1 <SHEEP> or 1 <GRAIN>. Instead of that good, you can buy 1 <PIG> for 1 <FOOD> or 1 <CATTLE> for 2 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.C138_AnimalFeeder.name: Animal Feeder
messages.occupations.C139_BasketmakersWife.descri: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <REED> and 1 <FOOD>. At any time, you can turn 1 <REED> into 2 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.C139_BasketmakersWife.name: Basketmaker's Wife
messages.occupations.C140_PackagingArtist.descrip: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <GRAIN>. Each time you get a __Minor Improvement__ action, you can take a __Bake Bread__ action instead.
messages.occupations.C140_PackagingArtist.name: Packaging Artist
messages.occupations.C141_SheepProvider.descripti: Each time any player (including you) uses the __Sheep Market__ accumulation space, you get 1 <GRAIN>.
messages.occupations.C141_SheepProvider.name: Sheep Provider
messages.occupations.C142_MarketCrier.description: Each time you use the __Grain Seeds__ action space, you can get an additional 1 <GRAIN> and 1 <VEGETABLE>. If you do, each other player gets 1 <GRAIN>.
messages.occupations.C142_MarketCrier.name: Market Crier
messages.occupations.C143_StoneBuyer.description: When you play this card, you can immediately buy exactly 2 <STONE> for 1 <FOOD>. From the next round on, once per round, you can buy 1 <STONE> for 2 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.C143_StoneBuyer.name: Stone Buyer
messages.occupations.C144_ReedRoofRenovator.descr: Each time another player renovates, you immediately get 1 <REED> from the general supply. When you play this card in a 3-player game, you immediately get 1 <REED>.
messages.occupations.C144_ReedRoofRenovator.name: Reed Roof Renovator
messages.occupations.C145_ForestReviewer.descript: Each time after any player (including you) uses the unoccupied __Grove__ or __Forest__ accumulation space while the other of the two is occupied, you get 1 <REED>.
messages.occupations.C145_ForestReviewer.name: Forest Reviewer
messages.occupations.C146_WorkshopAssistant.descr: Place unique pairs of different building resources on this card, one for each improvement you have built. Each time another player renovates, you may move one such pair to your supply.
messages.occupations.C146_WorkshopAssistant.name: Workshop Assistant
messages.occupations.C147_Cowherd.description: Each time you use the __Cattle Market__ accumulation space, you get 1 additional <CATTLE>.
messages.occupations.C147_Cowherd.name: Cowherd
messages.occupations.C148_MudWallower.description: Every fourth time you use an accumulation space, you get 1 <PIG>, held by this card.
messages.occupations.C148_MudWallower.name: Mud Wallower
messages.occupations.C149_ResourceRecycler.descri: Each time another player renovates to <STONE>, if you live in a clay house, you can pay 2 <FOOD> to build a clay room at no additional cost.
messages.occupations.C149_ResourceRecycler.name: Resource Recycler
messages.occupations.C150_ParrotBreeder.descripti: On your turn, if you pay 1 <GRAIN> to the general supply, you can use the same action space (unless it is the __Meeting Place__ action space) that the player to your right has just used on their turn (not retroactive).
messages.occupations.C150_ParrotBreeder.name: Parrot Breeder
messages.occupations.C151_SowingDirector.descript: Each time after another player uses the __Grain Utilization__ action space, you get a __Sow__ action.
messages.occupations.C151_SowingDirector.name: Sowing Director
messages.occupations.C152_Puppeteer.description: Each time another player uses the __Traveling Players__ accumulation space, you can pay them 1 <FOOD> to immediately play an occupation without paying an occupation cost.
messages.occupations.C152_Puppeteer.name: Puppeteer
messages.occupations.C153_PatternMaker.descriptio: Each time another player renovates, you can exchange exactly 2 <WOOD> for 1 <GRAIN>, 1 <FOOD>, and 1 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.occupations.C153_PatternMaker.name: Pattern Maker
messages.occupations.C154_TwinResearcher.descript: Each time you use one of the two accumulation spaces for the same type of good containing exactly the same number of goods, you can also buy 1 bonus <SCORE> for 1 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.C154_TwinResearcher.name: Twin Researcher
messages.occupations.C155_FoodDistributor.descrip: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <GRAIN> and, at the start of this returning home phase, an amount of <FOOD> equal to the number of occupied Round 1-14 action spaces.
messages.occupations.C155_FoodDistributor.name: Food Distributor
messages.occupations.C156_HoofCaregiver.descripti: Immediately add 1 <CATTLE> from the general supply to the __Cattle Market__ accumulation space. Afterward, for each cattle on __Cattle Market__, you get 1 <GRAIN> plus 1 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.C156_HoofCaregiver.name: Hoof Caregiver
messages.occupations.C157_ResourceAnalyzer.descri: Before the start of each round, if you have more building resources than all other players of at least two types, you get 1 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.C157_ResourceAnalyzer.name: Resource Analyzer
messages.occupations.C158_ForestCampaigner.descri: Each time before you place a person, if there are at least 8 <WOOD> total on accumulation spaces, you get 1 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.C158_ForestCampaigner.name: Forest Campaigner
messages.occupations.C159_FishermansFriend.descri: At the start of each round, if there is more <FOOD> on the __Traveling Players__ than on the __Fishing__ accumulation space, you get the difference from the general supply.
messages.occupations.C159_FishermansFriend.name: Fisherman's Friend
messages.occupations.C160_Outrider.description: Each time before you use the action space on the most recently revealed action space card (after it has been placed on the round space), you get 1 <GRAIN>.
messages.occupations.C160_Outrider.name: Outrider
messages.occupations.C161_PotatoDigger.descriptio: When you play this card, if you have at least 2/4/5 unplanted <FIELD> tiles, you immediately get 1/2/3 <VEGETABLE>.
messages.occupations.C161_PotatoDigger.name: Potato Digger
messages.occupations.C162_ForestOwner.description: This card is an action space for all. If another player uses it, they get 3 <WOOD> and must give you 1 <WOOD> from the general supply. If you use it, you get 4 <WOOD>.
messages.occupations.C162_ForestOwner.name: Forest Owner
messages.occupations.C163_MaterialDeliveryman.des: Each time any player (including you) takes 5/6/7/8+ goods from an accumulation space, you get 1 <WOOD>/<CLAY>/<REED>/<STONE> from the general supply.
messages.occupations.C164_GermanHeathKeeper.descr: Each time any player (including you) uses the __Pig Market__ accumulation space, you get 1 <SHEEP> from the general supply.
messages.occupations.C164_GermanHeathKeeper.name: German Heath Keeper
messages.occupations.C165_GameCatcher.description: When you play this card, pay 1 <FOOD> for each remaining harvest to immediately get 1 <CATTLE> and 1 <PIG>.
messages.occupations.C165_GameCatcher.name: Game Catcher
messages.occupations.C166_CattleWhisperer.descrip: Add 5 and 8 to the current round and place 1 <CATTLE> on each corresponding round space. At the start of these rounds, you get the <CATTLE>.
messages.occupations.C166_CattleWhisperer.name: Cattle Whisperer
messages.occupations.C167_CattleBuyer.description: Each time another player uses the __Fencing__ action space, you can buy exactly 1 <SHEEP>/<PIG>/<CATTLE> from the general supply for 1/2/2 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.C167_CattleBuyer.name: Cattle Buyer
messages.occupations.C168_AnimalCatcher.descripti: Each time you use the __Day Laborer__ action space, instead of 2 <FOOD>, you can get 3 different animals from the general supply. If you do, you must pay 1 <FOOD> each harvest left to play.
messages.occupations.C168_AnimalCatcher.name: Animal Catcher
messages.occupations.C169_FastMason.description: Immediately after each time you use a <CLAY>/<STONE> accumulation space, you can renovate your house to <CLAY>/<STONE> without paying <REED>.
messages.occupations.C169_FastMason.name: Fast Mason
messages.occupations.C170_AmateurFencer.descripti: When you play this card, if you have no pastures yet, you can immediately <FENCE> exactly 1 space in your farmyard without paying <WOOD> for the <FENCE>.
messages.occupations.C170_AmateurFencer.name: Amateur Fencer
messages.occupations.C171_YoungArtist.description: In the returning home phase of each round, you can pay 1 <FOOD> to either take a __Minor Improvement__ action or to draw 2 new minor improvements.
messages.occupations.C171_YoungArtist.name: Young Artist
messages.occupations.C172_FieldCounter.descriptio: Each time another player plows a <FIELD>, place 1 <FOOD> on this card. Once this game, you can turn this card face down to get the <FOOD> on it.
messages.occupations.C172_FieldCounter.name: Field Counter
messages.occupations.C173_TopOuter.description: Each time the __House Building__ action space on the game board extension is used, you get all of the <FOOD> from the __Traveling Players__ accumulation space.
messages.occupations.C173_TopOuter.name: Top-Outer
messages.occupations.C174_StoneCustodian.descript: At the end of each work phase, if 1 <STONE> accumulation space has <STONE> left, you get 1 <GRAIN> If 2 <STONE> accumulation spaces have <STONE> left, you get 1 <VEGETABLE> instead.
messages.occupations.C174_StoneCustodian.name: Stone Custodian
messages.occupations.C175_VillageTeacher.descript: Immediately after each time you use a __Lessons__ action space, if this is the 1st/2nd/3rd occupied __Lessons__ action space that round, you get 1 <FOOD>/<GRAIN>/<VEGETABLE>.
messages.occupations.C175_VillageTeacher.name: Village Teacher
messages.occupations.C176_Cleanacre.description: Each time you use the __Farmland__, __Cultivation__, or __Farm Supplies__ action (the latter only being available with 6 players), you also get 2 <CLAY>.
messages.occupations.C176_Cleanacre.name: Cleanacre
messages.occupations.C177_MountainHiker.descripti: Immediately after each time you use an accumulation space on the game board extension, you can buy 1 <STONE> for 1 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.C177_MountainHiker.name: Mountain Hiker
messages.occupations.C178_OnSiteReverend.descript: At the start of each harvest, you get 1 building resource of your choice.
messages.occupations.C178_OnSiteReverend.name: On-Site Reverend
messages.occupations.C179_BovinePioneer.descripti: Each time you create at least one new pasture from unfenced farmyard spaces you get 1 <CATTLE>.
messages.occupations.C179_BovinePioneer.name: Bovine Pioneer
messages.occupations.C180_Trapper.description: Each time after you use a <WOOD> accumulation space, if this is the 2nd/3rd/4th occupied <WOOD> accumulation space that round, you can buy 1 <SHEEP>/<PIG>/<CATTLE> for 1 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.C180_Trapper.name: Trapper
messages.occupations.D085_Reader.description: As soon as you have 6 (7 in draft mode) occupations in front of you (including this one), this card provides room for one person.
messages.occupations.D085_Reader.name: Reader
messages.occupations.D085_Reader.rules: In simultaneous draft mode, the occupation threshold is fixed at 7, regardless of draft pool size.
messages.occupations.D086_SheepAgent.description: You can keep 1 <SHEEP> on this card for each occupation card in front of you (including this one), unless it is already able to hold animals.
messages.occupations.D086_SheepAgent.name: Sheep Agent
messages.occupations.D087_MasterBuilder.descripti: Once your house has at least 5 rooms, at any time, but only once this game, you can add another room at no cost.
messages.occupations.D087_MasterBuilder.name: Master Builder
messages.occupations.D088_Millwright.description: You immediately get 1 <GRAIN>. Each time you build <FENCE>, <STABLE>, and rooms, or renovate your house, you can replace up to 2 building resources of any type with 1 <GRAIN> each.
messages.occupations.D088_Millwright.name: Millwright
messages.occupations.D089_Stablehand.description: Each time you build at least 1 <FENCE>, you can also build a <STABLE> without paying <WOOD> for the <STABLE>.
messages.occupations.D089_Stablehand.name: Stablehand
messages.occupations.D090_PlowMaker.description: Each time you use the __Farmland__ or __Cultivation__ action space, you can pay 1 <FOOD> to plow 1 additional <FIELD>.
messages.occupations.D090_PlowMaker.name: Plow Maker
messages.occupations.D091_Plowman.description: Add 4, 7, and 10 to the current round and place a <FIELD> tile on each corresponding round space. At the start of these rounds, you can plow the <FIELD> for 1 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.D091_Plowman.name: Plowman
messages.occupations.D092_ChildOmbudsman.descript: From round 5 on, if you have room in your house, at the end of each person action, you can take a __Family Growth__ action with that person. If you do, you get 2 negative <SCORE>.
messages.occupations.D092_ChildOmbudsman.name: Child Ombudsman
messages.occupations.D093_SheepInspector.descript: Once per work phase, after you complete a person action, you can pay 1 <SHEEP> and 2 <FOOD> to return another person you placed home, unless it is on the __Meeting Place__ action space.
messages.occupations.D093_SheepInspector.name: Sheep Inspector
messages.occupations.D094_HenpeckedHusband.descri: Each time you take a __Build Rooms__ action with the second person you place, return the first person you placed home, unless it is on the __Meeting Place__ action space.
messages.occupations.D094_HenpeckedHusband.name: Henpecked Husband
messages.occupations.D095_SiteManager.description: When you play this card, immediately build a major improvement. When paying its cost, you can replace up to 1 building resource of each type with 1 <FOOD> each.
messages.occupations.D095_SiteManager.name: Site Manager
messages.occupations.D096_Furnisher.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 2 <WOOD>. Each time after you build at least one new room, you can build or play a number of improvements equal to the number of new rooms you built, paying up to 1 <WOOD> less for each such improvement.
messages.occupations.D096_Furnisher.name: Furnisher
messages.occupations.D097_BeggingStudent.descript: When you play this card, you must immediately take 1 <BEGGING> marker. At the start of each harvest, you can play 1 occupation without paying an occupation cost.
messages.occupations.D097_BeggingStudent.name: Begging Student
messages.occupations.D098_Transactor.description: Immediately before the final harvest at the end of round 14, you can take all the building resources that are left on the entire game board.
messages.occupations.D098_Transactor.name: Transactor
messages.occupations.D099_EarthenwarePotter.descr: If you play this card in round 4 or before, after the final harvest, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> for each person for which you then pay 1 <CLAY>.
messages.occupations.D099_EarthenwarePotter.name: Earthenware Potter
messages.occupations.D100_LordoftheManor.descript: During scoring, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> for each scoring category in which you score the maximum 4 points. (The bonus point is also awarded for 4 fenced stables.)
messages.occupations.D100_LordoftheManor.name: Lord of the Manor
messages.occupations.D101_SugarBaker.description: Each time after you use the __Grain Utilization__ action space, you can buy 1 bonus <SCORE> for 1 <FOOD>. Place the <FOOD> on the action space (for the next visitor).
messages.occupations.D101_SugarBaker.name: Sugar Baker
messages.occupations.D102_SampleStableMaker.descr: At the start of each returning home phase, you can return a built stable to your supply to get 1 <WOOD>, 1 <GRAIN>, 1 <FOOD>, and a __Minor Improvement__ action.
messages.occupations.D102_SampleStableMaker.name: Sample Stable Maker
messages.occupations.D103_CanalBoatman.descriptio: Each time you use __Fishing__ or __Reed Bank__, you can pay 1 <FOOD> to immediately place another person on this card. If you do, you get your choice of 3 <STONE> or 1 <GRAIN> plus 1 <VEGETABLE>.
messages.occupations.D103_CanalBoatman.name: Canal Boatman
messages.occupations.D104_Cultivator.description: For each new <FIELD> tile you get, you also get 1 <WOOD> and 1 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.D104_Cultivator.name: Cultivator
messages.occupations.D105_Sculptor.description: Each time you use a <CLAY> accumulation space, you also get 1 <FOOD>. Each time you use a <STONE> accumulation space, you also get 1 <GRAIN>.
messages.occupations.D105_Sculptor.name: Sculptor
messages.occupations.D106_WhiskyDistiller.descrip: At any time, you can pay 1 <GRAIN>. If you do, add 2 to the current round and place 4 <FOOD> on the corresponding round space. At the start of that round, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.D106_WhiskyDistiller.name: Whisky Distiller
messages.occupations.D107_Bellfounder.description: In the returning home phase of each round, if you have at least 1 <CLAY>, you can use this card to discard all of your <CLAY> and get your choice of 3 <FOOD> or 1 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.occupations.D107_Bellfounder.name: Bellfounder
messages.occupations.D108_StoneCarver.description: Each harvest, you can use this card to turn exactly 1 <STONE> into 3 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.D108_StoneCarver.name: Stone Carver
messages.occupations.D109_SowingMaster.descriptio: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <WOOD>. Each time after you use the __Grain Utilization__ or __Cultivation__ action space, you get 2 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.D109_SowingMaster.name: Sowing Master
messages.occupations.D110_FishFarmer.description: Each time there is 1/2/3+ <FOOD> on the __Fishing__ accumulation space, you get an additional 2 <FOOD> on the __Reed Bank__/ __Clay Pit__/ __Forest__ accumulation spaces.
messages.occupations.D110_FishFarmer.name: Fish Farmer
messages.occupations.D111_InteriorDecorator.descr: Each time you renovate, place 1 <FOOD> on each of the next 6 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.D111_InteriorDecorator.name: Interior Decorator
messages.occupations.D112_YoungFarmer.description: Each time you use the __Major Improvement__ action space, you also get 1 <GRAIN> and, afterward, you can take a __Sow__ action.
messages.occupations.D112_YoungFarmer.name: Young Farmer
messages.occupations.D113_FoodMerchant.descriptio: For each <GRAIN> you harvest from a <FIELD>, you can buy 1 <VEGETABLE> for 3 <FOOD>. If you harvest the last <GRAIN> from a <FIELD>, the <VEGETABLE> costs you only 2 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.D113_FoodMerchant.name: Food Merchant
messages.occupations.D114_SeedTrader.description: Place 2 <GRAIN> and 2 <VEGETABLE> on this card. You can buy them at any time. Each <GRAIN> costs 2 <FOOD>; each <VEGETABLE> costs 3 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.D114_SeedTrader.name: Seed Trader
messages.occupations.D115_FodderPlanter.descripti: In the breeding phase of each harvest, for each newborn animal you get, you can sow crops in exactly 1 field.
messages.occupations.D115_FodderPlanter.name: Fodder Planter
messages.occupations.D116_TreeInspector.descripti: This card is a 1 <WOOD> accumulation space for you only. Each time the newly revealed action space card is a __Quarry__ accumulation space, you must discard all <WOOD> from this card.
messages.occupations.D116_TreeInspector.name: Tree Inspector
messages.occupations.D117_WoodExpert.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 2 <WOOD>. Each improvement costs you up to 2 <WOOD> less, if you pay 1 <FOOD> instead.
messages.occupations.D117_WoodExpert.name: Wood Expert
messages.occupations.D118_Bonehead.description: When you play this card, immediately place 6 <WOOD> on it. Immediately after each time you play a card from your hand, including this one, you get 1 <WOOD> from this card.
messages.occupations.D118_Bonehead.name: Bonehead
messages.occupations.D119_WoodBarterer.descriptio: Each time before you use an action space with a __Build Fences__ or __Build Rooms__ action, you can choose to either get 2 <WOOD> or exchange up to 2 <WOOD> for 1 <REED> each.
messages.occupations.D119_WoodBarterer.name: Wood Barterer
messages.occupations.D120_ClayDeliveryman.descrip: Place 1 <CLAY> on each remaining space for rounds 6 to 14. At the start of these rounds, you get the <CLAY>.
messages.occupations.D120_ClayDeliveryman.name: Clay Deliveryman
messages.occupations.D121_ClayPlasterer.descripti: Renovating to <CLAY> only costs you exactly 1 <CLAY> and 1 <REED>. Each clay room only costs you 3 <CLAY> and 2 <REED> to build.
messages.occupations.D121_ClayPlasterer.name: Clay Plasterer
messages.occupations.D122_ClayCarrier.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 2 <CLAY>. At any time, but only once per round, you can buy 2 <CLAY> for 2 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.D122_ClayCarrier.name: Clay Carrier
messages.occupations.D123_RenovationPreparer.desc: For each new <WOOD>/clay room you build, you get 2 <CLAY>/2 <STONE>.
messages.occupations.D123_RenovationPreparer.name: Renovation Preparer
messages.occupations.D124_Emissary.description: At any time, you can place a good from your supply on this card to get 1 <STONE>. You must place different goods on this card. (<FOOD> is also considered a good.)
messages.occupations.D124_Emissary.name: Emissary
messages.occupations.D125_ForestTrader.descriptio: Each time you use a <WOOD> or <CLAY> accumulation space, you can also buy exactly 1 building resource. <WOOD>, <CLAY>, and <REED> cost 1 <FOOD> each; <STONE> costs 2 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.D125_ForestTrader.name: Forest Trader
messages.occupations.D126_FieldCultivator.descrip: Pile 1 <WOOD>, 1 <CLAY>, 1 <REED>, 1 <STONE>, 1 <REED>, 1 <CLAY>, and 1 <WOOD> on this card. Each time you harvest a field tile, you can also take the top good from the pile.
messages.occupations.D126_FieldCultivator.name: Field Cultivator
messages.occupations.D127_HardworkingMan.descript: This card is an action space for you only. If each other player has more rooms than you, it provides the __Day Laborer__, __Build Rooms__, and __Major Improvement__ actions (all three).
messages.occupations.D127_HardworkingMan.name: Hardworking Man
messages.occupations.D128_BuildingTycoon.descript: Each time after another player builds 1 or more rooms, you can give them 1 <FOOD> to build exactly 1 room yourself. (You must pay the building cost of the room.)
messages.occupations.D128_BuildingTycoon.name: Building Tycoon
messages.occupations.D129_LumberVirtuoso.descript: Each harvest in which you have at least 5 <WOOD> in your supply, you can discard down to 5 <WOOD> to take a __Build Stables__ or __Build Wood Rooms__ action by paying the usual costs.
messages.occupations.D129_LumberVirtuoso.name: Lumber Virtuoso
messages.occupations.D130_RecreationalCarpenter.d: At the end of each work phase in which you did not use the __Meeting Place__ action space, you can take a __Build Rooms__ action without placing a person.
messages.occupations.D131_CraftsmanshipPromoter.d: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <STONE>. You can build any of the major improvements in the bottom row of the supply board even when taking a __Minor Improvement__ action.
messages.occupations.D132_HideFarmer.description: During scoring, you can pay 1 <FOOD> each for any number of unused farmyard spaces. You do not lose points for these spaces.
messages.occupations.D132_HideFarmer.name: Hide Farmer
messages.occupations.D133_BeerTentOperator.descri: In the feeding phase of each harvest, you can use this card to turn 1 <WOOD> plus 1 <GRAIN> into 1 bonus <SCORE> and 2 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.D133_BeerTentOperator.name: Beer Tent Operator
messages.occupations.D134_OysterEater.description: Each time the __Fishing__ accumulation space is used, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> and must skip placing your next person that round. (You can place the person on a later turn.)
messages.occupations.D134_OysterEater.name: Oyster Eater
messages.occupations.D135_GardeningHeadOfficial.d: If there are still 3/6/9 complete rounds left to play, you immediately get 2/3/4 <WOOD>. During scoring, each player with the most <VEGETABLE> in their <FIELD> gets 2 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.occupations.D136_AnimalActivist.descript: If there are still 3/6/9 complete rounds left to play, you immediately get 2/3/4 <WOOD>. During scoring, each player with the most fenced <STABLE> gets 2 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.occupations.D136_AnimalActivist.name: Animal Activist
messages.occupations.D137_TradeTeacher.descriptio: Each time after you use a __Lessons__ action space, you can buy up to 2 different goods: <GRAIN>, <STONE>, <SHEEP>, and <PIG> for 1 <FOOD> each; <CATTLE> and <VEGETABLE> for 2 <FOOD> each.
messages.occupations.D137_TradeTeacher.name: Trade Teacher
messages.occupations.D138_PetLover.description: Each time you use an accumulation space providing exactly 1 animal, you can leave it on the space and get one from the general supply instead, as well as 3 <FOOD> and 1 <GRAIN>.
messages.occupations.D138_PetLover.name: Pet Lover
messages.occupations.D139_Chairman.description: Each time another player uses the __Meeting Place__ action space, both they and you get 1 <FOOD> (before taking the actions). If you use it, you get 1 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.D139_Chairman.name: Chairman
messages.occupations.D140_Loudmouth.description: Each time you take at least 4 building resources or 4 animals from an accumulation space, you also get 1 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.D140_Loudmouth.name: Loudmouth
messages.occupations.D141_SeedSeller.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <GRAIN>. Each time you use the __Grain Seeds__ action space, you get 1 additional <GRAIN>.
messages.occupations.D141_SeedSeller.name: Seed Seller
messages.occupations.D142_PotatoPlanter.descripti: At the end of each work phase in which you occupy the __Clay Pit__ or __Reed Bank__ accumulation space while the respective other is unoccupied, you get 1 <VEGETABLE>.
messages.occupations.D142_PotatoPlanter.name: Potato Planter
messages.occupations.D143_TreeCutter.description: Each time you use an accumulation space providing at least 3 goods of the same type except <WOOD>, you get an additional 1 <WOOD>. (<FOOD> is also considered a good.)
messages.occupations.D143_TreeCutter.name: Tree Cutter
messages.occupations.D144_WaterWorker.description: Each time after you use any of the __Fishing__, __Reed Bank__, __Day Laborer__ spaces or the action space of round 4, you get 1 additional <REED>.
messages.occupations.D144_WaterWorker.name: Water Worker
messages.occupations.D145_RoofExaminer.descriptio: When you play this card, if you have 1/2/3/4 major improvements, you immediately get 2/3/4/5 <REED>.
messages.occupations.D145_RoofExaminer.name: Roof Examiner
messages.occupations.D146_Porter.description: Each time you take at least 4 of the same building resource from an accumulation space, you get 1 additional building resource of the accumulating type and 1 <FOOD>
messages.occupations.D146_Porter.name: Porter
messages.occupations.D147_TrapBuilder.description: Each time you use the __Day Laborer__ action space, place 1 <FOOD>, 1 <FOOD>, and 1 <PIG> on the next 3 round spaces, respectively. At the start of these rounds, you get the good.
messages.occupations.D147_TrapBuilder.name: Trap Builder
messages.occupations.D148_DomesticianExpert.descr: You can keep 2 <SHEEP> on the border between each pair of orthogonally adjacent rooms.
messages.occupations.D148_DomesticianExpert.name: Domestician Expert
messages.occupations.D149_CasualWorker.descriptio: Each time another player uses a __Quarry__ accumulation space, you can choose to get 1 <FOOD> or build a <STABLE> without paying <WOOD>.
messages.occupations.D149_CasualWorker.name: Casual Worker
messages.occupations.D150_GodlySpouse.description: Each time you take a __Family Growth__ action with the second person you place in a round, return the first person you placed home, unless it is on the __Meeting Place__ action space.
messages.occupations.D150_GodlySpouse.name: Godly Spouse
messages.occupations.D151_SpinDoctor.description: Immediately after each time you use the __Traveling Players__ accumulation space, you can place another person on an action space of your choice, regardless whether or not the action space is occupied.
messages.occupations.D151_SpinDoctor.name: Spin Doctor
messages.occupations.D151_SpinDoctor.rules: No card, including this one, can allow you to use __Meeting Place__ if it is already occupied.
messages.occupations.D152_Patron.description: Immediately before each time you play an occupation after this one (even before paying the occupation cost), you get 2 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.D152_Patron.name: Patron
messages.occupations.D153_WealthyMan.description: At the start of each of the 1st/2nd/3rd/4th/5th/6th harvest, if you have at least 1/2/3/4/5/6 <GRAIN> <FIELD>, you get 1 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.occupations.D153_WealthyMan.name: Wealthy Man
messages.occupations.D154_ChimneySweep.descriptio: Renovating to <STONE> costs you 2 <STONE> less. During scoring, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> for each other player living in a stone house.
messages.occupations.D154_ChimneySweep.name: Chimney Sweep
messages.occupations.D155_Ebonist.description: Each harvest, you can use this card to turn exactly 1 <WOOD> into 1 <FOOD> and 1 <GRAIN>.
messages.occupations.D155_Ebonist.name: Ebonist
messages.occupations.D156_RetailDealer.descriptio: Place 3 <GRAIN> and 3 <FOOD> on this card. Each time you use the __Resource Market__ action space, you also get 1 <GRAIN> and 1 <FOOD> from this card.
messages.occupations.D156_RetailDealer.name: Retail Dealer
messages.occupations.D157_PartyOrganizer.descript: As soon as the next player but you gains their 5th person, you immediately get 8 <FOOD> (not retroactively). During scoring, if only you have 5 people, you get 3 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.occupations.D157_PartyOrganizer.name: Party Organizer
messages.occupations.D158_BeanCounter.description: Each time you use an action space on round spaces 1 to 8, place 1 <FOOD> on this card. Each time this cards has 3 <FOOD> on it, move the <FOOD> to your supply.
messages.occupations.D158_BeanCounter.name: Bean Counter
messages.occupations.D159_ReedSeller.description: At any time, you can turn 1 <REED> into 3 <FOOD>. Any other player can prevent this by buying the <REED> for 2 <FOOD> from you. If multiple players are interested, choose one.
messages.occupations.D159_ReedSeller.name: Reed Seller
messages.occupations.D160_Midwife.description: Each time another player uses the first person they place in a round to take a __Family Growth__ action, you get 1 <GRAIN> from the general supply.
messages.occupations.D160_Midwife.name: Midwife
messages.occupations.D161_CabbageBuyer.descriptio: Each time any player (including you) renovates and then builds no/1 minor/1 major improvement, you can buy 1 <VEGETABLE> for 3/2/1 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.D161_CabbageBuyer.name: Cabbage Buyer
messages.occupations.D162_ClayFirer.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 2 <CLAY>. At any time, you can turn <CLAY> into <STONE>: you get 1 <STONE> for 2 <CLAY>, and 2 <STONE> for 3 <CLAY>.
messages.occupations.D162_ClayFirer.name: Clay Firer
messages.occupations.D163_JourneymanBricklayer.de: When you play this card, you immediately get 2 <STONE>. Each time another player renovates to <STONE> or builds a stone room, you get 1 <STONE>.
messages.occupations.D164_PetGrower.description: Each time you use an animal accumulation space, if afterward you have no animal in your house, you also get 1 <SHEEP>.
messages.occupations.D164_PetGrower.name: Pet Grower
messages.occupations.D165_PigStalker.description: Each time you use an animal accumulation space, you get an additional 1 <PIG> if you occupy a Round 1-14 action space which is immediately to the left or right of that accumulation space.
messages.occupations.D165_PigStalker.name: Pig Stalker
messages.occupations.D166_StableMilker.descriptio: Each time you build at least 2 <STABLE> on the same turn, you also get 1 <CATTLE>.
messages.occupations.D166_StableMilker.name: Stable Milker
messages.occupations.D167_PureBreeder.description: You immediately get 1 <WOOD>. After each round that does not end with a harvest, you can breed exactly one type of animal. (This is not considered a breeding phase.)
messages.occupations.D167_PureBreeder.name: Pure Breeder
messages.occupations.D168_Stockman.description: When you build your 2nd/3rd/4th <STABLE>, you immediately get 1 <CATTLE>/<PIG>/<SHEEP>, even if built on the same turn (but not retroactively).
messages.occupations.D168_Stockman.name: Stockman
messages.occupations.D169_Plowsmith.description: Each time another player takes at least 4 <WOOD> from an accumulation space, you can immediately pay 1 <FOOD> to plow 1 <FIELD>.
messages.occupations.D169_Plowsmith.name: Plowsmith
messages.occupations.D170_FoldBuilder.description: This card is an action space for all. It provides a __Build Fences__ action and then 1 <SHEEP>. If another player uses it, they must first pay you 1 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.D170_FoldBuilder.name: Fold Builder
messages.occupations.D171_SeniorTeacher.descripti: Each time another player pays <FOOD> on a __Lessons__ action space, you get exactly 1 of that <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.D171_SeniorTeacher.name: Senior Teacher
messages.occupations.D172_PutcherMaker.descriptio: At any time, you can exchange 1 <REED> for 2 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.D172_PutcherMaker.name: Putcher Maker
messages.occupations.D173_TownClerk.description: Each time a major improvement is built, place 1 <FOOD> on this card. Once this game, you can turn this card face down to get the <FOOD> on it.
messages.occupations.D173_TownClerk.name: Town Clerk
messages.occupations.D174_LoessGardener.descripti: Each time you use the __Clay Pit__ accumulation space, you can also buy 1 <VEGETABLE> for 1 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.D174_LoessGardener.name: Loess Gardener
messages.occupations.D175_Countryman.description: Each time any player (including you) takes a __Renovation__ action on an action space, you can sow crops in exactly 1 <FIELD>.
messages.occupations.D175_Countryman.name: Countryman
messages.occupations.D176_Woodshacker.description: In the work phase of each round, the first and the second time you use a <WOOD> accumulation space, you also get 1 and 2 <CLAY> respectively.
messages.occupations.D176_Woodshacker.name: Woodshacker
messages.occupations.D177_Graduate.description: When you play this card you immediately pay 1 <FOOD>. If you do, you get 2 <STONE> and 2 <REED>.
messages.occupations.D177_Graduate.name: Graduate
messages.occupations.D178_SubstituteTeacher.descr: Each time all three __Lessons__ action spaces are occupied, you can use this card with a person to get your choice of 1 building resource or 1 crop of each type.
messages.occupations.D178_SubstituteTeacher.name: Substitute Teacher
messages.occupations.D179_Bullcatcher.description: When both action spaces on round spaces 3 and 6 are occupied, you can use this card with a person to get 1 <CATTLE> and 2 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.D179_Bullcatcher.name: Bullcatcher
messages.occupations.D180_PartTimeWorker.descript: Each time you use an accumulation space with exactly 2/4/6 goods on it, you can leave 1/2/3 goods on the space. If you do, you get 1 <SHEEP>/<PIG>/<CATTLE>.
messages.occupations.D180_PartTimeWorker.name: Part-Time Worker
messages.occupations.E085_MasterTanner.descriptio: For each <PIG> or <CATTLE> you turn into <FOOD>, you can place 1 of that <FOOD> on this card. While its <FOOD> equals your number of rooms, this card provides room for 1 person.
messages.occupations.E085_MasterTanner.name: Master Tanner
messages.occupations.E086_PenBuilder.description: At any time, you can discard 1 <WOOD> from your supply. This card can hold two animals of any type for each <WOOD> discarded this way.
messages.occupations.E086_PenBuilder.name: Pen Builder
messages.occupations.E087_MasterRenovator.descrip: At the end of the work phases of rounds 7 and 9, you can take a __Renovation__ action without placing a person and pay 1 building resource of your choice less.
messages.occupations.E087_MasterRenovator.name: Master Renovator
messages.occupations.E088_MasterFencer.descriptio: Once you live in a stone house, at the start of each round, you can pay 2 or 3 <WOOD> to build up to 3 or 4 <FENCE>, respectively.
messages.occupations.E088_MasterFencer.name: Master Fencer
messages.occupations.E089_Stallwright.description: After you play your 2nd, 3rd, 5th, and 7th occupation (including this one), you can build 1 <STABLE> at no cost.
messages.occupations.E089_Stallwright.name: Stallwright
messages.occupations.E090_DungCollector.descripti: Each time you get 2 or more newborn animals, you can pay 1 <FOOD> to plow 1 field.
messages.occupations.E090_DungCollector.name: Dung Collector
messages.occupations.E091_PlowBuilder.description: You can build the Joinery when taking a __Minor Improvement__ action. If you use the Joinery (or an upgrade thereof) during the harvest, you can pay 1 <FOOD> to plow 1 field.
messages.occupations.E091_PlowBuilder.name: Plow Builder
messages.occupations.E092_FieldDoctor.description: Once this game, if you live in a house with exactly 2 rooms surrounded by 4 field tiles, you can use any __Wish for Children__ action space even without room.
messages.occupations.E092_FieldDoctor.name: Field Doctor
messages.occupations.E093_Motivator.description: On your first turn each round, if you have no unused farmyard spaces, you can place a person from your supply.
messages.occupations.E093_Motivator.name: Motivator
messages.occupations.E094_Prophet.description: When you play this card, immediately take a __Renovation__ action. Afterward, you can take a __Build Fences__ action. (Both actions require their usual cost.)
messages.occupations.E094_Prophet.name: Prophet
messages.occupations.E095_Miller.description: You can immediately build a <BAKE>-improvement by paying its cost. Each time another player uses the __Grain Seeds__ action space, you can take a __Bake Bread__ action.
messages.occupations.E095_Miller.name: Miller
messages.occupations.E096_Elder.description: You can play this card at the start of the work phase of round 1 without placing a person. (This card has no effect other than counting as a played occupation.)
messages.occupations.E096_Elder.name: Elder
messages.occupations.E097_Beneficiary.description: If this is your 3rd occupation, you can immediately play another occupation for an occupation cost of 1 <FOOD> and/or play 1 minor improvement by paying its cost.
messages.occupations.E097_Beneficiary.name: Beneficiary
messages.occupations.E098_Prodigy.description: If this is your 1st occupation, you immediately get 1 <SCORE> for each improvement you have. (This will not apply to improvements played after this card.)
messages.occupations.E098_Prodigy.name: Prodigy
messages.occupations.E099_UncaringParents.descrip: At the end of each harvest, if you live in a stone house, you get 1 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.occupations.E099_UncaringParents.name: Uncaring Parents
messages.occupations.E100_MuseumCaretaker.descrip: At the start of each work phase, if you have at least 1 <WOOD>, 1 <CLAY>, 1 <REED>, 1 <STONE>, 1 <GRAIN>, and 1 <VEGETABLE> in your supply, you get 1 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.occupations.E100_MuseumCaretaker.name: Museum Caretaker
messages.occupations.E101_Blighter.description: When you play this card, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> for each complete stage left to play. You may not play any more occupations.
messages.occupations.E101_Blighter.name: Blighter
messages.occupations.E102_Acquirer.description: At the start of each round, you can pay <FOOD> equal to the number of people you have to buy 1 good of your choice from the general supply.
messages.occupations.E102_Acquirer.name: Acquirer
messages.occupations.E103_Wolf.description: Pile (from bottom to top) 1 <CLAY>, 1 <WOOD>, and 1 <GRAIN> on this card. Each time you get a good matching the top item, you can move that item to your supply and get 1 <PIG>.
messages.occupations.E103_Wolf.name: Wolf
messages.occupations.E104_SpiceTrader.description: If you play this card in round 4 or before, place 3 <VEGETABLE> on the space for round 11. At the start of that round, you get the <VEGETABLE>.
messages.occupations.E104_SpiceTrader.name: Spice Trader
messages.occupations.E105_Pioneer.description: When you play this card and each time before you use the most recent action space card, you get 1 building resource of your choice and 1 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.E105_Pioneer.name: Pioneer
messages.occupations.E106_EmergencySeller.descrip:
When you play this card, you can immediately turn as many building resources into <FOOD> as you have people:
<WOOD>/<CLAY> <ARROW> 2 <FOOD>
<REED>/<STONE> <ARROW> 3 <FOOD>
messages.occupations.E106_EmergencySeller.name: Emergency Seller
messages.occupations.E107_LandSurveyor.descriptio: In the field phase of each harvest, if you have at least 2/4/6/7 <FIELD>, you get 1/2/3/4 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.E107_LandSurveyor.name: Land Surveyor
messages.occupations.E108_BlackberryFarmer.descri: Each time you build <FENCE>, place 1 <FOOD> on each remaining round space, up to the number of <FENCE> just built. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.E108_BlackberryFarmer.name: Blackberry Farmer
messages.occupations.E109_BraidMaker.description: Each harvest, you can use this card to exchange 1 <REED> for 2 <FOOD>. You can build the  __Basketmaker\\
messages.occupations.E109_BraidMaker.name: Braid Maker
messages.occupations.E110_Dentist.description: At the start of each harvest, you can place 1 <WOOD> from your supply on this card, irretrievably. In each feeding phase, you get 1 <FOOD> for each <WOOD> on this card.
messages.occupations.E110_Dentist.name: Dentist
messages.occupations.E111_Recluse.description: As long as you have no minor improvements in front of you, you get 1 <FOOD> at the start of each round and 1 <WOOD> at the start of each harvest.
messages.occupations.E111_Recluse.name: Recluse
messages.occupations.E112_GrainThief.description: Each time you would harvest a grain field, you can leave the grain on the field and take 1 <GRAIN> from the general supply instead.
messages.occupations.E112_GrainThief.name: Grain Thief
messages.occupations.E113_Godmother.description: Each time you take a __Family Growth__ action, you also get 1 <VEGETABLE>.
messages.occupations.E113_Godmother.name: Godmother
messages.occupations.E114_ShedBuilder.description: When you build your 1st and 2nd <STABLE>, you get 1 <GRAIN>. When you build your 3rd and 4th <STABLE>, you get 1 <VEGETABLE>. (This does not apply to <STABLE> you have already built.)
messages.occupations.E114_ShedBuilder.name: Shed Builder
messages.occupations.E115_SeedServant.description: Each time after you use the __Grain Seeds__ action space, you can take a __Bake Bread__ action. Each time after you use the __Vegetable Seeds__ action space, you can take a __Sow__ action.
messages.occupations.E115_SeedServant.name: Seed Servant
messages.occupations.E116_FirCutter.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <FOOD>. Each time after you use an animal accumulation space with your 1st/2nd/3rd/4th/5th person, you get 1/1/2/2/3 <WOOD>.
messages.occupations.E116_FirCutter.name: Fir Cutter
messages.occupations.E117_PipeSmoker.description: At the start of each harvest, if you have at least 1 <GRAIN> <FIELD>, you get 2 <WOOD>.
messages.occupations.E117_PipeSmoker.name: Pipe Smoker
messages.occupations.E118_KindlingGatherer.descri: Each time you get <FOOD> from an action space, you get 1 additional <WOOD>.
messages.occupations.E118_KindlingGatherer.name: Kindling Gatherer
