messages.occupations.E119_LandHeir.description: If you play this card in round 4 or before, place 4 <WOOD> and 4 <CLAY> on the space for round 9. At the start of this round, you get the resources.
messages.occupations.E119_LandHeir.name: Land Heir
messages.occupations.E120_ScrapCollector.descript: Alternate placing 1 <WOOD> and 1 <CLAY> on each of the next 6 round spaces, starting with <WOOD>. At the start of these rounds, you get the respective resource.
messages.occupations.E120_ScrapCollector.name: Scrap Collector
messages.occupations.E121_HillCultivator.descript: Each time you use the __Grain Seeds__ or __Vegetable Seeds__ action space, you also get 2 or 3 <CLAY>, respectively.
messages.occupations.E121_HillCultivator.name: Hill Cultivator
messages.occupations.E122_Cottar.description: Each time you play or build an improvement, you get your choice of 1 <WOOD> or 1 <CLAY> immediately after paying its cost.
messages.occupations.E122_Cottar.name: Cottar
messages.occupations.E123_ResourceHoarder.descrip: Pile resources as depicted on this card. You can use the top item(s) when building a room, playing/building an improvement, or renovating. (From bottom to top: <STONE>, <CLAY>, <STONE>, <REED>, <WOOD>, <CLAY>)
messages.occupations.E123_ResourceHoarder.name: Resource Hoarder
messages.occupations.E124_MayorCandidate.descript: You immediately get 2 <WOOD> and 2 <STONE>. During scoring, you get 1 negative point for each <WOOD> and each <STONE> in your supply. You can no longer discard <WOOD> or <STONE>.
messages.occupations.E124_MayorCandidate.name: Mayor Candidate
messages.occupations.E125_DelayedWayfarer.descrip: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 building resource of your choice and, once all people have been placed this round, you can place a person from your supply.
messages.occupations.E125_DelayedWayfarer.name: Delayed Wayfarer
messages.occupations.E126_TaxCollector.descriptio: Once you live in a stone house, at the start of each round, you get your choice of 2 <WOOD>, 2 <CLAY>, 1 <REED>, or 1 <STONE>.
messages.occupations.E126_TaxCollector.name: Tax Collector
messages.occupations.E127_DiligentFarmer.descript: When you play this card, if you would score the maximum 4 points in 3 scoring categories (including fenced <STABLE>), you can extend your house by 1 room at no cost.
messages.occupations.E127_DiligentFarmer.name: Diligent Farmer
messages.occupations.E128_Saddler.description: Each time after you build a major improvement, you can pay 1 <FOOD> to plow 1 <FIELD>.
messages.occupations.E128_Saddler.name: Saddler
messages.occupations.E129_Imitator.description: If you have a person on the __Day Laborer__ action space, you can use non-accumulating round 1-9 action spaces even if they are occupied.
messages.occupations.E129_Imitator.name: Imitator
messages.occupations.E130_Overachiever.descriptio: Each time you use a __Wish for Children__ action space, you can play 1 additional improvement by paying its cost minus 1 resource of your choice.
messages.occupations.E130_Overachiever.name: Overachiever
messages.occupations.E131_MarketMaster.descriptio: Immediately after each time you place your last person in a round on the __Traveling Players__ accumulation space, you can play 1 occupation for an occupation cost of 1 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.E131_MarketMaster.name: Market Master
messages.occupations.E132_VeggieLover.name: Veggie Lover
messages.occupations.E133_ChampionBreeder.descrip: Each time you place 2 or 3+ newborn animals on your farm during the breeding phase of the harvest, you get 1 or 2 bonus <SCORE>, respectively.
messages.occupations.E133_ChampionBreeder.name: Champion Breeder
messages.occupations.E134_Omnifarmer.description: Each harvest, you can place 1 harvested crop or 1 newborn animal on this card, irretrievably. Once this game, if there are 2/3/4/5 different goods on this, you get 3/5/7/9 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.occupations.E134_Omnifarmer.name: Omnifarmer
messages.occupations.E135_Pickler.description: If there are still 1/3/6/9 complete rounds left to play, you immediately get 1/2/3/4 <WOOD>. During scoring, each player with the most total <VEGETABLE> gets 3 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.occupations.E135_Pickler.name: Pickler
messages.occupations.E136_AnimalHusbandryWorker.d: If there are still 3/6/9 complete rounds left to play, you immediately get 2/3/4 <WOOD> and a __Build Fences__ action. During scoring, each player with the most pastures gets 2 <SCORE>.
messages.occupations.E137_FlaxFarmer.description: Each time you use the __Reed Bank__ accumulation space, you also get 1 <GRAIN>. Each time you use the __Grain Seeds__ action space, you also get 1 <REED>.
messages.occupations.E137_FlaxFarmer.name: Flax Farmer
messages.occupations.E138_LivestockExpert.descrip: If you play this card in round 11 or before, choose an animal type: you immediately get a number of animals of that type equal to the number you already have on your farm.
messages.occupations.E138_LivestockExpert.name: Livestock Expert
messages.occupations.E139_BunnyBreeder.descriptio: Select a future round space, subtract the number of the current round from it, and place this many <FOOD> on that space. At the start of that round, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.E139_BunnyBreeder.name: Bunny Breeder
messages.occupations.E140_Carter.description: Next round, each time you use a building resource accumulation space, you also get 1 <FOOD> for each building resource that you take from the space.
messages.occupations.E140_Carter.name: Carter
messages.occupations.E141_VegetableVendor.descrip: Each time you use the __Major Improvement__ or __Vegetable Seeds__ action space, you also get 1 <VEGETABLE> or a __Major or Minor Improvement__ action, respectively.
messages.occupations.E141_VegetableVendor.name: Vegetable Vendor
messages.occupations.E142_Smuggler.description:
In the feeding phase of each harvest, you can exchange up to 2 goods as follows:
[<WOOD> <ARROW> <GRAIN>]
or
[<GRAIN> <ARROW> <STONE>]
messages.occupations.E142_Smuggler.name: Smuggler
messages.occupations.E143_Hewer.description: From round 3 on, at the end of each work phase in which all <CLAY> accumulation spaces are unoccupied, you get 1 <STONE> and 1 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.E143_Hewer.name: Hewer
messages.occupations.E144_WaresSalesman.descripti: Each time any player (including you) plays or builds a card that lets them turn building resources into <FOOD>, you get exactly 1 corresponding building resource and 1 <REED>.
messages.occupations.E144_WaresSalesman.name: Wares Salesman
messages.occupations.E145_Parvenu.description: If you play this card in round 7 or before, choose <CLAY> or <REED>: you immediately get a number of that building resource equal to the number you already have in your supply.
messages.occupations.E145_Parvenu.name: Parvenu
messages.occupations.E146_Reseller.description: Once this game, immediately after playing or building an improvement, you can choose to get its printed cost from the general supply.
messages.occupations.E146_Reseller.name: Reseller
messages.occupations.E147_AnimalDriver.descriptio: At the start of each harvest, if you have 1/2/3+ fenced <STABLE>, you get 1 <SHEEP>/<PIG>/<CATTLE>.
messages.occupations.E147_AnimalDriver.name: Animal Driver
messages.occupations.E148_Lazybones.description: Place (up to) 1 <STABLE> each on __Grain Seeds__, __Farmland__, __Day Laborer__, and __Farm Expansion__. Build the <STABLE> at no cost when another player uses that action space.
messages.occupations.E148_Lazybones.name: Lazybones
messages.occupations.E149_MidnightFencer.descript: At the start of the last harvest, you can take up to 2 of each other player's unbuilt <FENCE> and build them on your farm at no cost. (Your farm can then have over 15 <FENCE>.)
messages.occupations.E149_MidnightFencer.name: Midnight Fencer
messages.occupations.E150_RockBeater.description: You can use an action space providing both <STONE> and a different building resource even if it is occupied by another player. Stone rooms cost you 2 <STONE> less each.
messages.occupations.E150_RockBeater.name: Rock Beater
messages.occupations.E151_DeliveryNurse.descripti: Once this game, if you have all types of animals, you can use any __Wish for Children__ action space even without room.
messages.occupations.E151_DeliveryNurse.name: Delivery Nurse
messages.occupations.E152_BargainHunter.descripti: At the start of each round, you can place 1 <FOOD> from your supply on the __Traveling Players__ accumulation space to play a minor improvement by paying its cost.
messages.occupations.E152_BargainHunter.name: Bargain Hunter
messages.occupations.E153_StoneSculptor.descripti: Each harvest, you can use this card to exchange exactly 1 <STONE> for 1 bonus <SCORE> and 1 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.E153_StoneSculptor.name: Stone Sculptor
messages.occupations.E154_Margrave.description: Once you live in a stone house, you get 2 <FOOD> each time any player renovates and, during scoring, 1 bonus <SCORE> for each wood house and clay house.
messages.occupations.E154_Margrave.name: Margrave
messages.occupations.E155_Visionary.description: If you play this card in round 4 or before, you get 1 <STONE>, 1 <VEGETABLE>, and 2 <PIG>. You cannot grow your family until round 11, unless all other players already have.
messages.occupations.E155_Visionary.name: Visionary
messages.occupations.E156_ClaypitOwner.descriptio: Each time another player plays or builds an improvement with a printed <CLAY> cost, you get 1 <FOOD> and 1 <CLAY>.
messages.occupations.E156_ClaypitOwner.name: Claypit Owner
messages.occupations.E157_Usufructuary.descriptio: When you play this card as your first occupation, you immediately get 1 <FOOD> for every other occupation in play (by any player), up to a maximum of 7 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.E157_Usufructuary.name: Usufructuary
messages.occupations.E158_StoneCustodian.descript: At the end of each work phase, you get 1 <FOOD> for each <STONE> accumulation space with <STONE> on it.
messages.occupations.E158_StoneCustodian.name: Stone Custodian
messages.occupations.E159_OldMiser.description: In the feeding phase of each harvest, each of your people requires 1 less <FOOD>. During scoring, your people are worth 2 points each instead of 3.
messages.occupations.E159_OldMiser.name: Old Miser
messages.occupations.E160_KelpGatherer.descriptio: Each time another player uses the __Fishing__ accumulation space, they get 1 additional <FOOD> and you get 1 <VEGETABLE>.
messages.occupations.E160_KelpGatherer.name: Kelp Gatherer
messages.occupations.E161_ElderBaker.description: This card is an action space for you only. When you use it, you get 3 <GRAIN>. You can build the __Stone Oven__ major improvement even when taking a __Minor Improvement__ action.
messages.occupations.E161_ElderBaker.name: Elder Baker
messages.occupations.E162_Entrepreneur.descriptio: At the start of each round, you can move 1 <FOOD> to this card or discard 1 <FOOD> from it. If you do either, you get 1 building resource of a type you currently do not have.
messages.occupations.E162_Entrepreneur.name: Entrepreneur
messages.occupations.E163_Patroness.description: Each time after you play an occupation after this one, you get 1 building resource of your choice.
messages.occupations.E163_Patroness.name: Patroness
messages.occupations.E164_MountainPlowman.descrip: Each time you plow at least 1 <FIELD>, you get 1 <SHEEP> for each <FIELD> that you just plowed.
messages.occupations.E164_MountainPlowman.name: Mountain Plowman
messages.occupations.E165_MasterHuntsman.descript: When you play this card and each time you build a major improvement, you get 1 <PIG>.
messages.occupations.E165_MasterHuntsman.name: Master Huntsman
messages.occupations.E166_Roastmaster.description: Each time you use the __Traveling Players__ or __Fishing__ accumulation spaces, you can move exactly 1 <FOOD> from that space to the other to get 1 <CATTLE>.
messages.occupations.E166_Roastmaster.name: Roastmaster
messages.occupations.E167_DairyCrier.description: When you play this card, each player (including you) can choose to get 2 <SHEEP> or 2 <FOOD>; you also get 1 <CATTLE>.
messages.occupations.E167_DairyCrier.name: Dairy Crier
At the start of each round, you get 1 <SHEEP>/<PIG>/<CATTLE> for each unoccupied <WOOD>/<CLAY>/stone room in your house.
messages.parentFaces.PR01.text: Place 1 stable from your supply on round space 2. At the start of that round, you can build the stable at no cost.
messages.parentFaces.PR02.text: Place 1 field tile on round space 12. At the start of that round, you can plow the field.
messages.parentFaces.PR03.text: Place 1 cattle on round space 8. At the start of that round, you get the cattle.
messages.parentFaces.PR04.text: Place 1 wild boar on round space 7. At the start of that round, you get the wild boar.
messages.parentFaces.PR05.text: Place 1 sheep on round space 4. At the start of that round, you get the sheep.
messages.parentFaces.PR06.text: Place 1 vegetable on round space 7. At the start of that round, you get the vegetable.
messages.parentFaces.PR07.text: Place 1 grain on round space 4. At the start of that round, you get the grain.
messages.parentFaces.PR08.text: Place 1 stone on round space 3. At the start of that round, you get the stone.
messages.parentFaces.PR09.text: Place 1 reed on round space 5. At the start of that round, you get the reed.
messages.parentFaces.PR10.text: Place 1 wood on round space 1. At the start of that round, you get the wood.
messages.parentFaces.PR11.text: Place 1 food on round space 1. At the start of that round, you get the food.
messages.parentFaces.PR12.text: Place 1 clay on round space 1. At the start of that round, you get the clay.
messages.parentFaces.PS01.rewards.1.reward: If you do, you immediately get 1 stone.
messages.parentFaces.PS01.rewards.2.reward: If you do, you immediately get 2 stone.
messages.parentFaces.PS01.rewards.3.reward: If you do, you immediately get 3 stone.
messages.parentFaces.PS02.rewards.1.reward: If you do, you immediately get 1 building resource of the type that your house is made of.
messages.parentFaces.PS02.rewards.2.reward: If you do, you immediately get 2 building resources of the type that your house is made of.
messages.parentFaces.PS02.rewards.3.reward: If you do, you immediately get 3 building resources of the type that your house is made of.
messages.parentFaces.PS03.rewards.1.reward: If you do, you immediately get 1 minor improvement. To do so, draw three cards of each eligible type and keep one.
messages.parentFaces.PS03.rewards.2.reward: If you do, you immediately get 1 occupation. To do so, draw three cards of each eligible type and keep one.
messages.parentFaces.PS03.rewards.3.reward: If you do, you immediately get both 1 minor improvement and 1 occupation. To do so, draw three cards of each eligible type and keep one.
messages.parentFaces.PS04.rewards.1.reward: If you do, you immediately get 1 different building resource of your choice.
messages.parentFaces.PS04.rewards.2.reward: If you do, you immediately get 2 different building resources of your choice.
messages.parentFaces.PS04.rewards.3.reward: If you do, you immediately get 3 different building resources of your choice.
messages.parentFaces.PS05.rewards.1.reward: If you do, you immediately get 1 wood.
messages.parentFaces.PS05.rewards.2.reward: If you do, you immediately get 2 clay.
messages.parentFaces.PS05.rewards.3.reward: If you do, you immediately get 3 reed.
messages.parentFaces.PS06.rewards.1.requirement: 6 total cards in play, including the parent cards
messages.parentFaces.PS06.rewards.1.reward: If you do, you immediately get 1 food.
messages.parentFaces.PS06.rewards.2.requirement: 8 total cards in play, including the parent cards
messages.parentFaces.PS06.rewards.2.reward: If you do, you immediately get 3 food.
messages.parentFaces.PS06.rewards.3.requirement: 10 total cards in play, including the parent cards
messages.parentFaces.PS06.rewards.3.reward: If you do, you immediately get 5 food.
messages.parentFaces.PS07.rewards.1.reward: If you do, you can immediately sow up to 1 field. (This is considered a single __Sow__ action.)
messages.parentFaces.PS07.rewards.2.reward: If you do, you can immediately sow up to 2 fields. (This is considered a single __Sow__ action.)
messages.parentFaces.PS07.rewards.3.reward: If you do, you can immediately sow up to 3 fields. (This is considered a single __Sow__ action.)
